title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
title_zh: 面向安全机器人操作的搭载障碍物感知约束框架的编码智能体
authors: Bingxin Xu, Yuzhang Shang, Zhen Dong, Emilio Ferrara
abstract: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.
summary_zh: 编码智能体已成为机器人操作领域极具前景的范式：由语言模型将机器人控制器编写为程序，以此方式构建的智能体无需针对机器人进行专项训练即可操控机器人。然而该范式是否具备安全性尚未得到验证。本文在安全约束条件下对编码智能体开展评估，设置的每个任务都包含操作目标与机器人不得触碰的障碍物。结果显示智能体虽会追逐目标，但绝大多数情况下都会与障碍物发生碰撞，仅将任务完成作为唯一目标而完全忽略安全性。智能体在推理轨迹中已经考虑到障碍物，提示词也明确禁止触碰障碍物，因此问题并非出在感知或指令层面，而是规划环节：设定的安全约束从未被列为优先项。本文通过将操作过程分解为路径规划阶段和丰富接触阶段，定位了故障根源：在路径行进过程中，模型无法将安全约束列为优先项，既没有安全通行路径的概念，也无法在选定路径不可行时执行重规划；在接触执行阶段，模型没有意识到接触动作同样受同一安全约束限制。为填补这一缺陷，本文提出SafeHarness（安全约束框架），为模型配备两套障碍物感知约束机制，使其能够将安全约束列为优先项：障碍物感知路径规划将物体映射为边界框，在其上方生成由航点序列组成的候选路径，智能体可提前规划路径、验证路径可行性，必要时执行重规划后再运行；障碍物感知接触执行模块则会选择接触位置，确保接触动作本身避开障碍物。实验结果显示，SafeHarness的任务成功率达71.9%，避碰率达87.5%，相比此前的SOTA（当前最优水平）分别高出6.5%和27.0%，两项指标分别是未搭载约束框架的同类型智能体的2.3倍和1.5倍。

title: Can 4D Foundation Models Remember?
title_zh: 4D基础模型具备记忆能力吗？
authors: Guangzhao He, Hadar Averbuch-Elor, Wei-Chiu Ma
abstract: Perceiving and remembering the visual world is fundamental to navigating and interacting with our environment. Current 4D foundation models, such as camera-controllable video models or 4D reconstruction models, can perceive and reconstruct dynamic environments, but how well they remember what they have perceived remains an open question. Existing benchmarks largely rely on pixel-level metrics and lack ground truth for objects once they leave the field of view, making them unable to evaluate visual memory in an object-centric manner against references. To fill this gap, we introduce PersistBench, a dataset and metric suite that leverages 360{\deg} videos as omniscient ground truth and proposes three evaluation aspects: object permanence, motion continuity, and appearance preservation. Evaluating various models across diverse categories reveals that current models can only maintain short-term consistency that degrades significantly once objects leave the field of view. Our findings highlight the gap between current model capabilities and robust visual memory ("seeing is not remembering"), providing guidance for future development of 4D foundation models. Dataset and code are available on the project page: https://guangzhaohe.com/persistbench.
summary_zh: 感知并记忆视觉世界是智能体导航与环境交互的基础。当前的4D基础模型，例如可控相机视频模型、4D重建模型，已经可以感知并重建动态环境，但这类模型对已感知内容的记忆能力仍有待探究。现有基准大多依赖像素级指标，当物体移出视野后便缺乏对应的真值标注，无法以物体为中心参照基准评估视觉记忆能力。为填补这一空白，本文提出PersistBench（持久记忆基准套件），该数据集与指标套件以360°全视角视频作为全知真值，从物体恒存性、运动连续性、外观保留度三个维度开展评估。对多类不同模型在不同类别任务上的测试结果表明，当前模型仅能维持短期一致性，一旦物体移出视野，一致性就会大幅下降。该研究结果明确了当前模型能力与鲁棒视觉记忆之间的差距（即“看见不等于记住”），为后续4D基础模型的开发提供了指导。数据集与代码可在项目主页获取：https://guangzhaohe.com/persistbench。

title: SplashSplat: Reconstructing Splashing Liquids from Real-World Multi-View Videos
title_zh: SplashSplat：从真实世界多视角视频重建飞溅液体
authors: Peiyu Liu, Dingxi Zhang, Federico Tombari, Marc Pollefeys, Christina Tsalicoglou, Daniel Barath
abstract: A splash lives for a fraction of a second: sheets tear into ligaments and droplets, appearance is view-dependent and nearly textureless, and little persists long enough to track. Reconstruction research has consequently focused on smoke, synthetic liquids, or gently deforming surfaces. To our knowledge, no synchronized multi-view dataset of splashing liquids exists. We therefore introduce a benchmark of 20 real scenes, from coherent streams to violent splashes, captured by seven synchronized, calibrated 4K cameras at 60 fps, with manually refined per-view liquid and container masks and fixed evaluation splits. We further present SplashSplat, built on a single principle: impose physical structure only where the observations can constrain it. Per-frame liquid SDFs fused from the masks provide the geometry, level-set transport between consecutive SDFs yields a coarse velocity field, and Lagrangian carriers advected along this flow, corrected against each new observation and reseeded where coverage is lost, decode local Gaussians for differentiable rendering. SplashSplat outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic Gaussian splatting methods on our real captures and on a synthetic benchmark, with physically more plausible motion and a lower training cost. The same representation supports temporal interpolation and style transfer without re-optimization.
summary_zh: 飞溅液体的存在时间极短：液膜会撕裂为韧带和液滴，外观随视角变化且几乎无纹理特征，几乎没有足够长的持续特征可供追踪，因此现有重建研究大多聚焦于烟雾、合成液体或缓变表面。据本文作者所知，目前尚无公开的同步多视角飞溅液体数据集。为此，本文构建了包含20个真实场景的基准数据集，场景覆盖连贯水流到剧烈飞溅的不同形态，由7台经过同步校准的4K相机以60fps帧率采集，所有视角的液体与容器掩膜均经过人工优化，同时提供固定的评估划分方案。本文进一步提出SplashSplat（飞溅液体重建方法），其核心设计原则为：仅在观测数据可约束的范围内施加物理结构。该方法通过融合掩膜得到的每帧液体SDF（符号距离函数）获取几何信息，通过相邻SDF之间的水平集传输生成粗略速度场，沿该流场平流拉格朗日载体，结合新观测结果校正载体状态并在覆盖缺失区域重新生成载体，最终解码出局部高斯分布以实现可微渲染。在真实采集数据集与合成基准测试中，SplashSplat的表现均优于当前最优的动态高斯溅射方法，生成的运动物理合理性更强，训练成本更低。该表示无需重新优化即可支持时间插值与风格迁移任务。

title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
title_zh: FAMOS：基于稀疏观测的前馈3D关节建模
authors: Kevin Qu, Tao Sun, Massimiliano Viola, Liyuan Zhu, Zhizhuo Zhou, Sayan Deb Sarkar, Konrad Schindler, Iro Armeni
abstract: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence. Most feed-forward methods infer articulation from a single observation and therefore rely heavily on learned category-level shape priors. We present FAMOS, a feed-forward model that predicts movable-part segmentation and joint parameters from a sparse, unordered set of partial point clouds. Our model jointly reasons over multiple observations and naturally supports a variable number of inputs, including a single view. To aggregate articulation cues across observations, we introduce a Multi-state Articulation Transformer with alternating state-wise and global attention. We further propose an observed articulation span objective that supervises the motion range each part exhibits across the input observations, encouraging the model to leverage the full observation set. To overcome the limited scale and diversity of existing datasets, we introduce a procedural data generator that synthesizes self-annotated assets during training. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility, ACD, and ArtiCraft-10K demonstrate consistent improvements over both feed-forward and optimization-based baselines. Project page: https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos
summary_zh: 从稀疏单目视图中对关节物体建模极具挑战性，因为单帧观测仅能提供部分几何与运动证据。大多数前馈方法仅基于单帧观测推断关节结构，因此高度依赖学习得到的类别级形状先验。本文提出FAMOS（前馈3D关节建模模型），可从稀疏无序的部分点云集合中预测可移动部件分割结果与关节参数。该模型可同时对多帧观测进行联合推理，自然支持可变数量的输入，包括单视图输入。为聚合跨观测的关节线索，本文引入多状态关节Transformer，交替执行状态级注意力与全局注意力。本文进一步提出观测关节跨度目标函数，用于监督各部件在输入观测中呈现的运动范围，引导模型充分利用全部观测集。为解决现有数据集规模有限、多样性不足的问题，本文引入程序化数据生成器，可在训练过程中合成自带标注的资产。在PartNet-Mobility、ACD、ArtiCraft-10K三个数据集上开展的实验表明，该方法相比前馈类基线方法和基于优化的基线方法均取得了一致的性能提升。项目主页：https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos。

title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
title_zh: Paint-Anything：面向图像生成与编辑的统一任意颜色控制方法
authors: Ji Xie, Dewei Zhou, Xinyu Huang, Zhennan Chen, Xun Wang
abstract: Professional design requires any-color control: the ability to specify an object's target color with any 24-bit hex value for image generation and editing. Prior work has explored color generation, editing, and colorization, but often relies on dedicated color representations or specialized inference procedures. Advances in large language models offer a simpler starting point: even compact models can associate hex values with color semantics. We present Paint-Anything, which learns a shared hex-prompt interface for generation and editing through object-level color supervision. We develop a data pipeline that constructs Paint-500K from real images through object grounding, perceptual color labeling, and editing-pair synthesis. Since shadows make real-image labels only approximate colors, we complement this supervision with pure-color anchors whose pixels exactly match their paired hex values. These anchors are used only at high-noise timesteps, leaving low-noise training to natural images. We further introduce Any Color Benchmark (ACBench), comprising ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit, to measure object-level hex color fidelity across both tasks. On FLUX.2-4B, Paint-Anything improves ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit scores by 85.3% and 28.3%, respectively, relative to the base model, with ablations supporting the training recipe. It also achieves the highest average CompColor score among the compared methods.
summary_zh: 专业设计需要任意颜色控制能力：即在图像生成与编辑过程中，可通过任意24位十六进制值指定物体的目标颜色。现有研究已对颜色生成、编辑与上色任务开展探索，但大多依赖专用颜色表示或特殊推理流程。大语言模型的发展提供了更简洁的实现路径：即使是轻量模型也可以将十六进制值与颜色语义关联起来。本文提出Paint-Anything方法，通过物体级颜色监督学习得到面向生成与编辑任务的共享十六进制提示接口。本文搭建的数据流水线从真实图像中构建了Paint-500K数据集，依次完成物体定位、感知颜色标注与编辑对合成。由于阴影会导致真实图像的颜色标注存在近似误差，本文补充了纯色锚点样本，其像素值与配对的十六进制值完全匹配。这类锚点样本仅在高噪声训练步使用，低噪声训练步仍使用自然图像。本文进一步提出ACBench（任意颜色基准套件），包含ACBench-T2I和ACBench-Edit两个子集，用于在两项任务中衡量物体级十六进制颜色保真度。在FLUX.2-4B模型上，相比基础模型，Paint-Anything可将ACBench-T2I与ACBench-Edit的得分分别提升85.3%和28.3%，消融实验验证了训练方案的有效性，同时该方法在所有对比方法中取得了最高的平均CompColor得分。

title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
title_zh: ERCPMP-Gx：用于结直肠息肉病形态学、组织病理学和基因组表征的内窥镜图像与视频数据集
authors: Zahra Ghaffari, Massih Bahar, Mojgan Forootan, Ali Darvishi, Hamidreza Bolhasani
abstract: Hereditary polyposis syndromes can be precursor lesions to colorectal cancer and are associated with a broad spectrum of extracolonic tumors. Early identification and accurate classification of these syndromes are essential for timely diagnosis, individualized patient management, and targeted surveillance strategies for affected families. However, public endoscopic datasets are largely organized around the individual sporadic polyp, and none links the polyposis phenotype to histopathology and germline findings at the patient level. Here, we present ERCPMP-Gx, an endoscopic, histopathological, and genomic dataset developed to support the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in the recognition, characterization, and classification of colorectal polyposis. Most procedures were performed using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE), narrow-band imaging (NBI), magnifying NBI (M-NBI), and NBI with near focus modes, yielding 160 images and accompanying video clips. Approximately eighty percent of cases represent clinically and/or genetically confirmed hereditary polyposis syndromes (PG), including familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS), juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), and ganglioneuroma syndrome (GNS), while the remaining twenty percent comprise non-hereditary polyps and polyp-mimicking lesions with overlapping morphological features (Non-PG), included to support differential classification. Each released record is linked, where available, to standardized endoscopic annotations, representative histopathology, and clinically reported germline findings, forming an AI-ready, patient-level annotation framework. The dataset is publicly accessible at Mendeley (https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2). For the latest updates and further information, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com.
summary_zh: 遗传性息肉病综合征是结直肠癌的癌前病变，还与广泛的肠外肿瘤相关。早期识别并准确分类这类综合征，对及时诊断、个性化患者管理、受累家庭的定向监测策略至关重要。但现有公开内窥镜数据集大多围绕单个散发性息肉构建，没有数据集在患者层面将息肉病表型与组织病理学、生殖系突变结果关联起来。本文发布ERCPMP-Gx数据集，这是一套整合内窥镜、组织病理学与基因组信息的数据集，用于支持人工智能在结直肠息肉病识别、表征与分类任务中的应用。绝大多数数据使用Olympus EVIS X1系统采集，覆盖白光内镜（WLE）、窄带成像（NBI）、放大窄带成像（M-NBI）、近聚焦窄带成像四种模式，共包含160张图像及配套视频片段。其中约80%的病例为临床或基因确诊的遗传性息肉病综合征（PG），包括家族性腺瘤性息肉病（FAP）、Peutz-Jeghers综合征（PJS）、幼年性息肉病综合征（JPS）、神经节瘤综合征（GNS）；剩余20%的病例为非遗传性息肉及形态特征重叠的类息肉病变（Non-PG），用于支持鉴别分类。所有公开记录在可获取的前提下均关联了标准化内窥镜标注、代表性组织病理学结果与临床报告的生殖系突变结果，形成了面向人工智能应用的患者级标注框架。该数据集可在Mendeley平台公开获取：https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2，最新更新与更多信息可访问DataBioX网站：https://databiox.com。

title: FlowSGS: Improving Flow Matching Priors for Inverse Imaging with Stochastic Interpolants
title_zh: FlowSGS：基于随机插值子改进逆成像的流匹配先验
authors: Tianao Li, Xinhui Qian, Emma Alexander
abstract: Flow matching has emerged as the state-of-the-art generative model and has been used for plug-and-play (PnP) priors to solve inverse problems in computational imaging. However, existing flow-based inverse solvers assume linear forward models and/or make simplifying approximations in posterior sampling. To circumvent these problems, we introduce FlowSGS, a flow-based posterior sampling method using Split Gibbs Sampling (SGS) to decompose the posterior into a likelihood step and a prior step. Specifically, we sample from the likelihood step using Langevin dynamics and leverage the Stochastic Interpolants (SI) framework to integrate a pretrained flow model into the prior step. We provide a form for the prior step that uses SI's reverse-time SDE, and show connections to previous PnP methods. Moreover, with the aid of the flow prior's straight probability paths and a novel timestep correction technique for the reverse-time SDE, FlowSGS requires fewer network evaluations in its prior step than plug-and-play diffusion samplers. Our experiments show state-of-the-art performance on a range of inverse problems. For the first time, we provide an experiment on a nonlinear inverse problem (Fourier phase retrieval) for flow-based inverse solvers.
summary_zh: 流匹配是当前性能最优的生成模型，已被用作即插即用（PnP）先验求解计算成像中的逆问题。但现有基于流的逆求解器假设前向模型为线性，且在后验采样过程中引入了简化近似。为解决上述问题，本文提出FlowSGS，这是一种基于流的后验采样方法，采用SGS（拆分吉布斯采样）将后验分布分解为似然步与先验步。具体而言，该方法使用朗之万动力学完成似然步采样，利用SI（随机插值子）框架将预训练流模型整合到先验步中。本文给出了基于SI逆时随机微分方程的先验步形式，并阐明了其与现有PnP方法的关联。此外，借助流先验的直概率路径与本文提出的新型逆时随机微分方程时间步校正技术，FlowSGS在先验步中所需的网络评估次数少于即插即用扩散采样器。大量逆问题上的实验结果表明该方法达到了当前最优性能，本文首次针对非线性逆问题（傅里叶相位恢复）开展了基于流的逆求解器实验。

title: OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher
title_zh: OPTED：无需渲染的教师模型驱动的端到端驾驶在线策略微调
authors: Damiano Da Col, Maximilian Igl, Peter Karkus, Kashyap Chitta, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone, Konrad Schindler, Christos Sakaridis
abstract: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/
summary_zh: 随着预训练数据规模扩大带来的收益逐渐递减，训练后优化在自动驾驶等物理人工智能领域的重要性不断提升。端到端驾驶策略通常在开环条件下通过行为克隆在人类演示数据上完成预训练，但闭环部署过程中的累积误差会导致车辆脱离训练数据分布，提升安全事故风险。闭环训练后优化可缓解该风险，但针对基于传感器的策略需要成本高昂的仿真环境支持。本文提出OPTED（端到端驾驶在线策略微调框架），将强化学习与端到端策略的训练后优化解耦：首先使用向量化输入（高精度地图与边界框）训练特权教师模型，再由该教师模型在闭环训练后优化阶段为预训练学生模型提供监督信号。本文将OPTED应用于TransFuser和VaVAM两个基于相机的模型，在AlpaSim仿真环境中使用真实驾驶日志的3DGS（3D高斯溅射）神经重建结果完成微调，两个模型的驾驶得分分别提升至原来的1.6倍和9.5倍。对照实验表明，相比直接使用强化学习进行训练后优化，OPTED仅需不到千分之一的仿真交互次数即可达到同等闭环性能，同时策略更贴近人类先验。项目主页：https://01dami23.github.io/opted/。

title: Should This Case Be Adapted? Prediction Fragmentation Controls Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: 该病例是否应当适配？预测碎片化对测试时自适应的调控作用
authors: Lili Wang, Jing Li, Xiaowen Sun, Xiangyu Hu, Zhuangzhuang Gu, Jian Liu, Srihari Nelakuditi, Yan Tong
abstract: Episodic test-time adaptation resets a frozen segmenter to source weights $M_0$ on each case and adapts for a fixed step count. A fixed horizon conflates a cohort-level question, how far to adapt, with an irreducibly per-case one, whether this case should be adapted at all. Cohort means hide that decision: on cross-vendor cardiac MRI the mean $\Delta$Dice from adaptation is statistically indistinguishable from zero while 58.7% of cases are individually made worse. We quantify this harm as harmful accepted area (HA), the harmful fraction of the edited area a controller deploys. Held-out tuning gives a stronger baseline than a fixed horizon, but the budget it selects transfers on neither of the two main medical benchmarks, and no global budget can condition on the case. We show that prediction fragmentation---the disagreement geometry between $M_0$ and the adapted mask $M_k$---predicts HA with no labels or extra backward passes at decision time, comparably on three benchmarks (Spearman $\rho$ 0.50--0.60), at a quarter of gradient-norm's latency. A case-level router built on it cuts HA from 0.228 to 0.139 on a benchmark that took no part in its design, with the design frozen and only cut-points recalibrated there. On the cardiac benchmark the design was selected on, the router cuts HA from 0.129 to 0.013 at matched Dice and 1.10 deployed updates, against the retrospective-best budget found post hoc on evaluation labels, and reduces that 58.7% to 20.0%, an upper bound we quantify. Where the retained cases are not net-helped (as on prostate), the router still cuts HA but concedes accuracy, a boundary we report. Thresholds are fit once on a labeled split disjoint from evaluation; decisions use no labels or gradients. The template ports across architecture and domain (nnU-Net$\to$SegFormer, Cityscapes$\to$ACDC) with coordinate, thresholds and per-bucket actions instantiated per domain.
summary_zh: episodic测试时自适应会在每个病例上将冻结的分割器重置为源域权重M0，再执行固定步数的自适应。固定自适应步数的设置将队列层面的全局问题（应当自适应多少步）与完全病例相关的个体问题（该病例是否应当执行自适应）混淆了。队列层面的平均指标掩盖了决策偏差：在跨厂商心脏MRI数据集上，自适应带来的平均Dice系数增量在统计上与零无显著差异，但有58.7%的病例经过自适应后性能反而下降。本文将该负面影响量化为HA（有害接受面积），即控制器执行的编辑区域中产生负面影响的占比。在留出集上调优得到的基线方法性能优于固定步数方案，但该方法选择的全局预算无法在两个主流医学基准上泛化，不存在可针对不同病例动态调整的全局预算。本文研究发现，预测碎片化——即源域模型M0与自适应后掩膜Mk之间的不一致几何特征——可在决策阶段无需标注、无需额外反向传播即可预测HA，在三个基准上的Spearman相关系数ρ可达0.50~0.60，推理延迟仅为梯度范数方法的四分之一。基于该特征构建的病例级路由模型，在完全未参与设计的独立基准上可将HA从0.228降至0.139，该过程中模型设计完全冻结，仅在目标基准上重新校准截断点。在用于模型设计的心脏基准上，该路由模型在Dice系数相当、平均更新次数仅为1.10的条件下，相比事后在评估标签上得到的回溯最优预算方案，可将HA从0.129降至0.013，将性能下降病例的占比从58.7%降至20.0%，该值为本文量化得到的性能下降占比理论上界。在自适应无法带来整体性能提升的场景（如前列腺分割任务）中，该路由模型仍可降低HA，但会损失部分精度，本文报告了该性能边界。所有阈值仅在与评估集无交集的标注划分上拟合一次，决策过程无需任何标注或梯度。该框架可跨架构和领域迁移（从nnU-Net迁移到SegFormer，从Cityscapes迁移到ACDC），仅需为不同领域实例化坐标、阈值与分桶操作即可。

title: Towards Scaling Marine Perception with Synthetic Data
title_zh: 基于合成数据拓展海洋感知规模的研究
authors: Haoyu Ma, Onur Bagoren, Anja Sheppard, Elias Fandi, Ashrith Edukulla, Tanner Aslan, Natasha Sieh, Jingyu Song, Katherine A. Skinner
abstract: Scalable machine learning in challenging underwater environments is strongly limited by the lack of labeled real-world training data. This data is often expensive and laborious to gather, making large-scale real-world data challenging to gather and curate. However, simulated data can help close the gap, enabling many learning-based tasks for underwater perception. In this work, we extend OceanSim, an IsaacSim-based underwater perception simulator, with a Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) pipeline for training models to be used in underwater scenarios. The proposed pipeline enables users to generate large, automatically labeled, photorealistic datasets with configurable scene appearance, structure, and sensor settings. We evaluate the pipeline on a real-world sea urchin detection task and study how different forms of synthetic scene variation affect sim-to-real performance. Based on these experiments, we discuss findings on our results, main limitations of the current pipeline and identify future directions for improving underwater rendering fidelity, scene diversity, and the evaluation of sim-to-real generalization. The open-source code can be found at https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim.
summary_zh: 水下环境缺乏标注真实训练数据，严重限制了机器学习方法在该场景下的规模化应用。这类数据的采集成本高、工作量大，很难大规模收集与整理。而仿真合成数据可填补该缺口，支撑水下感知领域的各类学习任务。本研究在OceanSim（基于IsaacSim的水下感知模拟器）的基础上扩展了SDG（合成数据生成）流水线，用于训练水下场景部署的模型。该流水线支持用户生成大规模自动标注的照片级真实感数据集，可灵活配置场景外观、结构与传感器参数。本文在真实海胆检测任务上对该流水线开展评估，研究不同类型的合成场景变化对 sim-to-real（仿真到真实域泛化）性能的影响。基于实验结果，本文讨论了研究发现、当前流水线的主要局限性，并明确了后续改进水下渲染保真度、场景多样性、仿真到真实泛化评估的未来方向。开源代码可访问：https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim。

title: FunArt: Decoding Functional Structure and Articulation from Generative 3D Latents
title_zh: FunArt：从生成式3D隐空间解码功能结构与关节运动关系
authors: Dennis Rotondi, Abdelrhman Werby, Kai O. Arras
abstract: To operate effectively in human environments, robots must identify articulated objects, segment their movable and interactive parts, and estimate their kinematic models. Existing articulated scene representations typically recover kinematics from observed interactions, while methods operating on static scans often decouple articulation from functional interactive elements. We present FunArt, a framework that constructs articulation-aware functional 3D scene graphs from posed RGB-D observations captured in a single static configuration. FunArt reconstructs object instances, converts their fused geometry directly into the O-Voxel representation of TRELLIS.2, and exploits its frozen, sparse-compression VAE as a structural prior. A lightweight query-based decoder combines compact object-level latents with dense, surface-aligned features to jointly segment movable parts and functional interactive elements while estimating motion type, axis, origin, and range. On the Articulate3D dataset, FunArt achieves state-of-the-art performance across movable-part segmentation, articulation estimation, and functional-element segmentation, both with and without ground-truth object input. In the end-to-end setting, it outperforms the strongest baselines by 1.5 AP_{50} points for movable parts, 2.8 AP_{50} points under joint origin-and-axis constraints, and 6.7 AP_{50} points for functional elements. These results demonstrate that generative 3D latents encode actionable structural cues that can initialize robotic perception and planning before physical interaction.
summary_zh: 为了在人类环境中高效运行，机器人必须识别关节类物体，分割其可移动交互部件，并估计其运动学模型。现有关节场景表示方法通常从观测到的交互行为中恢复运动学信息，而针对静态扫描数据的处理方法往往会将关节运动关系与功能交互元素解耦。本文提出FunArt框架，可从单静态配置下采集的带位姿RGB-D观测数据中构建具备关节感知能力的功能3D场景图。FunArt重建物体实例，将融合后的几何结构直接转换为TRELLIS.2的O-Voxel（体素表示），并利用其冻结的稀疏压缩VAE（变分自编码器）作为结构先验。轻量级的基于查询的解码器将紧凑的物体级隐变量与对齐表面的密集特征相结合，在估计运动类型、轴、原点和范围的同时，联合分割可移动部件与功能交互元素。在Articulate3D数据集上，无论是否输入真值物体标注，FunArt在可移动部件分割、关节运动估计和功能元素分割任务上均达到当前最优性能。在端到端设置下，其可移动部件分割性能比最优基线高出1.5个AP₅₀点，关节原点与轴联合约束下的估计性能高出2.8个AP₅₀点，功能元素分割性能高出6.7个AP₅₀点。上述结果表明，生成式3D隐空间编码了可操作的结构线索，能够让机器人在物理交互前完成感知与规划的初始化。

title: Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies
title_zh: 面向3D扩散策略的无显式轨迹前瞻学习方法
authors: Zhongbo Zhang, Zaibin Zhang, Yifan Wang, Changbo Yan, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu
abstract: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.
summary_zh: 3D扩散策略擅长基于当前观测生成具备几何合理性的动作，但成功的操作任务不仅需要判断当前可行的运动，还需要预判交互行为的后续走向。现有策略大多将这种前瞻能力留给动作学习过程隐式涌现。本文提出Movement Trend Guidance（运动趋势引导），一种无需引入显式规划即可为模型提供前瞻能力的简洁高效方法。仅通过短时间的观测历史，策略即可学习交互演化的紧凑隐表示。训练阶段，稀疏的未来夹爪状态对该表示进行监督；推理阶段，仅保留该隐变量作为面向未来的条件信息，与当前观测共同输入模型。该隐变量为动作生成提供全局条件约束，额外的门控FiLM（特征线性调制）分支仅作用于UNet的瓶颈层。本文方法仅在DP3基础上新增3.52%的参数量，既保留了原有的密集动作与滚动时域公式，又在RoboTwin2.0、LIBERO-40和DexArt数据集上持续超越DP3基线模型。在50任务的RoboTwin2.0混合训练设置下，所提方法性能为62.8%，优于基线的56.1%；在LIBERO-40数据集上性能为71.93%，优于基线的37.08%；在5项真实机器人任务上性能为72.0%，优于基线的49.0%。结果表明，扩散策略无需获知精确的移动目标，仅通过掌握交互行为的整体走向即可获得显著的性能提升。

title: Earth Surface Immune System for Rapid Monitoring of Unknown Anomalies
title_zh: 面向未知异常快速监测的地表免疫系统
authors: Jingtao Li, Qian Zhu, Xinyu Wang, Deren Li, Liangpei Zhang, Yanfei Zhong
abstract: Earth surface anomalies, driven by escalating climate change, and expanding human activities, are increasing in both frequency and diversity, yet their limited historical data and unpredictability make them fundamentally different from conventional remote sensing targets. Existing methods address specific anomaly categories or stop at localization, leaving a gap between detection and actionable information. Here we present ESIA, an Earth Surface Immune System whose architecture is constrained by three principles from the biological immune system, refined over millions of years against equally diverse and uncertain threats. A non-specific innate immune stage treats anomalies as unobserved changes in time-series satellite imagery, generating binary localization maps at 14.51 km2/s without assuming any anomaly category, surpassing the strongest general baseline by 37% in F1. A specific adaptive immune stage applies negative selection to filter text prompts and matches surviving prompts with localized image patches through a multi-modal foundation model, enabling open-vocabulary recognition of unknown anomaly attributes including category, affected area, and damage severity, with recognition F1 exceeding 80%. A mutation mechanism tunes minimal embeddings at test time, adapting to each scene in 3.26s using a single reference image pair. We validate ESIA on a global-scale dataset covering 19,801.60 km2 across six anomaly categories, comparing against 22 models, and further apply it to quantify degraded farmland in the Dnipro Delta following the Kakhovka Dam collapse and assess burn severity from 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles. This unprecedented flexibility in handling unknown anomalies opens new avenues for real-time disaster response and environmental surveillance.
summary_zh: 受气候变化加剧与人类活动范围扩张的影响，地表异常事件的发生频率与类型多样性持续提升，但这类事件历史数据有限、不可预测的特性使其与传统遥感监测目标存在本质差异。现有方法仅能处理特定类别的异常，或仅能完成异常定位，在检测结果与可落地应用信息之间存在明显缺口。本文提出ESIA（地表免疫系统），其架构遵循生物免疫系统经数百万年演化形成的、针对多样化不确定威胁的三项核心设计原则。非特异性先天免疫阶段将异常视为卫星图像时序中的未观测变化，无需假设任何异常类别即可生成二值定位图，处理速度达14.51 km²/s，F1值比最优通用基线高出37%。特异性适应性免疫阶段采用阴性选择机制过滤文本提示，通过多模态基础模型将留存的提示与定位后的图像块进行匹配，实现未知异常属性（包括类别、影响范围、破坏严重程度）的开放词汇识别，识别F1值超过80%。突变机制在测试阶段对少量嵌入进行微调，仅需单组参考图像对即可在3.26s内完成对单一场景的适配。本文在覆盖19801.60 km²、包含6类异常的全球规模数据集上对ESIA进行验证，对比了22个现有模型，并将其应用于卡霍夫卡大坝溃坝后第聂伯三角洲退化农田量化、2025年洛杉矶Palisades火灾烧伤严重程度评估任务。该前所未有的未知异常处理灵活性为实时灾害响应与环境监测开辟了新路径。

title: DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
title_zh: DexTouch-WM：从人类触觉数据学习动作条件触觉世界模型以支持灵巧机器人操作
authors: Yan Qin, Yue Chen, Wenwei Lin, Shujia Liu, Chuqiao Lyu, Kailun Su, Chenze Yu, Ping Luo, Wenbo Ding, Tianxing Chen, Renjing Xu
abstract: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.
summary_zh: 学习面向富接触灵巧操作的预测模型需要大量密集触觉交互数据，但这类数据在真实机器人上的采集成本极高，且受限于特定实体传感器。本文提出DexTouch-WM，一种动作条件世界模型，可从易规模化采集的人类触觉数据中学习，联合预测未来RGB观测与双边触觉动力学。核心思路是：当人类与机器人的触觉观测空间、动作空间实现对齐后，二者的操作过程具备可迁移的接触动力学特性。本文在人手与灵巧机器人手上部署传感布局完全一致的柔性压阻阵列，将人类运动重定向到机器人动作空间，使人类交互数据可直接监督用于真实机器人预测的动力学模型。DexTouch-WM通过解剖感知触觉令牌与对齐动作条件，将预训练视频专家与轻量级触觉专家耦合。在人到机器人的泛化实验中，固定5小时真实机器人监督数据，将人类交互数据时长从0提升至100小时后，尽管人类与机器人任务集完全不相交，模型在机器人域的视觉、几何与接触预测任务性能仍获得显著提升。除预测任务外，本文还将该世界模型作为代理环境用于策略评估，作为合成轨迹生成器用于真实机器人策略学习，结果表明可规模化采集的人类交互数据可为灵巧机器人世界模型的学习提供互补的数据维度。

title: PROVIA: Procedure State Tracking for Online Mistake Detection in Egocentric Videos
title_zh: PROVIA：面向第一视角视频在线错误检测的流程状态跟踪方法
authors: Di Wen, Kailun Yang, Jimmy Weissert, Luc Maria Scherrer, Cedric Z\"ollner, Ruiping Liu, Yufan Chen, Jiale Wei, Junwei Zheng, Kunyu Peng
abstract: An assistant watching egocentric video should notice a mistake from past frames alone, before the next step begins, and keep working once the person recovers. A mistake changes the state of the work, so every later step has to be read against what was done rather than against the plan. The first-mistake protocol that current online methods report on cuts each recording at its first mistake, so a fixed-time rule that never looks at the video is right on every case. We evaluate on complete trials, where mistakes and recoveries arise naturally, under a validation false-alarm budget and against controls that use timing alone. PROVIA keeps two records apart: a factual state, a learned summary of the steps each actor performed, mistakes included, and the accepted progress, an exact posterior over the state of an automaton induced from correct demonstrations by Bayesian state merging and over the execution status of each actor. Procedure-state transitions occur only in the correct-status branch; the mistake and correction branches retain the source state. A sequential test turns the per-frame mistake probability into alarms. With one filter and one optimization rule, PROVIA ranks mistakes best among the evaluated controlled baselines on CaptainCook4D, IndustReal, HoloAssist and IMPACT-ego. At a validation budget of 0.1 false alarms per minute it recalls .154 against .128 on CaptainCook4D and .034 against .015 on HoloAssist, where it leads at every budget. The pipeline runs at 58-70 frames per second. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/PROVIA.
summary_zh: 面向第一视角视频的辅助系统应当仅基于历史帧信息在下一步操作开始前识别出错误，并在操作人员修正错误后继续正常工作。错误会改变工作状态，因此后续所有步骤都需要对照已完成的实际操作进行校验，而非对照原始计划。现有在线方法采用的首错协议会在首次出现错误时截断整个视频，导致完全不依赖视频内容的固定时间规则即可在所有样本上取得正确结果。本文在包含自然发生的错误与修正过程的完整试验序列上开展评估，设置验证阶段误报率阈值，并与仅基于时间信息的对照方法进行对比。PROVIA维护两类独立记录：一类是事实状态，即对每个操作者实际执行步骤（包含错误）的学习得到的摘要；另一类是可接受进度，即基于正确演示通过贝叶斯状态合并推导得到的自动机状态后验分布，以及每个操作者的执行状态后验分布。流程状态转移仅发生在状态正常分支，错误与修正分支保留原始状态信息。通过序贯检验将逐帧错误概率转换为告警信号。仅使用一个滤波器与一个优化规则，PROVIA在CaptainCook4D、IndustReal、HoloAssist和IMPACT-ego数据集上的错误检测性能优于所有对照基线。在验证阶段每分钟0.1次误报的阈值下，其在CaptainCook4D上的召回率为0.154，优于基线的0.128；在HoloAssist上的召回率为0.034，优于基线的0.015，且在所有误报阈值下性能均领先。该流水线的运行速度可达58-70帧/秒。相关源码已开源至https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/PROVIA。

title: Refinement Is Inherently Editable: Training-Free Prompt-to-Prompt Image Editing with Generative Refinement Network
title_zh: 细化过程天然可编辑：基于生成式细化网络的免训练提示到提示图像编辑方法
authors: Yulong Chen, Ziqian Zhang, Haoyu Zhang, Ao He, Senmao Li, Kai Wang
abstract: Text-guided image editing must introduce the requested changes while preserving unrelated source content. Diffusion-based editors rely on spatial controls whose inaccuracies can leave edits incomplete or alter unrelated regions. Causal autoregressive editors face a further constraint: their fixed decoding order limits revision of earlier decisions. We introduce RefineEdit, a training-free prompt-to-prompt image editing framework built on a Generative Refinement Network. Our key idea is to couple edit localization with content generation through the global refinement of binary image codes, allowing editing evidence to be reassessed as the image evolves. RefineEdit initializes an editing branch from an intermediate source state, reusing the emerging layout. We compare the probabilities assigned by the two branches to the same source-sampled bits, using their signed differences to select editable positions and bits. Selected bits follow editing refinement, while the remaining bits copy the evolving source state. To stabilize editing across refinement steps, adaptive spatial freezing limits unnecessary mask expansion, while finite bit locking keeps recently selected bits editable. The framework requires no additional training, external masks, or attention control. Across nine editing categories of PIE-Bench, RefineEdit achieves the best background-preservation scores in PSNR, LPIPS, MSE and SSIM, together with the highest whole-image and edited-region CLIP scores among the evaluated methods.
summary_zh: 文本引导图像编辑需要在保留无关源内容的前提下引入用户指定的修改。基于扩散的编辑方法依赖空间控制，其精度不足容易导致编辑不完整或修改无关区域。因果自回归编辑方法则存在额外约束：固定解码顺序限制了对早期生成结果的修正。本文提出RefineEdit，一种基于生成式细化网络的免训练提示到提示图像编辑框架。核心思路是通过对二值图像编码的全局细化，将编辑定位与内容生成过程耦合，使编辑判断可随着图像生成过程动态调整。RefineEdit从源图像的中间状态初始化编辑分支，复用已生成的布局信息。通过对比两个分支对同一源采样比特分配的概率，利用二者的符号差选择可编辑位置与比特。选中的比特执行编辑细化，其余比特直接复制源图像的演化状态。为了在细化过程中稳定编辑效果，自适应空间冻结机制可避免掩码不必要的扩张，有限比特锁定机制可保证近期选中的比特始终处于可编辑状态。该框架无需额外训练、外部掩码或注意力控制。在PIE-Bench的9类编辑任务中，RefineEdit的PSNR（峰值信噪比）、LPIPS（学习感知图像块相似性）、MSE（均方误差）、SSIM（结构相似性）等背景保留指标均为最优，同时全图与编辑区域的CLIP得分也在所有对比方法中最高。

title: PhGS: Post-Hoc Pruning and Refinement of Single-View Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
title_zh: PhGS：面向单视图前馈3D高斯重建的事后剪枝与细化方法
authors: Rinto Yagawa, Han Cheng, Dieter Schmalstieg, Hideo Saito, Shohei Mori
abstract: Recent single-view feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) generation predicts a fixed number of Gaussians per camera ray, introducing severe spatial redundancy. Most existing compaction strategies target multi-view setups to exploit cross-view consistency and are incompatible with single-image models. Instead of retraining the base feed-forward network to directly output compact representations, our insight is to keep the base models frozen and apply post-hoc pruning and recurrent refinement to the generated Gaussians. Consequently, we propose a backbone-agnostic compaction pipeline for single-view feed-forward 3DGS that couples an importance-score-based pruning mechanism with a trainable, lightweight recurrent refinement module, which iteratively updates the surviving primitives to restore image quality. Our results demonstrate seamless integration with existing baselines while preserving novel-view rendering fidelity and achieving high memory reduction. Furthermore, our method supports flexible inference-time keep ratios for application needs.
summary_zh: 近期提出的单视图前馈3D高斯Splatting（3DGS）生成方法会为每个相机光线预测固定数量的高斯点，引入严重的空间冗余。现有大多数压缩策略面向多视图场景设计，利用跨视图一致性，无法适配单图像模型。本文无需重新训练基础前馈网络直接输出紧凑表示，核心思路是冻结基础模型，对生成的高斯点执行事后剪枝与循环细化。基于该思路，本文提出一种与骨干网络无关的单视图前馈3DGS压缩流水线，将基于重要性得分的剪枝机制与可训练的轻量级循环细化模块耦合，迭代更新留存的基元以恢复图像质量。实验结果表明，该方法可与现有基线无缝集成，在保留新视角渲染保真度的同时大幅降低内存占用，还可根据应用需求在推理阶段灵活调整留存比例。

title: INSPECT: Learning Robot View Selection from Assistant Use
title_zh: INSPECT：从辅助系统使用记录中学习机器人视角选择策略
authors: Di Wen, Kailun Yang, Wenhao Guo, Yitian Shi, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Ruiping Liu, Jiale Wei, Rania Rayyes, Kunyu Peng
abstract: Robots inspecting an assembly must determine which parts are present and whether they are correctly installed. During egocentric assembly assistance, head motion and workpiece handling reveal evidence for these checks, while spoken state confirmations link observations to procedural outcomes. We introduce INSPECT, which learns robot view preferences from records of a smart-glasses assistant that answers part queries and provides next-step guidance. Presence-Invariant TwinSwap (PI-TwinSwap) calibrates object evidence through paired identity interventions. Claim-indexed supervision separates evidence requirements from camera-reproducible observation changes. Object-centered calibration adapts relative view preferences to robot poses, while clause-level screening checks predicted evidence. The robot selects views using only its current observation and known poses, without candidate images. Evaluation uses annotated assistant-video replay to simulate state feedback, without target-domain view labels for policy training. On images of physical gearbox assemblies, INSPECT achieves the highest view utility among the compared non-oracle policies and raises human-rated full verifiability from 34.8% to 41.7% compared with keeping the current view. On commercial angle-grinder recordings in IMPACT, the transferred relative-view selector increases the correct decision rate from 50.6% to 54.3% with a frozen perception head. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT.
summary_zh: 执行装配检测任务的机器人需要判断所有部件是否存在、安装是否正确。在第一视角装配辅助场景下，头部运动与工件操作行为可提供检测所需的证据，语音状态确认信息可将观测与流程结果关联起来。本文提出INSPECT方法，从智能眼镜辅助系统的历史记录中学习机器人的视角偏好，该辅助系统可回答部件查询并提供下一步操作引导。所提Presence-Invariant TwinSwap（PI-TwinSwap，存在不变双交换）方法通过成对身份干预校准物体证据。基于标注结果的监督机制将证据需求与相机可复现的观测变化解耦。以物体为中心的校准可将相对视角偏好适配到机器人位姿，子句级筛选机制可校验预测得到的证据。机器人仅需基于当前观测与已知位姿即可完成视角选择，无需候选图像。评估过程采用标注后的辅助视频回放模拟状态反馈，策略训练阶段无需目标域视角标注。在真实变速箱装配图像测试集上，对比所有非先知策略，INSPECT的视角效用最高，与保持当前视角的基线相比，人工评估的完全可验证率从34.8%提升至41.7%。在IMPACT数据集的商用角磨机操作记录测试中，冻结感知头的情况下，迁移后的相对视角选择器将正确决策率从50.6%提升至54.3%。相关源码已开源至https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT。

title: RawSLAM: Online HDR Gaussian SLAM from Linear Radiance
title_zh: RawSLAM：基于线性辐射度的在线高动态范围高斯SLAM
authors: Marina Orozco Gonz\'alez, Luis Merino
abstract: Current dense visual SLAM systems rely almost exclusively on 8-bit tonemapped Low Dynamic Range (LDR) inputs, limiting their robustness in extreme lighting where shadows and highlights trigger tracking drift and mapping collapse. Conversely, existing raw and High Dynamic Range (HDR) reconstruction pipelines operate strictly offline. They depend on Structure-from-Motion preprocessing and are not suited for large inter-frame motion. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first online Gaussian SLAM framework that tracks and maps directly on single-exposure 16-bit linear HDR imagery. Our method rests on three core components: an architecture-agnostic HDR Gaussian Splatting module featuring an MLP-free logarithmic parameterization of Gaussian color features; a Reinhard range-compressed photometric objective; and structure-guided spatial gradient weighting. Combined, these components allow our approach to outperform a direct HDR adaptation of MonoGS in both trajectory and reconstruction accuracy, while rendering natively in linear scene radiance for post-rendering processing. The same formulation runs unchanged on standard 8-bit inputs, roughly halving the MonoGS baseline error. Furthermore, our HDR Gaussian module transfers seamlessly to SplaTAM, Gaussian SLAM, and DROID-W, eliminating all tracking failures these systems suffer on challenging illumination sequences. To enable this research, we introduce RawSLAM: a dataset of 10 real-world indoor sequences featuring 16-bit RAW imagery, aligned depth, IMU measurements, and external OptiTrack poses. Code and dataset will be made publicly available soon.
summary_zh: 当前主流的稠密视觉SLAM系统几乎全部依赖8位色调映射的低动态范围（LDR）输入，在阴影、高亮等极端光照场景下鲁棒性不足，容易出现跟踪漂移与建图崩溃。而现有RAW（原始数据）与高动态范围（HDR）重建流水线均为离线设计，依赖运动恢复结构预处理，无法适配大帧间运动场景。据本文作者所知，这是首个可直接基于单曝光16位线性HDR图像执行跟踪与建图的在线高斯SLAM框架。该方法包含三个核心组件：与架构无关的HDR高斯Splatting模块，采用无MLP（多层感知机）的对数形式对高斯颜色特征进行参数化；Reinhard范围压缩光度目标函数；结构引导的空间梯度加权机制。三者结合后，该方法的轨迹精度与重建精度均优于直接适配HDR的MonoGS基线，且原生输出线性场景辐射度，支持后续渲染处理。该公式在标准8位输入下也可直接运行，将MonoGS基线的误差降低约一半。此外，所提HDR高斯模块可无缝迁移至SplaTAM、Gaussian SLAM与DROID-W，完全消除这些系统在挑战性光照序列上的跟踪失败问题。为支撑相关研究，本文发布RawSLAM数据集，包含10个真实世界室内序列，提供16位RAW图像、对齐深度、IMU测量值与外部OptiTrack位姿标注。相关代码与数据集将很快对外公开。

title: CoRef-GS: Cooperative Referring Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Agent Scene Understanding
title_zh: CoRef-GS：面向多智能体场景理解的协同指代高斯Splatting方法
authors: Zhikun Zhou, Kunyu Peng, Runyi Yang, Junhao Cai, Di Wen, Ruiping Liu, Danda Pani Paudel, Yi Zhou, Luc Van Gool, Kailun Yang
abstract: Referring scene understanding for embodied robots requires grounding object- and relation-centric language queries from a designated viewpoint. While a local semantic Gaussian map can support such grounding within one agent's observations, cooperative settings require this ability to remain effective after independently reconstructed maps are aligned and fused. In this setting, the referred target or its contextual landmark may come from another agent's observations, while spatial relations must still be interpreted from the querying robot's viewpoint. We formulate this problem as cooperative referring Gaussian grounding over fused maps, which requires geometric alignability, instance-level semantic comparability, and view-conditioned relation reasoning. Existing language-aware Gaussian methods mainly focus on single-map querying, whereas Gaussian registration methods optimize geometric or photometric alignment without preserving language-grounding-oriented semantic compatibility. We propose CoRef-GS, a cooperative referring Gaussian splatting framework. CoRef-GS constructs local open-vocabulary instance-aware Gaussian maps, then aligns partially overlapping maps with a cross-agent alignment module by geometric and semantic consistency, and grounds queries using a view-conditioned mask relation graph. We further introduce CoQuad-Ref, a dual-quadruped benchmark spanning both real-world and simulated indoor scenes. Experiments show that, on simulated scenes, CoRef-GS reduces the rotation error from 2.58{\deg} after coarse initialization to 0.15{\deg} after refinement, and improves real-world referring mIoU over ReferSplat from 52.6% to 68.8%. The established benchmark and source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git.
summary_zh: 面向具身机器人的指代场景理解任务需要从指定视角出发，将以物体和关系为中心的语言查询与物理场景关联。尽管单智能体观测得到的局部语义高斯地图可支持这类关联，但在协同场景下，多个独立重建的地图完成对齐融合后，该能力仍需保持有效。在该设置下，查询指代的目标或其上下文地标可能来自其他智能体的观测，而空间关系仍需从查询机器人的视角进行解读。本文将该问题定义为融合地图上的协同指代高斯关联任务，要求方法具备几何可对齐性、实例级语义可比性与视角条件关系推理能力。现有语言感知高斯方法主要聚焦单地图查询，而高斯配准方法仅优化几何或光度对齐，无法保留面向语言关联的语义兼容性。本文提出CoRef-GS协同指代高斯Splatting框架：CoRef-GS首先构建局部开放词汇实例感知高斯地图，随后通过跨智能体对齐模块基于几何与语义一致性对齐部分重叠的地图，最终通过视角条件掩码关系图完成查询关联。本文还构建了覆盖真实场景与仿真室内场景的双四足机器人基准数据集CoQuad-Ref。实验结果表明，在仿真场景下，CoRef-GS将粗对齐后的旋转误差从2.58°降低至0.15°；在真实场景下，其指代任务的mIoU（平均交并比）从ReferSplat的52.6%提升至68.8%。相关基准数据集与源码将开源至https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git。

title: DocAttriBench: Benchmarking Answer Grounding in Document Visual Question Answering
title_zh: DocAttriBench：文档视觉问答中答案锚定任务的基准评测
authors: Luca De Grandis (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy), Silvia Cappelletti (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy), William Raccagni (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy, University of Pisa, Pisa, Italy), Marcella Cornia (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy), Lorenzo Baraldi (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy), Rita Cucchiara (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy)
abstract: Answer grounding in document visual question answering remains an open challenge: most benchmarks lack grounding annotations or provide limited-quality labels, while constructing grounded datasets still requires costly manual effort. We introduce DocAttriBench (DAB), a large-scale benchmark for fine-grained, element-level source attribution in Document VQA, grounding answers to specific layout elements such as text blocks, tables, and images. To build DAB, we propose a Mask-based Perplexity-Derived Attribution method (MAPPET) that combines document layout and language modeling to identify the most informative element for each answer. MAPPET measures the increase in perplexity after masking candidate elements and attributes the answer to the element contributing most to model confidence. Applying MAPPET to multiple existing Document VQA datasets yields DAB, with 237k documents and 296k question-answer pairs with element-level grounding. We benchmark grounding-capable multimodal LLMs on DAB, evaluating answer accuracy, attribution accuracy, and overall answer quality. Results show that while larger models generally achieve higher answer accuracy, even the strongest models often fail to localize the supporting elements. DAB provides a scalable benchmark for developing grounded, verifiable, and trustworthy Document VQA models. Dataset and code are available at https://aimagelab.github.io/DocAttriBench/.
summary_zh: 文档视觉问答中的答案锚定仍是尚未解决的公开挑战：现有多数基准数据集缺少锚定标注，或提供的标签质量有限，而构建带锚定标注的数据集需要耗费高昂的人工成本。本文提出DocAttriBench（DAB，文档属性基准集），这是面向文档视觉问答的细粒度、元素级来源归因的大规模基准数据集，可将答案锚定到文本块、表格、图像等特定布局元素。为构建DAB数据集，本文提出基于掩码的困惑度衍生归因方法（MAPPET），该方法结合文档布局与语言建模，可为每个答案识别出信息量最高的对应元素。MAPPET通过计算掩码候选元素后模型困惑度的增幅，将答案归因于对模型置信度贡献最大的元素。将MAPPET应用于多个现有文档视觉问答数据集后得到的DAB数据集包含23.7万份文档、29.6万个带元素级锚定标注的问答对。本文在DAB基准上对具备锚定能力的多模态大语言模型开展评测，评估指标包括答案准确率、归因准确率和整体答案质量。实验结果表明，尽管更大规模的模型通常能实现更高的答案准确率，但即便是性能最优的模型也经常无法定位到支撑答案的对应元素。DAB为开发具备锚定能力、可验证、可信的文档视觉问答模型提供了可扩展的基准平台。数据集和代码可访问链接https://aimagelab.github.io/DocAttriBench/获取。

title: OmniMimic: Dynamics-completed Motion Augmentation for Multi-style Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion
title_zh: OmniMimic：面向多风格全向四足机器人运动的动力学补全运动增强方法
authors: Sheng Wu, Guoqiang Zhao, Zhe Yang, Fei Teng, Zhikun Zhou, Yanlin Yang, Zheng Fang, Hong Zheng, Yaonan Wang, Kailun Yang
abstract: Animal demonstrations provide quadruped robots with natural and distinctive gait styles that are difficult to specify through hand-crafted rewards. However, their narrow directional coverage leaves little style-consistent supervision for backward, lateral, and turning commands. We present OmniMimic, a training framework that turns directionally limited animal demonstrations into a single multi-gait policy over target per-axis velocity ranges. OmniMimic first combines temporal reversal, constrained dynamics completion, and sagittal reflection to construct robot-specific kinematic and physical supervision beyond the observed directions. It then expands commands progressively from the demonstrated velocity distribution toward the target per-axis bounds, and uses a shared actor with soft-gated, gait-specialized residual experts to balance reusable locomotion skills with gait-specific corrections. Across four gaits in simulation, OmniMimic reduces mean foot-position RMSE at forward and backward reference velocities by 12.9% and velocity-tracking RMSE on a uniform Cartesian command grid by 63.1%, compared with the matched APEX baseline. The project page is at https://OmniMimic.github.io.
summary_zh: 动物演示可为四足机器人提供自然且风格独特的步态，这类步态很难通过人工设计的奖励函数实现。但动物演示的方向覆盖范围较窄，几乎无法为后退、侧移、转向等指令提供风格一致的监督信号。本文提出OmniMimic（全向模仿训练框架），可将方向覆盖受限的动物演示转化为在目标各轴速度范围内统一的多步态策略。OmniMimic首先结合时序反转、约束动力学补全和矢状面反射操作，构建超出观测方向范围的机器人专属运动学与物理监督信号；随后从已演示的速度分布开始，逐步将指令扩展到目标各轴的速度边界，同时采用带软门控、步态专属残差专家的共享Actor网络，在可复用的运动技能和步态专属修正之间实现平衡。在仿真环境下的4种步态场景中，与对照基线方法APEX相比，OmniMimic在前向和后向参考速度下的平均足部位移均方根误差降低12.9%，在均匀笛卡尔指令网格上的速度跟踪均方根误差降低63.1%。项目主页为https://OmniMimic.github.io。

title: A Dual-Stream Regulated Reconstruction and Segmentation Network with Hierarchical Artifact-Prior Modeling for Ultra-Low-Field Pediatric Neuroimaging
title_zh: 面向超低场儿科神经影像的融合分层伪影先验建模的双流正则化重建与分割网络
authors: Bahram Jafrasteh, Leo Milecki, Qingyu Zhao
abstract: Automated quality assessment, enhancement, and segmentation of multiple structures in $0.064\,\mathrm{T}$ ultra-low-field pediatric MRI are limited by a low signal-to-noise ratio, weak anatomical boundaries, and frequent artifacts. We present a unified framework for the LISA 2026 Challenge that performs all three tasks together within one inference pipeline. A network with two coupled streams, built on a 3D U-Net, first reconstructs an enhanced uLF volume and then combines the original and enhanced images for subcortical segmentation. To improve boundary stability, we add an auxiliary class covering brain tissue outside the target structures, derived from whole brain masks. A head conditioned on an artifact graph predicts the seven artifact ratings from reconstruction residuals and frozen segmentation features. We address the scarcity of dense annotations using diffeomorphic registration from atlas to target for label propagation and to regularize anatomical reconstruction. We report validation results across all three tasks.
summary_zh: 0.064T超低场儿科磁共振成像的多结构自动质量评估、增强与分割任务受限于低信噪比、解剖边界模糊、伪影频发等问题。本文针对LISA 2026挑战赛提出一个统一框架，可在单条推理流水线中同时完成上述三项任务。该网络基于3D U-Net构建，包含两个耦合分支，首先重建得到增强后的超低场体数据，随后融合原始图像与增强图像完成皮层下结构分割。为提升边界稳定性，本文基于全脑掩码新增覆盖目标结构外脑组织的辅助类别。基于伪图图的预测头可从重建残差和冻结的分割特征中预测7类伪影的评分。针对密集标注稀缺的问题，本文采用从图谱到目标图像的微分同胚配准实现标签传播，同时对解剖重建过程施加正则化约束。本文报告了全部三项任务的验证集结果。

title: Automated Goldsmith's Mark Retrieval in Silverware
title_zh: 银器金匠标记的自动检索方法
authors: Atmik Tiwari, Vincent Christlein, Mark Fichtner, Freya Gohlke, Birgit Sch\"ubel, Theresa Witting, Heike Zech, Mathias Zinnen
abstract: For art historians, goldsmith marks play a critical role in the identification and dating of artifacts. In practice, experts must manually compare a query mark against hundreds of documented examples, a process that is both tedious and highly dependent on specialist knowledge. To address this, we present an AI-assisted retrieval pipeline that combines mark localization with metric-learning fine-tuning across three backbone architectures: an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, a supervised ViT-S/16, and a self-supervised DINOv2 ViT-S/14. We conduct a systematic evaluation of cropping strategies, where we measure the impact of no cropping, manual ground-truth cropping, and learned detection-based cropping, and assess their interaction with each backbone. Our strongest configuration, DINOv2 ViT-S/14 with manual crop and metric-learning fine-tuning, achieves an mAP of 62.63% and a Top-1 accuracy of 73.74%. Our experiments show that self-supervised pretraining and mark localization are the two most impactful factors, with learned cropping recovering the majority of the gain from manual cropping without requiring ground-truth annotations at inference time. To enable reproducibility and adoption in the digital humanities, we release our manually annotated dataset and codebase, and deploy the system via a public web interface.
summary_zh: 对艺术史学家而言，金匠标记在文物识别与断代工作中起到关键作用。实际场景中，专家需要人工将待查询标记与数百份已记录的样本逐一比对，该过程不仅繁琐，还高度依赖专业知识。为解决该问题，本文提出一套AI辅助检索流水线，融合标记定位与度量学习微调技术，在三类骨干架构上开展验证：分别是在ImageNet上预训练的ResNet-50、监督式ViT-S/16、自监督DINOv2 ViT-S/14。本文针对裁剪策略开展系统性评估，分别测试无裁剪、人工真值裁剪、基于学习得到的检测结果裁剪三类方案的效果，同时评估不同裁剪策略与各骨干网络的交互作用。性能最优的配置（带人工裁剪、经度量学习微调的DINOv2 ViT-S/14）实现了62.63%的平均精度均值（mAP）和73.74%的Top-1准确率。实验结果表明，自监督预训练和标记定位是影响检索性能的两个最重要因素，基于学习得到的裁剪方案可在推理阶段无需真值标注的前提下，还原人工裁剪带来的绝大部分性能增益。为支持数字人文领域的可复现性与落地应用，本文开源了人工标注数据集和代码库，并通过公共网页界面部署了该系统。

title: Grounded Product Understanding in Livestream Videos
title_zh: 直播视频中的锚定产品理解
authors: Xinyu Zhang, Junjie Chen, Jiawei Ge, Qianlong Li, Libin Ma, Baokun Pan, Yahui Luo
abstract: E-commerce livestreams have emerged as an important channel for presenting products to online consumers, containing multiple products whose information is scattered in different moments. This poses significant challenges for downstream product understanding applications, such as product-centric livestream clipping, where models need to identify the product and its relevant segments for information gathering. However, existing benchmarks for general product understanding typically evaluate product retrieval and temporal localization in isolation, leaving the critical correspondence between product identity and temporal evidence largely unassessed. To address this limitation, we introduce GPUB, a large-scale benchmark comprising 3,000 livestream instances with quality-controlled multi-moment temporal annotations and a catalog of over 31K fashion products. GPUB supports three evaluation tasks: the main task Grounded Product Understanding (GPrU) requires jointly identifying the target product and localizing its supporting moments from a livestream video and a candidate product set; Product Retrieval and Product Moment Localization serve as two complementary subtasks. Evaluation of existing multimodal models shows that GPrU remains highly challenging, with the best-performing baseline achieving only 10.13% Pair mAP@.3. To narrow the performance gap, we further develop UniPro, a unified product understanding model that derives product-aligned and temporally structured representations from shared multimodal encoding, improving Pair mAP@.3 to 21.53% while achieving 37.23% Joint R@1@.3 on GPrU.
summary_zh: 电商直播已成为向线上消费者展示产品的重要渠道，单场直播通常包含多款产品，产品相关信息分散在不同的时间片段中，这给下游产品理解应用带来了显著挑战，例如以产品为核心的直播片段剪辑任务，要求模型识别目标产品并定位对应的相关片段以收集信息。但现有面向通用产品理解的基准数据集通常将产品检索和时序定位任务分开评估，几乎没有对产品身份与时序证据之间的关键对应关系进行评测。为弥补这一缺陷，本文提出GPUB（直播产品理解基准集），这是一个大规模基准数据集，包含3000条直播样本、经质量控制的多时刻时序标注，以及超过3.1万个时尚产品的目录。GPUB支持三类评测任务：主任务锚定产品理解（GPrU）要求结合直播视频和候选产品集，同时完成目标产品识别和对应支撑时刻的定位；产品检索和产品时刻定位是两个互补的子任务。对现有多模态模型的评测结果表明，锚定产品理解任务仍极具挑战性，性能最优的基线方法仅能实现10.13%的Pair mAP@.3指标。为缩小性能差距，本文进一步提出UniPro（统一产品理解模型），该模型通过共享多模态编码生成与产品对齐、时序结构化的表征，将Pair mAP@.3指标提升至21.53%，同时在锚定产品理解任务上实现37.23%的Joint R@1@.3指标。

title: SenseFuse: Label-Free Fusion of Image and Shape Encoders for Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation
title_zh: SenseFuse：面向开放词汇3D实例分割的无标签图像与形状编码器融合方法
authors: Euiseok Han, Tri Ton, Hwanhee Kim, Seungyeon Ryu, Chang D. Yoo
abstract: Open-vocabulary scene understanding is fundamental for robotics, laying the groundwork for spatial reasoning and object manipulation. While closed-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation heavily leverages 3D shape information, state-of-the-art open-vocabulary methods remain predominantly restricted to 2D image features or image-distilled representations during mask labeling. In this paper, we propose SenseFuse, a label-free fusion method that balances 2D image and 3D shape encoders for robust open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, refining only the mask-labeling stage of existing pipelines. We reveal that 2D image and 3D shape encoders exhibit largely disjoint failure patterns and rarely share identical wrong labels, whereas two 2D image encoders frequently repeat the same errors. This distinct behavior makes the 2D and 3D pair inherently complementary. We introduce an adaptive mechanism that selects a scene-level fusion weight to maximize a label-free sensitivity measure, estimated directly from a single scene's unlabeled proposals in milliseconds. SenseFuse improves labeling accuracy in every evaluated setting across ScanNet200, Replica, and ScanNet++, recovering 67-100% (median 93%) of the gain achievable with an oracle weight, and it raises instance AP in 21 of 22 reported settings. Code is available at https://github.com/hanes1207/SenseFuse.
summary_zh: 开放词汇场景理解是机器人领域的基础能力，为空间推理和物体操作任务提供支撑。尽管闭集3D实例分割任务已大量利用3D形状信息，但当前最先进的开放词汇方法在掩码标注阶段仍大多仅使用2D图像特征或从图像蒸馏得到的表征。本文提出SenseFuse（感知融合框架），这是一种无标签融合方法，可平衡2D图像编码器和3D形状编码器的输出，实现鲁棒的开放词汇3D实例分割，仅对现有流水线的掩码标注阶段进行优化。研究发现，2D图像编码器和3D形状编码器的失效模式几乎完全不重叠，二者很少给出相同的错误标签，而两个2D图像编码器则经常出现重复错误。这种特性使得2D和3D编码器组合天然具备互补性。本文引入自适应机制，选择场景级融合权重以最大化无标签灵敏度指标，该指标可直接从单场景的无标注候选框中在毫秒级时间内估算得到。在ScanNet200、Replica和ScanNet++数据集的所有评测设置中，SenseFuse均提升了标注准确率，可达到使用理想权重所能获得性能增益的67%~100%（中位数为93%），在22组评测设置的21组中提升了实例分割平均精度（AP）。代码可访问链接https://github.com/hanes1207/SenseFuse获取。

title: Cross-Architecture Foundation-Model Distillation for Edge Flood Segmentation
title_zh: 面向边缘端洪水分割的跨架构基础模型蒸馏方法
authors: Fabian Schmalstieg, Karsten Mueller, Wojciech Samek
abstract: Geospatial foundation models can provide strong flood-segmentation performance, but their size limits deployment on memory-constrained edge hardware. We distill a 300-million-parameter Prithvi-EO-2.0 teacher, fine-tuned on the 252 manually labeled Sen1Floods11 training scenes, into a 0.7-million-parameter EfficientViT-B0 student. The teacher supervises additional unlabeled Sentinel-2 imagery, allowing the student training set to grow without new manual annotations. At the matched budget of 252 scenes, teacher-supervised training is competitive with direct training and improves STURM-Flood performance across tested configurations; a geometry-matched control shows that label source alone does not explain the difference. Scaling the teacher-supervised pool to 2,500 scenes narrows the remaining student--teacher gap: the float student reaches 0.787 water intersection over union on the Sen1Floods11 test split against 0.822 for the teacher, matches the teacher on STURM-Flood under our evaluation protocol, and remains below it on WorldFloods-v2. After activation replacement and quantization-aware training, the student runs as a 1.5-megabyte 8-bit integer (INT8) TensorRT engine on a Jetson Xavier NX at 5.57 milliseconds of graphics processing unit (GPU) compute per 512-by-512 image, with approximately 14 megabytes of runtime device memory. A fixed modified normalized difference water index (MNDWI) threshold is competitive with both models on the two clean external benchmarks, so we interpret those benchmarks as generalization tests rather than as evidence of learned-model superiority over a spectral rule. The results support the conclusion: foundation-model supervision can amplify a fixed manual annotation budget into a substantially larger training set and yield a compact, deployable edge model.
summary_zh: 地理空间基础模型可实现优秀的洪水分割性能，但模型体积过大限制了其在内存受限边缘硬件上的部署。本文将在252个人工标注Sen1Floods11训练场景上微调得到的3亿参数Prithvi-EO-2.0教师模型，蒸馏为仅含70万参数的EfficientViT-B0学生模型。教师模型可对额外的无标注Sentinel-2影像提供监督信号，无需新增人工标注即可扩充学生模型的训练集。在训练集规模同为252个场景的匹配条件下，教师监督训练的性能与直接训练相当，且在所有测试配置下均提升了STURM-Flood数据集上的性能；经几何匹配的对照实验表明，仅标签来源差异无法解释该性能提升。将教师监督的数据集规模扩充至2500个场景后，学生模型与教师模型的性能差距进一步缩小：浮点精度学生模型在Sen1Floods11测试集上的水体交并比达到0.787，教师模型对应指标为0.822；在本文的评测协议下，学生模型在STURM-Flood数据集上的性能与教师模型持平，在WorldFloods-v2数据集上的性能略低于教师模型。经激活替换和量化感知训练后，学生模型可生成体积仅1.5MB的8位整型（INT8）TensorRT引擎，部署在Jetson Xavier NX硬件上时，处理单张512×512图像的GPU计算耗时仅为5.57毫秒，运行时设备内存占用约14MB。在两个干净的外部基准数据集上，固定的改进型归一化差异水体指数（MNDWI）阈值方法的性能与上述两个模型相当，因此本文将这两个基准视为泛化能力测试集，而非证明学习得到的模型优于光谱规则的依据。实验结果验证了如下结论：基础模型监督可在固定人工标注预算的前提下大幅扩充训练集规模，生成体积紧凑、可部署在边缘端的模型。

title: When Do Language-Grounded Explanations Help? A Graph-Bottleneck for Farm Monitoring Interpretable Sheep Facial Pain
title_zh: 语言锚定解释何时生效？面向农场监测可解释绵羊面部疼痛识别的图瓶颈方法
authors: Alam Noor, Miguel Guti'errez Gait'an
abstract: Automated pain recognition from facial expression could make continuous welfare assessment practical in sheep, but adoption depends on trust: a stockperson cannot act on a score that arrives without justification. We ground a model in the Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale (SPFES) by letting each detected facial region attend over text embeddings of the clinical descriptors and then test whether the resulting explanations mean anything. They do not. Ablating an entire descriptor changes the predicted logit by about $10^{-4}$, and the most-attended cue agrees with the predicted pain level in only $32.6\%$ of regions, although the attention maps, the learned gate, and the generated text all proposed otherwise. We therefore remove the appearance bypass with a concept bottleneck whose classifier reads only SPFES concept scores, supervised by per-region state annotations that image-level pipelines discard. This costs $0.05$--$0.10$ in Cohen's $\kappa$ but yields concepts that are demonstrably learned: minority pain-indicating states are recovered at $3.5$--$8.3\times$ their base rates, and the ear and eye severity orderings emerge without severity supervision. Removing the supervision alone leaves $\kappa$ unchanged while concept accuracy falls to $0.109$, showing that architectural necessity does not imply semantic validity. We also show that pooled concept accuracy is misleading under clinical imbalance and provide a cross-validated, protocol-matched benchmark of seven methods on this dataset.
summary_zh: 基于面部表情的自动化疼痛识别可实现绵羊福利的持续评估，但该技术的落地依赖于可信度：如果没有合理解释，牧场工作人员无法直接使用模型输出的疼痛评分。本文将模型与绵羊疼痛面部表情量表（SPFES）对齐，让每个检测到的面部区域对临床描述符的文本嵌入进行注意力计算，随后验证生成的解释是否具备实际意义。实验结果表明初始方案生成的解释不具备实际意义：擦除完整描述符仅能使预测对数几率产生约10^-4的变化，尽管注意力图、学习得到的门控和生成文本都给出了相反的结论，但被注意力权重最高的线索与预测疼痛等级相符的区域占比仅为32.6%。因此本文移除外观旁路，引入概念瓶颈模块，该模块的分类器仅读取SPFES概念得分，由图像级流水线会丢弃的逐区域状态标注提供监督。该方案仅使Cohen's κ指标下降0.05~0.10，但模型确实可学习到有效概念：指示疼痛的少数状态的召回率是其基准占比的3.5~8.3倍，无需疼痛等级监督即可自动得到耳朵和眼睛的严重程度排序。仅移除概念监督不会改变κ指标，但概念准确率会降至0.109，说明架构层面的约束无法保证语义有效性。本文还证明，在临床数据类别不平衡的场景下，池化后的概念准确率指标存在误导性，同时在该数据集上给出了7种方法经交叉验证、符合统一协议的基准评测结果。

title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing
title_zh: WeVisDoc：面向鲁棒端到端文档解析的从覆盖度到能力提升框架
authors: Hao Yu, Kang Liu, Linnan Zhao, Jiabo Zhan, Chong Sun, Chen Li, Jing Lyu
abstract: Document parsing converts document images into structured content and requires reliable performance across diverse layouts and acquisition conditions. Yet training corpora are biased toward common document types and clean digital pages, while expanding coverage alone does not specify how to address a parser's remaining weaknesses. We present WeVisDoc, a two-stage data-centric framework for robust end-to-end document parsing. Stage I broadens semantic, structural, and appearance coverage through heterogeneous data and structure-preserving degradation synthesis. Stage II uses a held-out probe to measure the Stage I parser's residual errors within fixed visual-structural clusters. These diagnostics guide targeted data construction and reallocation of the target-token budget. WeVisDoc-4B achieves an Overall score of 95.38 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and a mean Overall score of 75.54 across the three PureDocBench tracks, ranking first among the compared end-to-end parsers in all four settings. Compared with Stage I, Stage II improves Overall scores for the 2B and 4B models on both benchmarks, with larger gains on the degraded PureDocBench tracks, including a 4.03-point gain for the 4B model on the Real Degraded track.
summary_zh: 文档解析任务需要将文档图像转换为结构化内容，要求模型在不同布局、不同采集条件下都能输出可靠结果。但现有训练语料偏向常见文档类型和干净的数字页面，仅扩大数据覆盖范围无法针对性解决解析器的剩余缺陷。本文提出WeVisDoc（文档视觉解析框架），这是一套以数据为核心的两阶段鲁棒端到端文档解析框架。第一阶段通过异质数据和保结构退化合成操作，拓宽语义、结构和外观层面的覆盖范围。第二阶段使用预留的探测集，在固定的视觉-结构簇中测量第一阶段训练得到的解析器的残留误差，基于该诊断结果指导针对性的数据构建和目标token预算的重新分配。WeVisDoc-4B模型在OmniDocBench v1.6上的综合得分达到95.38，在PureDocBench的三个赛道上的平均综合得分为75.54，在全部四个评测设置下的性能均位列所有对比端到端解析器的第一。与第一阶段的模型相比，第二阶段的优化提升了2B和4B参数模型在两个基准上的综合得分，在存在退化的PureDocBench赛道上的性能提升幅度更大，其中4B参数模型在真实退化赛道上的得分提升了4.03个百分点。

title: TouchSight: Bare-Handed Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Video via Generative Visual Augmentation
title_zh: TouchSight：基于生成式视觉增强的第一人称视频裸手触觉预测方法
authors: Danyan Zhou, Jinxuan Lu, Jiawei Lin, Tianxing Chen, Chuqiao Lyu, Wenbo Ding
abstract: Tactile signals provide direct contact and force measurements that are essential for understanding physical interactions and enabling dexterous robotic manipulation. However, tactile sensing requires direct measurement at contact interfaces, making large-scale data collection reliant on intrusive, costly, and restrictive instrumentation. We present TouchSight, a monocular egocentric vision framework for dense full-hand contact force prediction that leverages 500 hours of pressure-glove recordings and extensive hand-object interaction (HOI) data. To address the appearance gap between gloved training data and bare-hand real-world scenarios, we construct TwinTouch-20H: 20 hours of paired visual data in which generative video models re-render gloved recordings as bare-hand observations against new backgrounds while preserving the original measured tactile labels. TouchSight predicts dense force from both gloved and generated bare-hand videos, outperforms prior contact prediction methods on OakInk2, qualitatively generalizes to natural bare-hand egocentric videos from unseen datasets, and improves consistently as glove supervision scales. These results demonstrate that dense tactile signals can be recovered from egocentric vision alone, without tactile instrumentation at capture time.
summary_zh: 触觉信号可提供直接的接触和力测量结果，是理解物理交互、实现机器人灵巧操作的核心要素。但触觉传感要求在接触界面直接测量，大规模数据采集需要使用侵入性强、成本高昂、使用场景受限的专用设备。本文提出TouchSight（触觉视觉预测框架），这是一个单目第一人称视觉框架，可实现全手密集接触力预测，训练过程利用了500小时的压力手套记录数据和大量手-物交互（HOI）数据。为解决带手套的训练数据与真实场景裸手数据之间的外观差异，本文构建了TwinTouch-20H数据集：包含20小时的配对视觉数据，通过生成式视频模型将带手套的记录重新渲染为裸手观测结果，同时替换为新背景，完全保留原始测量得到的触觉标签。TouchSight可从带手套视频和生成的裸手视频中预测密集力，在OakInk2数据集上的性能优于现有接触预测方法，可泛化到未见过的数据集里的自然裸手第一人称视频，且性能随带手套监督数据规模的扩大持续提升。上述结果证明，无需在采集阶段部署触觉传感设备，仅通过第一人称视觉即可恢复出密集触觉信号。

title: Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent
title_zh: Navi-Agent：无定位单目导航智能体
authors: Wenyuan Xie, Mengyang Hong, Yongzhong Wang, Yanbiao Ji, Yijin Zhou, Shaokai Wu, Shalayiding Sirejiding, Huayi Zhou, Yi-Chao Chen, Ma Ling, Yue Ding, Hongtao Lu
abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.
summary_zh: 连续环境视觉语言导航（Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments, VLN-CE）要求具身智能体在未知环境中执行长程指令。现有零样本VLN-CE系统通常通过几何定位或基于坐标的表示来维护空间状态。近期的几何约束导航方法取消了深度信息和全局一致坐标，但为位置确认、进度验证和故障恢复维持持续空间感知仍然存在挑战。本文提出Navi-Agent，一款零样本VLN-CE智能体，可从视觉观测和已执行的运动历史中构建无坐标空间状态。Navi-Agent将该状态组织为导航拓扑结构，其中节点代表视觉位置，边代表运动转移。该表示支持基于观测的近似自定位、任务进度验证以及基于视觉重访的故障恢复。Navi-Agent通过将指令分解为子目标、执行局部视觉导航、并通过构建的空间状态验证已访问位置实现闭环导航。在零样本VLN-CE基准和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，Navi-Agent在几何约束方法中取得了当前最优性能，同时与依赖几何定位的方法相比也具备竞争力。

title: Compact Vision Models for Iris Presentation Attack Detection under Presentation Attack Instrument Shift and Environmental Degradation
title_zh: 面向呈现攻击设备偏移与环境退化场景的紧凑型虹膜呈现攻击检测视觉模型
authors: Athanasios Angelakis, Marta Gomez-Barrero
abstract: Iris presentation attack detection (PAD) is security-critical when a subsystem that appears reliable during development encounters presentation attack instruments (PAIs) or acquisition conditions absent from validation data. We benchmark three compact scratch-trained computer-vision models, each with at most approximately 0.26 million trainable parameters, on the Notre Dame subset of LivDet-Iris 2017 under PAI-driven domain shift and environmental degradation. All models are trained without external pretraining or data augmentation and evaluated over five seeds. A validation-selected threshold is transferred unchanged to the known-attack, unknown-attack, corrupted, and pooled test partitions. From known to unknown attack presentations, Attack Presentation Classification Error Rate (APCER) increases by 17.11-30.47 percentage points and Detection Equal Error Rate (D-EER) increases by 7.38-12.73 percentage points. At the validation-selected threshold, ZACH-ViT obtains the lowest unknown-attack APCER (47.69 +/- 4.84%) and D-EER (38.87 +/- 0.93%), while Compact-TransMIL obtains the lowest Bona Fide Presentation Classification Error Rate (BPCER). ZACH-ViT also gives the lowest unknown-attack BPCER at an APCER limit of 10% (81.29 +/- 1.95%). The high absolute errors show that the comparative advantage of the best compact model does not constitute deployment readiness under unknown PAIs.
summary_zh: 当开发阶段表现可靠的子系统遇到验证数据中不存在的呈现攻击仪器（Presentation Attack Instruments, PAI）或采集条件时，虹膜呈现攻击检测（Presentation Attack Detection, PAD）就成为关键安全环节。本文在LivDet-Iris 2017的Notre Dame子集上，针对PAI导致的域偏移和环境退化场景，对3个从零训练的紧凑型计算机视觉模型进行基准测试，每个模型最多仅含约26万个可训练参数。所有模型均不使用外部预训练或数据增强进行训练，并在5个随机种子下完成评估。经验证集选定的阈值直接迁移至已知攻击、未知攻击、损坏样本和合并测试分区。从已知攻击到未知攻击场景，攻击呈现分类错误率（Attack Presentation Classification Error Rate, APCER）上升17.11~30.47个百分点，检测等错误率（Detection Equal Error Rate, D-EER）上升7.38~12.73个百分点。在验证集选定阈值下，ZACH-ViT取得最低的未知攻击APCER（47.69±4.84%）和D-EER（38.87±0.93%），而Compact-TransMIL取得最低的真实呈现分类错误率（Bona Fide Presentation Classification Error Rate, BPCER）。在APCER限制为10%的条件下，ZACH-ViT也取得了最低的未知攻击BPCER（81.29±1.95%）。极高的绝对误差表明，最优紧凑型模型的相对优势并不代表其在未知PAI场景下已达到部署就绪状态。

title: MM-Future: Multi-Mode Joint World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
title_zh: MM-Future：面向自动驾驶的多模式联合世界-动作建模
authors: Shuai Liu, Hechangle Gong, Hao Jiang, Runlin He, Junxiang Zhan, Kai Huang, Sheng Yang, Shaoqing Ren
abstract: Autonomous driving involves coupled decision-making and scene evolution under multi-mode uncertainty. To capture this coupling and uncertainty, we introduce MM-Future, a world-action model that generates multiple paired scene-action hypotheses and models bidirectional interaction within each pair. Each hypothesis is initialized from a structured action prior and an independent future scene source, which are then co-evolved through a modality-aware diffusion Transformer. To support efficient multi-mode rollout, MM-Future compresses multi-view video into planning-oriented representations, dubbed MM-Tokens. Finally, a future-conditioned proposal scorer ranks trajectory candidates by shared history context and their paired predicted future. On NAVSIM navtest, MM-Future achieves 94.0 PDMS and 91.5 EPDMS, while attaining a 32.3 HD-Score in zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show consistent improvements over both single-mode and action-only variants, validating the benefit of multi-mode joint world-action modeling.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶涉及多模式不确定性下的耦合决策与场景演化过程。为捕捉该耦合关系与不确定性，本文提出MM-Future，一款世界-动作模型，可生成多组配对的场景-动作假设，并对每组假设内的双向交互进行建模。每个假设由结构化动作先验和独立的未来场景源初始化，随后通过模态感知扩散Transformer实现协同演化。为支持高效的多模式推演，MM-Future将多视角视频压缩为面向规划的表示，命名为MM-Tokens。最后，未来条件化提案评分器基于共享历史上下文及其配对的预测未来对轨迹候选进行排序。在NAVSIM navtest数据集上，MM-Future取得94.0的PDMS指标和91.5的EPDMS指标，同时在HUGSIM上的零样本闭环评估中取得32.3的HD-Score指标。消融实验表明，该模型相比单模式变体和仅动作建模变体均实现了一致提升，验证了多模式联合世界-动作建模的优势。

title: EliGSiR: Continual RGB-D Mapping with Gaussian Splatting under Bounded Compute
title_zh: EliGSiR：有限算力下基于高斯溅射的持续RGB-D建图
authors: Bj\"orn Ellensohn, Elmar Rueckert, Christian Rauch
abstract: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting assumes a closed set of observations and long optimization schedules. Continual RGB-D mapping in contrast poses the problem that new observations arrive online, while previously reconstructed regions must be preserved. We present EliGSiR (Evidence-guided Load-adaptive Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Image Replay), a continual Gaussian mapper that controls how the available optimization budget is used as the reconstruction evolves. Map-Guided View Scheduling filters redundant incoming views and reconsiders retained views according to the current state of the map. Load-Adaptive Fidelity adjusts supervision resolution to the current mapping load instead of following a fixed resolution schedule. Targeted Geometry Growth separates depth supervision from Gaussian creation and adds geometric capacity only where repeated RGB-D observations indicate missing or misplaced structure. Together, these mechanisms adapt which views are optimized, how much image detail is used, and where the representation grows while mapping remains active. We evaluate EliGSiR on Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet++, and real RGB-D sensor sequences, considering both the final reconstruction and the map available throughout acquisition. On TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household, EliGSiR reaches 21.52 dB with the same ground-truth mapping poses used by the controlled baselines, compared with 19.42 dB for SplaTAM. In the tracked-pose comparison, EliGSiR with live ORB-SLAM3 poses reaches 23.02 dB in 155.5 s, compared with 20.10 dB in 230.9 s for CaRtGS using its native tracker. We further evaluate reconstruction throughout acquisition and show how EliGSiR adaptive view scheduling, supervision fidelity, and geometry growth improve the use of the available mapping budget.
summary_zh: 传统3D高斯溅射方法假设观测集是封闭的，且需要长时优化调度。与之相对，持续RGB-D建图面临的问题是新观测在线到达，同时必须保留之前重建的区域。本文提出EliGSiR（证据引导的负载自适应增量高斯溅射与图像重放），一款持续高斯建图器，可在重建过程中控制可用优化预算的使用方式。地图引导视图调度模块过滤冗余的入站视图，并根据当前地图状态重新考虑保留的视图。负载自适应保真度模块根据当前建图负载调整监督分辨率，而非遵循固定的分辨率调度。目标几何增长模块将深度监督与高斯创建过程分离，仅在重复RGB-D观测表明存在缺失或错位结构的位置添加几何容量。上述机制共同调整待优化视图、使用的图像细节量以及表示的增长位置，同时保持建图过程持续运行。本文在Replica、TUM RGB-D、ScanNet++数据集和真实RGB-D传感器序列上对EliGSiR进行评估，同时考虑最终重建结果和采集过程中可用的地图状态。在TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household序列上，使用与对照基线相同的真值建图位姿时，EliGSiR达到21.52 dB，而SplaTAM仅为19.42 dB。在跟踪位姿对比中，使用实时ORB-SLAM3位姿的EliGSiR在155.5秒内达到23.02 dB，而使用原生跟踪器的CaRtGS在230.9秒内仅达到20.10 dB。本文进一步评估了整个采集过程中的重建效果，证明EliGSiR的自适应视图调度、监督保真度和几何增长机制可提升可用建图预算的利用效率。

title: Fast Cross-Strength Multi-Contrast Brain MRI Translation using Latent Bridge Matching
title_zh: 基于潜在桥接匹配的快速跨场强多对比度脑部MRI转换
authors: Siddharth Srivastava, Till Bretschneider
abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) acquired at different field strengths exhibits pronounced variation in noise, resolution, homogeneity, and contrast, which limits comparability across acquisition settings and complicates downstream analysis. We address this with a unified conditional model for controllable field-to-field synthesis, built on the framework of conditional latent bridge matching. Our single model achieves highly competitive results across the validation phase for all three tasks of the MRIxFields2026 challenge without task-specific architectures or training. We achieve fast generation with only a single inference step, producing all modality and field-strength combinations for $30$ axial slices in under $90$ seconds, as well as cross-modality-strength translation for a full volume in under $70$ seconds, on a single NVIDIA A5000 GPU. We further provide extensive ablations regarding different components of our solution. Code: https://gitlab.com/siddharthsrivastava/mrixfields-2026
summary_zh: 不同场强下采集的磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）在噪声、分辨率、均匀度和对比度方面存在显著差异，限制了不同采集设置下结果的可比性，给下游分析带来困难。本文基于条件潜在桥接匹配框架，构建了统一的条件模型，实现可控的场强到场强合成。本文的单个模型在MRIxFields2026挑战赛全部三个任务的验证阶段均取得极具竞争力的结果，无需针对特定任务设计架构或训练策略。该方法仅需单步推理即可实现快速生成，在单张NVIDIA A5000 GPU上，生成30个轴向切片的所有模态和场强组合耗时不足90秒，完成全容积跨模态-场强转换耗时不足70秒。本文还针对解决方案的不同组件开展了全面的消融实验。代码地址：https://gitlab.com/siddharthsrivastava/mrixfields-2026

title: FreqDINO++: A Frequency-Guided Multi-Task Routing Vision Foundation Model for Universal Ultrasound Analysis
title_zh: FreqDINO++：面向通用超声分析的频率引导多任务路由视觉基础模型
authors: Qing Xu, Yixuan Zhang, Yue Li, Xiangjian He, Qian Zhang, Mainul Haque, Rong Qu, Wenting Duan, Jieyun Bai, Zhen Chen
abstract: Ultrasound image analysis plays a crucial role in cancer screening and prenatal diagnosis, yet comprehensive assessment requires jointly addressing tasks such as lesion segmentation and benign-malignant classification. While recent vision foundation models have shown remarkable universal representations, unlocking their potential for ultrasound is bottlenecked by the considerable domain gap from natural images. Existing methods typically fine-tune heavy vision encoders for isolated tasks, incurring substantial computational overhead while overlooking the underlying commonalities across heterogeneous tasks. In this work, we propose FreqDINO++, a frequency-guided multi-task routing vision foundation model for universal ultrasound analysis. We first introduce a Multi-task Routing Adapter (MR-Adapter) to support parameter-efficient integration of task-common and task-specific knowledge, a Frequency-aware Feature Enhancer (F$^2$-Enhancer) is then designed to capture the rich multi-scale frequency characteristics of ultrasound images, and a Task-aligned Collaborative Decoder (TC-Decoder) is devised to promote collaboration between dense and global prediction tasks through global-local token interaction. Extensive experiments on large-scale multi-task and external single-task ultrasound benchmarks demonstrate that FreqDINO++ consistently outperforms strong baselines and recent foundation models across 27 diverse clinical task scenarios, while also showing promising generalization to unseen data. The code is at https://github.com/MingLang-FD/FreqDINO-Plus.
