summary_zh: 超声图像分析在癌症筛查和产前诊断中发挥着关键作用，而综合评估需要同时解决病灶分割、良恶性分类等多项任务。尽管近期视觉基础模型已展现出优异的通用表示能力，但自然图像与超声图像之间的显著域差限制了其在超声场景下的潜力释放。现有方法通常针对孤立任务微调重型视觉编码器，不仅产生巨大的计算开销，还忽略了异构任务间的潜在共性。本文提出FreqDINO++，一款面向通用超声分析的频率引导多任务路由视觉基础模型。首先引入多任务路由适配器（Multi-task Routing Adapter, MR-Adapter），支持任务共性知识和任务特性知识的参数高效集成；随后设计频率感知特征增强器（F²-Enhancer），捕捉超声图像丰富的多尺度频率特征；最后提出任务对齐协作解码器（Task-aligned Collaborative Decoder, TC-Decoder），通过全局-局部令牌交互促进密集预测任务与全局预测任务之间的协作。在大规模多任务和外部单任务超声基准上的大量实验表明，FreqDINO++在27个不同临床任务场景下的表现始终优于强基线模型和近期的基础模型，同时对未见过的数据也展现出良好的泛化能力。代码地址：https://github.com/MingLang-FD/FreqDINO-Plus.

title: AgriScope: Pixel-Grounded Multimodal Understanding for Agricultural Images
title_zh: AgriScope：面向农业图像的像素级 grounded 多模态理解
authors: Abderrahmene Boudiaf, Mohamad Alanssari, Irfan Hussain, Sajid Javed
abstract: Agricultural image understanding requires fine-grained recognition of plant diseases, pests, crop structures, and botanical species under complex real-world conditions. Despite recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing models remain limited to text-only outputs and lack pixel-level visual grounding capabilities. In this work, we introduce AgriScope, a unified pixel-grounded multimodal framework for agricultural image understanding. AgriScope jointly supports image-level, region-level, and pixel-level understanding within a unified framework, enabling tasks such as grounded caption generation, referring expression segmentation, and multi-turn multimodal interaction for agricultural imagery. AgriScope integrates biologically specialized semantic representations with dense spatial grounding through biological-semantic encoding, dense spatial representations, and pixel decoding. To support large-scale grounded learning, we introduce AgriGround, a large-scale pixel-grounded agricultural multimodal instruction-tuning dataset containing over 500K images and 11M instruction-following samples spanning plant disease analysis, crop and weed identification, insect pest recognition, and fine-grained botanical understanding. AgriGround is constructed through a multi-stage automatic annotation pipeline that integrates multimodal caption generation, phrase-level grounding, segmentation mask generation, and task-oriented instruction synthesis to produce densely grounded supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple agricultural vision-language tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of AgriScope in pixel-grounded multimodal understanding, establishing a strong benchmark for agricultural vision-language learning and visual grounding. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at (https://github.com/boudiafA/AgriScope)
summary_zh: 农业图像理解需要在复杂真实场景下对植物病虫害、作物结构和植物物种进行细粒度识别。尽管多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）近期取得了诸多进展，但现有模型仍局限于纯文本输出，缺乏像素级视觉 grounded 能力。本文提出AgriScope，一款面向农业图像理解的统一像素级 grounded 多模态框架。AgriScope在统一框架内同时支持图像级、区域级和像素级理解，可实现 grounded 字幕生成、指代表达分割以及面向农业图像的多轮多模态交互等任务。AgriScope通过生物语义编码、密集空间表示和像素解码模块，将植物学专属语义表示与密集空间 grounded 能力相集成。为支持大规模 grounded 学习，本文构建了AgriGround，一个大规模像素级 grounded 农业多模态指令调优数据集，包含超过50万张图像和1100万条指令遵循样本，覆盖植物病害分析、作物与杂草识别、害虫识别以及细粒度植物学理解任务。AgriGround通过多阶段自动标注流水线构建，集成多模态字幕生成、短语级grounding、分割掩码生成和面向任务的指令合成，可生成密集标注的监督数据。在多个农业视觉-语言任务上的大量实验证明了AgriScope在像素级 grounded 多模态理解任务上的有效性，为农业视觉-语言学习和视觉grounding建立了优质基准。数据集和代码将公开于：https://github.com/boudiafA/AgriScope

title: LLM-Guided Transformation of Non-Critical Driving Scenes into Safety-Critical Scenarios Using Augmented Reality
title_zh: 基于增强现实的大语言模型引导非关键驾驶场景向安全关键场景转换方法
authors: Noura Fady, Farah Khaled, Catherine M. Elias
abstract: Testing Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) requires realistic safety-critical scenarios, but collecting such data from real-world driving is costly and unsafe. This paper presents an automated pipeline that transforms safe driving scenes into safety-critical scenarios by combining computer vision, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Augmented Reality (AR). The system detects and tracks road users, extracts safety features including distance, velocity, motion direction, and Time-to-Collision (TTC), and assesses scene criticality. Safe scenes are modified by an LLM, which generates realistic collision-inducing objects and behaviors that are integrated into the original scene using AR. The proposed pipeline was evaluated on the nuScenes dataset, achieving 97.52% safety classification accuracy and successfully generating realistic scenarios such as pedestrian crossings, rear overtaking vehicles, and sudden-stop events. The results demonstrate an effective and flexible approach for automated generation of safety-critical scenarios to support the testing and validation of autonomous driving systems.
summary_zh: 测试自动驾驶系统（Autonomous Driving Systems, ADS）需要真实的安全关键场景，但从真实驾驶场景中采集这类数据成本高昂且存在安全风险。本文提出一套自动化流水线，结合计算机视觉、大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）和增强现实（Augmented Reality, AR）技术，将安全驾驶场景转换为安全关键场景。该系统检测并跟踪道路参与者，提取距离、速度、运动方向和碰撞时间（Time-to-Collision, TTC）等安全特征，评估场景关键度。大语言模型对安全场景进行修改，生成符合真实逻辑的可引发碰撞的对象和行为，再通过AR技术将其集成到原始场景中。所提出的流水线在nuScenes数据集上完成评估，安全场景分类准确率达到97.52%，可成功生成行人横穿、后方车辆超车、紧急停车等真实场景。结果表明，该方法可高效灵活地自动生成安全关键场景，为自动驾驶系统的测试与验证提供支撑。

title: TinyCNN: A 193K-Parameter Network for On-Device Plant Disease Detection, with a Cross-Dataset Robustness Diagnosis
title_zh: TinyCNN：面向端侧植物病害检测的19.3万参数网络及跨数据集鲁棒性诊断
authors: Ngoc-Bao Ho-Lam, Thai-Anh Nguyen
abstract: Detecting crop disease early is central to sustainable agriculture and food security under United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 2 (Zero Hunger), and is especially urgent in resource-constrained regions where expert diagnosis is scarce but low-cost mobile devices are widespread. This paper presents TinyCNN, a lightweight convolutional neural network for on-device plant disease classification. TinyCNN uses depthwise separable convolution blocks and contains only 193,190 trainable parameters with 110.05M MACs for a 224x224 input image. On the 38-class PlantVillage benchmark, TinyCNN achieves 98.88% test accuracy and 98.03% macro-F1 while being approximately 58x smaller than ResNet18 and 11.8x smaller than a MobileNetV2 teacher, directly reducing the energy, memory, and cost footprint of inference in line with Green AI principles. The paper further analyzes vanilla knowledge distillation as a sustainable model-compression strategy; an ablation over alpha in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} and T in {2, 4} selects alpha=0.3, T=4, producing a distilled TinyCNN with 98.81% test accuracy. Finally, cross-dataset evaluation from PlantVillage to PlantDoc reveals a substantial robustness gap under real-world conditions, which a Grad-CAM analysis attributes to off-leaf, background-driven attention consistent with shortcut learning. TinyCNN is thus an energy-efficient, deployable building block for sustainable agricultural intelligence, while field robustness remains the key barrier to durable real-world impact.
summary_zh: 作物病害早期检测是落实联合国可持续发展目标2（零饥饿）、实现可持续农业和保障粮食安全的核心环节，在专家诊断资源稀缺但低成本移动设备普及的资源受限地区尤为迫切。本文提出TinyCNN，一款用于端侧植物病害分类的轻量级卷积神经网络。TinyCNN采用深度可分离卷积块，仅包含193190个可训练参数，针对224×224输入图像的运算量仅为110.05M次乘加运算。在38类PlantVillage基准数据集上，TinyCNN的测试准确率达到98.88%，宏F1值达到98.03%，其模型体积约为ResNet18的1/58，MobileNetV2教师模型的1/11.8，符合绿色AI理念，直接降低了推理过程的能耗、内存占用和成本开销。本文进一步分析了作为可持续模型压缩策略的普通知识蒸馏方法，在参数alpha∈{0.3,0.5,0.7}和参数T∈{2,4}范围内开展消融实验，选定alpha=0.3、T=4的配置，得到的蒸馏后TinyCNN测试准确率可达98.81%。最后，从PlantVillage到PlantDoc的跨数据集评估表明，真实场景下模型存在显著的鲁棒性差距，Grad-CAM分析显示该差距源于叶片外、背景主导的注意力机制，符合捷径学习特征。因此TinyCNN是面向可持续农业智能的高能效、可部署基础组件，而场景鲁棒性仍是其实现长期实际价值的核心障碍。

title: Queries Knew More Than We Thought: Uncovering Latent Knowledge in Segmentation Models
title_zh: 查询的潜力远超预期：挖掘分割模型中的潜在知识
authors: Ignacio M. De la Jara, Cristian Rodriguez-Opazo, Damith Ranasinghe
abstract: Modern segmenters often fail after the expensive computation has already been done: a useful mask is present among the model's query-conditioned candidates, but the deployed selection rule does not expose it. We study this output-selection bottleneck in frozen DETR-family models. A ground-truth-only oracle first shows substantial hidden headroom in already-computed mask proposals. This raises a simple question: How can we better use the masks a segmenter has already computed but does not expose? We then ask whether that headroom can be recovered without adding queries, generating new masks, rerunning the backbone, or updating weights. HYDRA is a small selector trained only on cached frozen outputs. At inference time, it scores the cached candidates against an explicit keep-baseline option and acts only when a held-out calibrated margin indicates the selected candidate is sufficiently better. Trained on training-split caches and calibrated on held-out data, HYDRA improves Mask2Former, MaskDINO, and OneFormer by up to +7.41 dataset mIoU points on ADE20k and COCO, and improves SAM 3 by +9.4 class-macro prompt-IoU points on average across eight domains while preserving useful predictions through calibration. Paired LoRA controls show that lightweight weight adaptation does not remove the bottleneck: exposed predictions are often flat or worse, while routing over the adapted candidates still recovers accuracy. Finally, we connect the effect to query specialization under bipartite matching and verify it in a controlled TinyDETR study. These results show that frozen segmenters should be evaluated not only by the masks they expose, but also by the useful candidates they suppress.
summary_zh: 现代分割器往往在完成高成本计算后仍出现性能失效：模型基于查询生成的候选结果中存在可用掩码，但部署时采用的选择规则无法将其筛选出来。本文针对冻结状态下的DETR（检测Transformer）家族模型，研究这一输出选择瓶颈问题。首先，仅使用真值的先知实验表明，已计算得到的掩码候选结果中存在大量未被利用的潜在性能空间。这引出了一个核心问题：我们如何更好地利用分割器已经计算完成、却未被输出的掩码？随后本文探究是否无需新增查询、生成新掩码、重新运行骨干网络或更新权重，即可释放这部分潜在性能空间。本文提出HYDRA（仅在缓存冻结输出上训练的小型选择器），在推理阶段将缓存候选结果与显式保留基线选项进行打分对比，仅当留出集校准后的余量表明选中候选结果性能足够更优时才执行输出操作。在训练集缓存上完成训练、在留出数据上完成校准后，HYDRA可在ADE20k和COCO数据集上将Mask2Former、MaskDINO、OneFormer的平均交并比（mIoU）指标最高提升7.41个点，在8个域上将SAM 3的类别平均提示交并比（prompt-IoU）平均提升9.4个点，同时通过校准机制保留有效预测。配对LoRA（低秩适配）对照实验表明，轻量级权重适配无法消除该瓶颈：直接输出的预测结果性能往往持平甚至更差，而基于适配后候选结果的路由机制仍可恢复精度。最后，本文将该效应与二分匹配下的查询特化现象相关联，并通过受控的TinyDETR实验进行验证。研究结果表明，评估冻结分割器的性能时，不应仅参考其输出的掩码，还需考虑其未输出的大量有效候选结果。

title: CleanVideo: Adaptive Concept Erasure for Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
title_zh: CleanVideo：面向文本到视频扩散模型的自适应概念擦除方法
authors: Junchi Liao, Hongji Li, Wenrui Zhou, Lijie Hu
abstract: Concept erasure aims to selectively eliminate undesired visual semantics from pre-trained generative models without compromising their general utility. Extending concept erasure from images to video is nontrivial. Target concepts emerge gradually and vary across frames and denoising steps. As a result, fixed interventions may miss the target or introduce blurring, jitter, and content distortion. We propose CleanVideo, a selective erasure framework that performs low-dimensional subspace intervention controlled by a tri-modal gating mechanism. By jointly processing spatiotemporal visual features, timestep signals, and textual semantics, CleanVideo determines where, when, and whether to intervene, steering erased content toward natural surrogate concepts when such surrogates can be clearly defined while preserving non-target content. Experiments on three video diffusion models show that CleanVideo effectively erases target concepts while maintaining visual fidelity and temporal coherence, outperforming existing baselines under frame-level and video-level evaluations and under concept-recovery attacks when the protected pipeline remains intact.
summary_zh: 概念擦除旨在从预训练生成模型中选择性消除不需要的视觉语义，同时不损害模型的通用性能。将概念擦除任务从图像领域扩展到视频领域并非易事：目标概念会逐步出现，且在不同帧和不同去噪步长下存在差异，因此固定干预策略可能无法命中目标，还会引入模糊、抖动和内容失真问题。本文提出CleanVideo，一种由三模态门控机制控制、执行低维子空间干预的选择性擦除框架。通过联合处理时空视觉特征、时间步信号和文本语义，CleanVideo可确定干预的位置、时机以及是否需要执行干预，在可明确定义自然替代概念时将待擦除内容引导至替代概念，同时保留非目标内容。在三个视频扩散模型上开展的实验表明，CleanVideo可有效擦除目标概念，同时保持视觉保真度和时间一致性，在帧级、视频级评估以及概念恢复攻击场景下的表现均优于现有基线方法，且可保证受保护流水线的完整性。

title: AI or Real: Detecting Partially Altered Videos Under Resource-Constrained Environments
title_zh: AI生成还是真实拍摄：资源受限环境下的部分篡改视频检测
authors: Tamoghna Chakraborty, Md Nurul Absur, Sourya Saha, Saptarshi Debroy
abstract: The proliferation of generative video models has shifted the practical detection threat from fully fabricated clips to partially manipulated footages. Although modern detectors achieve strong accuracy using foundation backbones of 400M+ parameters, their resource footprint precludes edge deployment. In this paper, we present a lightweight full-frame detector for partially manipulated AI-generated video, designed for deployment on edge hardware without face-detection preprocessing. The system distills a DINOv2-Base teacher into a frozen MobileNetV3-Small student through a pipeline that combines temperature-annealed soft-label transfer, attention-diversity regularization, frame-level supervision, and a residual feature adapter that conditions ImageNet features for artifact detection. We additionally target two failure modes specific to the partial-manipulation regime: false positives on legitimate scene cuts, addressed through within-video temporal hard negatives; and threshold-level miscalibration on the dominant pure-real class, addressed through calibration-aware sampling. Evaluation on a 55,393-sample spliced test set across fake-frame ratios from 6.2% to 31.2% demonstrates the student model closing 58% of the gap to the DINOv2-Base teacher (AUC 0.766) while running at 3.65 ms per 16-frame clip on RTX A4000 with a 150.4 MB checkpoint compatible with edge-device memory and latency budgets.
summary_zh: 生成式视频模型的普及使得实际检测威胁从完全伪造的视频片段转向部分篡改的视频素材。尽管基于参数量超过4亿的骨干网络构建的现代检测器可实现较高精度，但其资源占用过大，无法部署在边缘设备上。本文提出一种面向部分篡改AI生成视频的轻量级全帧检测器，无需人脸检测预处理即可部署在边缘硬件上。该系统通过融合温度退火软标签迁移、注意力多样性正则化、帧级监督以及针对ImageNet特征做伪影检测适配的残差特征适配器的流水线，将DINOv2-Base教师模型蒸馏为冻结状态的MobileNetV3-Small学生模型。本文还针对部分篡改场景特有的两类失效模式做了优化：通过视频内时序难例样本解决合法场景切换导致的误报问题，通过感知校准采样解决占主导地位的纯真实类别在阈值层面校准失准的问题。在包含55393个样本、伪造帧占比覆盖6.2%~31.2%的拼接测试集上的评估结果表明，学生模型可弥补DINOv2-Base教师模型58%的性能差距（AUC达0.766），在RTX A4000上处理每段16帧视频的速度达3.65ms，生成的150.4MB检查文件可满足边缘设备的内存和延迟预算要求。

title: Generative Verification: Rethinking the Uncertainty Signal for Active Learning of Object Detection
title_zh: 生成式验证：重新审视面向目标检测主动学习的不确定性信号
authors: Licheng Zhang, Zheng Gong
abstract: Nearly every acquisition function for active object detection shares one arrangement, in that the model being improved is also the model being interrogated. We depart from it. In generative verification an independent generative model re-derives the label of a detection from the pixels inside its predicted box, and the disagreement between the two becomes the acquisition signal. Two properties follow from the arrangement itself rather than from any tuning. A displaced box, a box on background and a correct box carrying the wrong label all yield a crop that fails verification, so the failure modes arrive already combined in one scalar and the hand-weighted classification and localization terms of existing criteria are no longer needed. And because the verifier never observes the detector confidence, confidently wrong detections score highest, although a self-derived signal reads them as uninteresting and they are the costliest to leave unlabeled. We build the verifier as a conditional diffusion model whose diffusion target is a label representation rather than an image. Its reverse process is stochastic, so repeated generations return a distribution whose concentration reports how firmly the evidence determines the label, where a classifier returns a single point estimate. On PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO the signal outperforms output-uncertainty, feature-geometry, perturbation and ensemble criteria, gaining about one mAP50 point per round on MS-COCO, with its largest margins in the early rounds where confident detector errors are most common.
summary_zh: 几乎所有面向主动目标检测的获取函数都采用同一架构：待优化的模型同时也是被查询的模型。本文跳出这一范式，提出生成式验证方法：由独立的生成式模型根据预测框内的像素重新推导检测结果的标签，将二者之间的不一致性作为获取信号。该架构本身可带来两个不依赖调优的优良特性：偏移框、背景框以及标签错误的正确框生成的裁剪结果均无法通过验证，因此各类失效模式可被整合为一个标量，无需再对现有准则中的分类项和定位项进行人工加权；同时由于验证器从未获取检测器的置信度信息，置信度高的错误检测结果得分最高，而传统自生成信号会将这类样本判定为低价值样本，这类样本若不标注会带来最高的性能损失。本文将验证器构建为条件扩散模型，其扩散目标为标签表征而非图像，其逆过程具备随机性，因此多次生成可返回一个分布，分布的集中度可反映证据对标签的确定程度，而传统分类器仅能返回单点估计结果。在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO数据集上，该信号的表现优于输出不确定性、特征几何、扰动和集成类准则，在MS-COCO数据集上每轮标注可提升约1个mAP50指标，在置信度高的检测器错误最常出现的前期轮次中优势尤为明显。

title: Distance to Class Prototypes: Active Learning for Object Detection
title_zh: 到类别原型的距离：面向目标检测的主动学习方法
authors: Licheng Zhang, Zheng Gong
abstract: Deploying a deep object detector in a new setting is limited less by architecture than by the cost of annotating data from that setting. Active learning lowers the cost by choosing which images to label, and the choice is only as good as the signal used to score an unlabeled image. That signal is usually the class posterior, which is cheap but poorly calibrated, or the disagreement across several models or several stochastic passes, which is better but multiplies inference over a pool far larger than the labeled set. We propose a signal richer than the posterior yet still read from one forward pass of one network. A supervised contrastive term added to the training objective shapes a per-object embedding space in which distance encodes class membership, and an unlabeled detection is scored by how far it lies from the region occupied by its predicted category, weighted by its confidence. The criterion needs no ensemble, no auxiliary predictor and no repeated inference, and its entire cost is 2.89M parameters, an increase of 8.3% over a bare detector. On PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO it beats the posterior of the same detector in every round in which a selection is made, by up to 1.08% mAP50 against run to run deviations of 0.02% to 0.18%, and it stays competitive with ensemble and Monte Carlo dropout criteria costing three to fifty forward passes per unlabeled image. Experiments use the single-stage detector under which the compared criteria report their results, so that the selection decision is isolated from the strength of the detector.
summary_zh: 在新场景下部署深度目标检测器的瓶颈往往不在于架构，而在于该场景下的数据标注成本。主动学习通过选择需要标注的图像降低成本，而选择的效果完全取决于用于给未标注图像打分的信号质量。现有信号通常分为两类：一类是类别后验概率，成本低但校准效果差；另一类是多个模型或多次随机前向传播的结果差异，效果更好但需要对远大于标注集的候选池执行多次推理。本文提出一种比类别后验信息更丰富、但仅需对单个网络执行单次前向传播即可获取的信号。本文在训练目标中加入监督对比项，塑造出面向每个目标的嵌入空间，该空间中的距离可编码类别归属关系，未标注检测结果的得分由其与预测类别对应区域的距离、结合检测器置信度加权得到。该准则无需集成模型、无需辅助预测器、无需重复推理，整体仅新增289万参数量，相比基础检测器的参数量增幅仅为8.3%。在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO数据集上，该方法在每轮标注中的表现均优于同一检测器输出的类别后验信号，mAP50最高可提升1.08%（远高于0.02%~0.18%的运行间偏差），且性能与需要对每张未标注图像执行3~50次前向传播的集成、蒙特卡洛丢弃法准则相当。实验采用现有对比基准方法通用的单阶段检测器，保证选择决策的性能不受检测器本身强度的干扰。

title: SAGE-Yoga: Multi-Cue Learning for Yoga Pose Classification and Joint-Level Correction
title_zh: SAGE-Yoga：面向瑜伽姿势分类与关节级校正的多线索学习方法
authors: Hung Le Chi, Khanh Minh Huynh, Long Nghia Tran Pham, Tan Phuc Huynh, Trong-Thuan Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran
abstract: Automated yoga analysis requires both accurate pose classification and interpretable feedback on pose execution. However, existing methods often rely on a single visual prediction, struggle to distinguish visually similar poses, and treat pose classification and correction as separate tasks. To address these limitations, we propose SAGE-Yoga, a unified coarse-to-fine framework for yoga pose classification and joint-level correction from a single RGB image. Inspired by how yoga instructors assess posture using multiple complementary cues, SAGE-Yoga first employs a bagging-based ensemble of complementary visual backbones to generate a ranked set of candidate pose classes. Additionally, a margin-based gating mechanism preserves confident visual predictions while invoking geometric verification only for ambiguous cases. Moreover, once the final pose class is determined, SAGE-Yoga retrieves a medoid reference pose and compares the observed joint angles with class-specific distributions to identify misaligned joints. Finally, these deviations are translated into actionable corrective feedback. Empirically, experiments on the Yoga-82 dataset show that the visual ensemble achieves 89.0% Top-1 accuracy, while the complete framework improves performance to 90.7% Top-1 accuracy and 90.1% Macro-F1. These results demonstrate that combining complementary visual evidence with selective geometric verification improves fine-grained pose classification while enabling interpretable, joint-level correction.
summary_zh: 自动化瑜伽分析需要同时实现高精度的姿势分类和可解释的姿势执行反馈。但现有方法通常依赖单一视觉预测，难以区分视觉上相似的姿势，且将姿势分类和校正作为两个独立任务处理。针对上述局限，本文提出SAGE-Yoga，一个可从单张RGB图像中同时完成瑜伽姿势分类和关节级校正的统一由粗到细框架。受瑜伽教练使用多类互补线索评估姿势的思路启发，SAGE-Yoga首先采用基于Bagging的互补视觉骨干集成生成排序后的候选姿势类别集合；其次，基于余量的门控机制可保留置信度高的视觉预测结果，仅对模糊案例调用几何验证；在确定最终姿势类别后，SAGE-Yoga检索该类别的中值参考姿势，将观测到的关节角度与类别专属分布做对比，识别出未对齐的关节，最终将偏差转化为可执行的校正反馈。在Yoga-82数据集上的实验结果表明，视觉集成模块的Top-1精度可达89.0%，完整框架的Top-1精度可达90.7%，宏F1值可达90.1%。结果表明，结合互补视觉证据与选择性几何验证，可在提升细粒度姿势分类性能的同时，输出可解释的关节级校正建议。

title: Scene-Q: Confidence-Aware Coarse-to-Fine Querying of 3D Scenes with Selective VLM Reasoning
title_zh: Scene-Q：结合选择性视觉语言模型推理的置信度感知3D场景由粗到细查询框架
authors: Juno Kim, Yesol Park, Hye-Jung Yoon, Byoung-Tak Zhang
abstract: Indoor mobile robots require open-vocabulary scene understanding that grounds natural-language queries in a consistent 3D map. Many existing systems ultimately rely on cosine-similarity retrieval with contrastive image--text encoders, which is efficient but brittle when labels are near-synonymous or multiple similar instances appear. We present Scene-Q, a confidence-aware coarse-to-fine querying framework that normalizes encoder scores with temperature scaling and selectively invokes a reasoning VLM only for low-confidence cases. High-confidence queries are answered by fast retrieval, while ambiguous ones are reranked over a small top-K candidate set using the original multi-view images and instance bounding boxes, enabling context-aware disambiguation at low cost. Scene-Q improves open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation on ScanNet200 and natural-language 3D instance retrieval on real-world reconstructions, with the largest gains on spatial and relational queries while keeping a substantial fraction of queries on the fast path.
summary_zh: 室内移动机器人需要具备开放词汇场景理解能力，可将自然语言查询映射到一致的3D地图中。现有多数系统最终依赖对比图文编码器的余弦相似度检索，该方案效率高，但在标签为近义词或存在多个相似实例时鲁棒性较差。本文提出Scene-Q，一种置信度感知的由粗到细查询框架，通过温度缩放对编码器得分做归一化处理，仅对低置信度案例选择性调用具备推理能力的VLM（视觉语言模型）。高置信度查询通过快速检索返回结果，模糊查询则基于原始多视图图像和实例边界框在Top-K小候选集上做重排序，以较低成本实现感知上下文的歧义消解。Scene-Q可提升ScanNet200数据集上的开放词汇3D实例分割性能，以及真实场景重建下的自然语言3D实例检索性能，在空间类和关系类查询上的性能提升最为显著，同时可保证大部分查询通过快速路径完成处理。

title: A Two-Stage Multi-Scale Attention-Based Network for Weakly Supervised Cataract Fundus Image Enhancement
title_zh: 面向弱监督白内障眼底图像增强的两阶段多尺度注意力网络
authors: Xiaoyong Fang, Yue Wang, Xiangyu Li, Wanshu Fan, Dongsheng Zhou
abstract: Cataract is a major cause of vision loss and hinders further diagnosis. However, cataract fundus image enhancement often grapples with challenges such as limited paired cataract retinal images and insufficient recovery of fine details in the retinal images. To mitigate these challenges, we in this paper propose a two-stage multi-scale attention-based network (TSMSA-Net) for weakly supervised cataract fundus image enhancement. Our TSMSA-Net leverages the domain transformation to synthesis paired real-like cataract images, solving the problem of difficult acquisition of paired images. To further extract detailed information from fundus images and reduce the generation of artifacts during the enhancement process, we propose a multi-scale attention-based stage to learn more useful features for cataract image enhancement. Experimental results on Kaggle and ODIR-5K demonstrate that our TSMSA-Net outperforms current state-of-the-art cataract fundus images enhancement even without paired images and exhibits certain generalization ability. Experimental results on Kaggle and ODIR-5K datasets indicate that our TSMSA-Net outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods for cataract fundus image enhancement, even in the absence of paired images. Additionally, it demonstrates a certain level of generalization capability. The enhancement also can improve the performance of vessel segmentation and classification in cataract images.
summary_zh: 白内障是导致视力损伤的主要诱因，会阻碍后续眼科诊断的开展。但白内障眼底图像增强任务长期面临配对白内障视网膜图像数量不足、视网膜图像细节恢复不充分等挑战。为解决上述问题，本文提出TSMSA-Net（两阶段多尺度注意力网络），用于弱监督场景下的白内障眼底图像增强。TSMSA-Net利用域变换合成类真实白内障配对图像，解决了配对图像难以获取的问题。为进一步提取眼底图像的细节信息、减少增强过程中的伪影生成，本文设计了基于多尺度注意力的子阶段，学习更多适用于白内障图像增强的有效特征。在Kaggle和ODIR-5K数据集上的实验结果表明，即使不使用配对图像，TSMSA-Net的表现也优于当前最先进的白内障眼底图像增强方法，具备一定的泛化能力。经增强后的图像还可提升白内障图像的血管分割和分类任务性能。

title: VLN on the Fly: An Onboard Vision-Language Navigation Stack for Aerial Robots
title_zh: VLN on the Fly：面向空中机器人的机载视觉语言导航系统栈
authors: Marco S. Tayar, Felipe Tommaselli, Gianluca Capezutto, Pedro Antonio Rabelo Saraiva, Pedro H. V. de Freitas, Lucas Kido, Guilherme Sonego, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker
abstract: Running vision-language navigation fully onboard an aerial robot is hard, since grounding, planning, and control must share limited compute and a single-stage error is difficult to isolate in flight. End-to-end aerial policies fuse these stages into one network, giving up the observability and safety checks a modular stack keeps available. We propose VLN on the Fly, an onboard stack that keeps grounding, planning, and control as separate, inspectable stages. A quantized VLM grounds an instruction to a coarse image cell, depth lifts it to a 3D goal, a fast B-spline planner returns a feasible trajectory, and a pretrained reinforcement learning policy tracks it to motor commands across quadrotors. Across 15 onboard flights over three everyday referents in a controlled indoor volume, the stack reaches the target in 13 of 15 trials with 5.72 cm mean goal error and 39.3% average GPU utilization. In 6 additional cluttered-environment trials, the stack tracks collision-free trajectories under onboard perception gating.
summary_zh: 在空中机器人上完全机载运行视觉语言导航（VLN）任务难度极高： grounding（语义映射）、规划、控制模块需要共享有限的计算资源，且飞行过程中难以隔离单阶段错误。端到端空中策略将上述阶段融合为单个网络，舍弃了模块化系统栈具备的可观测性和安全校验能力。本文提出VLN on the Fly，一种机载系统栈，将语义映射、规划、控制保留为独立可检查的阶段。量化后的VLM（视觉语言模型）将指令映射到粗粒度图像单元格，通过深度信息将其提升为3D目标，快速B样条规划器返回可行轨迹，预训练强化学习策略跟踪轨迹并将其转化为四旋翼可执行的电机指令。在受控室内场景下针对3类日常参照物开展的15次全机载飞行实验中，该系统栈在15次实验里有13次成功抵达目标，平均目标误差为5.72cm，GPU平均利用率为39.3%。在额外6次杂乱环境实验中，该系统栈可在机载感知门控机制下跟踪无碰撞轨迹。

title: MoSSGate: Memory-Modulated State-Space Gating for Skin Lesion Segmentation
title_zh: MoSSGate：面向皮肤病变分割的内存调制状态空间门控模块
authors: Anum Awan, Mahnoor Buriro, Muhammad Younas Khan, Md Imam Ahasan
abstract: Accurate skin lesion segmentation is crucial for reliable computer-aided dermatological diagnosis, yet existing convolutional and transformer-based models often struggle to jointly capture long-range spatial dependencies and fine boundary details under limited computational budgets. This trade-off between global context modeling and boundary-aware localization frequently leads to over-segmentation, fragmented predictions, or missing thin peripheral structures. To address this challenge, we propose MoSSGate, a plug-and-play module for U-Net that integrates (i) boundary-aware spatial gating to restrict long-range propagation to informative regions, (ii) an external memory modulator that provides sample-adaptive dynamic control, and (iii) parallel 2D state-space modeling for efficient global context aggregation with linear complexity. The proposed design enables adaptive, context-aware information propagation while preserving sharp and accurate lesion boundaries. Extensive experiments on the ISIC 2017 and ISIC 2018 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy with strong efficiency, achieving 86.3% and 85.9% mIoU and 92.6% and 90.6% Dice, respectively, while requiring substantially fewer FLOPs than most competing CNN-based methods. These results highlight a favorable accuracy efficiency trade-off for high-resolution medical image segmentation.
summary_zh: 高精度皮肤病变分割是可靠的计算机辅助皮肤科诊断的基础，但现有卷积和Transformer模型在有限计算预算下往往难以同时捕获长程空间依赖关系和精细边界细节。全局上下文建模和边界感知定位之间的权衡问题，经常导致过分割、预测结果碎片化或遗漏边缘薄层结构等问题。针对该挑战，本文提出MoSSGate，一种可直接插入U-Net的即插即用模块，集成三类设计：（1）边界感知空间门控，将长程传播限制在信息丰富的区域；（2）外部内存调制器，提供样本自适应动态控制能力；（3）并行2D状态空间建模，以线性复杂度实现高效全局上下文聚合。该设计可实现自适应、感知上下文的信息传播，同时保留清晰准确的病变边界。在ISIC 2017和ISIC 2018基准上开展的大量实验表明，该模块兼具顶尖精度和高推理效率，两个数据集上的mIoU分别达86.3%和85.9%，Dice系数分别达92.6%和90.6%，所需的浮点运算量远低于多数对比的CNN方法，在高精度医学图像分割任务上实现了优异的精度-效率权衡。

title: MTF-Net: Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network for Pedestrian Intention Prediction
title_zh: MTF-Net：用于行人意图预测的多模态时序特征融合网络
authors: Md Mahfuzur Rahman, Pengzhan Zhou, A. F. M. Abdun Noor, Md Imam Ahasan, Md Mustafizur Rahman, Fang Qu
abstract: Accurately predicting pedestrian intentions is crucial for ensuring safe and proactive interaction between autonomous vehicles and pedestrians. However, existing approaches often depend on architectures that either model temporal dependencies within individual modalities or fuse modalities only at coarse semantic levels. To address these limitations, we propose MTF-Net, a novel Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network that jointly models kinematic, appearance, and contextual cues for pedestrian intention prediction. MTF-Net integrates four complementary modalities-bounding-box dynamics, human pose keypoints, local context, and scene-level semantics within a recurrent fusion framework enhanced by gated linear units (GLUs). These GLU-based modules adaptively regulate cross-modal information flow, enabling interpretable and efficient feature interaction across temporal scales. Through three dedicated temporal encoding branches and an attention-guided fusion head, the proposed model robustly anticipates pedestrian crossing intentions several frames before they occur. Extensive evaluations on the PIE and JAAD benchmarks demonstrate that MTF-Net surpasses recent transformer- and graph-based models, achieving up to 0.95 AUC on PIE and 0.94 AUC on JAAD, while maintaining real-time performance. The results highlight that reliable pedestrian intention prediction arises from principled multi-modal fusion rather than excessive architectural complexity.
summary_zh: 准确预测行人意图是保障自动驾驶车辆与行人之间安全主动交互的核心前提。现有方法通常依赖两类架构：一类仅对单模态内的时序依赖关系建模，另一类仅在粗粒度语义层级完成模态融合，两类方案均存在明显局限。为解决上述问题，本文提出MTF-Net——一种全新的多模态时序特征融合网络，可联合建模运动学、外观与上下文三类线索以实现行人意图预测。MTF-Net在由门控线性单元（Gated Linear Units, GLUs）增强的循环融合框架内整合了四类互补模态：边界框动态、人体姿态关键点、局部上下文与场景级语义。基于GLU的模块可自适应调控跨模态信息流，实现跨时间尺度下可解释且高效的特征交互。通过三个专用时序编码分支与注意力引导的融合头，该模型可在行人横穿意图发生前数帧就完成鲁棒预测。在PIE与JAAD基准数据集上的大量评估结果表明，MTF-Net性能超越近年提出的基于Transformer与图的相关模型，在PIE数据集上的AUC（曲线下面积）可达0.95，在JAAD数据集上可达0.94，同时可保持实时运算性能。研究结果表明，可靠的行人意图预测源于合理的多模态融合设计，而非过度复杂的架构堆叠。

title: Needles in a Raystack: Ultra-Sparse LiDAR Occupancy Detection for Bat Tracks
title_zh: 射线堆中的细针：面向蝙蝠航迹的超稀疏激光雷达占用检测
authors: Nico Klar, Pankaj Rana, Nizam Gifary, Jakob Traub, Aamir Ahmad
abstract: In real LiDAR recordings of bats over open fields, cross-checked with acoustic monitoring, a reconstruction-based 3D convolutional autoencoder baseline fails to recover foreground trajectories. In contrast, the proposed U-Net recovers sparse foreground occupancy in diagnostic experiments and produces coherent occupancy patterns along bat flight trajectories, providing a practical basis for validation-scale experiments, later clustering of flight tracks, and future integration of bat activity information into biodiversity-aware turbine curtailment strategies.
summary_zh: 在野外场景下采集的真实蝙蝠激光雷达记录中，经声学监测交叉验证后发现，基于重建的3D卷积自encoder基线模型无法恢复前景轨迹。与之相比，本文提出的U-Net在验证实验中可恢复稀疏前景占用信息，沿蝙蝠飞行轨迹生成连贯的占用模式，为验证级实验、后续飞行航迹聚类，以及未来将蝙蝠活动信息纳入兼顾生物多样性的风机减载策略提供了实用基础。

title: Ischemic Stroke Segmentation and Net Water Uptake Quantification on Multicenter Non-Contrast CT Using Supervised Target-Domain Adaptation
title_zh: 基于监督目标域适配的多中心非增强CT缺血性卒中分割与净水摄取量化
authors: Linus Britt, Maximilian Nielsen, Susan Klapproth, Andre Kemmling, Michael H. Lev, Gabriel Broocks, Rene Werner, Thilo Sentker
abstract: Conclusion: Target-domain adaptation supported NCCT-only infarct segmentation across heterogeneous external cohorts, although performance varied across domains. The approach enabled low-error NWU quantification from baseline NCCT without advanced imaging, supporting further prospective clinical evaluation.
summary_zh: 研究结论：目标域适配技术支持仅使用非增强CT（Non-Contrast CT, NCCT）在异质外部队列中完成梗死灶分割，尽管不同域下的模型性能存在差异。该方法无需高级成像手段，即可从基线NCCT图像中实现低误差的净水摄取（Net Water Uptake, NWU）量化，可为后续前瞻性临床评估提供支撑。

title: Task-Oriented Semantic Feature Transmission for Multi-Task Satellite Remote Sensing over Low-SNR Channels
title_zh: 低信噪比信道下面向多任务卫星遥感的任务导向型语义特征传输
authors: Shuoyuan Sun, Hongyu Wang, Mugen Peng, Wenjia Xu
abstract: Conventional satellite remote sensing transmission follows a reconstruct-then-infer paradigm that optimizes pixel-level fidelity, creating an objective mismatch with downstream tasks such as classification and detection, especially at low SNR. This paper investigates a task-oriented framework that bypasses image reconstruction and directly transmits semantic features extracted by a multitask-pretrained backbone. A lightweight channel adaptation module (CAM) compresses feature dimensionality for bandwidth reduction, and a feature restorer recovers task-relevant structure after channel corruption. With the backbone frozen, the CAM and task-specific downstream heads are jointly optimized with task and feature-level supervision under random-SNR training. Under the adopted AWGN setting, experiments on scene classification and object detection show consistent gains over reconstruction-oriented JSCC baselines across different SNR conditions, with the largest improvements in the low-SNR regime.
summary_zh: 传统卫星遥感传输遵循“先重建、后推理”的范式，以优化像素级保真度为目标，与分类、检测等下游任务存在目标 mismatch，在低信噪比（SNR）场景下该问题尤为突出。本文提出一种任务导向型框架，跳过图像重建步骤，直接传输经多任务预训练骨干网络提取的语义特征。其中轻量级信道适配模块（Channel Adaptation Module, CAM）通过压缩特征维度降低带宽占用，特征恢复器则在信道引入干扰后恢复与任务相关的特征结构。骨干网络参数保持冻结的前提下，在随机信噪比训练设置下对CAM与各任务专属下游头进行联合优化，同时施加任务级与特征级监督。在采用的加性高斯白噪声（AWGN）设置下，场景分类与目标检测实验结果表明，该方法在不同信噪比条件下的性能均优于面向重建的联合信源信道编码（JSCC）基线模型，在低信噪比区间下的性能提升幅度最为显著。

title: Bridging Modalities on the Cortex: Surface-based MRI to PET Translation with a Diffusion Bridge
title_zh: 皮层上的模态桥接：基于表面的MRI通过扩散桥实现PET图像转换
authors: Yitong Li, Alexandra Samoylova, Fabian Bongratz, Timo Grimmer, Dennis M. Hedderich, Igor Yakushev, Christian Wachinger
abstract: Cortical hypometabolism measured by Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography (FDG-PET) is a highly sensitive biomarker for dementia diagnosis. However, high costs, radiation exposure, and limited accessibility constrain its clinical utility. While cross-modal synthesis from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers a promising alternative, existing volumetric generation methods do not explicitly account for the highly folded cortical geometry, where disease-related patterns predominantly reside. To address this, we introduce a novel surface-based diffusion bridge framework DB-SUiT for MRI-to-PET translation that operates natively on the cortical manifold. A conditional Spherical U-shaped vision Transformer (SUiT) is specifically designed to model the intricate cross-modal relationships while preserving surface topology. It combines spherical convolutional encoders for multi-scale surface feature extraction with bottleneck Transformers to capture long-range spatial dependencies, while incorporating demographic and subcortical conditions to refine the synthesis. Evaluated on two datasets, including subjects with different dementia types, DB-SUiT demonstrates high-fidelity synthesis that substantially outperforms other baselines. In automated dementia classification, synthesized PET surfaces improve performance over MRI by 14.2% and PET volumes by 11.3%, approaching the performance of real PET surfaces. In a blinded reader study, synthetic PET achieved 85.5% diagnostic accuracy, compared with 75.8% for MRI and 95.2% for real PET. This further demonstrates cross-cohort and cross-pathology generalization, as the model was evaluated without retraining on an external cohort that included a dementia subtype not represented during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT.
summary_zh: 经氟代脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描（FDG-PET）测得的皮质低代谢是痴呆诊断的高灵敏度生物标志物。但该技术成本高、存在辐射暴露、可及性有限，制约了其临床应用。从磁共振成像（MRI）实现跨模态合成是极具潜力的替代方案，但现有体素生成方法未明确考虑高度折叠的皮质几何结构——而疾病相关特征主要分布在该结构上。针对该问题，本文提出一种全新的基于表面的扩散桥框架DB-SUiT，用于在皮质流形上原生实现MRI到PET的转换。本文专门设计了条件球面U型视觉Transformer（SUiT），可在保留表面拓扑结构的前提下建模复杂的跨模态关系。该架构结合了用于多尺度表面特征提取的球面卷积编码器与用于捕获长程空间依赖的瓶颈Transformer模块，同时纳入人口统计学与皮质下条件以优化合成效果。在包含不同痴呆类型受试者的两个数据集上开展的评估结果表明，DB-SUiT可实现高保真度合成，性能大幅超越其他基线模型。在自动痴呆分类任务中，合成得到的PET表面相比原始MRI的性能提升14.2%，相比PET体素的性能提升11.3%，性能接近真实PET表面。在双盲阅片研究中，合成PET的诊断准确率达85.5%，对比之下MRI为75.8%，真实PET为95.2%。该模型在未经过重新训练的外部队列（包含训练集中未出现的痴呆亚型）上仍表现出优异的跨队列、跨病理泛化能力。相关代码开源于：https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT。

title: Cross-Modal Attention Acts as a Frequency Filter: Why Verbose Prompts Improve Robustness in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 跨模态注意力充当频率滤波器：为何冗余提示可提升视觉语言模型的鲁棒性
authors: Farooq Ahmad Wani, Maria Sofia Bucarelli, Mujtaba Hussain Mirza, Oleksandr Pryymak, Aryo Pradipta Gema, Iacopo Masi, Pasquale Minervini, Fabrizio Silvestri
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are fragile under image corruption. We find that the wording of the question affects VLMs in two opposite ways. Verbose questions make VLMs substantially more robust---e.g., rephrasing "Is there a cat?" into "Please look carefully and answer: is there a cat?". Conversely, VLMs become more fragile under corruption when the question is semantically complex or finer-grained, e.g., "what colour is the cup left of the chair?" instead of "is there a cup?". Both effects stem from question-conditioned cross-modal attention, which induces a spectral filter over image patches: verbose questions broaden its frequency support, while fine-grained questions concentrate it onto fewer visual scales. The model's answer drifts most when this filter and the corruption sit on the same spatial frequencies. We test the filter view on Qwen3-VL and LLaVA-OneVision across GQA and CLEVR; verbose paraphrasing reduces drift variance by 70--81% on the 8B models. The practical recipe---pad the prompt---further yields measurable gains in accuracy, even under image corruption.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在图像受到干扰时表现十分脆弱。研究发现，提示语的措辞会从两个相反方向影响VLMs的性能：冗余提示可大幅提升VLMs的鲁棒性，例如将“图中有猫吗？”改写为“请仔细观察后回答：图中有猫吗？”；反之，当提示语语义复杂或粒度更细时，例如将“图中有杯子吗？”替换为“椅子左侧的杯子是什么颜色？”，VLMs在图像干扰下会变得更加脆弱。两种效应均源于以提示为条件的跨模态注意力：该注意力会在图像块上生成一个频谱滤波器，冗余提示会拓宽该滤波器的频率支持范围，而细粒度提示会将其集中到更少的视觉尺度上。当该滤波器与图像干扰处于同一空间频率时，模型的输出偏差最大。本文在Qwen3-VL与LLaVA-OneVision模型上、基于GQA与CLEVR数据集开展验证，结果表明冗余提示改写可将8B参数模型的输出偏差方差降低70%~81%。本文提出的实用方案——对提示进行冗余填充，即使在图像存在干扰的场景下也可带来可观测的精度提升。

title: AnyviewMeter: Adapting Robotic Reward Models with Camera Geometry and Multi-View Attention
title_zh: AnyviewMeter：结合相机几何与多视图注意力的机器人奖励模型适配
authors: Yuang Tu, Runjia Tan, Yujie Yan, Jinghan Hu, Chen Lv
abstract: Robotic reward models evaluate task execution from visual observations, but their predictions can change with camera viewpoint and occlusion even when the underlying task state is unchanged. Adapting a pretrained reward model to a local task therefore requires accounting for how that task is observed. We introduce AnyviewMeter, a geometry-conditioned adaptation framework for robotic reward models that represent task progress as a scalar reward signal. It combines low-rank fine-tuning with token-aligned Plucker rays and synchronous block attention: ray conditioning incorporates camera geometry into visual features and attention queries and keys, while block attention fuses synchronized views inside the pretrained decoder. The framework supports both single-view reward prediction and joint multi-view evaluation through parameter-efficient adaptation of a pretrained Robometer model. On PickCube, single-view adaptation improves progress prediction in every camera group and reduces mean absolute error under a changed field of view by approximately 21% relative to RGB fine-tuning. Across simulated manipulation tasks, joint multi-view prediction reduces progress error by 41-69% compared with averaging single-view RGB predictions and improves temporal ordering in approximately 88% of task-camera groups. On real tasks with fixed and wrist-mounted cameras, mean absolute error decreases by approximately 21% relative to averaged RGB fine-tuning. These results support camera geometry and joint visual evidence as useful components of task-specific robotic reward adaptation.
summary_zh: 机器人奖励模型通过视觉观测评估任务执行情况，但即使底层任务状态未发生变化，其预测结果也会随相机视角变化或出现遮挡而改变。因此将预训练奖励模型适配到本地任务时，必须考虑任务的观测方式。本文提出AnyviewMeter——一种面向机器人奖励模型的几何条件适配框架，可将任务进度表征为标量奖励信号。该框架结合了低秩微调、 token对齐的普吕克射线与同步块注意力机制：射线条件化将相机几何信息嵌入视觉特征、注意力查询与键中，块注意力则在预训练解码器内部融合同步视图。该框架通过对预训练Robometer模型进行参数高效适配，同时支持单视图奖励预测与多视图联合评估。在PickCube任务上，单视图适配可提升所有相机组的进度预测精度，在视场变化场景下的平均绝对误差相比RGB微调方案降低约21%。在模拟操纵任务中，多视图联合预测的进度误差相比单视图RGB预测结果取平均的方案降低41%~69%，在约88%的任务-相机组中提升了时序排序准确性。在搭载固定相机与腕部相机的真实任务中，平均绝对误差相比RGB微调结果取平均的方案降低约21%。上述结果表明，相机几何信息与联合视觉证据是面向特定任务的机器人奖励适配的有效组件。

title: A Smaller Transformer in Your Transformer
title_zh: Transformer内嵌小型Transformer
authors: Dhananjay Tomar, Marius Aasan, Andreas Kleppe, Ad\'in Ram\'irez Rivera
abstract: Recent findings indicate that Vision Transformers settle into locally similar computational phases, implying a level of depthwise computational redundancy. However, existing methods to exploit this redundancy either fail to reduce inference compute or severely degrade model expressivity. In this work, we formalise a unified view of block redundancy that decouples the geometry from specific surrogate interventions. We then introduce Transformer-Within-Transformer (TWT), a post-hoc method that fuses contiguous groups of redundant layers into a single learned surrogate layer. TWT reduces parameter count and inference compute while remaining competitive with original models using half the depth on natural images, and in several downstream histopathology settings, TWT matches or even improves on the original baseline.
summary_zh: 近年研究发现，视觉Transformer会进入局部相似的计算阶段，说明其在深度维度存在计算冗余。但现有利用该冗余的方法要么无法降低推理计算量，要么会严重损害模型的表达能力。本文对块冗余的统一视图进行形式化定义，将特征几何与特定代理干预解耦。随后提出Transformer内Transformer（Transformer-Within-Transformer, TWT）——一种后处理方法，可将连续的冗余层组融合为单个可学习代理层。TWT可减少参数量与推理计算量，在自然图像任务上性能与深度为自身两倍的原始模型相当，在多个下游组织病理学任务上，TWT的性能与原始基线模型持平甚至更优。

title: G^2RA-NET: Graph-based Cross-Slice Relation Modeling with Attention Gating for Medical Image Segmentation
title_zh: G²RA-NET：基于图的带注意力门控的医学图像跨切片关系建模分割网络
authors: Shengye Wang, Zonglin Wu, Liang Fan, Yule Xue, Haozhe Zhao
abstract: Medical image segmentation supports quantitative clinical analysis and computer-aided diagnosis. Recent methods for medical image segmentation have improved both local feature representation and volumetric context modeling. However, existing methods still strug- gle to efficiently model cross-slice relations in anisotropic volumet- ric images, limiting segmentation consistency and accuracy. This pa- per proposes G^2RA-Net, a medical image segmentation framework that combines graph-based cross-slice relation modeling with atten- tion gating. Graph-Based Slice Relationship Modeling (GSRM) cap- tures anatomical dependencies across consecutive slices by repre- senting each slice as a graph node and propagating semantic con- text through graph message passing. The Cross-Slice Attention Gate (CSAG) then selects relevant neighboring context and emphasizes target anatomical regions through attention-guided feature modula- tion. Experiments on brain MRI and abdominal CT datasets demon- strate that G^2RA-Net outperforms representative methods in seg- mentation accuracy and boundary quality. Ablation studies further validate the proposed design.
summary_zh: 医学图像分割是临床定量分析与计算机辅助诊断的重要支撑。近年医学图像分割方法在局部特征表征与体上下文建模方面均取得了性能提升，但现有方法仍难以高效建模各向异性体图像中的跨切片关系，制约了分割结果的一致性与精度。本文提出G²RA-Net，一种融合基于图的跨切片关系建模与注意力门控的医学图像分割框架。其中基于图的切片关系建模模块（Graph-Based Slice Relationship Modeling, GSRM）将每个切片表征为图节点，通过图消息传递传播语义上下文，捕获连续切片间的解剖依赖关系；随后跨切片注意力门（Cross-Slice Attention Gate, CSAG）通过注意力引导的特征调制，筛选相关邻域上下文并突出目标解剖区域。在脑部MRI与腹部CT数据集上的实验结果表明，G²RA-Net的分割精度与边界质量均优于代表性对比方法，消融实验进一步验证了各模块设计的有效性。

title: PointEvent: Rethinking Event-based Tiny Object Detection via Serialized Motion Evidence Accumulation
title_zh: PointEvent：基于序列化运动证据累积的事件基小目标检测重构方法
authors: Zongze Wu, Baofeng Jia, Weiqi Yan, Jingyuan Zhang, Yu Zang, Xiaoyu Chen, Jing Han
abstract: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and motion sensitivity for tiny UAV detection, yet distant targets generate sparse and fragmented events that are easily overwhelmed by clutter and ego-motion. Existing methods mainly rely on dense event representations or local sparse spatiotemporal modeling, resulting in redundant computation or fragmented modeling of motion continuity across distant asynchronous events. To address this limitation, we introduce serialized motion evidence accumulation, which treats motion continuity as an ordered evidence propagation process. Specifically, the same event stream is organized into locality-preserving spatiotemporal paths and chronology-preserving temporal paths through the latent complementary serializations. Based on this principle, we propose PointEvent, a lightweight event-wise state-space framework that alternates serialized scans across the complementary orders, progressively consolidating fragmented motion evidence beyond fixed local neighborhoods. A high-resolution event branch preserves fine-grained target responses, while compact context modulation suppresses interference. Experiments demonstrate that PointEvent achieves SOTA with the fewest parameters and fastest measured inference among the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/wzz-z/PointEvent
summary_zh: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率与运动灵敏度，可用于小型无人机检测，但远距离目标生成的事件稀疏且碎片化，极易被背景杂波与自运动干扰掩盖。现有方法大多依赖密集事件表征或局部稀疏时空建模，存在计算冗余或远距离异步事件间运动连续性建模碎片化的问题。针对该局限，本文提出序列化运动证据累积机制，将运动连续性视为有序证据传播过程。具体而言，通过两种互补的潜在序列化方式，将同一事件流组织为保留局部性的时空路径与保留时序性的时间路径。基于该机制，本文提出PointEvent——一种轻量级的逐事件状态空间框架，可在互补的不同顺序下交替执行序列化扫描，在超出固定局部邻域的范围逐步整合碎片化的运动证据。其中高分辨率事件分支保留细粒度目标响应，紧凑上下文调制模块则可抑制干扰。实验结果表明，在所有对比方法中，PointEvent参数量最少、实测推理速度最快，性能达到当前最优水平。相关代码开源于：https://github.com/wzz-z/PointEvent

title: A Free Lunch? Adapting PP-OCRv6 for Historical Text Recognition
title_zh: 免费午餐？面向历史文本识别的PP-OCRv6适配研究
authors: Benjamin Kiessling (ALMAnaCH)
abstract: Despite impressive reported scores, large vision-language models have seen limited practical uptake in historical automatic text recognition because of their computational cost, dependence on large-scale pretraining, and hallucination. Historical ATR therefore continues to rely largely on compact CRNN line recognizers, which are visually grounded and trainable on modest data. Lightweight recurrence-free recognizers promise the accuracy of larger models with the practical advantages of CRNNs, yet have not been comprehensively evaluated on historical writing. We adapt PP-OCRv6, a recent compact text recognizer without strong language modeling, for historical line recognition and compare it with a conventional CRNN across generalized pretraining, domain-specific training, corpus-level fine-tuning, and manuscript-specific few-shot adaptation on multilingual Latin- and Arabic-script material. While PP-OCRv6 does not consistently outperform the baseline when trained from scratch, heterogeneous pretraining produces markedly better generalization. Comparisons with the Qwen3.5-based Medusa recognizer further show that fine-tuned PP-OCRv6 can outperform a large VLM tailored towards historical Latin-script HTR.
summary_zh: 尽管大视觉语言模型在公开测试集上取得了亮眼的得分，但受限于计算成本高、依赖大规模预训练、存在幻觉问题，其在历史自动文本识别（Historical ATR）领域的实际应用十分有限。因此当前历史自动文本识别领域仍主要依赖轻量型CRNN（卷积循环神经网络）行识别器，这类模型具备视觉可解释性，仅需少量数据即可完成训练。无轻量循环结构的识别器有望在保留CRNN实际应用优势的同时，达到更大模型的识别精度，但目前尚未在历史手写文本场景下得到全面评估。本文对近期提出的无强语言建模的紧凑型文本识别器PP-OCRv6进行改造，使其适配历史文本行识别任务，并在多语种拉丁文字与阿拉伯文字数据集上，从通用预训练、领域专属训练、语料级微调、面向手稿的小样本适配四个维度，将其与传统CRNN模型开展对比实验。结果显示，从零训练时PP-OCRv6的表现并未持续优于基线模型，但异质预训练可显著提升其泛化能力。与基于Qwen3.5的Medusa识别器的对比实验进一步表明，经过微调的PP-OCRv6性能可超过针对拉丁文字历史手写文本识别（HTR）定制的大视觉语言模型。

title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
title_zh: Astronex-World 1.0：实时交互式世界模型基础框架
authors: Xin Zhou, Cong Miao
abstract: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 本文提出Astronex-World 1.0，一款开源可控视频世界模型基础框架。给定文本提示（文本转视频）或初始观测图像（图像转视频），该模型可在帧对齐相机轨迹、连续动作、具身标识符的约束下预测未来视觉状态，同时支持在推演过程的指定位置插入文本事件。该模型系列包含两类架构：用于全上下文生成的双向模型，以及基于块因果注意力与跨块KV缓存实现持久生成的因果模型，二者均以Wan2.2-TI2V-5B为预训练基底。其中PRoPE模块注入相机内参与外参，64维动作流对每一层Transformer层进行调制。该模型采用五阶段训练流程：实现双向相机与动作控制、将主干网络转换为块因果生成架构、蒸馏得到少步学生模型、恢复混合域动力学特性、应用非对称DMD/DMD2分布匹配。其因果模型可生成832×480分辨率、24fps的视频。全部五个训练阶段可在2张NVIDIA L20 48GB GPU上运行，因果模型可在单张该类GPU上实现实时流生成。该模型在WBench Navi基准上得分73.5，在WBench Full基准上得分70.0。在WBench Full基准上，该5B参数模型性能超过136亿参数的LongCat-Video与140亿参数的Helios，与220亿参数的LTX-2.3差距不到1分，同时性能优于在相同5B预训练基底上基于NVIDIA A100 GPU后训练得到的YUME 1.5。预留的动作输入输出接口支持后续面向具身智能与自动驾驶任务的后训练。

title: GRF-Recon: Global Ray-Field Optimization for Long-Sequence Feed-forward Reconstruction
title_zh: GRF-Recon：面向长序列前馈重建的全局光线场优化方法
authors: Enpeng Li, Yunzhou Zhang, Zhiyao Zhang, Dexuan Lyu, Chenyu Wang, Chiyuan Cui, Cheng Cheng
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction provides an efficient paradigm for scene modeling from image sequences. Scaling these models to large monocular scenarios are constrained by excessive GPU memory footprint, degraded local geometry, and long-term trajectory drift. Existing chunk-based optimization strategies provide limited geometric constraints and fail to maintain global consistency over extended trajectories. We present a unified framework for stable and scalable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long monocular sequences. Our approach builds on coarse-to-fine trajectory alignment augmented by lightweight geometric prior injection. Distilling monocular geometric cues into the feed-forward backbone via LoRA adaptation improves depth accuracy on fine structures while preserving inference efficiency. We introduce a hybrid-weight sparse ray-field optimization that leverages high-frequency geometric features to guide local point-cloud refinement and enforce consistent inter-frame ray constraints. Unlike prior chunk-based methods, this establishes strong cross-frame geometric coupling while maintaining scalability. Finally, an efficient trajectory stitching strategy with joint ray-error optimization explicitly reduces accumulated drift. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves competitive trajectory accuracy compared with representative SLAM systems, while maintaining globally consistent 3D reconstruction in large-scale scenarios.
summary_zh: 前馈式三维重建为从图像序列开展场景建模提供了高效范式。但这类模型在大规模单目场景下的应用受限于过高的GPU显存占用、局部几何质量退化、长时序轨迹漂移等问题。现有基于分块的优化策略提供的几何约束十分有限，无法在长轨迹上维持全局一致性。本文提出一套面向长单目序列的稳定可扩展前馈三维重建统一框架。该方法基于由粗到细的轨迹对齐架构，辅以轻量级几何先验注入。通过LoRA（低秩适配）将单目几何线索蒸馏到前馈主干网络中，在保留推理效率的同时提升精细结构的深度精度。本文还提出一种混合权重稀疏光线场优化方法，利用高频几何特征引导局部点云优化，强制帧间光线约束保持一致。与此前的分块类方法不同，该方法在保证可扩展性的同时建立了强帧间几何耦合。最后，本文提出一种结合联合光线误差优化的高效轨迹拼接策略，可显式减少累积漂移。大量实验表明，本文提出的方法轨迹精度可与代表性SLAM系统相媲美，同时可在大规模场景下实现全局一致的三维重建。

title: AVTrace: Diagnosing Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning in Omni Models
title_zh: AVTrace：全模态模型的音视频时序推理能力诊断框架
authors: Longyin Zhang, Parth Sakhare Mahendra, Chengwei Wei, Ning Zhang, Lim Ming Chong, Sirui He, Ai Ti Aw
abstract: Omni models can describe video content, but can they locate events in time, preserve event order, and judge audio-visual synchronization? We introduce AVTrace (Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning Assessment and Capability Evaluation), a silver-standard diagnostic suite spanning onset and span grounding, synchronization, next-step prediction, cross-modal localization, chain parsing, and event-conditioned comprehension. It contains 34,114 training examples and category-balanced development and test splits of 3,500 and 7,000 examples. We evaluate five open omni models under their respective input configurations using reference-blind response normalization followed by deterministic scoring. All five off-the-shelf systems score below the test split's majority-label baseline of 0.556 on synchronization verification, and obtain low scores on chain parsing and event-conditioned grounding and comprehension. Development-set perturbations reveal task-dependent sensitivity in Qwen3-Omni-30B to modality removal and changes in visual input processing, without isolating their underlying causes. Parameter-efficient temporal post-training improves Gemma4-E4B-it on several benchmark metrics. On three external image benchmarks, task metrics change modestly, including some degradations, while teacher-forcing perplexity decreases. Together, these findings show that semantic reference-text overlap should not be treated as a proxy for temporal localization, and that AVTrace can identify task-specific weaknesses while providing a testbed for temporal post-training.
summary_zh: 全模态模型可描述视频内容，但这类模型是否具备事件时序定位能力、能否保留事件顺序、能否判断音视频同步性？本文提出AVTrace（音视频时序推理评估与能力评测套件），一套覆盖事件起始点与时间跨度定位、同步性校验、下一步预测、跨模态定位、链式语义解析、事件条件下语义理解任务的银标准诊断评测集。该评测集包含34114条训练样本，以及类别均衡的3500条开发集样本与7000条测试集样本。本文采用无参考响应归一化结合确定性打分的方案，在各自输入配置下对5款开源全模态模型开展评测。结果显示，5款开箱即用的系统在同步性验证任务上的得分均低于测试集多数标签基线0.556，在链式解析、事件条件下的定位与理解任务上得分均较低。开发集扰动实验显示，Qwen3-Omni-30B对模态移除、视觉输入处理方式变化存在任务相关的敏感性，但现有方法无法定位其背后的根本原因。参数高效的时序后训练可提升Gemma4-E4B-it在多个基准指标上的表现。在三个外部图像基准上，任务指标仅发生小幅波动，部分指标甚至出现下降，同时教师强制下的困惑度有所降低。上述结果共同表明，语义参考文本的重叠度不应被视为时序定位能力的替代指标，AVTrace可识别全模态模型在特定任务上的短板，同时可作为时序后训练的测试平台。

title: QCPruner: Query-Conditioned Population Coverage for Visual Token Pruning
title_zh: QCPruner：面向视觉Token剪枝的查询条件化总体覆盖方法
authors: Shengli He (Guizhou University), Yongchao Liang (Guizhou University), Roumeng He (Shanghai Ocean University), Junjie Zeng (Guizhou University), Jiyuan He (Guizhou University), Can Wu (Guizhou University), Li Zheng (Guizhou University)
abstract: The high visual-token load in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) motivates training-free pruning to reduce later-layer computation, but under a fixed budget, pruning must preserve query-relevant evidence while avoiding redundancy. Existing methods rank tokens, diversify selected subsets, or optimize coverage without using a shared per-visual query utility to weight both visual targets and candidate representatives. We introduce QCPruner, which makes both roles query-conditioned through bilateral utility weighting. Using keyword-matched query anchors, QCPruner fuses two cross-modal cues into utility and applies it to both visual targets and candidate representatives within visual-affinity-based coverage. The resulting nonnegative facility-location objective is monotone and submodular, retains the standard (1-1/e) greedy guarantee, and requires no model training or parameter updates. Across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-Video, and Qwen2.5-VL, QCPruner achieves the highest average relative performance among evaluated complete-system pruning methods at every reported token budget. At 32 of 576 tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it retains 96.1% of unpruned performance, versus 93.9% for the strongest evaluated baseline. At 256 of 1296 tokens on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the corresponding values are 96.7% and 92.5%.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中过高的视觉Token负载推动了训练无关的剪枝技术发展，以降低后续层的计算量，但在固定Token预算下，剪枝操作需要保留与查询相关的证据，同时避免冗余。现有方法对Token排序、实现选中子集的多样化、优化覆盖度，但均未使用共享的单视觉查询效用权重同时对视觉目标与候选代表进行加权。本文提出QCPruner，通过双边效用加权让视觉目标与候选代表均实现查询条件化。QCPruner使用关键词匹配的查询锚点，将两类跨模态线索融合为效用值，在基于视觉亲和度的覆盖计算中同时应用于视觉目标与候选代表。最终得到的非负设施选址目标函数满足单调性与子模性，保留了标准的(1-1/e)贪心算法性能保证，且无需任何模型训练或参数更新。在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-Video、Qwen2.5-VL等模型上的实验表明，在所有公开的Token预算设置下，QCPruner在所有参评的完整系统剪枝方法中平均相对性能最高。在LLaVA-1.5-7B模型上仅保留576个Token中的32个时，其性能可达到未剪枝版本的96.1%，优于性能最强的基线方法的93.9%；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型上仅保留1296个Token中的256个时，对应数值分别为96.7%与92.5%。

title: An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras
title_zh: 面向事件相机的保留事件信息的速度不变表征方法
authors: Mikihiro Ikura, Luna Gava, Jiahang Wu, Chiara Bartolozzi, Arren Glover
abstract: Event cameras provide low-latency, high temporal resolution perception for real-time vision tasks such as robotics.The novel circuitry (i.e. asynchronous, independent pixels) that enables these advantages also introduces new algorithmic challenges. Velocity-invariant representations alleviate missing observations under slow motion and motion blur under fast motion, but most discard temporal information by converting events into image-like representations. We propose Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields (SCARF), a real-time velocity-invariant representation that preserves raw events while consistently handling fast motion, stationary scenes, and independently moving objects. SCARF achieves state-of-the-art performance in both computational efficiency and representation quality.
summary_zh: 事件相机可为机器人等实时视觉任务提供低延迟、高时间分辨率的感知能力。支撑上述优势的新型电路结构（即异步独立像素）也带来了新的算法挑战。速度不变表征可缓解慢速运动下的观测缺失问题与快速运动下的运动模糊问题，但现有多数方法将事件转换为类图像表征，丢失了时序信息。本文提出SCARF（中心活跃感受野集合），一种实时速度不变表征，可保留原始事件信息，同时稳定处理快速运动、静态场景、独立运动物体三类场景。SCARF在计算效率与表征质量上均达到当前最优性能。

title: Beyond the Foreground: FOV-Aware Polyp Image Synthesis via Lesion-Guided Adaptive Mucosal Context Propagation
title_zh: 超越前景：通过病灶引导的自适应黏膜上下文传播实现视场感知的息肉图像合成
authors: Tong Wang, Yuting He, Bin Ren, Yutong Xie, Guanyu Yang
abstract: Synthetic image and mask pairs can alleviate scarce colonoscopy annotations, but realistic synthesis requires preserving the supplied lesion while generating compatible mucosa. Existing foreground-guided methods treat all non-foreground pixels as background and rely mainly on local integration. Directly applying them to colonoscopy causes two problems: non-mucosal black regions contaminate generated tissue, and local reasoning produces inconsistent mucosal texture and illumination. We propose LAMP, the first foreground-guided framework for polyp image synthesis based on lesion-guided adaptive mucosal context propagation. LAMP explicitly separates the lesion, valid mucosa, and camera exterior using a field-of-view (FOV) mask. Lesion-to-Mucosa cross-attention extracts lesion appearance conditions for valid-mucosa locations, while FOV-constrained multidirectional Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value propagates them over legal tissue support. An adaptive gate then controls their residual fusion into the diffusion U-Net. Extensive experiments on five polyp datasets demonstrate that LAMP substantially outperforms existing methods in overall generation quality and consistently improves five downstream segmentation models. Our code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP.
summary_zh: 合成图像与对应掩码对可缓解结肠镜标注稀缺的问题，但逼真的合成需要在保留给定病灶的同时生成匹配的黏膜组织。现有前景引导类方法将所有非前景像素视为背景，主要依赖局部融合，直接应用于结肠镜场景会引发两个问题：非黏膜黑色区域会污染生成的组织，局部推理会导致黏膜纹理与光照不一致。本文提出LAMP，首个基于病灶引导自适应黏膜上下文传播的息肉图像合成前景引导框架。LAMP利用视场（FOV）掩码显式分离病灶、有效黏膜、相机外部区域。病灶到黏膜的交叉注意力为有效黏膜区域提取病灶外观条件，受视场约束的多方向视觉接收加权键值机制将上述条件在合法组织区域内传播，之后自适应门控将其残差融合到扩散U-Net中。在5个息肉数据集上开展的大量实验表明，LAMP的整体生成质量显著优于现有方法，可稳定提升5款下游分割模型的性能。相关代码将发布于https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP。

title: Enhanced Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer via Teacher Prediction Refinement
title_zh: 通过教师预测细化实现检测Transformer的增强知识蒸馏
authors: Yitong Xing, Yuhao Cheng, Yanping Li, Yichao Yan
abstract: Detection Transformers (DETRs) achieve strong performance in object detection but remain challenging to deploy on edge devices due to their high computational cost. Existing DETR distillation methods mainly focus on aligning distillation points, while largely overlooking the quality of the teacher's supervision itself. We observe that due to stage-wise non-monotonic prediction behavior in DETRs, well-localized or correctly classified predictions from earlier stages may degrade in later ones, and some negative predictions become increasingly overconfident. As a result, relying solely on the current stage's predictions yields inaccurate and inconsistent supervision. To address this issue, we propose Teacher Prediction Refinement Distillation (TPRD), a plug-and-play module that refines teacher predictions before distillation by exploiting stage-wise prediction information. TPRD improves supervision quality through Positive Prediction Correction (PPC), which corrects degraded positive predictions by restoring more accurate ones from earlier stages, ensuring reliable localization and classification signals, and Negative Prediction Suppression (NPS) suppresses the influence of overconfident negatives, preventing them from providing misleading supervision to the student. To preserve informative dark knowledge, we further introduce Maximum Dark Knowledge Preservation (MDKP), which selectively refines target-class logits while retaining non-target relations. Extensive experiments on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method. Our code is available at https://github.com/xingyitong1/TPRD.
summary_zh: 检测Transformer（DETR）在目标检测任务上取得了优异性能，但受限于高计算成本，其在边缘设备上的部署仍存在较大挑战。现有DETR蒸馏方法主要聚焦于蒸馏点的对齐，很大程度上忽略了教师模型监督信号本身的质量。本文观察到，由于DETR存在分阶段非单调预测特性，早期阶段定位准确或分类正确的预测在后续阶段可能出现性能退化，部分负样本预测的置信度会过度升高。因此仅依赖当前阶段的预测会产生不准确、不一致的监督信号。为解决该问题，本文提出TPRD（教师预测细化蒸馏），一款即插即用模块，可利用分阶段预测信息在蒸馏前对教师预测进行细化。TPRD通过正样本预测校正（PPC）提升监督质量：从早期阶段恢复更准确的预测，校正退化的正样本预测，确保可靠的定位与分类信号；同时通过负样本预测抑制（NPS）降低过度自信的负样本的影响，避免其向学生模型提供误导性监督。为保留高价值暗知识，本文进一步提出最大暗知识保留（MDKP）机制，选择性细化目标类对数概率，同时保留非目标类之间的关联关系。在MS COCO与PASCAL VOC数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性与鲁棒性。相关代码可访问https://github.com/xingyitong1/TPRD获取。

title: LapaTrack-3D: 6 DoF pre-operative shape tracking for laparoscopic surgery
title_zh: LapaTrack-3D：面向腹腔镜手术的术前6自由度形状跟踪算法
authors: Jingwei Song, Javid Hussain Jakir, Ray Zhang, Wenwei Zhang, Hao Zhou, Xiaomeng Xian, Maani Ghaffari
abstract: This work proposes a real-time 6 Degree-of-Freedom (6 DoF) tracking algorithm for monocular laparoscopic surgery. It provides alignment between intra-operative video and pre-operative data (e.g., CT). The 6 DoF tracking offers a solution for accurately locating the internal anatomy of the target organ despite the lack of tactile feedback and transparency. The ORB-SLAM2 framework is adopted and modified for prior-based 3D tracking with four major modifications. First, the primitive 3D shape is used for fast initialization of the ORB-SLAM2 monocular mode. Second, a pseudo-segmentation strategy is employed to separate the target organ from the background for tracking. Third, the 3D shape is incorporated as a geometric prior in its pose graph optimization. Fourth, the Multi-Scale Retinex with Chromaticity Preservation (MSRCP) algorithm is leveraged and modified for image enhancement in challenging illumination scenarios. In-vivo and ex-vivo experiments validate that LapaTrack-3D provides robust 3D tracking and effectively handles typical challenges such as poor illumination, fast motion, out-of-field-of-view scenarios, partial visibility, and ``organ-background'' relative motion. LapaTrack-3D achieves a processing rate of 13 Hz for 1280*720 pixel video.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向单目腹腔镜手术的实时6自由度（6 DoF）跟踪算法，可实现术中视频与术前CT等数据的对齐。该6自由度跟踪方案可在缺乏触觉反馈与场景透明度的前提下，实现目标器官内部解剖结构的精确定位。本文对ORB-SLAM2框架进行改造，基于先验信息实现3D跟踪，共包含四处核心修改：第一，利用原始3D形状实现ORB-SLAM2单目模式的快速初始化；第二，采用伪分割策略将目标器官与背景分离以实现跟踪；第三，将3D形状作为几何先验引入位姿图优化；第四，对保色度多尺度Retinex（MSRCP）算法进行改造，用于在复杂光照场景下实现图像增强。体内与体外实验验证表明，LapaTrack-3D可实现鲁棒的3D跟踪，有效应对光照不佳、快速运动、视场外场景、部分可见、器官与背景相对运动等典型挑战。针对1280×720分辨率的视频，LapaTrack-3D的处理速率可达13Hz。

title: DirtyMoCap: Robust Motion Capture from Unconstrained Markers
title_zh: DirtyMoCap：面向无约束标记点的鲁棒动作捕捉方法
authors: Long Wang, Shuting Zhao, Shen Yan, Siyuan Yu, Xiaoben Li, Zeyu Cai, Yumeng Hou, Yuliang Xiu
abstract: Optical motion capture delivers high-fidelity human motion, but its reliance on strict marker layouts and clean trajectories severely limits its real-world applicability. In practice, tracking systems frequently output unconstrained markers: sparse, noisy, and unordered point clouds with unknown or varying configurations. To bridge the gap between corrupted raw markers and parametric human models, we introduce DirtyMoCap, a robust, marker-layout-free framework. Our core insight is to map unordered marker observations to a fixed set of "proxy anchors" comprising skeletal joints and body surface points, which serve as a stable intermediate representation. We first initialize and track these anchors over long sequences using a recurrent sliding-window architecture. Then, a custom differentiable Gauss-Newton solver fits the SMPL-H model to the tracked anchors to recover full-body pose, translation, and shape. By explicitly deriving geometric residuals, our solver learns adaptive observation confidence, smoothness, and prior weights end-to-end, adapting dynamically to the reliability of the input data. Extensive experiments on diverse, noisy marker configurations demonstrate that DirtyMoCap successfully generalizes across arbitrary layouts using only a single trained model. It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art configuration-specific baselines in both joint and vertex reconstruction accuracy, while our custom CUDA solver achieves up to a 100x speedup over standard PyTorch implementations. We further apply DirtyMoCap to heterogeneous raw optical MoCap recordings of traditional Chinese martial arts, yielding a Kung Fu motion dataset of temporally coherent SMPL-H reconstructions. Code and data are available at https://wanglongzju.github.io/DirtyMoCap-Project-Page.
summary_zh: 光学动作捕捉可输出高保真的人体运动数据，但这类方法依赖严格的标记点布局与干净的轨迹，极大限制了其在真实场景下的适用性。实际应用中，跟踪系统经常输出无约束标记点：即配置未知或动态变化的稀疏、带噪、无序点云。为打通受损原始标记点与参数化人体模型之间的鸿沟，本文提出DirtyMoCap，一款鲁棒的、无需标记点布局先验的动作捕捉框架。本文的核心思路是将无序标记点观测映射到由骨骼关节与人体表面点组成的固定“代理锚点”集合，将其作为稳定的中间表征。本文首先采用循环滑动窗口架构，在长序列上初始化并跟踪这些锚点；之后采用自定义可微高斯-牛顿求解器，将SMPL-H模型拟合到跟踪得到的锚点上，恢复全身姿态、平移量与体型参数。通过显式推导几何残差，本文的求解器可端到端学习自适应观测置信度、平滑度与先验权重，动态适配输入数据的可靠性。在多种不同的带噪标记点配置上开展的大量实验表明，仅使用单个训练得到的模型，DirtyMoCap即可在任意标记点布局上实现有效泛化。在关节与顶点重建精度上，其性能持续优于当前最优的面向特定配置的基线方法，同时本文自定义的CUDA求解器相比标准PyTorch实现最高可实现100倍的加速。本文进一步将DirtyMoCap应用于中国传统武术的异质原始光学动作捕捉记录，得到了时序连贯的SMPL-H重建功夫动作数据集。相关代码与数据可访问项目主页https://wanglongzju.github.io/DirtyMoCap-Project-Page获取。

title: CitySTAR: Structured and Topology-Aware Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Urban 3D Grounding
title_zh: CitySTAR：面向开放词汇城市3D实体定位的结构化与拓扑感知推理
authors: Shuai Zhang, Hongye Hou, Qinghe Liu, Zhuoxiao Li, Dongli Wu, Jing Ou, Yuan Liu, Wufan Zhao
abstract: 3D grounding aims to localize target entities in complex scenes from natural language and plays a fundamental role in embodied perception and spatial reasoning. However, existing approaches mostly rely on feature similarity or direct matching, making it difficult to connect natural-language intent with the implicit semantic and geometric structures hidden in billion-scale urban point clouds. We reformulate city-scale 3D grounding as structured constraint reasoning, where description semantics are organized into computable cross-modal constraints over open-vocabulary 3D entities, attributes, and spatial relations. We present CitySTAR, a training-free framework for reasoning-driven urban 3D grounding. CitySTAR lifts raw billion-scale urban point clouds into a query-ready scene graph of open-vocabulary 3D instances, with CodeLLM-driven tools supplying multimodal evidence for node attributes and 3D spatial relations. It then models target-context topology with paired hypergraphs and performs bidirectional topology verification for structural disambiguation. Finally, a Reflective Cross-modal Grounding module integrates topology consistency and candidate-centered 2D visual evidence to make decisions over a metric-aware 3D context graph. To further support this setting, we introduce CitySTAR-3D, an enhanced benchmark that improves semantic coverage, instance completeness, bounding-box fidelity, and spatial-relation complexity in city-scale 3D grounding. Extensive experiments show that CitySTAR consistently improves open-world urban 3D grounding while maintaining strong interpretability and generalization.
summary_zh: 3D实体定位任务旨在从自然语言出发在复杂场景中定位目标实体，是具身感知与空间推理领域的基础任务。现有方法大多依赖特征相似度或直接匹配，难以将自然语言意图与十亿级城市点云中隐藏的隐式语义结构、几何结构建立关联。本文将城市级3D实体定位任务重构为结构化约束推理问题，把描述语义组织为可计算的跨模态约束，作用于开放词汇3D实体、属性与空间关系。本文提出CitySTAR这一无需训练的推理驱动型城市3D实体定位框架：首先将原始十亿级城市点云升维为可支持查询的开放词汇3D实例场景图，由CodeLLM（代码大语言模型）驱动工具为节点属性与3D空间关系提供多模态证据；随后通过成对超图对目标-上下文拓扑进行建模，执行双向拓扑校验以实现结构消歧；最后通过反射式跨模态定位模块融合拓扑一致性与以候选为中心的2D视觉证据，在度量感知3D上下文图上输出最终定位结果。为支撑该任务设置，本文进一步推出CitySTAR-3D增强基准数据集，提升了城市级3D实体定位任务的语义覆盖度、实例完整度、边界框保真度与空间关系复杂度。大量实验表明，CitySTAR在保持强可解释性与泛化性的同时，可持续提升开放世界城市3D实体定位的性能。

title: GS-PI: An Optimization-Decoupled Appearance Decomposition Approach for Generating PBR Gaussian Assets
title_zh: GS-PI：面向生成PBR高斯资产的优化解耦外观分解方法
authors: Jieting Xu, Rengan Xie, Zijian Huang, Zehui Jin, Rui Wang, Yuchi Huo
abstract: Gaussian Splatting (GS) excels at novel-view synthesis but encodes baked-in radiance, tightly entangling illumination with geometry and preventing seamless integration into physically based rendering (PBR) pipelines. Existing inverse-rendering methods attempt to disentangle materials via joint optimization, but often suffer from competing objectives that cause severe ambiguities and residual lighting artifacts. To overcome this, we present GS-PI, a novel optimization-decoupled framework that casts PBR material generation as a geometry-conditioned diffusion process on 3D point clouds. By operating directly in the 3D domain, our method inherently guarantees multi-view consistency, sidestepping the severe pixel correspondence issues that challenge 2D diffusion approaches. We introduce a multi-scale cross-view conditioning mechanism that integrates three complementary components: a global semantic prior, source-anchored photometric cues, and an absolute spatial learned view-direction conditioning signal. This design efficiently compresses complex multi-view evidence, mitigating cross-view projection misalignment and successfully preventing specular highlights from baking into intrinsic colors. By extracting a point cloud from a pre-trained Gaussian model, predicting PBR attributes via conditional diffusion, and distilling them back through differentiable rasterisation, we yield a fully relightable PBR-GS asset. GS-PI outperforms recent inverse-rendering baselines while replacing per-scene joint illumination/BRDF optimization with a learned diffusion pass followed by a short target-driven distillation, without requiring proxy meshes.
summary_zh: Gaussian Splatting（GS，高斯泼溅渲染）在新视角合成任务上表现优异，但它编码了烘焙后的辐射值，将光照与几何紧密耦合，无法无缝接入PBR（Physically Based Rendering，基于物理的渲染）流水线。现有逆渲染方法尝试通过联合优化解耦材质，但常出现目标冲突问题，引发严重歧义与残留光照伪影。为解决该问题，本文提出GS-PI这一全新优化解耦框架，将PBR材质生成任务转化为3D点云上以几何为条件的扩散过程。由于直接在3D域运算，该方法天然保证多视角一致性，规避了2D扩散方法面临的严重像素对应问题。本文设计了多尺度跨视角条件机制，融合三类互补组件：全局语义先验、源锚定光度线索、绝对空间学习视图方向条件信号。该设计可高效压缩复杂多视角证据，缓解跨视角投影错位，成功避免镜面高光被烘焙到固有颜色中。通过从预训练高斯模型提取点云、经条件扩散预测PBR属性、再通过可微光栅化将属性蒸馏回高斯表示，最终得到完全可重光照的PBR-GS资产。GS-PI性能超越近年逆渲染基线方法，无需代理网格，以学习到的扩散过程搭配短时间目标驱动蒸馏替代了逐场景光照/BRDF双向联合优化流程。

title: BinoGen: Scaling egocentric binocular data for embodied visual perception and learning
title_zh: BinoGen：面向具身视觉感知与学习的自中心双目数据规模化生成框架
authors: Chunpeng Li, Ya-tang Li
abstract: Embodied visual perception relies on temporally coherent visual experience accumulated through continuous engagement with the environment. However, collecting large-scale egocentric binocular observations together with dense annotations remains costly and difficult. Moreover, visual experience is shaped not only by the environment but also by the embodiment of the observer, including viewing height, field of view, binocular geometry, and motion through the scene. To address these challenges, we present BinoGen, an automated framework for generating large-scale, embodiment-aware egocentric binocular visual experiences in indoor environments. BinoGen jointly models environmental and observer variation through generative scene synthesis, probabilistic object instantiation, appearance randomization, stochastic trajectory generation, and configurable binocular camera setups. The framework produces synchronized binocular videos together with dense multimodal supervision, including depth maps, optical flow, surface normals, semantic maps, object coordinates, and camera poses. Using BinoGen, we construct a dataset comprising more than 20 million annotated images for supervised learning. We demonstrate two complementary utilities of BinoGen. First, incorporating BinoGen data consistently improves real-world visual perception, including depth estimation, object detection, and video object tracking. Second, paired human-inspired and mouse-inspired observations from the same environments enable controlled investigation of how observer embodiment affects perceptual learning. Embodiment-specific adaptation substantially improves performance, while joint training enables a single model to perform competitively across both embodiments. Together, these results demonstrate that large-scale, controllable visual experience can improve embodied perception...
summary_zh: 具身视觉感知依赖智能体与环境持续交互积累的时间连贯视觉经验，但采集大规模自中心双目观测数据及稠密标注的成本极高、落地难度大。此外，视觉经验不仅由环境决定，还受观测者的具身属性影响，包括观测高度、视场角、双目几何参数与场景内运动模式。为应对上述挑战，本文提出BinoGen这一自动化框架，可在室内环境中生成大规模、感知具身属性的自中心双目视觉经验。BinoGen通过生成式场景合成、概率化实例生成、外观随机化、随机轨迹生成、可配置双目相机设置，联合建模环境与观测者的变化。该框架可输出同步双目视频及稠密多模态监督数据，包括深度图、光流、表面法向量、语义图、物体坐标与相机位姿。基于BinoGen，本文构建了包含2000余万张标注图像的数据集用于监督学习。本文验证了BinoGen的两类互补效用：第一，引入BinoGen生成的数据可持续提升真实场景视觉感知任务性能，包括深度估计、目标检测与视频目标跟踪；第二，同一环境下生成的类人、类鼠配对观测数据，可支持控制变量研究观测者具身属性如何影响感知学习过程。针对特定具身属性的自适应可大幅提升模型性能，而联合训练可让单模型在两类具身属性场景下均取得有竞争力的结果。上述结果证明，大规模可控视觉经验可有效提升具身感知能力。

title: SlugTrails: An Egocentric Benchmark for Floor Plan Localization in Large Buildings
title_zh: SlugTrails：面向大型建筑楼层平面图定位的自中心基准数据集
authors: Yunqian Cheng, Roberto Manduchi
abstract: Floor-plan-based indoor visual localization enables infrastructure-free positioning, but most methods are developed and evaluated in small residential environments unlike the large public buildings of real deployment. We introduce SlugTrails, a floor plan localization benchmark for large indoor spaces under realistic egocentric sensing: $30$ Hz Aria glasses recordings across three campus buildings and six floors ($22089$ m$^2$ of floor plan outline), CAD-derived floor plans with semantic classes and circulation space masks, and trajectories aligned into the floor plan frame using laser-surveyed anchors. One protocol covers three practical ways of gathering geometry under a limited field of view -- a single walking frame, a stationary multi-view sweep, and a walking stream with odometry -- so methods designed for different regimes are compared on the same buildings and ground truth. Evaluating five representative geometric and learned systems under their native sensing configurations, we find that stock checkpoints (official released weights) are near zero on SlugTrails (at most $0.004$ R@1m30$^{\circ}$ on walking single frames), while fine-tuning on SlugTrails improves every trainable family on all three tasks (e.g., F$^3$Loc $0.0 \rightarrow 0.141$ single-frame and $0.03 \rightarrow 0.66$ sequential), with gains compounding as observations accumulate. The same fine-tuned weights also improve cross-dataset generalization on LaMAR with no LaMAR training (sequential R@1m $0.048 \rightarrow 0.143$ for F$^3$Loc and $0.063 \rightarrow 0.127$ for UnLoc), whereas train-from-scratch on SlugTrails alone stays far below fine-tuning from stock weights -- evidence that floor plan localization is currently limited by indoor data rather than by architecture. We release the dataset, protocols, and tools at https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails.
summary_zh: 基于楼层平面图的室内视觉定位可实现无基础设施定位，但现有多数方法均在小型住宅环境下开发与评估，和实际部署场景中的大型公共建筑存在较大差异。本文推出SlugTrails这一面向大型室内空间的楼层平面图定位基准数据集，面向真实自中心传感场景构建：包含3栋校园建筑共6层（总平面图覆盖面积22089平方米）的30Hz Aria眼镜录制数据、带语义类别与通行空间掩码的CAD导出楼层平面图、经激光测量锚点对齐到平面图坐标系的轨迹。数据集的评估协议覆盖三类视场受限场景下的几何信息采集方式：单帧步行视角、静止多视角扫描、带里程计的步行流，可让面向不同场景设计的方法在同一建筑与真值体系下对比。本文对5类代表性几何方法与学习方法在原生传感配置下开展评估，发现官方发布的预训练权重在SlugTrails上性能接近零（单步行帧下R@1m30°指标最高仅为0.004），而在SlugTrails上微调后所有可训练方法在三类任务上的性能均有提升（例如F³Loc的单帧指标从0.0提升至0.141，序列指标从0.03提升至0.66），性能增益随观测积累进一步叠加。微调后的权重在未参与训练的LaMAR数据集上的跨数据集泛化性能也有提升（例如F³Loc的序列R@1m指标从0.048提升至0.143，UnLoc从0.063提升至0.127），而仅在SlugTrails上从零训练的模型性能远低于基于预训练权重微调的模型，证明当前楼层平面图定位任务的瓶颈是室内数据不足而非模型架构缺陷。本文公开了数据集、评估协议与相关工具，项目地址为https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails。

title: BINDER: A Latent Variable Model for Probabilistic Medical Image Registration
title_zh: BINDER：面向概率医学图像配准的隐变量模型
authors: Stefano Cerri, Amirhossein Hassankhani, Ya\"el Balbastre, Koen Van Leemput
abstract: We propose a new probabilistic model for general-purpose medical image registration that builds upon the mutual information registration criterion. It centers around a spatial interpolation technique that assumes latent voxel-wise correspondences between the images being registered. By exploiting these latent variables, we derive dedicated optimization and MCMC sampling techniques that only involve closed-form iterative updates. When applied to nonlinear registration, an efficient demons-like optimization algorithm is obtained that shows robust out-of-the-box performance across a variety of monomodal and multimodal registration tasks. We also demonstrate a corresponding sampler that can quantify, for the first time, uncertainty in multimodal registration scenarios with very high-dimensional 3D deformations. Our code, which we call BINDER (Bayesian INference for DEformable Registration), is freely available at https://github.com/ste93ste/BINDER.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于互信息配准准则的通用型概率医学图像配准新模型，核心是一种空间插值技术，假设待配准图像之间存在体素级隐式对应关系。利用这些隐变量，本文推导了专用优化方法与MCMC采样技术，仅包含闭式迭代更新步骤。将该方法应用于非刚性配准场景时，可得到类Demons的高效优化算法，在各类单模态与多模态配准任务上均表现出开箱即用的鲁棒性能。本文还实现了对应的采样器，首次实现了高维3D形变多模态配准场景下的不确定性量化。本文将该开源实现命名为BINDER（Bayesian INference for DEformable Registration，贝叶斯可变形配准推断），项目地址为https://github.com/ste93ste/BINDER。

title: PART: Learning 3D Part Assembly and Retrieval with Transformers
title_zh: PART：基于Transformer的3D零件装配与检索学习框架
authors: Ruchao Bao, Wenzheng Wu, Chucheng Xiang, Zhongyuan Liu, Yuan Liu, Jinxin Dong, Ligang Liu, Ziqi Wang
abstract: 3D assembly is fundamental to modern manufacturing and digital content creation. In this paper, we present PART, a unified transformer-based framework for 3D part retrieval and assembly: given a target shape and a part library, PART automatically selects the appropriate parts and predicts their 6-DoF poses to reconstruct the target. While prior work has achieved impressive progress on assembling a pre-defined set of parts, this more practical retrieval-based setting remains largely unexplored. The task faces three key challenges: (i) a combinatorially explosive search space that grows exponentially with library size; (ii) variable-length outputs, as different targets require different numbers of parts; and (iii) continuous 6-DoF pose estimation for part assembly. To address these, we formulate retrieval and assembly as a set prediction problem and design a novel transformer-based framework that retrieves parts and regresses their poses with variable-length output. Additionally, we exploit the duality between part pose estimation and target segmentation through joint training and a novel segmentation-enhanced optimization module. Finally, We curate a large-scale dataset of 80K+ shapes, and the results show that PART generalizes to scene layouts, image targets, and real-world scans.
