These decisions reflect two distinct sources of uncertainty - spatial uncertainty over candidate locations and semantic uncertainty over target identity - that are often conflated in VLM-based search systems. We introduce a spatial-semantic uncertainty formulation that maintains separate beliefs over each component and integrates probabilistic VLM evidence into a global target-identity posterior, including probability mass for undiscovered targets. This decomposition allows an information-theoretic planner to independently value candidate discovery and target disambiguation through spatial and semantic expected information gain (EIG), providing an explicit mechanism for trading broader exploration against earlier identification. We evaluate six VLM uncertainty-elicitation interfaces on 500 synthetic targets and show that similar recognition accuracy can conceal substantial differences in calibration and false confidence. In degraded-observation search-and-identify experiments, EIG-based planners reach confident decisions in 75.0%-92.5% of trials, compared with 20.0% for Random search, while different spatial-semantic weightings achieve comparable identification accuracy once confidence is attained. Increasing semantic emphasis reduces unnecessary exploration and VLM queries, demonstrating that explicitly planning over semantic uncertainty can accelerate target resolution without sacrificing decision quality. These results highlight the distinct roles of uncertainty representation and uncertainty-driven planning in embodied VLM systems.
summary_zh: 基于自然语言描述搜索目标的机器人不仅需要确定搜索位置，还需要判断观测到的候选对象是否为期望目标。这类决策对应两类完全不同的不确定性：候选位置的空间不确定性与目标身份的语义不确定性，二者在现有基于VLM（Vision-Language Model，视觉语言模型）的搜索系统中常被混淆。本文提出一种空间-语义不确定性建模框架，分别维护两类分量的置信度，并将概率化VLM证据整合到全局目标身份后验分布中，其中包含未发现目标的概率质量。该分解方法让信息论规划器可通过空间与语义期望信息增益（Expected Information Gain, EIG）分别评估候选发现与目标消歧的价值，提供了在大范围探索与提前识别之间做权衡的显式机制。本文在500个合成目标上评估了6种VLM不确定性输出接口，结果表明相似的识别准确率可能掩盖校准性能与误报置信度的显著差异。在观测条件受限的搜索识别实验中，基于EIG的规划器可在75.0%~92.5%的试次中得到置信决策，而随机搜索的该比例仅为20.0%；且达到置信状态后，不同空间-语义权重设置的识别精度相当。提升语义权重占比可减少不必要的探索与VLM查询次数，证明针对语义不确定性做显式规划可在不损失决策质量的前提下加速目标定位。该结果凸显了不确定性表征与不确定性驱动规划在具身VLM系统中的独特作用。

title: Time-Efficient Iterative Learning Planning for Safety-Critical Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
title_zh: 面向安全关键动态避障的高效迭代学习规划方法
authors: Zhiyi Chen, Shuli Lv, Chen Min, Yong Xu, Jian Sun, Quan Quan
abstract: Autonomous mobile robots require timeefficient planning and safety-critical dynamic obstacle avoidance under constrained onboard computation. While Iterative Learning Planning (ILP) offers lightweight and efficient traversal planning, it lacks explicit mechanisms for dynamic obstacle perception and avoidance. This article extends ILP to safety-critical navigation in dynamic environments by integrating an anticipatory risk-blended control barrier function (ARB-CBF). The extended ILP learns traversal-speed and steering-bias profiles via a fractionalpower update based on local obstacle risk, generating nominal control commands that ARB-CBF modifies at runtime for real-time safety guarantees. Algorithmic analysis demonstrates that the ILP replanning stage scales at O(kN) for k iterations and N waypoints, while ARB-CBF executes with linear complexity. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments validate the framework, demonstrating superior temporal efficiency and safety with lower computational overhead compared to optimizationbased baselines, making it highly suitable for resourceconstrained platforms.
summary_zh: 自主移动机器人在机载计算资源受限的条件下，需要兼具时间高效性与安全保障性的动态避障规划能力。迭代学习规划（Iterative Learning Planning, ILP）是一种轻量高效的遍历规划方法，但缺乏针对动态障碍物的显式感知与规避机制。本文通过集成前瞻风险融合控制屏障函数（Anticipatory Risk-Blended Control Barrier Function, ARB-CBF），将ILP扩展到动态环境下的安全关键导航场景。扩展后的ILP基于局部障碍物风险的幂次更新规则学习遍历速度与转向偏差分布，生成标称控制指令，再由ARB-CBF在运行时修正指令以提供实时安全保障。算法分析表明，ILP重规划阶段的时间复杂度为O(kN)，其中k为迭代次数，N为航点数量，ARB-CBF的执行过程为线性复杂度。大量仿真与真实场景实验验证了该框架的性能，与基于优化的基线方法相比，其在更低计算开销下实现了更优的时间效率与安全性能，非常适合资源受限的平台部署。

title: Resilient Motion Planning for Free-Flying Space Robots under Actuator Failures
title_zh: 执行器故障下自由飞行空间机器人的弹性运动规划
authors: Nicolas de Maddalena, Joris Verhagen, Jana Tumova
abstract: Free-flying robots rely on multiple thrusters to maneuver in space. If one or more of these thrusters fail, the robot may lose control authority and risk mission failure. At the same time, their free-flying nature implies that, even in the absence of actuation, they continue along (locally) straight-line trajectories. In this work we present a probabilistic, proactive, motion planning framework that explicitly accounts for actuator failures in space. We model actuator failure modes as a Markov chain and propagate the probability of successfully reaching the goal along the planning horizon. Precomputed reachable sets evaluate the robot's capabilities of reaching waypoints under potential failures and an RRT$^*$-based planner concatenates these waypoints. The resulting algorithm maximizes the overall target-reaching probability, providing maximally resilient motion plans utilizing free-flying properties. We validate our approach experimentally on a physical free-flyer platform with injected actuator failures.
summary_zh: 自由飞行机器人依靠多个推进器实现空间机动，若一个或多个推进器发生故障，机器人可能失去控制权限，导致任务失败。同时，自由飞行的特性意味着即使没有执行器输入，机器人也会沿局部直线轨迹持续运动。本文提出一种概率化主动运动规划框架，显式考虑空间场景下的执行器故障问题。我们将执行器故障模式建模为马尔可夫链，在规划时域内传播机器人成功抵达目标的概率。通过预计算可达集评估机器人在潜在故障条件下抵达各航点的能力，再基于RRT*规划器串联这些航点。最终得到的算法可最大化整体目标抵达概率，生成充分利用自由飞行特性的高弹性运动规划。我们在搭载注入式执行器故障的实体自由飞行平台上对所提方法完成了实验验证。

title: Imagine-TAMP: Imagination-Guided Task and Motion Planning in Partial Observability
title_zh: Imagine-TAMP：部分可观测场景下基于想象引导的任务与运动规划
authors: Antareep Singha, Shivaram Kumar, Yoonwoo Kim, Yoonchang Sung
abstract: Robots operating in cluttered environments must often manipulate objects whose locations are only partially observable. A central challenge is deciding whether to acquire another observation or to first manipulate objects that may occlude the target. Conventional task and motion planning (TAMP) approaches typically make this decision using symbolic action costs or expensive geometric planning, neither of which adequately captures how likely an observation is to reveal an occluded target. We introduce Imagine-TAMP, an interleaved planning and execution framework that uses semantic and geometric imagination to compare alternative task-level strategies under partial observability before committing to expensive motion planning. A vision-language model shapes a particle belief over target locations using commonsense relationships between the target and visible objects, while a generative scene model estimates plausible geometry in unobserved regions. Given a target hypothesis and imagined scene, Imagine-TAMP generates multiple symbolic plan skeletons and assigns non-unit costs that approximate both manipulation effort and target visibility from sensing actions, distinguishing a short but poorly informative observation strategy from a longer strategy that first manipulates an occluder to better expose the target. The selected skeleton is then refined into a feasible continuous plan and executed, with new observations updating the belief and triggering replanning when necessary. Experiments show that imagination-guided evaluation improves observation-versus-manipulation decisions: in viewpoint-constrained shelf scenes, non-unit geometric evaluation increases success from 46.0% to 84.0%, while semantic belief shaping further reduces manipulation and replanning. On a real robot, the complete system reduces planning time by 32% relative to a geometry-only ablation.
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中运行的机器人通常需要操作位置仅部分可观测的物体，核心挑战在于判断是获取新观测，还是先操作可能遮挡目标的物体。传统任务与运动规划（Task and Motion Planning, TAMP）方法通常基于符号动作成本或高代价的几何规划完成该决策，二者都无法充分表征观测揭示被遮挡目标的可能性。本文提出Imagine-TAMP，一种规划与执行交错的框架，在执行高代价运动规划前，利用语义与几何想象能力对比部分可观测场景下的不同任务级策略。视觉语言模型通过目标与可见物体之间的常识关系构建目标位置的粒子置信度，生成式场景模型则估计未观测区域的合理几何结构。给定目标假设与想象场景，Imagine-TAMP生成多个符号规划骨架，并为其分配非单位成本，同时近似操作开销与感知动作的目标可见性，区分观测时间短但信息不足的策略，与先操作遮挡物以更好暴露目标的长耗时策略。选中的骨架随后被优化为可行的连续规划并执行，新观测会更新置信度，必要时触发重规划。实验表明，基于想象的评估可提升观测与操作的决策质量：在视点受限的货架场景中，非单位几何评估将任务成功率从46.0%提升至84.0%，语义置信度构建进一步减少了操作与重规划次数。在真实机器人平台上，完整系统的规划时间比仅使用几何信息的消融版本降低32%。

title: RoboFind: Multi-Agent Personalized Object Search for People Who Are Blind or Have Low Vision
title_zh: 面向视障与低视力人群的多智能体个性化目标搜索系统RoboFind
authors: Ruiping Liu, Shaofang Quan, Qian Yin, Jingqi Zhang, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Di Wen, Weijia Fan, Kailun Yang, M. Saquib Sarfraz, Tamim Asfour, Kunyu Peng, Rainer Stiefelhagen
abstract: Blind and low-vision users often need to locate a specific personal object rather than an arbitrary instance of the same category. The task calls for a robot that can move through the space and reach viewpoints the user cannot, and for an accessible interface where the user says which object is meant and learns whether the right one was found. We present RoboFind, a multi-agent framework in which a smartphone teaches the target and a quadruped robot carries out the search. A Target Teaching Agent converts guided smartphone recordings into a semantic target profile and a reusable multi-view reference bank through an accessible capture flow with AR guidance, speech and haptic feedback, and screen-reader support, so later missions refer to a stored object without repeating the teaching process. At runtime, a Navigation Agent explores the environment and proposes candidate targets, a Verification Agent checks each candidate against the stored references, and a Coordination and Recovery Agent completes the mission or triggers recovery and continued search. Across 32 real-robot missions, RoboFind reaches 85.0% success against 25.0% for a reconstructed sequential first-stop baseline over 20 trials with ten targets, and reduces false success from 75.0% to 5.0%. On six shared targets it succeeds in 10/12 trials, against 5/12 for 12 independently executed GPT-6 Astra-only trials. These results show that the multi-agent design fits the demands of personalized object search, where verifying object identity before declaring completion is what makes the outcome something a user can rely on.
summary_zh: 视障与低视力用户通常需要定位特定的个人物品，而非同类物品的任意实例。该任务需要机器人能够移动到用户无法抵达的视点，同时提供可访问的交互界面，让用户指定目标物品并确认是否找到正确对象。本文提出RoboFind，一套多智能体框架，由智能手机端完成目标教学，四足机器人执行搜索任务。目标教学智能体通过支持AR引导、语音与触觉反馈、屏幕阅读器的可访问采集流程，将引导式智能手机录制内容转换为语义目标特征与可复用的多视图参考库，后续任务可直接调用存储的物品信息，无需重复教学过程。运行时，导航智能体探索环境并提出候选目标，验证智能体将每个候选与存储的参考信息比对，协调与恢复智能体完成任务或触发恢复机制继续搜索。在32次真实机器人任务中，针对10个目标的20次测试里，RoboFind的任务成功率达85.0%，而传统顺序遍历基线方法的成功率仅为25.0%，误报率从75.0%降至5.0%。针对6个共享目标的测试中，RoboFind在12次试次中成功10次，而仅使用GPT-6 Astra的独立执行方案在12次试次中仅成功5次。结果表明，该多智能体设计适配个性化目标搜索的需求，在宣告任务完成前先验证物体身份的机制可保障输出结果的可靠性。

title: Implementation of Tightly-Coupled SLAM Fusion of GPS, IMU, and LiDAR for Autonomous Vehicles
title_zh: 面向自主车辆的GPS、IMU与激光雷达紧耦合SLAM融合实现
authors: Amr O. Elmehrath, Farah Khaled, Rana Nahas, Catherine M. Elias
abstract: Autonomous vehicles depend entirely on Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) to navigate safely in unknown environments. However, relying on a single sensory modality introduces critical failure points: LiDAR systems degrade in featureless corridors, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) accumulate mathematical drift, and GPS drops frequently in urban canyons. This paper presents the implementation of a tightly-coupled SLAM fusion architecture that integrates a Velodyne 3D LiDAR, a high-frequency IMU, and GPS to achieve continuous spatial awareness. Utilizing a phased development methodology, we establish a 2D baseline to validate hardware synchronization and transform geometries before upgrading to a full 3D architecture driven by FAST-LIO2. This advanced approach uses an Iterated Error-State Kalman Filter (IESKF) to process dense 3D laser points alongside continuous inertial data, eliminating motion blur at high speeds. To eradicate long-term drift, a GTSAM pose-graph optimization back-end executes multi-modal loop closures. Evaluated across simulated environments and physical deployments, the results demonstrate that tightly-coupled 3D fusion effectively overcomes individual sensor blind spots to generate highly detailed point clouds, providing the foundational High-Definition (HD) maps required for advanced downstream autonomous planners.
summary_zh: 自主车辆完全依赖同时定位与建图（Simultaneous Localization and Mapping, SLAM）技术在未知环境中安全导航，但仅使用单一传感器模态会引入关键故障点：激光雷达系统在无特征走廊场景下性能下降，惯性测量单元（Inertial Measurement Unit, IMU）会累积数学漂移，GPS在城市峡谷场景下频繁丢信号。本文实现了一套紧耦合SLAM融合架构，集成Velodyne 3D激光雷达、高频IMU与GPS，实现连续空间感知。采用分阶段开发方法，首先构建2D基线系统验证硬件同步与几何变换逻辑，再升级为基于FAST-LIO2的完整3D架构。该改进方法使用迭代误差状态卡尔曼滤波器（Iterated Error-State Kalman Filter, IESKF）处理稠密3D激光点云与连续惯性数据，消除高速场景下的运动模糊。为消除长期漂移，后端采用GTSAM位姿图优化实现多模态回环检测。在仿真环境与真实部署场景下的评估结果表明，紧耦合3D融合可有效克服各传感器的固有盲区，生成细节丰富的点云，为下游高级自主规划器提供所需的基础高精（HD）地图。

title: JEPA-WAM: Connecting Generated Visual Instructions to World Action Models through JEPA Latent Representations
title_zh: JEPA-WAM：通过JEPA潜在表征将生成的视觉指令连接至世界动作模型
authors: Tianbin Liu, Jian Zhu, Taiyi Su, Jianjun Zhang, Chong Ma, Zitai Huang, Yi Xu
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated strong robotic manipulation capabilities by augmenting pretrained video generative models with action experts. However, current WAMs still show limited instruction-following ability when conditioned solely on text instructions. We argue that this limitation stems in part from a structural imbalance in robot-learning data: rich visual-action trajectories are often paired with sparse and repetitive language annotations, allowing policies to identify tasks from visual context and motion regularities rather than grounding the instruction itself. To address this limitation, we introduce JEPA-WAM, which augments each text instruction with a bank of stochastically generated visual instructions, providing diverse visual cues for instruction following. Specifically, JEPA-WAM uses an off-the-shelf text-to-image generator to sample multiple task-completion images conditioned on the text instruction, without training the generator. Although these generated images may differ from the current visual scene in appearance and layout, they remain semantically aligned with the instruction and serve as visual goal references. To focus on task-level semantics beyond appearance, we encode these references with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. The resulting dense goal representations are compressed into compact goal tokens that condition both the video and action experts through cross-attention. We further construct a real-robot instruction-following benchmark covering in-distribution, out-of-distribution scene, and out-of-distribution instruction settings. On this benchmark, JEPA-WAM achieves success rates of 87.3%, 74.5%, and 80.9% in these three settings, outperforming {\pi}0 and Fast-WAM by at least 10.0, 27.3, and 14.5 percentage points, respectively.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Model, WAM）通过为预训练视频生成模型配备动作专家，已展现出优异的机器人操作能力，但现有WAM仅以文本指令为条件时，指令跟随能力仍存在明显局限。本文认为该局限部分源于机器人学习数据的结构失衡：丰富的视觉-动作轨迹通常搭配稀疏且重复的语言标注，导致策略可从视觉上下文与运动规律中识别任务，而非将指令本身作为 grounding 依据。为解决该问题，本文提出JEPA-WAM，为每个文本指令配备一组随机生成的视觉指令库，为指令跟随提供多样化视觉线索。具体而言，JEPA-WAM使用现成的文生图模型，以文本指令为条件采样多张任务完成图像，无需对生成模型做额外训练。尽管生成图像的外观与布局可能和当前视觉场景存在差异，但在语义层面与指令对齐，可作为视觉目标参考。为聚焦外观之外的任务级语义，使用冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器对这些参考图像做编码，得到的稠密目标表征被压缩为紧凑的目标token，通过交叉注意力机制为视频专家与动作专家提供条件约束。本文进一步构建了覆盖分布内场景、分布外场景、分布外指令三类设置的真实机器人指令跟随基准。在该基准上，JEPA-WAM在三类设置下的成功率分别为87.3%、74.5%与80.9%，比π0与Fast-WAM的性能分别高出至少10.0、27.3与14.5个百分点。

title: Strategic Transformer for Resource-Constrained Multi-Object Navigation in Ultra-Large-Scale Environments
title_zh: 面向超大规模环境下资源受限多目标导航的策略Transformer
authors: Daiki Iwata, Kanji Tanaka, Senta Hishida
abstract: Resource-constrained multi-object navigation in vast indoor environments ($>2,000\text{ m}^2$) poses significant challenges for efficiency and strategic planning. To tackle this, we reformulate the task as a Set Orienteering Problem (SOP), providing an optimization framework under resource constraints where exploitation is governed by the SOP model and exploration is managed by a separate heuristic switcher. Conventional baselines suffer from either rigid planning or myopic behaviors. To overcome these limitations and resolve the NP-hard computational challenges of SOP for real-time navigation, we develop the Strategic Transformer. This lightweight architecture functions as a priority planner that internalizes expert combinatorial logic into a predictable $41.03\text{ ms}$ forward pass while reducing teacher-student information asymmetry. Incorporating geometric attention biases allows the network to effectively model long-range structural dependencies. By coupling the Transformer's macro-plan with a bounded iterative 2-opt local refinement on a capped candidate graph, our framework achieves a $94\times$ speedup compared to heavy meta-heuristics, ensuring bounded-latency inference suitable for onboard deployment. Experiments on ProcTHOR validate that our method successfully bridges the gap between exploration and exploitation, outperforming carefully re-implemented baselines under Progress weighted by Path Length (PPL) and establishing a new benchmark for scalable, resource-constrained navigation.
summary_zh: 在面积大于2000平方米的超大室内环境中执行资源受限多目标导航任务，对算法效率与策略规划能力提出了极高要求。为解决该问题，本文将该任务重构为定向集问题（Set Orienteering Problem, SOP），构建资源约束下的优化框架：利用SOP模型管理开发过程，用独立的启发式切换器管理探索过程。传统基线方法要么规划逻辑僵化，要么行为短视。为克服上述局限、解决SOP面向实时导航的NP难计算挑战，本文开发了策略Transformer。该轻量架构作为优先级规划器，将专家组合逻辑内化到仅耗时41.03ms的前向传播过程中，同时降低师生信息不对称程度。引入几何注意力偏置可让网络有效建模长程结构依赖。将Transformer生成的宏观规划与受限候选图上的有界迭代2-opt局部优化相结合，本文框架的速度比重型元启发式算法快94倍，可保障适合机载部署的有界延迟推理。在ProcTHOR环境上的实验验证了所提方法可有效填补探索与开发之间的鸿沟，在路径长度加权进度（Progress weighted by Path Length, PPL）指标上的表现优于经过精心复现的基线方法，为可扩展的资源受限导航任务建立了新基准。

title: GPT-6-Astra in a Navigation Workflow: Behavioral Analysis in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
title_zh: 导航工作流中的GPT-6-Astra：连续环境下零样本视觉语言导航的行为分析
authors: Guangzhao Dai, Qi Wu, Bin Zhu
abstract: We study GPT-6-Astra in a zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) system, where it interprets instructions, assesses its surroundings, and proposes actions. The system uses a common observation--decision--execution workflow with direct model API calls, without a packaged agent harness or navigation-specific fine-tuning. In this workflow, each request receives selected observations, execution feedback, and retained progress records. Evaluation covers the complete system, including context management and action control. We evaluate the system on 50 of the 100 R2R-CE val-unseen episodes used by Open-Nav. It achieves a success rate of 52.0\%, an SPL of 48.9\%, and an nDTW of 70.8\%. Our analysis highlights three findings. First, recorded responses link landmarks and earlier actions to instructions using observations and supplied history. Second, reviews include requests for additional views and revisions of uncertain judgments. Third, the results suggest a gap between task understanding and autonomous completion: an unfinished crossing is recognized while rotation continues. At termination, 36.0\% of episodes succeed with a workflow-accepted STOP, while another 16.0\% meet the distance criterion at the step limit. These results highlight a central challenge: translating correct local judgments into sustained progress and appropriate stopping.
summary_zh: 本文研究了零样本连续环境视觉语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments, VLN-CE）系统中的GPT-6-Astra模型，该系统可解读导航指令、评估周边环境并输出动作决策。系统采用通用的观测-决策-执行工作流，直接调用模型API，无需封装专用智能体框架，也无需针对导航任务做专项微调。在该工作流中，每一次模型请求都会输入筛选后的观测结果、执行反馈以及留存的进度记录。本次评估覆盖包含上下文管理与动作控制在内的完整系统，在Open-Nav项目使用的100个R2R-CE验证集未见过场景片段中选取50个开展测试，系统最终达到52.0%的成功率、48.9%的SPL（路径长度加权成功率）以及70.8%的nDTW（归一化动态时间规整）指标。本次分析得到三项核心结论：第一，模型输出的响应内容可结合观测信息与历史记录，将地标、前期动作与导航指令关联起来；第二，模型的反馈内容包含对补充视角信息的请求，以及对不确定判断的修正；第三，实验结果表明任务理解与自主完成之间存在差距：模型可识别出未完成的穿越动作，但仍会持续执行旋转操作。在任务终止时，36.0%的场景片段通过工作流认可的STOP动作成功完成导航，另有16.0%的场景片段在步数上限时满足距离达标条件。上述结果凸显了该领域的核心挑战：如何将正确的局部判断转化为持续的任务推进，以及输出合理的停止动作。

title: Universal Navigation Interface: Robot-Free Data for Wheeled Robot Navigation
title_zh: 通用导航接口：面向轮式机器人导航的无机器人数据采集方案
authors: Sarvesh Prajapati, Ananya Trivedi, Lorena Maria Genua, Drake Moore, Bruce Maxwell, Taskin Padir
abstract: Collecting real-world navigation data for mobile robots typically requires platform-specific teleoperation, making large-scale collection expensive and difficult to scale. We introduce Universal Navigation Interface (UNI), a robot-free data collection paradigm that uses a four-wheeled rollator walker (rollator) and smartphone to collect physically constrained human demonstrations. Because the rollator cannot climb stairs, negotiate uncut curbs, or pass through narrow gaps, demonstrations are naturally biased toward wheeled-feasible routes. Using UNI, we collect 37.2 km of real-world navigation data and recover metric trajectories that directly supervise goal-conditioned navigation models. Fine-tuning visual-navigation models on UNI reduces trajectory prediction error by 17.4-24.8% on held-out UNI demonstrations. Evaluation on other navigation datasets shows benefits that vary by dataset and metric. We further demonstrate closed-loop transfer to a powered wheelchair in curb, staircase, and curb-cut scenarios. These results support low-cost physical proxies as a practical source of navigation supervision collected without the target robot.
summary_zh: 为移动机器人采集真实世界导航数据通常需要针对特定平台做遥操作，导致大规模数据采集成本高昂、难以规模化落地。本文提出通用导航接口（Universal Navigation Interface, UNI），这是一种无机器人的数据采集范式，使用四轮助行器与智能手机采集符合物理约束的人类演示数据。由于助行器无法爬楼梯、越过未修整的路缘、穿过狭窄缝隙，采集得到的演示数据天然偏向轮式机器人可通行的路径。通过UNI方案，本文共采集了37.2公里的真实世界导航数据，还原得到的度量轨迹可直接作为目标条件导航模型的监督信号。在UNI数据集上对视觉导航模型做微调后，模型在未见过的UNI演示集上的轨迹预测误差降低了17.4%-24.8%。在其他导航数据集上的评估结果显示，该方案带来的性能增益随数据集与评价指标的不同存在差异。本文进一步验证了该方法可闭环迁移到动力轮椅平台，在路缘、楼梯、路缘切口场景下均表现良好。上述结果表明，低成本物理代理是无需目标机器人即可采集导航监督数据的实用方案。

title: AnyViewDex: View-Invariant Dexterous Manipulation from RGB Observations
title_zh: AnyViewDex：基于RGB观测的视角不变性灵巧操作
authors: Soham Patil, Om Sanjay Gunjal, Sourabh Bhosale, Arhan Chavare, Ramandeep Singh Hora, Spandan Roy
abstract: Visuomotor policies for multi-fingered dexterous manipulation are highly sensitive to camera viewpoint shifts. To achieve view invariance, recent methods increasingly rely on explicit 3D modalities like RGB-D or point clouds, which can introduce hardware dependencies, calibration requirements, and vulnerability to sensor noise during real-world deployment. In this work, we show that view-invariant control can be achieved without explicit test-time 3D sensing by encoding geometric knowledge into the visual representation during simulation. We present AnyViewDex, an asymmetric training pipeline that combines multi-view contrastive alignment with privileged 3D geometric supervision. By regressing absolute 3D object coordinates during simulated training, this auxiliary objective provides a geometric grounding signal that mitigates the spatial collapse of the globally pooled contrastive embedding. At deployment, the policy operates zero-shot using only uncalibrated monocular RGB and proprioception. We validate this approach across both reinforcement learning and student-teacher distillation. In hardware evaluation on an xArm7 with a 16-DoF LEAP Hand, AnyViewDex reaches 76.7% grasping success across eight unseen objects and six uncalibrated viewpoints (480 trials; 2,400 across all ablation conditions), indicating that geometrically grounded monocular policies transfer zero-shot without test-time depth. Project Page: https://anyviewdex.github.io/
summary_zh: 多指灵巧操作的视觉运动策略对相机视角偏移高度敏感。为实现视角不变性，现有方法越来越依赖RGB-D、点云等显式3D模态，这类模态会引入硬件依赖、标定要求，且在真实场景部署时易受传感器噪声影响。本文提出，在仿真阶段将几何知识编码到视觉表征中，无需在测试阶段使用显式3D传感即可实现视角不变控制。本文提出AnyViewDex，这是一种非对称训练流水线，融合了多视图对比对齐与特权3D几何监督。通过在仿真训练阶段回归物体的绝对3D坐标，该辅助任务提供了几何锚定信号，可缓解全局池化对比嵌入的空间坍缩问题。部署阶段，策略仅使用未标定的单目RGB图像与本体感知即可实现零样本运行。本文在强化学习与师生蒸馏两种范式下均验证了该方法的有效性。在搭载16自由度LEAP灵巧手的xArm7机械臂硬件平台上开展测试，AnyViewDex在8个未见过的物体、6个未标定视角下的抓取成功率达到76.7%（共480次测试，所有消融实验合计2400次测试），证明经过几何锚定的单目策略无需测试阶段的深度信息即可实现零样本跨场景迁移。项目主页：https://anyviewdex.github.io/

title: Safety-Critical Scenanrio Emerges from Initial Scene
title_zh: 安全关键场景从初始场景中生成
authors: Yin Wu, Jiarong Wei, Carl Esselborn, Shubham Phoolari, Ahmed Abouelazm, Daniel Slieter, J. Marius Z\"ollner
abstract: Safety-critical driving scenario generation has largely focused on manipulating the behavior of surrounding agents while starting from an initial scene from driving data. This assumption can limit the space of discoverable failures, since driving data can provide little opportunity for meaningful interaction. For example, in the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 20.44% of recorded slices feature a stationary ego vehicle that never moves, and 30.39% of initial frames contain no nearby traffic participants within 10 meters. We instead study safety-critical scenario generation as an initialization problem: given agnostic black-box driving policies, we learn to generate realistic initial scenes that are more likely to evolve into critical interactions. We propose AdvScene, a conditional latent diffusion model that is trained in two stages. Starting from pretraining on naturalistic driving data, we post-train the adversarial-agent generation branch using reinforcement learning with feedback from closed-loop simulator rollouts. Conditioning on ego driving displacement prevents the ego from remaining static, and RL finetuning induces criticality directly with non-differentiable safety-critical metrics. Experiments on the Waymo dataset across 12 combinations of ego and traffic policies show that our AdvScene substantially increases the rate of ego-fault collision events and TTC<3s events.
summary_zh: 现有安全关键驾驶场景生成研究大多从驾驶数据的初始场景出发，操控周边智能体的行为来生成场景。该假设会限制可发现的故障空间，因为真实驾驶数据中很少出现有意义的交互场景：例如Waymo开放运动数据集中，20.44%的记录片段中自车全程静止，30.39%的初始帧内10米范围内没有其他交通参与者。本文将安全关键场景生成作为初始化问题开展研究：给定未知的黑盒驾驶策略，学习生成更易演化出关键交互的真实初始场景。本文提出AdvScene，这是一种两阶段训练的条件潜扩散模型。首先在自然驾驶数据上做预训练，之后利用闭环仿真 rollout 的反馈，通过强化学习对对抗智能体生成分支做后训练。基于自车行驶位移做条件约束可避免自车保持静止，强化学习微调可直接通过不可微的安全关键指标诱导生成场景的关键程度。在Waymo数据集上针对12种自车与交通策略组合开展的实验表明，本文提出的AdvScene可大幅提升自车责任碰撞事件与TTC（碰撞时间）小于3秒事件的生成概率。

title: Graph-Based Design of Soft Grippers with Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity Optimisation
title_zh: 基于图的多目标质量多样性优化软爪设计
authors: Andre Farinha, Ge Shi, Harry Bowman, Brendan Tidd, David Howard, Josh Pinskier
abstract: Our results show that optimization over a sufficiently diverse set of grasping cases leads to designs with emergent generalization, exhibiting improved robustness compared to task-specific solutions on novel scenarios. These findings suggest that diversity-driven optimization offers a principled pathway toward general-purpose soft grippers, aligned with the adaptable nature of soft robotics.
summary_zh: 实验结果表明，在足够多样化的抓取案例集上开展优化，得到的软爪设计会涌现出泛化能力，在新场景下相比面向特定任务的解决方案具备更优的鲁棒性。该发现表明，多样性驱动的优化是开发通用型软爪的合理路径，与软体机器人的自适应特性高度契合。

title: FlipToSee: A Probabilistic Stable Placement Prior for Active Visual Exploration via Regrasping
title_zh: FlipToSee：基于重抓取的主动视觉探索概率稳定放置先验
authors: Chang Shu, Sushil Samuel Dinesh, Shinkyu Park
abstract: Active visual exploration of tabletop objects often requires reorienting an unknown resting object onto a different stable support face to expose occluded surfaces. To identify such placements without exhaustive physical search, we learn a probabilistic placement prior from a single-view point cloud. Stable placement prediction is inherently multimodal, and conventional 6-DoF regression introduces further ambiguity by modeling translation and in-plane yaw. We therefore propose FlipToSee, a probabilistic framework that removes this representational ambiguity by parameterizing placements as unit support normals on $S^2$ while modeling their multimodal conditional distribution via a von Mises--Fisher mixture density network. To decouple mode diversity from physical robustness, FlipToSee deterministically extracts a compact candidate set from the mixture components and applies robustness-aware reranking using an auxiliary head trained with candidate-aligned supervision. In simulation, FlipToSee achieves $98.4\%$ first-proposal success on in-distribution objects, $95.3\%$ on out-of-distribution shapes, and $90.0\%$ under zero-shot transfer to household YCB objects. We further demonstrate the learned placement prior on a physical robot by integrating it with grasp and motion planning for exploratory regrasping.
summary_zh: 对桌面物体的主动视觉探索通常需要将未知的静置物体翻转到不同的稳定支撑面上，以暴露被遮挡的表面。为了无需穷尽物理搜索即可确定这类放置位置，本文从单视图点云中学习概率放置先验。稳定放置预测本质上是多模态任务，传统的6自由度回归方法会通过建模平移与平面内偏航角引入额外歧义。为此本文提出FlipToSee，这是一种概率框架，将放置位置参数化为二维球面上的单位支撑法向量，消除了表征歧义，同时通过冯·米塞斯-费舍尔混合密度网络对其多模态条件分布建模。为了将模态多样性与物理鲁棒性解耦，FlipToSee从混合分量中确定性地提取精简候选集，并通过使用候选对齐监督训练的辅助头开展鲁棒性感知重排序。在仿真环境中，FlipToSee在分布内物体上的首个候选放置成功率为98.4%，在分布外形状上为95.3%，在零样本迁移到家用YCB物体时仍达到90.0%的成功率。本文将学习得到的放置先验与抓取、运动规划模块集成，在实体机器人平台上验证了其面向探索性重抓取的可用性。

title: Mechanical Precision Weeding with a Quadruped Robot
title_zh: 基于四足机器人的机械精准除草
authors: Ruben Beumer, Tom Janssen, Ren\'e van de Molengraft, Duarte Antunes
abstract: Herbicide-based weed control is increasingly unsustainable due to rising weed resistance and the adverse environmental impacts of chemical use. While mechanical weed control avoids these drawbacks, it is typically implemented using large machines that cause soil compaction. We propose a novel alternative based on small mobile robots for mechanical weeding. Compared with existing automated mechanical weeding approaches, the proposed method offers reduced soil compaction, simpler automation, and improved scalability. Our solution involves a Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped robot equipped with a custom weed removal tool featuring a milling bit at its end. The tool is rigidly attached to the robot and uses the degrees of freedom of the robot base by actuating the legs, while keeping the feet stationary. We develop a software architecture that enables autonomous weed removal and integrate this system with all other required components. We analyze the accuracy and efficiency of the current proof of concept both in an indoor and outdoor environment and provide recommendations for future work to make the system more accurate and efficient.
summary_zh: 由于杂草抗性不断提升、化学除草剂对环境的负面影响日益凸显，基于除草剂的杂草控制方案越来越难以为继。机械除草虽然可以避免上述缺陷，但现有方案大多使用大型机械，易造成土壤板结。本文提出一种基于小型移动机器人的新型机械除草替代方案，与现有自动化机械除草方法相比，该方案可降低土壤板结风险、简化自动化流程、提升可扩展性。本文的解决方案采用波士顿动力Spot四足机器人，搭载定制化除草工具，工具末端配备铣削头。该工具与机器人刚性连接，在保持足端静止的前提下，通过驱动腿部利用机器人本体的自由度完成除草动作。本文开发了可实现自主除草的软件架构，将该系统与所有必要组件完成集成。本文在室内与室外环境下对当前验证原型的准确性与效率开展了分析，并给出了后续提升系统精度与效率的优化方向建议。

title: DR-MPC: Fast and Feasible Dynamics-Relaxed Model-Predictive Control for Legged Locomotion
title_zh: DR-MPC：面向足式机器人运动的快速可行动力学松弛模型预测控制
authors: Run Wang, Alapati Tuerxun, Shuo Liu, Wei Xiao, J\'an Drgo\v{n}a, Yilin Mo, Liang Wu
abstract: This paper presents dynamics-relaxed model predictive control (DR-MPC), a novel MPC formulation for legged locomotion, and a tailored interior-point method (IPM) solver. The formulation combines online optimization feasibility by construction with a contact-aware input parameterization. DR-MPC moves the dynamics equality and affine input constraints into quadratic penalties and retains only nonempty box constraints. The resulting box-constrained quadratic program (QP) has a block-arrow Hessian that enables the state and affine-output directions to be eliminated through a Schur complement. The solver factors only the reduced control system after swing-force elimination and contact-aligned move blocking. For the evaluated implementations using the same DR-MPC formulation, our method achieves median end-to-end MPC speedups of $16.0\times$ over HPIPM and $4.4\times$ over OSQP, with comparable locomotion performance in simulation. DR-MPC achieves a median onboard MPC end-to-end time of $4.4$ ms and is validated on a Unitree Go1 quadruped. Open-source code will be made available after publication.
summary_zh: 本文提出动力学松弛模型预测控制（dynamics-relaxed Model-Predictive Control, DR-MPC），这是一种面向足式机器人运动的新型MPC公式，以及配套定制化的内点法（Interior-Point Method, IPM）求解器。该公式通过构造接触感知的输入参数化，从底层保证在线优化的可行性。DR-MPC将动力学等式约束与仿射输入约束转化为二次惩罚项，仅保留非空边界约束。最终得到的边界约束二次规划问题具有块箭头形海森矩阵，可通过舒尔补消去状态与仿射输出方向。求解器在完成摆动力消去与接触对齐分块后，仅对降维后的控制系统做分解。在使用相同DR-MPC公式的实现方案中，本文方法的端到端MPC速度相比HPIPM中位数提升16.0倍，相比OSQP中位数提升4.4倍，仿真中运动性能相当。DR-MPC在宇树Go1四足机器人平台上的板载端到端MPC运算中位数耗时为4.4毫秒，相关开源代码将在论文发表后公开。

title: Compliance for Free: Learning Identifiable Impedance via Bilateral Teleoperation
title_zh: 免费获得柔顺性：通过双边遥操作学习可识别阻抗
authors: Harsha Guda, Adri\`{a} Colom\'{e}, Carme Torras
abstract: Vision-language-action models tell a robot where to move, but not how hard to push. Contact-rich tasks depend on that second quantity, compliance, yet no widely used demonstration interface records it. The obstacle is identifiability as realized pose and measured force cannot separate the operator's intended equilibrium from their stiffness, so VR controllers, SpaceMouse and handheld grippers cannot supply compliance supervision even in principle. Prior compliance-output policies work around this with hand-specified task structure, privileged simulation contact state, or dedicated force and tactile hardware. Four-channel bilateral teleoperation removes the ambiguity directly by using the leader arm as a separate measurement of the intended equilibrium, making per-axis stiffness identifiable by regression using only the joint-torque sensing already on the manipulator. This yields per-timestep, direction-dependent compliance labels at zero annotation cost, which we use to fine-tune a VLA to emit stiffness alongside pose. On a Franka Research 3 wiping task, ours is the only policy of five whose contact force changes when the instruction asks for a firm wipe rather than a normal one (6.4N (normal) to 9.1N (firm) RMS, Cohen's d = 0.89, p = 0.023
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型可告知机器人移动的位置，但无法告知机器人施加力的大小。富接触任务高度依赖后者即柔顺性，但现有主流演示接口均无法记录该信息。该问题的根源在于可识别性限制：实际位姿与测量得到的力无法区分操作者的期望平衡点与刚度，因此VR控制器、SpaceMouse、手持夹爪从原理上都无法提供柔顺性监督信号。现有面向柔顺性输出的策略大多通过人工指定任务结构、特权仿真接触状态，或者专用力与触觉硬件来规避该问题。本文提出的四通道双边遥操作方案可直接消除该歧义：将主机械臂作为期望平衡点的独立测量源，仅利用机械臂自带的关节力矩传感，通过回归即可实现每个轴的刚度可识别。该方法可零标注成本得到逐时间步、方向相关的柔顺性标签，本文利用该标签微调VLA模型，使其在输出位姿的同时输出刚度。在Franka Research 3机械臂的擦拭任务中，本文提出的策略是5种对比策略中唯一可在指令要求大力擦拭而非普通擦拭时改变接触力的方案：普通擦拭的力均方根值为6.4N，大力擦拭为9.1N，科恩d值为0.89，p值为0.023。

title: MaskHarness-WAM: Instance-Grounded Harnessing for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
title_zh: MaskHarness-WAM：面向长周期机器人操作的实例锚定框架
authors: Zitai Huang, Taiyi Su, Jian Zhu, Jianjun Zhang, Chong Ma, Tianbin Liu, Weiyi Lu, Yi Xu, Hanli Wang
abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires not only stable local visuomotor control, but also continuous target tracking and reliable task progress assessment throughout execution. This challenge becomes particularly critical when multiple objects share identical appearances and must be manipulated in a prescribed order. In such scenarios, relying solely on a limited-horizon manipulation policy is often insufficient to determine which instance should be operated on and when the task should transition to the next stage. To address this challenge, we propose MaskHarness-WAM, an instance-grounded harness for long-horizon manipulation. The proposed system connects high-level task planning with low-level manipulation policies through target masks, while leveraging visual feedback for subtask scheduling and continuous execution. Since each subtask corresponds to a different target instance, the low-level policy requires a newly established initial target mask under the updated scene at each subtask transition. The harness continuously re-observes the environment, generates, and verifies the target mask at subtask boundaries, thereby updating the instance-level spatial condition provided to the low-level policy. Furthermore, the system advances the manipulation process by switching target instances according to the verified completion status of each subtask. Experiments on a real robot platform demonstrate that MaskHarness-WAM substantially outperforms limited-horizon policies on sequential multi-object manipulation, showing its effectiveness in extending local manipulation skills to reliable long-horizon execution.
summary_zh: 长周期机器人操作不仅需要稳定的局部视觉运动控制，还需要在整个执行过程中持续跟踪目标、可靠评估任务进度。当多个物体外观完全一致、且必须按指定顺序操作时，该挑战尤为突出。这类场景下，仅依靠有限视野的操作策略通常不足以判断当前应该操作哪个实例、任务何时应该切换到下一阶段。为解决该问题，本文提出MaskHarness-WAM，这是一种面向长周期操作的实例锚定框架。该系统通过目标掩码将高层任务规划与低层操作策略连接起来，同时利用视觉反馈实现子任务调度与持续执行。由于每个子任务对应不同的目标实例，每次子任务切换时，低层策略都需要在更新后的场景下重新生成初始目标掩码。该框架会在子任务边界持续重观测环境，生成并验证目标掩码，从而更新输入给低层策略的实例级空间条件。此外，系统还会根据每个子任务的验证完成状态切换目标实例，推进操作流程。在实体机器人平台上开展的实验表明，MaskHarness-WAM在序列多物体操作任务上的性能远优于有限视野操作策略，可有效将局部操作技能拓展为可靠的长周期执行能力。

title: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
title_zh: 面向高接触机器人插书任务的混合残差强化学习
authors: Tianyuan Liu, Rutherford Agbeshi Patamia, Benjamin Champion, Akansel Cosgun, Richard Dazeley
abstract: Placing a grasped book into a tight shelf is a compact but difficult contact-rich control problem: millimetre-scale pose error can turn a geometrically valid approach into jamming, failed release, or incomplete seating. We study this final phase after grasp acquisition and global approach, and ask how control authority should be divided between known geometry and learned behaviour. Our method retains a nominal task-space controller for structured insertion and seating, while residual PPO supplies bounded local corrections and decides when to release. Only the brief open-retreat-reclose transition is scripted. For the final policy used on hardware, a deployment-matched simulation evaluation over 512 fixed conditions yields 98.50 percent mean success (0.23 percentage-point sample SD) across three independent training runs, compared with 37.89 percent for nominal control. On the physical xArm7, 60 trials over 30 matched conditions show the same qualitative advantage: residual control raises success from 26.7 percent to 63.3 percent, reduces failures from 22 to 11, and wins 13 of the 15 matched conditions in which the two controllers differ. Robustness tests show that performance remains above 87 percent under initialization perturbations up to 1.5x, while very tight clearances expose the geometric limit of local correction. These results support a hybrid design in which geometry preserves reliable task structure and learning is concentrated on the contact-sensitive behaviour that fixed rules handle poorly.
summary_zh: 将抓取到的书籍放入紧凑书架是一项典型的高接触控制问题，尽管任务场景简单但实现难度极高：毫米级的位姿误差就会让几何层面可行的插入动作出现卡滞、释放失败或放置不到位的问题。本文聚焦抓取完成、全局路径规划结束后的最终作业阶段，研究如何在已知几何规则和学习得到的行为之间分配控制权限。我们的方法保留面向结构化插入和放置的标称任务空间控制器，同时通过残差PPO（近端策略优化）提供有界的局部修正并判断释放时机，仅对短暂的「打开-后退-闭合」过渡环节做脚本化预设。在硬件部署对应的仿真环境中，针对512种固定条件开展的评估显示，三次独立训练得到的最终策略平均成功率达98.50%（样本标准差为0.23个百分点），而纯标称控制的成功率仅为37.89%。在实体xArm7机械臂平台上，针对30组匹配条件开展的60次试验也呈现出一致的性能优势：残差控制将成功率从26.7%提升至63.3%，故障次数从22次降至11次，在两个控制器表现存在差异的15组匹配条件中，有13组残差控制的表现更优。鲁棒性测试表明，当初始化扰动最高达到基准值的1.5倍时，系统性能仍可保持在87%以上，而当间隙极小时，局部修正的几何极限就会暴露出来。上述结果验证了混合架构的有效性：几何规则可保障可靠的任务基础结构，而学习过程则聚焦于固定规则难以处理的接触敏感行为。

title: Execution-Aware Pre-Execution Ranking for Grasp-Conditioned Robotic Placement
title_zh: 面向抓取条件下机器人放置任务的执行感知预执行排序
authors: Tianyuan Liu, Rutherford Agbeshi Patamia, Benjamin Champion, Richard Dazeley, Akansel Cosgun
abstract: A geometrically valid placement can still be difficult to execute because the selected grasp changes the required end-effector pose, collision geometry, and transport motion. Placement is formulated as a pre-execution ranking problem in which supplied grasp-placement candidates are scored before planning. The model combines a typed target-conditioned point cloud with three pose descriptors and hierarchical heads for planning success and execution success conditioned on planning. On a 30-object, 1,235-scene dataset with scene-group-held-out splits, three-seed top-1 success on covered test groups reaches 85.63 +/- 1.08% for joint selection and 79.84 +/- 0.16% for fixed-target ranking. For the designated frozen seed-42 checkpoint, top-1 success improves from 72.84% to 85.78% over full-pool cuMotion for joint ranking and from 59.65% to 79.67% for fixed-target ranking. Frozen transfer to xArm7/MoveIt requires no xArm-specific retraining. Across 27 locked cases, 13 complete end to end (48.15%). Of the 16 cases that pass Top-5 preflight and begin execution, 13 succeed (81.25%). Candidate-level deployment-feasibility prediction reaches 81.25% recall, 85.20% specificity, and 83.23% balanced accuracy.
summary_zh: 几何层面可行的放置动作仍可能难以执行，原因在于选定的抓取方式会改变所需的末端执行器位姿、碰撞几何形态和搬运运动轨迹。本文将放置任务建模为预执行排序问题，在规划阶段之前就对输入的抓取-放置候选组合进行打分。该模型融合了带类型的目标条件点云、三类位姿描述符，以及分别面向规划成功率、规划条件下执行成功率的分层输出头。在包含30个物体、1235个场景、按场景分组留出测试集的数据集上，三次随机种子实验的联合选择任务覆盖测试组Top-1成功率达85.63±1.08%，固定目标排序任务的Top-1成功率达79.84±0.16%。针对指定的冻结种子42检查点，联合排序任务的Top-1成功率相比全池cuMotion方法从72.84%提升至85.78%，固定目标排序任务的Top-1成功率从59.65%提升至79.67%。将模型直接迁移到xArm7/MoveIt平台无需针对xArm做额外重训练。在27组锁定测试用例中，有13组实现了端到端完成（占比48.15%）；通过Top-5预校验并开始执行的16个用例中，有13个执行成功（占比81.25%）。候选级部署可行性预测的召回率达81.25%，特异度达85.20%，平衡准确率达83.23%。

title: Co-VLA: Consensus-based Federated Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: Co-VLA：基于共识的视觉-语言-动作模型联邦训练方法
authors: Haolong Li, Guner Dilsad Er, Michael Muehlebach, Joerg Stueckler
abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot learning, with performance improving as models and datasets scale. Scaling robot data collection, however, remains challenging because data are naturally distributed across robots, tasks, and locations, making centralization costly or impractical. Federated learning offers a way to train on decentralized robot data, but applying it to VLAs requires accounting for heterogeneous robot client data distributions. We present Co-VLA, which applies consensus optimization using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers~(ADMM) to federated VLA training. We show that the same algorithm supports both full-model training and parameter-efficient fine-tuning with both fixed-rank and rank-adaptive adapters. The name Co-VLA reflects both consensus and collaboration: clients with different local robot datasets collaboratively train a shared model without sharing their data. Our experiments demonstrate that Co-VLA achieves performance comparable to centralized training in both full-model training and parameter-efficient fine-tuning settings.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）是通用机器人学习领域极具潜力的范式，其性能会随着模型规模和数据集规模的扩大不断提升。但机器人数据采集的规模化推进始终面临挑战：数据天然分布在不同机器人、不同任务、不同场景中，集中式采集的成本极高甚至难以实现。联邦学习为分布式机器人数据训练提供了可行路径，但将其应用于VLA训练需要解决异构机器人客户端的数据分布差异问题。本文提出Co-VLA框架，采用基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的共识优化实现VLA的联邦训练。研究表明，该算法同时支持全模型训练，以及基于固定秩和秩自适应适配器的参数高效微调。Co-VLA的命名同时体现了共识与协作的核心特性：拥有不同本地机器人数据集的客户端无需共享原始数据，即可协作训练得到共享的全局模型。实验结果表明，无论是全模型训练场景还是参数高效微调场景，Co-VLA的性能都可以和集中式训练的性能相媲美。

title: Distributed Model Predictive Control with Connectivity-based Contracts
title_zh: 基于连通性契约的分布式模型预测控制
authors: Jorit Geurts, Danilo Saccani, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Andrea Carron
abstract: Teams of mobile robots rely on continuous communication with their neighbors for coordination, yet most distributed model predictive control (DMPC) schemes assume the communication network stays connected rather than actively enforcing it. Adding such a guarantee is hard since the usual mathematical condition for connectivity is nonconvex and links every agent to every other, which is incompatible with a scalable distributed real-time controller. We propose a DMPC framework in which each agent is assigned a connectivity contract: a local region prescribing where its predicted positions may lie over the prediction horizon. The contracts are designed so that, as long as every agent stays within its own contract, the team is guaranteed to remain connected. Given the maintained contract graph, an agent builds its contract from a single exchange with its immediate neighbors, after which every agent solves its own optimization problem independently. We prove that the resulting closed-loop system maintains connectivity, avoids collisions, and respects local state and input constraints. Simulation and hardware experiments on miniature autonomous car-like robots demonstrate the approach.
summary_zh: 多移动机器人团队的协作依赖于机器人之间的持续通信，但现有大多数分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）方案都假设通信网络始终保持连通，而非主动保障连通性。要额外增加连通性保障难度极大，因为常规的连通性数学条件是非凸的，且要求所有智能体两两关联，和可扩展的分布式实时控制器的设计要求不兼容。本文提出一种DMPC框架，为每个智能体分配连通性契约：该契约是一个局部区域，规定了智能体在预测时域内的预测位置允许分布的范围。契约的设计满足如下特性：只要所有智能体都处于自身的契约范围内，就可以保证整个机器人团队的通信网络始终连通。在契约图保持连通的前提下，每个智能体仅需要和直接相邻的智能体做一次信息交互即可构建自身的契约，之后所有智能体都可以独立求解自身的优化问题。本文从理论上证明，最终得到的闭环系统可以始终保持连通性、避免碰撞，同时满足本地状态和输入约束。在微型自主轮式机器人平台上开展的仿真和硬件实验验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
title_zh: 基于带量化动作表示的离线强化学习学习可靠泊车策略
authors: So Kuroki, Yujin Tang
abstract: Closed-loop robot policies require observation processing, state management, and situation-dependent branching, making them costly to design and tune manually. Although coding agents increasingly support control-code generation and optimization, it remains unclear whether implementations improved on source tasks also support policy acquisition for new tasks. We study this question by treating complete closed-loop implementations as reusable execution experience. For each source task, a coding agent generates policy code from a few successful demonstrations and iteratively improves it using simulation feedback. The validation-selected implementations are retained in a software archive. For new tasks, the agent generates and improves policies using archived implementations, target demonstrations, and execution feedback. The resulting policy is then frozen and executes without further model calls. Across four source tasks in RoboCasa, iterative optimization increases mean success from 28.3% to 64.2%. Across nine target tasks and three independent runs, mean success is 45.2% without references, 41.5% with initial source code, and 57.0% with optimized source code. Optimized references outperform initial references in all three runs on the nine-task average, with a mean gain of 15.6 percentage points. These results demonstrate the value of execution-improved software as a resource for acquiring new policies in this setting, although initial references remain better on two target tasks when averaged across runs.
summary_zh: 泊车是城市环境下自主车辆的常规任务，同时也是安全关键任务。但杂乱、弱结构化的泊车空间，加上周边车辆带来的交互不确定性，会阻碍可靠泊车轨迹的生成。为解决上述挑战，本文开发了面向交互感知自主泊车的路点级离线强化学习框架。具体而言，我们基于带旋转路点增强的分层专家轨迹构建了专用泊车数据集，覆盖非交互场景和交互场景。策略基于紧凑的状态表示构建，其中基于激光雷达的障碍物特征通过特征线性调制适配目标位姿。状态条件分词器进一步将连续路点序列量化为离散动作令牌，在此基础上执行保守Q学习，抑制对支撑不足动作的价值过估计。我们在高保真CARLA仿真器中开展了大量闭环实验，结果表明所提框架的泊车成功率在所有基线方法中最高，且可以可靠迁移到未见过的泊车位场景中。

title: Learning Reliable Parking Policies via Offline Reinforcement Learning with Quantized Action Representations
authors: Zewei Yang, Zengqi Peng, Jun Ma
abstract: Parking is a routine yet safety-critical task for autonomous vehicles operating in urban environments. However, cluttered and weakly structured parking spaces, compounded by the interactive uncertainty from surrounding vehicles, hinder reliable maneuver generation. To address these challenges, we develop a waypoint-level offline reinforcement learning framework for interaction-aware autonomous parking. Specifically, a dedicated parking dataset is constructed from hierarchical expert rollouts with rotational waypoint augmentation, covering both non-interactive scenarios and interactive ones. The policy is then conditioned on a compact state representation, in which LiDAR-based obstacle features are adapted to the target pose via feature-wise linear modulation. A state-conditioned tokenizer further quantizes continuous waypoint sequences into discrete action tokens, over which conservative Q-learning is performed to suppress value overestimation on poorly supported actions. Extensive closed-loop experiments are conducted in the high-fidelity CARLA simulator. The proposed framework attains the highest parking success rate among all baselines and transfers reliably to unseen parking slots.

title: GR2PO: Group Relative Return Policy Optimization for Continuous Robot Control
title_zh: GR2PO：面向连续机器人控制的组相对回报策略优化
authors: Pengqin Wang, Qiming Zhang, Shaojie Shen, Jun Ma
abstract: Actor-critic architecture has been widely used in continuous robot control. However, they rely on learning a value network, introducing additional computational overhead during training. Moreover, policy learning may also be affected by the approximation error of value estimation. Critic-free group relative policy optimization methods provide a simpler training approach by removing the need for a critic. However, they fail to learn long-term action outcomes when directly applying immediate rewards to policy optimization in dense-reward environments. To address these problems, we propose Group Relative Return Policy Optimization (GR2PO), a critic-free reinforcement learning framework for continuous robot control. GR2PO estimates the discounted returns from the parallelly collected trajectories, performs group normalization at each rollout time index, and uses relative advantages and clipped targets to update the policy. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, we instantiate it on robot control simulation environments and deploy the model to a real-world edge device. The results show that GR2PO significantly outperforms critic-free baselines that use immediate rewards and performs competitively against state-of-the-art actor-critic methods. Furthermore, GR2PO demonstrates competitive training efficiency. Inference tests on NVIDIA Jetson TX2 demonstrate the feasibility of deploying the learned policies on edge platforms. Further ablation experiments analyze the effects of parallel group size, return estimation methods, and target clipping ratio on learning performance. To support follow-up research, we will make the complete code publicly available after the paper is accepted, including the framework implementation, experimental configuration, and training and evaluation scripts.
summary_zh: 演员-评论家架构已在连续机器人控制领域得到广泛应用，但这类方法依赖于学习价值网络，会在训练过程中引入额外的计算开销，同时策略学习效果还可能受到价值估计近似误差的影响。无评论家的组相对策略优化方法无需引入评论家，训练流程更简洁，但在稠密奖励环境中直接将即时奖励用于策略优化时，无法学习到长期动作的收益。为解决上述问题，本文提出组相对回报策略优化（GR2PO），这是面向连续机器人控制的无评论家强化学习框架。GR2PO基于并行采集的轨迹估计折扣回报，在每个轨迹采样时间索引处执行组归一化，利用相对优势和裁剪后的目标更新策略。为验证所提框架的有效性，我们在机器人控制仿真环境中实例化该框架，并将模型部署到真实边缘设备上。结果表明，GR2PO的性能显著优于采用即时奖励的无评论家基线方法，和当前最先进的演员-评论家方法相比也具备竞争力，同时训练效率表现优异。在NVIDIA Jetson TX2平台上开展的推理测试验证了将学习得到的策略部署到边缘平台的可行性。后续消融实验分析了并行组规模、回报估计方法、目标裁剪比例对学习性能的影响。为支撑后续相关研究，论文录用后我们将公开全部代码，包括框架实现、实验配置、训练和评估脚本。

title: Constraint-Safe Graph-Context Scoring for Stable Point-Feature Labels Under Text-Width and Accessibility-Inspired Profiles
title_zh: 面向文本宽度与可访问性约束下稳定点特征标签的约束安全图上下文评分方法
authors: Taimoor Ahmad
abstract: Point-feature label placement on interactive maps must reconcile geometric validity, display yield, local placement utility, and stability across camera motion. Accessibility and multilingual requirements further change label dimensions, yet algorithmic evaluations often collapse these concerns into overlap counts. We present LABELSENSE-Pilot, a reproducible prototype that generates eight compass candidates per feature, scores candidates with a multilayer perceptron over graph-context summaries, adds a previous-placement bonus, and selects a layout through mixed-integer optimization. The executed scorer is deliberately not described as a graph transformer. Every returned layout is checked for viewport containment, per-feature uniqueness, and pairwise clearance. Experiments use 2,500 airport coordinates and names spanning 155 countries, with country-grouped splits and generated density, camera, text-suffix, preference, and enlarged-font stressors. Across five seeds, LABELSENSE-Pilot displayed 85.62 percent of labels with 2.09 percent flicker and zero collisions. Versus a handcrafted-utility integer program, LABELSENSE-Pilot sacrificed 1.43 percentage points of display while reducing flicker by 12.04 points. Enlarged-box-aware layouts produced zero proxy violations, whereas standard geometry reevaluated at 1.5x violated 52.57 percent of selected placements. These results establish an auditable engineering trade-off, not human accessibility, multilingual usability, or preference. Official recent baselines and participant evidence remain required before submission.
summary_zh: 交互式地图上的点特征标签放置需要兼顾几何有效性、显示率、局部放置效用，以及相机运动过程中的稳定性。可访问性和多语言要求会进一步改变标签的尺寸，但现有算法评估通常将这些需求简化为标签重叠计数问题。本文提出可复现原型系统LABELSENSE-Pilot，该系统为每个点特征生成8个方位的候选标签位置，基于图上下文摘要通过多层感知机对候选位置打分，加入上一帧放置位置的奖励项，最终通过混合整数优化选择最优布局。本文明确说明所使用的打分器并非图Transformer架构。所有输出的布局都会经过视口包含性、单特征标签唯一性、两两标签间距校验。实验采用覆盖155个国家的2500个机场坐标和名称数据集，按国家分组划分测试集，同时生成密度、相机、文本后缀、偏好、放大字体等压力测试条件。五次随机种子实验的结果显示，LABELSENSE-Pilot的标签显示率达85.62%，标签闪烁率仅为2.09%，且无任何碰撞。和基于人工设计效用的整数规划方法相比，LABELSENSE-Pilot的标签显示率仅下降1.43个百分点，但标签闪烁率降低了12.04个百分点。考虑放大标签尺寸生成的布局不存在任何代理违规情况，而采用标准几何规则在1.5倍放大条件下重新评估时，有52.57%的选中放置位置不符合要求。上述结果明确了可审计的工程权衡边界，相关方法尚未完全覆盖人类可访问性、多语言可用性和偏好需求，后续还需要补充最新官方基线和用户参与的验证证据才能正式投稿。

title: Improving Cross-embodiment Transfer in Latent Action Models with Action-Similarity Supervision
title_zh: 利用动作相似性监督提升潜动作模型的跨本体迁移能力
authors: Maxime Alvarez, Renzo Caballero, Tatsuya Matsushima, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo
abstract: As generalist robot policies gain vision and language from web-scale pretraining, demonstrations remain costly to collect and tied to the robot that recorded them. Latent action models (LAMs) address both by learning latent actions from action-free videos that can be shared across embodiments, however, in practice, LAMs are sensitive to background visual noise, and the same motion from two different robots may be encoded with different latents. One solution to the background visual noise is to add an auxiliary loss predicting the robot action from the latent action, further associating the latent action space to the embodiment specific robot action space. We study a different use of the same labels, through action-similarity supervision. The similarity between any two latent actions is trained to match the similarity of the two ground-truth robot action sequences. The ground-truth actions are never predicted by the LAM, so the latent action does not need to encode embodiment specifics. We evaluate cross-embodiment transfer on RoboTwin 2.0 in a controlled setup, two bimanual robots demonstrate disjoint task sets, a policy is trained on all the demonstrations, and each robot is evaluated closed-loop on the tasks only the other demonstrated. With the policy architecture and its hyperparameters, the dataset, and the evaluation protocol fixed, predicting latent actions instead of ground-truth actions more than doubles cross-embodiment success. Given the same ground-truth actions, similarity supervision transfers better than an auxiliary loss that predicts the ground-truth action during the LAM training. Computing the similarities on end-effector motion rather than joint-space motion, and letting the loss compare latent actions across the two robots, gives the best approach of the study.
summary_zh: 随着通用机器人策略从网页级预训练中获取视觉和语言能力，采集演示数据的成本仍然很高，且演示数据和录制它的机器人本体强绑定。潜动作模型（LAM）可以从无动作标注的视频中学习可跨本体共享的潜动作，解决上述问题，但在实际应用中LAM对背景视觉噪声十分敏感，不同机器人执行的相同运动可能被编码为完全不同的潜动作。针对背景视觉噪声问题，现有方案通常加入从潜动作预测机器人动作的辅助损失，将潜动作空间和特定本体的机器人动作空间进一步关联。本文研究了相同动作标签的另一种使用方式：动作相似性监督。该方法训练任意两个潜动作之间的相似度，使其和两个真实机器人动作序列的相似度匹配，且LAM不需要预测真实动作，因此潜动作无需编码特定本体的特性。我们在受控设置下的RoboTwin 2.0平台上评估跨本体迁移性能：两台双臂机器人分别演示互不重叠的任务集，在所有演示数据上训练统一策略，之后每台机器人仅在另一台机器人演示过的任务上开展闭环评估。在策略架构、超参数、数据集、评估协议完全固定的前提下，采用潜动作相似度监督而非预测真实动作的方法，可将跨本体迁移成功率提升一倍以上。在使用相同真实动作标签的前提下，相似度监督的迁移效果优于LAM训练过程中预测真实动作的辅助损失方法。基于末端执行器运动而非关节空间运动计算相似度，同时让损失函数跨两台机器人对比潜动作，可得到本研究中性能最优的方案。

title: TADreamer: Zero-Shot Language-Guided 3D Navigation for Terrestrial-Aerial Bimodal Robots via Video Imagination
title_zh: TADreamer：基于视频想象的陆空双模机器人零样本语言引导3D导航
authors: Xiangyu Li, Tiancheng Lai, Xijie Huang, Ruitian Pang, Siqi Shen, Juncheng Chen, Zaisheng Pan, Chao Xu, Fei Gao, Yanjun Cao
abstract: Language-guided navigation for terrestrial-aerial bimodal robots requires selecting routes and locomotion modes that match scene context and task intent. Generated videos can represent such motion sequences, but recovering metrically consistent navigation references from them is challenging because of scale ambiguity and axis-dependent geometric distortions. We present TADreamer, a zero-shot framework that grounds video-imagined navigation in measured geometry without task-specific training or fine-tuning. A vision-language model translates onboard observations and instructions into navigation prompts, selects valid generated videos, and provides corrective feedback when regeneration is needed. The selected video is reconstructed into 3D waypoints annotated with terrestrial or aerial modes. A two-stage calibration procedure uses field-of-view constraints to initialize scale estimation, then refines axis-dependent scales, rotation, and translation by registering the reconstructed point cloud to measured geometry. The calibrated waypoints and mode labels guide a planner that incorporates measured geometry for robot execution. Real-world experiments demonstrate navigation across seven indoor and outdoor scenarios. With five candidates per round, usable videos are obtained within two rounds in all seven scenarios. On the calibration observations, our method reduces mean absolute depth error by 87.7% and mean absolute relative depth error by 86.3% compared with NavDreamer.
summary_zh: 陆空双模机器人的语言引导导航需要选择和场景上下文、任务意图匹配的路径和运动模式。生成式视频可以表示这类运动序列，但受尺度歧义、和坐标轴相关的几何畸变影响，很难从生成视频中恢复出度量一致的导航参考信息。本文提出TADreamer零样本框架，无需针对特定任务训练或微调，即可将视频想象得到的导航轨迹锚定到实测几何空间中。视觉语言模型将机载观测和导航指令转换为导航提示，筛选出有效的生成视频，在需要重新生成时提供校正反馈。筛选得到的视频会被重建为标注有地面/空中运动模式的3D路点。两阶段校准流程首先利用视场约束初始化尺度估计，之后通过将重建点云配准到实测几何数据，优化和坐标轴相关的尺度参数、旋转参数和平移参数。校准后的路点和模式标签会输入融合实测几何信息的规划器，引导机器人执行导航任务。真实场景实验验证了该方法在7个室内外场景下的导航能力：每轮生成5个候选视频的前提下，7个场景全部可以在两轮以内得到可用视频。在校准观测集上，和NavDreamer方法相比，本文所提方法的平均绝对深度误差降低87.7%，平均绝对相对深度误差降低86.3%。

title: RotateIt! Fast and Reliable Single-Arm Garment Unfolding via Online-Adaptive Dynamic Rotation
title_zh: RotateIt!：基于在线自适应动态旋转的快速可靠单臂衣物展开方法
authors: Zeqing Zhang, Zuokun Xie, Ao Fang, Bin Dai, Zhengjie Shu, Yifeng Tang, Ziwei Wang
abstract: Robotic garment unfolding is essential for downstream tasks, yet quasi-static methods require repeated actions, while existing dynamic approaches predominantly rely on bimanual flinging. We present RotateIt!, a single-arm framework that uses adaptive axial rotation for dynamic garment unfolding. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first unfolding framework to employ dynamic axial rotation as its primary manipulation primitive. From a randomly initialized tabletop configuration, the robot selects a rotation-effective grasp and rotates the lifted garment about an approximately fixed anchor, generating inertial tension that separates overlapping layers within a compact workspace. A grasp ranker selects the anchor, while an online residual policy adapts the rotation extent and speed, thereby determining the release timing. Across seen and unseen simulated garments and eight unseen real garments, RotateIt! improves success within three attempts by 44.0-61.0 percentage points over quasi-static pick-and-place. The simulation-trained policies transfer zero-shot to the real world, achieving 75.6% success, 41% higher first-attempt coverage, and 26% higher final coverage. The resulting states further enable autonomous robotic folding without manual rearrangement.
summary_zh: 机器人物品展开是下游任务的核心前置环节，但现有准静态方法需要执行大量重复动作，而主流动态方案大多依赖双臂抛甩操作。本文提出RotateIt!，一套采用自适应轴向旋转实现动态衣物展开的单臂框架。据我们所知，这是首个将动态轴向旋转作为核心操作基元的衣物展开框架。该框架可从桌面随机初始构型出发，选择旋转高效的抓取点，将提起的衣物绕近似固定的锚点旋转，在紧凑工作空间内产生惯性张力使重叠衣层分离。抓取排序器负责选定锚点，在线残差策略可自适应调整旋转幅度与速度，进而确定释放时机。在可见、不可见的仿真衣物以及8种未见过的真实衣物测试中，RotateIt!的三次尝试内成功率相比准静态抓取放置方法提升了44.0~61.0个百分点。经仿真训练的策略可零样本迁移至真实场景，实现75.6%的成功率，首次尝试覆盖率提升41%，最终覆盖率提升26%。该方法得到的展开状态可进一步支持机器人在无需人工重排的前提下自主完成衣物折叠。

title: Vehicle Trajectory Prediction via Neural Fusion of Multiple EKF-Based Trajectory Candidates
title_zh: 基于多扩展卡尔曼滤波轨迹候选集神经融合的车辆轨迹预测
authors: Seong-Jun Kim, Seung-Hyun Kong
abstract: Predicting the future trajectories of surrounding vehicles in autonomous driving is important for collision risk assessment and safe ego-vehicle path planning. Conventional neural network-based trajectory predictors typically achieve strong prediction performance by exploiting agent history, dynamic scene graphs, and semantic maps. However, in specific motion regimes such as acceleration, deceleration, and turning, these predictors may fail to reflect physically feasible trajectories. To address this issue, this study proposes a framework that fuses the output of Trajectron++, a neural network-based trajectory predictor, with extended Kalman filter (EKF)-based multiple trajectory candidates at a late stage. On the nuScenes dataset, the proposed method reduces the average displacement error and final displacement error of the Trajectron++ robot baseline by 13.7% and 14.6%, respectively, without modifying the baseline architecture. These results indicate that EKF-based trajectory candidates can effectively complement neural trajectory prediction through learned fusion.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶场景中对周边车辆的未来轨迹预测，是碰撞风险评估与自车安全路径规划的重要基础。传统基于神经网络的轨迹预测器通常利用智能体历史运动数据、动态场景图与语义地图实现优异的预测性能，但在加速、减速、转向等特定运动工况下，这类预测器可能输出不符合物理可行性的轨迹。针对该问题，本研究提出一种后期融合框架，将基于神经网络的轨迹预测器Trajectron++的输出与多个基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的轨迹候选集进行融合。在nuScenes数据集上，所提方法在不修改Trajectron++基线架构的前提下，将其平均位移误差与最终位移误差分别降低了13.7%和14.6%。实验结果表明，基于EKF的轨迹候选集可通过学习得到的融合机制，有效补充神经轨迹预测的物理合理性。

title: HEROIC: Heterogeneous Evidential Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Identification and Cross-Robot Collaboration
title_zh: HEROIC：面向开放词汇识别与跨机器人协作的异构证据推理方法
authors: Mihir Chauhan, Aarav Jain, Addison Zucek, Manmeet Dang, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera
abstract: Multi-agent heterogeneous air-ground robot teams are attractive for open world search, with applications for reconnaissance, urban search and rescue missions (USAR), disaster response and recovery, and hazardous environments. These two platforms have different failure modes: aerial robots cover ground quickly but cannot resolve small or occluded targets from altitude, while ground robots can identify objects-of-interest, such as people or hazardous objects, at close range but cover less area. Existing language-tasked teams either have roles fixed prior, or have a language model assign them from hand-written capability tags, so the team is unable to know when within a mission an asset is no longer useful. We present HEROIC, a decentralized heterogeneous multi-agent open-vocabulary search coordination framework that requires agents to communicate in natural language only. HEROIC's initial agent role assignment is derived from sensor properties and a scale law to determine whether targets can be detected with a high confidence. From the mission's natural language prompt alone, this law assigns aerial flight altitudes and sweep spacing. When this calculated height falls below the altitude for safe flight, aerial agents re-task themselves from searcher to aerial triage, escort, and route guide for ground agents. Both robots maintain an evidential belief over the search area (bearing rays for positive evidence, a log-odds posterior for negative evidence) and gate any arrival on close-range verification. In full-stack experiments, HEROIC reaches the target 84% of the time across all 6 scenes, compares to 35-54% for vision-language frontier baselines, frontier-based search, lawnmower, and random-walk running the same perception, all while being 2-4x sooner to arrive at the target.
summary_zh: 多智能体异构空地机器人团队在开放世界搜索场景中具备显著应用价值，可支撑侦察、城市搜索与救援（USAR）、灾害响应恢复以及危险环境作业等任务。两类机器人平台存在不同的失效模式：空中机器人可快速覆盖地面区域，但受高度限制无法识别小型目标或被遮挡目标；地面机器人可近距离识别人物、危险物品等感兴趣目标，但覆盖范围有限。现有基于语言指令的机器人团队要么预先固定角色，要么由大语言模型根据人工编写的能力标签分配角色，无法在任务执行过程中判断某一智能体是否已失去作用。本文提出HEROIC，一套去中心化异构多智能体开放词汇搜索协调框架，要求智能体仅通过自然语言完成交互。HEROIC的初始智能体角色分配基于传感器属性与尺度定律实现，可判断目标是否能以高置信度被检测到。仅通过任务的自然语言提示，该定律即可分配空中机器人的飞行高度与扫描间距。当计算得到的飞行高度低于安全飞行阈值时，空中智能体将自主从搜索者角色切换为地面智能体的空中分诊员、护航员与路径引导员。两类机器人都会维护搜索区域的证据置信度（正证据用方位射线表示，负证据用对数几率后验表示），所有目标确认环节都需经过近距离验证。在全栈实验中，HEROIC在全部6个场景中的目标到达率达84%，而采用相同感知配置的视觉语言前沿基线、基于前沿的搜索方法、割草机遍历法与随机游走法的目标到达率仅为35%~54%，同时HEROIC抵达目标的速度比对比方法快2~4倍。

title: Affective Shared Autonomy: Temporal Affect Dynamics and Subjective Evaluation in Bimanual Teleoperation Tasks
title_zh: 情感共享自主：双臂遥操作任务中的时间情感动力学与主观评价
authors: Zhengji Liang, Guiyin Tian, Sijin Qu, Hainan Liu, Shiyan Hu
abstract: Physical teleoperation integrates human cognitive flexibility with robotic precision, yet demanding manipulation tasks frequently induce severe cognitive workload, acute frustration, and execution breakdown. Conventional shared autonomy paradigms rely primarily on task-based rules, such as spatial error boundaries, which disregard the operator's transient affective state and risk misaligned control interventions. To address this limitation, we propose an affect-aware shared autonomy teleoperation framework that dynamically modulates robotic assistance based on real-time operator state estimation. The system estimates operator affective states from synchronized facial video, cardiac signals, and bilateral arm kinematics, outputting a seven-state affective distribution and a three-category operational abstraction (neutral, productive, adverse). Affect-aware assistance is selectively triggered when the user is detected in a continuous adverse state, preserving task-positive engagement without unnecessary disruption. The empirical user study ($N = 30$) confirms that the proposed affective assistance increases the productive states by up to 39.7% without compromising user agency. The collected dataset represents the first multimodal dataset that provides continuous visual, physiological, and operator's bilateral motion tracking of temporal affective state shifts during bimanual teleoperation. Our multimodal fusion model outperforms zero-shot baselines (Qwen, MiniCPM-V) in tracking temporal state dynamics. This real-world deployment offers a new human-centric framework that integrates visual, physiological, and motion tracking for physical human-robot interaction.
summary_zh: 物理遥操作融合了人类的认知灵活性与机器人的操作精度，但高负荷操作任务往往会引发操作者严重的认知负载、强烈挫败感甚至执行中断。传统共享自主范式主要依赖空间误差边界等任务类规则，忽略了操作者的瞬时情感状态，容易出现控制干预不匹配的问题。针对该局限，本文提出一种情感感知型共享自主遥操作框架，可基于实时操作者状态估计动态调整机器人辅助策略。该系统通过同步采集的人脸视频、心电信号与双臂运动学数据估计操作者情感状态，输出7类情感分布与3类操作状态抽象（中性、高效、负面）。系统仅在检测到操作者持续处于负面状态时才选择性触发情感感知辅助，在不造成不必要干扰的前提下保障任务正向参与度。共30名受试者的实证用户研究表明，所提情感辅助策略可在不损害操作者控制权的前提下，将高效操作状态占比最高提升39.7%。本次采集的数据集是首个覆盖双臂遥操作过程中连续视觉、生理信号与操作者双臂运动跟踪的多模态数据集，可记录时间维度上的情感状态变化。本文提出的多模态融合模型在跟踪时间状态动态性方面的表现优于Qwen、MiniCPM-V等零样本基线。该真实场景部署方案提供了一种全新的以人为中心的人机交互框架，融合了视觉、生理与运动跟踪三类信号。

title: LIFD: Anchored Diffusion for 3D-Aware Scene Memory in Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: LIFD：面向机器人操作的具备3D感知场景记忆的锚定扩散模型
authors: Wenbo Li, Yiteng Chen, Wenhao Li, Qingyao Wu
abstract: Robotic manipulation under partial observability requires spatial information that extends beyond the current view. Geometry-aware RGB features describe visible structure, but previously observed regions may disappear as the robot or scene moves. Maintaining a useful scene representation therefore requires retaining observation history while inferring missing content without losing its connection to visible evidence. We introduce LIFD (Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do), a framework for persistent, 3D-aware scene memory. LIFD learns a scene-token representation from multi-view agreement and completes it from a single RGB view and recurrent memory. A rectified-flow model generates the tokens while Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention conditions completion on current geometric features. Compact slot features connect this representation to a manipulation policy. Multi-view and geometric supervision are used during representation learning; deployment requires one RGB camera, proprioception, and a task instruction. LIFD (Staged) reaches 91.6% average success on LIBERO and 79.8% on MetaWorld, improving LIBERO average success by 3.1 percentage points over Joint training. On four UR5e task families with ten demonstrations per family, it achieves 56.0% mean success, compared with 40.5% for OpenVLA-7B.
summary_zh: 部分可观测条件下的机器人操作需要获取超出当前视野范围的空间信息。具备几何感知的RGB特征可描述可见区域结构，但随着机器人移动或场景变化，此前观测到的区域可能从视野中消失。因此维护有效的场景表示需要保留观测历史，同时在不丢失与可见证据关联的前提下推断缺失内容。本文提出LIFD（Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do，即观察-想象-聚焦-执行），一套面向持久化3D感知场景记忆的框架。LIFD从多视图一致性中学习场景令牌表示，仅通过单张RGB视图与循环记忆即可补全场景内容。其中整流流模型负责生成令牌，锚定引导交叉注意力机制可基于当前几何特征为补全过程提供条件约束。紧凑的槽特征将该场景表示与操作策略相关联。表示学习阶段采用多视图与几何监督，部署阶段仅需一台RGB相机、本体感知传感器与任务指令即可运行。采用分阶段训练的LIFD在LIBERO基准测试中平均成功率达91.6%，在MetaWorld基准测试中达79.8%，相比联合训练方案将LIBERO的平均成功率提升了3.1个百分点。在4组UR5e任务族（每组包含10次演示样本）的测试中，LIFD的平均成功率达56.0%，高于OpenVLA-7B的40.5%。

title: Equivariant Filter Design for Acoustic and Depth Aided Inertial Navigation Systems
title_zh: 声学与深度辅助惯性导航系统的等变滤波器设计
authors: Arihant Lunawat, Pieter van Goor, Frank Dellaert, Stefan B. Williams
abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) navigating without GPS typically fuse inertial measurements with acoustic Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) velocities and pressure-derived depth. Posing the navigation state on a Lie group improves accuracy and consistency. However, state-of-the-art filters based on the Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (IEKF) append the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) biases as a Euclidean extension, which breaks the group-affine structure required for exact log-linear error dynamics, causing the reported covariance to degrade alongside the estimate. We apply the Tangent-Group (TG) symmetry, which carries the biases within the geometry of the state space, to derive an Equivariant Filter (EqF) for this system, leaving zero linearization error in the navigation states and second-order error only in the biases. We develop an equivariant output model for the DVL, whose update incurs only third-order linearization error, together with a direct pressure output. Monte Carlo simulations benchmark the TG-EqF against a Two-Frame-Group IEKF and a Multiplicative EKF. The TG-EqF reduces error by 18--25\% against both alternatives in each of attitude, velocity, and position. The main benefit is in the covariance it estimates: its Average Normalized Estimation Error Squared (ANEES) stays closer to its nominal value of one than that of the others. Offline analysis on AUV field data corroborates the findings of the simulations, demonstrating reduced position drift.
summary_zh: 无GPS信号场景下导航的自主水下航行器（AUV）通常会融合惯性测量数据、声学多普勒测速仪（DVL）输出的速度数据与压力传感器解算的深度数据。将导航状态定义在李群上可提升导航精度与一致性，但现有基于不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IEKF）的顶尖滤波器方案将惯性测量单元（IMU）偏置作为欧氏空间扩展项追加，破坏了实现精确对数线性误差动力学所需的群仿射结构，导致输出协方差随状态估计过程逐渐劣化。本文采用切线群（TG）对称性，将偏置纳入状态空间的几何属性中，推导得到该系统的等变滤波器（EqF），使导航状态的线性化误差为零，仅在偏置项上存在二阶误差。本文为DVL开发了等变输出模型，其更新过程仅引入三阶线性化误差，同时配套了直接压力输出模型。蒙特卡洛仿真将TG-EqF与两帧群IEKF、乘性EKF进行对比，结果显示TG-EqF在姿态、速度、位置三类指标上的误差相比两种对比方案均降低了18%~25%。该方案的核心优势体现在协方差估计性能上：其平均归一化估计误差平方（ANEES）比其他对比方案更接近标称值1。基于AUV实地数据的离线分析验证了仿真结论，证明该方案可有效降低位置漂移。

title: Decoupling Physical Speed from Path Parameterization in Singularity-Free Guiding Vector Fields
title_zh: 无奇异引导向量场中物理速度与路径参数化的解耦方法
authors: Zhouru Xiao, Sha Luo, Yang Lu, Mingliang Xiao, Weijia Yao, Bohuan Lin, Xianzhe Cheng, Yaonan Wang
abstract: The existing singularity-free guiding vector field (SF-GVF) with an additional virtual coordinate can eliminate singular points (i.e., points where the vector field vanishes) inherent in conventional GVFs and guarantee global convergence of robot trajectories to closed and self-intersecting desired paths. However, the desired speed given by the GVF along the desired path in the original lower-dimensional space cannot be arbitrarily specified but depends on path parameterizations. One possible workaround is to partially normalize the physical projection of the SF-GVF and assign a user-designed speed. However, we show that this workaround may introduce new singularities since the normalization denominator can become zero. To address this issue, we propose a new SF-GVF with prescribed physical speed (PPS). The integral curves of the new SF-GVF converge exponentially to the desired path from any initial condition in the higher-dimensional space (including virtual dimension); more importantly, the robot's physical speed converges to the PPS, while the path-error dynamics remain invariant under regular reparameterizations of the desired path. We further develop a saturated acceleration control law for second-order kinematic models. Finally, comparative simulations and 3D path-following experiments with a quadrotor under different PPS profiles validate the theoretical results and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 现有引入额外虚拟坐标的无奇异引导向量场（SF-GVF）可消除传统引导向量场固有的向量场零点奇异点，保证机器人轨迹全局收敛到闭合、自相交的期望路径。但现有方案中，引导向量场在低维原始空间期望路径上输出的期望速度无法任意指定，必须依赖路径参数化结果。一种可能的解决思路是对SF-GVF的物理投影做部分归一化，人为指定用户自定义速度，但本文证明该思路可能引入新的奇异点，原因是归一化分母可能变为零。针对该问题，本文提出一种支持预设物理速度（PPS）的新型SF-GVF。新SF-GVF的积分曲线可从高维空间（含虚拟维度）内任意初始条件出发指数收敛到期望路径；更重要的是，机器人的物理速度可收敛到预设物理速度，同时路径误差动力学在期望路径的常规重参数化操作下保持不变。本文进一步针对二阶运动学模型开发了饱和加速度控制律。最终，不同预设物理速度配置下的对比仿真与四旋翼3D路径跟踪实验验证了理论结论，证明了所提方法的有效性。

title: UniExo: Unified Multi-Skill Policies for Musculoskeletal Locomotion and Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control
title_zh: UniExo：面向肌肉骨骼运动与协同自适应外骨骼控制的统一多技能策略
authors: Yifei Yuan, Jakob Wolf, Ghaith Androwis, Xianlian Zhou
abstract: Daily locomotion encompasses diverse activities and frequent transitions between them, yet most exoskeleton controllers are designed for a single activity or a narrow set of related movements. Changes in activity therefore typically require explicit mode switching and separately tuned or retrained controllers. Simulation-based learning reduces the need for hardware-based tuning but generally retains this limitation. Here we present UniExo, a framework that first constructs a multi-skill musculoskeletal human policy and then jointly trains an exoskeleton control policy with it. Four single-skill imitation experts for walking, turning, running and backward walking are distilled into a single network structured by a skill latent and subsequently fine-tuned through reinforcement learning on transition sequences. The resultant unified human policy achieves a mean tracking success rate of 94.7% on unseen clips of the four skills and exhibits greater robustness to perturbations than its constituent experts. A single hip exoskeleton controller (UniExo) is initialized from hip moment prediction of the human policy and co-adapted with it through multi-agent reinforcement learning across the four skills. This co-adaptation shifts the timing of the assistance torque and raises the fraction of positive work delivered to the hip. When deployed on a custom hip exoskeleton, the controller generalizes across four treadmill speeds in six participants and assists one participant through a continuous route of all four skills and their transitions, without skill labels or explicit mode switching. UniExo thus provides a step towards replacing activity-specific controllers with unified, user-specific controllers that support diverse locomotor activities and the transitions between them.
summary_zh: 日常运动包含多种不同活动以及活动间的频繁切换，但绝大多数外骨骼控制器仅针对单一活动或少量相关运动设计。活动切换时通常需要显式的模式切换操作，使用单独调试或重新训练的控制器。基于仿真的学习方法降低了硬件调试需求，但仍普遍存在上述局限。本文提出UniExo框架，首先构建多技能肌肉骨骼人体运动策略，再与外骨骼控制策略进行联合训练。该框架将行走、转向、跑步、倒行4类单技能模仿专家模型蒸馏为基于技能隐变量结构的单网络，再通过强化学习在运动切换序列上完成微调。最终得到的统一人体运动策略在4类技能的未见过的测试片段上平均跟踪成功率达94.7%，相比组成它的单专家模型具备更强的扰动鲁棒性。单髋关节外骨骼控制器UniExo从人体运动策略的髋关节力矩预测结果初始化，通过多智能体强化学习在4类技能场景下与人体策略协同自适应。该协同自适应过程调整了辅助力矩的施加时机，提升了髋关节获得的正功占比。在定制化髋关节外骨骼上部署后，该控制器可在6名受试者的4种跑步机速度下泛化运行，还可支持1名受试者完成覆盖全部4类技能及其切换过程的连续路径任务，全程无需技能标签或显式模式切换。UniExo为替换面向特定活动的控制器、采用支持多类运动及运动切换的统一用户定制控制器提供了可行路径。

title: LYRIC: Language-Driven Physics-Based Character Control for Contact-Rich Whole-Body Object Interaction
title_zh: LYRIC：语言驱动的基于物理特征角色控制实现接触密集型全身物体交互
authors: Zeyu Han, Zichong Meng, Julian Tanke, Minami Matsumoto, Sergey Bashkirov, Yingruo Fan, Selim Engin, Dongseok Shim, Takashi Shibuya, Yuki Mitsufuji, Huaizu Jiang
abstract: We present LYRIC, a generative flow-matching controller for language-driven physics-based contact-rich interaction control, that enables simulated characters to perform contact-rich whole-body object interactions from a free-form language instruction and a sparse terminal object goal. To obtain reliable expert trajectories from imperfect motion-capture references, a single tracking policy is trained using geometry-conditioned interaction rewards and relaxed reference tracking near hand-object contact. To guide interaction progress without prescribing a full-body kinematic reference, we factorize the controller into a task-level planner that predicts short-horizon object and humanoid-root trajectories, and an action generator that resolves whole-body motion and contacts in closed loop. After behavior cloning, we freeze the planner and post-tune the action generator on policy using the planner's predictions as stable supervision for intermediate task progression. In a controlled OMOMO evaluation, our tracker achieves 64.3% success compared with 53.2% for an InterMimic reimplementation, while a unified policy achieves 76.5% on the full OMOMO dataset. On the held-out split, LYRIC achieves 90.3% task success, compared with 74.2% for the strongest matched kinematic-planner baseline, with better semantic alignment and motion quality. Without retraining, the controller also supports test-time object-waypoint guidance. Qualitative results further demonstrate robust, natural contact-rich interactions and zero-shot transfer to novel object shapes. The webpage is available at https://neu-vi.github.io/LYRIC/
summary_zh: 本文提出LYRIC，一款基于生成流匹配的语言驱动控制器，可实现基于物理引擎的接触密集型交互控制，支持仿真角色根据自由形式语言指令与稀疏的最终物体目标，完成接触密集型全身物体交互任务。为从不完善的动作捕捉参考数据中获取可靠的专家轨迹，本文利用几何条件交互奖励训练单跟踪策略，在人手-物体接触区域附近放松参考跟踪约束。为在不指定全身运动学参考的前提下引导交互进度，本文将控制器解耦为任务级规划器与动作生成器：前者负责预测短时间尺度的物体与仿人机器人根节点轨迹，后者在闭环中求解全身运动与接触状态。完成行为克隆后，本文冻结规划器参数，以规划器输出作为中间任务进度的稳定监督信号，通过策略后调优完成动作生成器的训练。在受控OMOMO评估中，本文的跟踪器实现了64.3%的成功率，优于InterMimic重实现方案的53.2%；统一策略在完整OMOMO数据集上的成功率达76.5%。在留出测试集上，LYRIC的任务成功率达90.3%，优于性能最优的对比运动学规划基线的74.2%，同时具备更好的语义对齐度与运动质量。无需重新训练，该控制器还可在测试阶段支持物体路点引导。定性结果进一步证明该方法可实现鲁棒、自然的接触密集型交互，可零样本迁移到全新物体形状。项目主页为：https://neu-vi.github.io/LYRIC/

title: VAST: V2X/Dynamic Map-Aware Autonomous Driving Systems Validation Toolchain
title_zh: VAST：支持V2X/动态地图感知的自动驾驶系统验证工具链
authors: Shunsuke Ito, Takuya Azumi
abstract: Cooperative autonomous driving in the IoT-to-Edge-to-Cloud continuum requires system-level validation across vehicles, infrastructure sensors, edge-side Dynamic Map services, and in-vehicle autonomous-driving stacks. This paper presents VAST, a V2X/Dynamic Map-aware validation toolchain that connects Scenic, Scenario Simulator v2, AWSIM, Autoware, and SIM-LDM. VAST does not introduce a new search algorithm; instead, it addresses interoperability challenges, including Lanelet2-to-Scenic mapping, ROS 2-based co-simulation through SS2, Dynamic Map object injection into Autoware, and collection of TTC, PET, collision, timeout, and performance measurements. In occluded-intersection scenarios, Lanelet2-compatible constrained sampling increases the edge-case discovery rate from 40.0% to 80.0% and reduces the average time per discovered edge case from 259.7 s to 110.4 s. Under the same generated scenario distribution, Dynamic Map availability reduces the collision rate from 78.0% to 40.0% and increases non-collision outcomes from 22.0% to 60.0%, with statistically significant TTC/PET shifts. A throughput study with 1-16 NPCs shows that sampling remains below 0.1 s, whereas AWSIM/Autoware execution and restart overhead dominate runtime. These results position VAST as a practical validation infrastructure for cooperative autonomous-driving CPSs.
summary_zh: 物联网-边缘-云连续体系下的协同自动驾驶需要覆盖车辆、基础设施传感器、边缘侧动态地图服务与车载自动驾驶栈的全系统级验证。本文提出VAST，一套支持V2X/动态地图感知的验证工具链，打通了Scenic、Scenario Simulator v2、AWSIM、Autoware与SIM-LDM多个组件。VAST并未提出全新的搜索算法，而是重点解决组件间互操作性难题，包括Lanelet2到Scenic的映射、基于ROS 2通过SS2实现的联合仿真、动态地图对象注入Autoware、以及TTC（碰撞时间）、PET（潜在碰撞时间间隙）、碰撞、超时与性能指标的采集。在遮挡路口场景下，兼容Lanelet2的约束采样将边缘案例发现率从40.0%提升至80.0%，将发现单个边缘案例的平均耗时从259.7秒降低至110.4秒。在相同生成场景分布下，动态地图可用将碰撞率从78.0%降至40.0%，将无碰撞结果占比从22.0%提升至60.0%，TTC与PET指标的变化具备统计显著性。覆盖1~16个非受控车辆的吞吐量测试显示，场景采样耗时始终低于0.1秒，运行时间主要由AWSIM/Autoware的执行与重启开销占据。上述结果表明VAST是面向协同自动驾驶信息物理系统的实用验证基础设施。

title: Towards High-DoF Dexterous Manipulation through VLA Post-Training
title_zh: 基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型后训练的高自由度灵巧操作实现路径
authors: Junlei Zhu, Shenzhe Yao, Chaogui Huang, Wenkai Zhu, Jingwei Peng, Guanqi He, Soren Schwertfeger, Jiahao Chen, Yide Liu
