We identify \emph{termination-token mismatch} between base students and post-trained teachers as an important source of this behavior. Across Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma, the two models can place their stopping probability on different EOS tokens, even when their declared stopping sets are identical. This mismatch can suppress the student's preferred termination action without reliably transferring the teacher-preferred alternative. We show that aligning the decoding stopping set alone is insufficient, while treating functionally equivalent EOS tokens as a shared semantic stopping action substantially mitigates mismatch-induced length inflation across all three model families. To further understand how termination behavior evolves over training, we study OPD across different K2-Horizon training stages. This stage-wise analysis shows that termination preferences can shift substantially during training, while also revealing a distinct length inflation late in the OPD run that persists beyond termination alignment. Together, these results identify termination mismatch as an important, but not exhaustive, source of OPD length dynamics. We release an implementation incorporating the proposed termination-handling corrections.
summary_zh: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的长度膨胀现象，即学生模型的生成响应可能过长，甚至耗尽生成预算。我们发现基础学生模型与后训练教师模型之间的终止令牌不匹配是导致该现象的重要原因。在Qwen3、Llama与Gemma三类模型中，即便二者声明的终止集完全相同，两个模型也可能将终止概率分配到不同的EOS令牌上。这种不匹配会抑制学生模型偏好的终止动作，同时无法可靠迁移教师模型偏好的替代终止动作。我们证明仅对齐解码终止集是不够的，而将功能等价的EOS令牌视为共享的语义终止动作，可在三类模型家族中大幅缓解由不匹配引发的长度膨胀问题。为进一步理解终止行为在训练过程中的演化规律，我们研究了不同K2-Horizon训练阶段下的OPD过程。该分阶段分析表明，终止偏好会在训练过程中发生显著变化，同时还发现OPD训练后期存在与终止对齐无关的特殊长度膨胀现象。上述结果共同表明，终止不匹配是OPD长度动态特性的重要来源，但并非唯一来源。我们开源了实现所提终止处理修正方案的代码。

title: Truncated automatic sparse differentiation for machine learning interatomic potentials
title_zh: 面向机器学习原子间势的截断式自动稀疏微分
authors: Marcel F. Langer, Adrian Hill, Michele Ceriotti
abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) learn the mapping from atomic positions to potential energy. The forces, the negative gradient of this energy, drive molecular dynamics and are readily obtained using automatic differentiation. Higher-order derivatives, most notably the Hessian, describe collective motion and allow the direct prediction of experimental observables, but are considered computationally inaccessible for large systems. We suggest a solution: in physical systems, interactions decay with distance, and most MLIPs build on this locality through message passing up to a finite receptive field. This implies both sparsity of higher-order derivatives and their decay with distance. This structure can be exploited using automatic sparse differentiation (ASD). We explain how to compute the sparsity pattern for MLIP derivatives and demonstrate that, for multiple foundation MLIPs, ASD computes full Hessians of large porous materials exactly, but with modest speedups at best. The larger gains come from truncated ASD: discarding small, but nonzero, Hessian entries between distant atoms yields order-of-magnitude speedups with negligible impact on predicted observables.
summary_zh: 机器学习原子间势（machine learning interatomic potentials, MLIPs）可学习从原子位置到势能的映射关系。作为势能负梯度的作用力是驱动分子动力学的核心变量，可通过自动微分便捷计算。高阶导数（尤其是海森矩阵）可描述集体运动、直接预测实验可观测量，但对于大体系而言其计算成本长期被认为是不可接受的。本文提出了一种解决方案：物理体系中相互作用随距离衰减，绝大多数MLIPs基于该局域性特性，通过有限感受野内的消息传递机制构建模型，这一特性决定了高阶导数的稀疏性及其随距离衰减的规律。该结构可通过自动稀疏微分（automatic sparse differentiation, ASD）加以利用。本文阐释了如何计算MLIP导数的稀疏模式，并针对多个基础MLIP模型验证发现：ASD可精确计算大体积多孔材料的完整海森矩阵，但仅能实现有限的速度提升。更大的性能增益来自截断式ASD：丢弃远距离原子之间数值极小但非零的海森矩阵元素，可实现数个数量级的速度提升，同时对预测可观测量的影响可忽略不计。

title: Radio Frequency Detection and Classification of Microplastics in Water
title_zh: 水中微塑料的射频检测与分类
authors: Jaden Tolbert, Md Saiful Islam, Pingshan Wang
abstract: Micro- and nano-plastic particles (MPs/NPs) are ubiquitous environmental contaminants whose increasing abundance and potential health impacts have created an urgent need for rapid, label-free detection methods. As particle size decreases to the low-micrometer range, conventional optical and spectroscopic techniques become increasingly challenging because of limited throughput and/or complex sample preparation. In this work, we present a machine learning (ML)-assisted radio-frequency (RF) dielectric spectroscopic cytometry (DiSC) platform for the label-free detection and classification of MPs. Eight types of $ 10 $ {\mu}m nominal-diameter MP particles suspended in deionized (DI) water were characterized at four frequencies spanning $ 0.2\text{-}9\text{ GHz} $. The measured alterations in RF scattering parameters (S-parameters), referenced to the carrier medium, were used to train supervised ML models for material classification, including the identification of MPs in mixed samples and saline-water environments. For eight MP classes suspended in DI water, the proposed method achieved macro-average F1-score, precision, and recall values exceeding $ 0.71 $. Furthermore, PET classification performance was largely maintained in saline carrier media containing $3.3\% $ and $ 6.6\% $ sea salt. These results demonstrate the feasibility of ML-assisted RF DiSC for rapid, single-particle MP classification in aqueous environments. Future work will focus on improving classification performance through enhanced RF calibration, increased spectral coverage, larger training datasets, and validation using environmentally aged and biologically contaminated microplastics.
summary_zh: 微纳塑料颗粒（MPs/NPs）是广泛存在的环境污染物，其丰度持续上升且存在潜在健康危害，研发快速、无标记的检测方法已成为迫切需求。当颗粒尺寸降至几微米量级时，传统光学与光谱技术受限于通量不足和/或复杂的样品前处理，应用难度显著提升。本文提出了一种机器学习辅助的射频介电谱流式细胞术（radio-frequency dielectric spectroscopic cytometry, DiSC）平台，可实现微塑料的无标记检测与分类。研究对悬浮于去离子水中标称直径为10μm的8类微塑料颗粒，在0.2~9GHz范围内的4个频率下开展表征，以载体介质为参考测得的射频散射参数（S参数）变化量用于训练监督式机器学习模型，实现材料分类，包括混合样本和盐水环境中的微塑料识别。针对悬浮于去离子水中的8类微塑料，所提方法的宏平均F1值、精确率和召回率均超过0.71。此外，在含有3.3%和6.6%海盐的盐水载体介质中，PET的分类性能基本保持稳定。上述结果验证了机器学习辅助射频DiSC技术在水环境中实现快速单颗粒微塑料分类的可行性。后续研究将通过优化射频校准、扩大光谱覆盖范围、扩充训练数据集、采用环境老化和生物污染微塑料开展验证，进一步提升分类性能。

title: Distributionally Robust Federated Learning with Multi-Source Data
title_zh: 面向多源数据的分布鲁棒联邦学习
authors: Yingzhu Liu, Zhongkui Li, Pengcheng You, Ashish Cherukuri
abstract: Federated learning trains a shared model from private client data. In practice, data-generating distributions may differ, and the true mixture across clients is often unknown, making the underlying group distribution difficult to specify. Existing approaches address cross-client mixture uncertainty by optimizing against the worst-case mixture, yet assume accurate client-wise distribution estimates. However, these estimates can be unreliable when based on finite samples. To handle both cross-client mixture uncertainty and within-client distributional ambiguity, we construct a global ambiguity set as the union of admissible mixtures of local ambiguity sets. The construction allows client-specific ambiguity radii and admits a client-wise separable reformulation. Leveraging this structure, we establish a high-probability out-of-sample performance guarantee. We further develop a federated algorithm for a penalty-based reformulation and prove its convergence under milder regularity conditions. Simulations validate the algorithm's effectiveness.
summary_zh: 联邦学习可基于多个私有客户端的数据训练共享模型。实际场景中，不同客户端的数据生成分布可能存在差异，且跨客户端的真实混合分布通常是未知的，导致底层群体分布难以明确界定。现有方法通过针对最坏情况混合分布优化来解决跨客户端混合不确定性问题，但这类方法假设客户端层面的分布估计是精确的。然而，当估计仅基于有限样本时，结果往往不可靠。为同时处理跨客户端混合不确定性和客户端内部的分布歧义问题，本文将全局歧义集构建为各局部歧义集的可接受混合分布的并集。该构建方式支持客户端自定义歧义半径，且可转化为客户端层面可分离的等价形式。利用该结构，本文推导得到了高概率的样本外性能保证。进一步针对基于惩罚项的等价重构形式开发了联邦学习算法，并在更宽松的正则条件下证明了算法的收敛性。仿真实验验证了该算法的有效性。

title: Resolution limits for process comparison from event data
title_zh: 基于事件数据的流程对比的分辨率极限
authors: Antony R. Lee, Peter Ti\v{n}o, Iain B. Styles
abstract: One hospital runs bloods and imaging at the same time. Another runs them one after the other, in either order, equally often. Knowing which actually happened, and how it is recorded in data, is critical for all operational managers. In process mining, the standard approach is to construct an event log, and attempt to discover concurrent and sequential processes in a data-driven way. We show this standard approach, built on the stochastic language of an event log, reports only the assumptions of its discovery algorithm, because every such log is explained equally well by a model with no concurrency at all. Further, before any data is acquired, we characterise when data can and cannot distinguish concurrent behaviour. Where it cannot, the distinction is recoverable from evidence the stochastic language discards, such as the times at which activities start and end, or object-centric records that fix an order within an execution. The remedy is therefore a choice of what is recorded, rather than a larger sample. This impacts decision making, as planning resource for truly concurrent services is very different from sequential services.
summary_zh: 某家医院的血液检测和影像检查是同步开展的，另一家医院则按任意顺序先后开展两种检查，两种顺序的占比完全相等。明确实际执行的流程以及数据中的记录方式，对所有运营管理者而言都至关重要。流程挖掘领域的标准方法是构建事件日志，以数据驱动的方式尝试发现并发和顺序流程。本文证明，这种基于事件日志随机语言的标准方法，实际输出的只是其发现算法的内置假设，因为所有这类事件日志都可以被完全不存在并发的模型同等程度地解释。此外，本文在获取任何数据之前，明确界定了数据能够区分并发行为和无法区分并发行为的边界。在无法通过现有数据区分的场景下，可以从随机语言丢弃的证据中恢复该差异，例如活动的开始和结束时间，或者固定单次执行内顺序的以对象为中心的记录。因此解决方案的核心是选择需要记录的信息，而非扩大样本量。该结论会对决策产生影响，因为为真正的并发服务配置资源和为顺序服务配置资源的方案存在显著差异。

title: Training Neural Networks to Approach the Optimum Bayes Estimator in Dense Multi-Emitter Localization
title_zh: 训练神经网络逼近密集多发射器定位中的最优贝叶斯估计器
authors: Yi Sun, Mona Sharifi, Muzna Yumman
abstract: We train neural networks on synthesized frames to approach the optimum Bayes estimator for dense emitter localization. The result justifies the future work on training neural networks to achieve high-throughput large-FOV super spatiotemporal resolution SMLM.
summary_zh: 本文在合成帧数据集上训练神经网络，逼近密集发射器定位任务中的最优贝叶斯估计器。研究结果为后续训练神经网络实现高通量、大视场、超高时空分辨率单分子定位显微镜（single-molecule localization microscopy, SMLM）的相关工作提供了理论支撑。

title: Correlation-Free Transition Path Sampling through Shooting Point Generation Guided by Committor Learning
title_zh: 基于通勤子学习引导的射击点生成实现无关联过渡路径采样
authors: Maximilian Negedly, Sebastian Falkner, Alessandro Coretti, Christoph Dellago
abstract: Studying the dynamical behavior of a system often depends on characterizing how it transitions between long-lived states. Because such transitions are rare, observing them usually requires specialized enhanced sampling techniques. Transition Path Sampling (TPS) is a well-established method for generating reactive trajectories, which is simple to implement and does not require the definition of a preconceived reaction coordinate. However, its efficiency is limited by its sequential nature and the resulting correlations between sampled paths. Previous work addressed this limitation by combining TPS with a sampling scheme based on conditioned Boltzmann Generators, a generative machine learning model capable of sampling a given target probability distribution. This approach produces uncorrelated transition paths but relies on an accurate reaction coordinate, which is rarely known in advance. Building on recent advances in committor learning, specifically on the Artificial Intelligence for Molecular Mechanism Discovery (AIMMD) method, in this work we introduce GenAIMMD, an iterative algorithm that actively and self-consistently learns the ideal reaction coordinate (the committor) and trains a conditioned Boltzmann Generator to sample from arbitrary bias windows along it. GenAIMMD thereby provides a correlation-free and fully parallelizable path sampling scheme that does not require prior knowledge of the system's transition mechanism. We apply GenAIMMD to a two-dimensional toy model and a higher-dimensional polymer system. In both cases, GenAIMMD succeeds in training the Boltzmann Generator and learning the committor. Benchmark results show a substantial increase in performance compared to standard TPS.
summary_zh: 研究系统的动力学行为通常需要刻画系统在长寿命状态之间的跃迁规律。由于这类跃迁属于稀有事件，观测跃迁过程通常需要专门的增强采样技术。过渡路径采样（Transition Path Sampling, TPS）是一种成熟的反应轨迹生成方法，具有实现简单、无需预先定义反应坐标的优势。但该方法的效率受限于其串行特性，以及采样路径之间产生的相关性。此前的研究通过将TPS与基于条件玻尔兹曼生成器（一种可采样指定目标概率分布的生成式机器学习模型）的采样方案结合，解决了该效率瓶颈。该方法可生成无关联的跃迁路径，但依赖于预先获知精确的反应坐标，而实际场景中几乎无法提前得到该坐标。基于通勤子学习领域的最新进展，特别是分子机制发现人工智能方法（Artificial Intelligence for Molecular Mechanism Discovery, AIMMD），本文提出了迭代算法GenAIMMD，可主动自洽地学习理想反应坐标（即通勤子），并训练条件玻尔兹曼生成器沿该坐标的任意偏置窗口开展采样。GenAIMMD由此实现了完全无关联、可全并行的路径采样方案，无需预先获知系统的跃迁机制。本文将GenAIMMD应用于二维玩具模型和高维聚合物体系，两个场景下GenAIMMD均成功训练了玻尔兹曼生成器并完成通勤子学习。基准测试结果表明，该方法的性能相比标准TPS有大幅提升。

title: Online Supervised Dimension Reduction with Random Features: Diagnostics and Computational Trade-offs
title_zh: 带随机特征的在线监督降维：诊断分析与计算权衡
authors: Zhenlin Yao, Wei Xiong
abstract: Accurate optimization of a supervised spectral objective need not produce an accurate population subspace or a better predictive representation. We investigate these distinctions for Online Kernel Supervised Principal Component Analysis (OKSPCA), which combines a centered cross-moment in finite random-feature coordinates with an Adam-style orthonormal basis update for an established objective. Fixed-map consistency, concentration and perturbation results describe the estimator and its exact subspace; same-target comparisons then assess the practical iterate separately. Across six predictive benchmarks, performance depends on the declared pipeline: replacing the tracker with the exact empirical target leaves the two regression deficits largely unchanged. Direct classification-rank models capture nearly all terminal objective energy on average, but a saved intermediate state exhibits substantial geometric deviation; a controlled sample-size study further separates empirical accuracy from population recovery. In distinct numerical-service workloads, exact on-request computation is faster in the tested classification settings, whereas Adam saves time relative to the tested full thin-SVD service for some dense wider-regression requests, alongside persistent geometric error. These diagnostics limit explanations based solely on terminal optimization accuracy and distinguish numerical cost from quality, rank coverage and freshness; they establish neither practical-tracker convergence nor predictive or deployment benefits from basis availability.
summary_zh: 针对监督谱目标函数的精确优化，并不一定能得到精确的总体子空间，也不一定能生成更优的预测表示。本文针对在线核监督主成分分析（Online Kernel Supervised Principal Component Analysis, OKSPCA）开展研究，该方法在有限随机特征坐标下构建中心化交叉矩，结合Adam风格的正交基更新机制优化既定目标函数。本文通过固定映射一致性、集中性和扰动结果描述估计器及其精确子空间，随后通过同一目标下的对比实验单独评估实际迭代过程的性能。在6个预测基准任务中，性能表现取决于所采用的流水线：将跟踪器替换为精确经验目标后，两种回归任务的性能缺陷基本没有变化。直接分类秩模型平均可捕获近99%的终端目标能量，但保存的中间状态存在显著的几何偏差；控制样本量的进一步实验结果表明，经验精度与总体恢复效果相互独立。在不同的数值服务工作负载下，测试的分类场景中按需精确计算速度更快，而对于部分密集宽回归请求，采用Adam优化相比测试的全薄奇异值分解服务可节省时间，但会伴随持续的几何误差。上述诊断结果表明，仅基于终端优化精度的解释并不充分，同时明确了数值计算成本与模型质量、秩覆盖度、新鲜度之间的差异，证明实际跟踪器既无法保证收敛，也无法通过获取基向量获得预测或部署层面的收益。

title: Seismic Site Response Prediction from Sparse Observations Using Finite-Element-Pretrained Latent Dynamics
title_zh: 基于有限元预训练潜动力学的稀疏观测地震场地响应预测
authors: Yi Zhu, Su Chen, Xiaojun Li
abstract: Numerical site-response predictions often deviate from observations, yet correcting these discrepancies is difficult because records are limited in both sensor coverage and number of events. This study proposes the Transfer-Enabled Forced Latent Autoencoder for Response Equations (FLARE-T) to improve these predictions by learning and calibrating low-dimensional latent dynamics that connect the base acceleration input to acceleration outputs at multiple depths. FLARE-T learns a low-dimensional response manifold and input-driven dynamics from dense finite-element simulations. It then trains a sparse encoder to map simulated sensor responses into the learned coordinates and uses limited records to calibrate the dynamics within them. A short response window initializes each prediction, while the complete base motion drives the response. The framework was evaluated using a layered-soil centrifuge test and the Lotung field vertical array. Test-set results show that FLARE-T improved multi-depth acceleration histories and 5%-damped pseudoacceleration response spectra relative to the original finite-element models, reducing errors at every evaluated sensor for motions of different intensities and, at Lotung, for both horizontal components. Two Lotung source models with different constitutive parameters achieved comparable test-set accuracy, indicating reduced dependence on precise prior calibration. FLARE-T therefore provides a data-efficient means of combining dense numerical response information with limited field records to improve future site-response predictions.
summary_zh: 数值场地响应预测结果通常与观测值存在偏差，由于传感器覆盖范围和事件记录数量均十分有限，校正这类偏差的难度很大。本文提出面向响应方程的迁移启用强制潜自编码器（Transfer-Enabled Forced Latent Autoencoder for Response Equations, FLARE-T），通过学习并校准连接基底加速度输入与多深度加速度输出的低维潜动力学，提升预测精度。FLARE-T首先从密集有限元模拟中学习低维响应流形和输入驱动的动力学，随后训练稀疏编码器将模拟传感器响应映射到已学习的坐标空间，利用有限的记录校准该空间内的动力学。该框架采用短响应窗口初始化每次预测，同时使用完整的基底运动驱动响应演化。研究通过层状土离心机试验和Lotung现场竖向台阵对该框架开展验证，测试集结果表明，与原始有限元模型相比，FLARE-T提升了多深度加速度时程和5%阻尼伪加速度反应谱的预测精度，在不同强度的运动场景下所有评估传感器的误差均有所降低，在Lotung台阵场景下两个水平分量的预测精度均得到提升。两个采用不同本构参数的Lotung源模型取得了相当的测试集精度，表明模型对精确先验校准的依赖度有所降低。因此FLARE-T是一种数据高效的方法，可融合密集数值响应信息与有限现场记录，提升未来的场地响应预测效果。

title: The Bias of Nonlinear Two-Time-scale Stochastic Approximation under Constant Step-Sizes
title_zh: 恒定步长下非线性双时间尺度随机逼近的偏差
authors: Djamel Rassem Lamouri, Dorian Baudry, Nicolas Gast
abstract: Two-timescale stochastic approximation (TTSA) is a fundamental tool for analyzing coupled iterative algorithms in reinforcement learning, optimization, and stochastic control. However, finite-time guarantees for nonlinear two-timescale schemes remain difficult to obtain, especially under constant step-sizes. In this paper, we study nonlinear TTSA with step-sizes $\alpha\gg\beta$. Under standard stability, regularity, and Markovian noise assumptions, we upper bound the mean-squared error and the bias of both iterates around their limiting equilibria. Our bounds scale as $O(\alpha+\beta^2/\alpha^2)$, which we prove to be tight when $\beta\le\alpha^{3/2}$. The analysis separates the contributions of initial conditions, fast-timescale tracking error, Markovian dependence, and timescale coupling, thereby clarifying the origin of the $\beta^2/\alpha^2$ term. Our results reveal qualitative differences from the linear TTSA setting previously studied, showing that nonlinear dynamics introduce additional finite-time effects that are absent in the linear case.
summary_zh: 双时间尺度随机逼近（Two-timescale stochastic approximation, TTSA）是分析强化学习、优化和随机控制领域耦合迭代算法的基础工具。但目前针对非线性双时间尺度方案的有限时间保证仍然难以推导，在恒定步长场景下尤为突出。本文研究步长满足α≫β条件的非线性TTSA，在标准稳定性、正则性和马尔可夫噪声假设下，推导得到两类迭代变量在各自极限平衡点附近的均方误差和偏差的上界。证明当β≤α^(3/2)时，该上界的阶为O(α+β²/α²)，且是紧的。本文的分析分离了初始条件、快时间尺度跟踪误差、马尔可夫相关性和时间尺度耦合的贡献，明确了β²/α²项的来源。研究结果揭示了该场景与此前研究的线性TTSA场景的本质差异，表明非线性动力学引入了线性场景下不存在的额外有限时间效应。

title: Learning Principal-Agent Contracts for Equitable Smallholder Carbon Farming under Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection
title_zh: 道德风险与逆向选择下公平小农户碳农业的委托-代理合约学习
authors: Rishi Bharadwaj, Yadati Narahari
abstract: Agricultural soils are a major untapped carbon sink. Carbon farming is emerging as a promising practice for tapping this potential. Smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture across South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are key to scaling climate mitigation via carbon farming. It is ironic that real-world carbon programs largely fail to reach them. We study this important gap through the lens of contract design. An aggregator offers a single pooled contract to a heterogeneous population of smallholder farmers who have private adoption costs (adverse selection) and exert unobserved effort (moral hazard), with agronomic outcomes evolving over multiple seasons. We formulate this evolving contracting problem as a POMDP and use reinforcement learning to learn a dynamic profit-maximising contract. We analyse the performance of the aggregator under various conditions. We find that a profit-maximising aggregator does not merely inherit the exclusion of smallholders, it amplifies it. On large farms the aggregator realises 87.7% of achievable adoption, against only 8.2% on smallholdings. Per-hectare Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) costs fall as farm size rises, and the aggregator's pooling contract compounds this gradient rather than offsetting it. A counterfactual that makes MRV costs purely area-proportional eliminates this disparity. Our results and simulation can guide contract and policy design that opens carbon income to smallholders while enabling agricultural soils to contribute to climate mitigation at scale.
summary_zh: 农业土壤是尚未被充分开发的重要碳汇，碳农业作为挖掘该潜力的重要实践，正受到广泛关注。小农户是南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲农业生产的主体，是通过碳农业实现大规模气候减缓的关键群体。但现实中绝大多数碳项目都未能覆盖小农户，这一矛盾现象值得深入研究。本文从合约设计的视角分析该问题：聚合商向异质性小农户群体提供统一的打包合约，农户的采用成本属于私有信息（逆向选择），且其投入的努力无法被直接观测（道德风险），农艺产出随多个生产季动态演化。本文将该动态合约问题建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Partially Observable Markov Decision Process, POMDP），采用强化学习学习动态的利润最大化合约，并分析不同条件下聚合商的性能表现。研究发现，追求利润最大化的聚合商不仅会延续小农户被排除在碳项目之外的现状，还会进一步加剧该不平等：大农场的碳农业采用率可达理论最大值的87.7%，而小农户的采用率仅为8.2%。单位公顷的测量、报告与核查（Measurement, Reporting and Verification, MRV）成本随农场规模增大而降低，聚合商的打包合约进一步放大了该梯度而非抵消其影响。反事实模拟表明，当MRV成本完全与面积成正比时，该不平等现象将完全消除。本文的研究结果和仿真框架可为合约与政策设计提供指导，在帮助小农户获得碳收入的同时，推动农业土壤在大规模气候减缓中发挥作用。

title: Model-based Bootstrap for Offline Policy Evaluation in Tabular Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向表格型强化学习离线策略评估的基于模型的自助法
authors: Weiwei Wang, Yuqiang Li, Xianyi Wu, Bingyi Jing
abstract: Offline policy evaluation (OPE) is crucial in high-stakes reinforcement learning applications, where new policies must be assessed reliably before deployment. In such settings, point estimates alone are insufficient; principled uncertainty quantification, such as confidence intervals and variance estimates, is essential for safe and risk-aware decision-making. A comprehensive way to unify these tasks is to estimate the sampling distribution of the evaluation error. Existing approaches, however, often suffer from limited robustness, scalability, or finite-sample validity. In this paper, we propose a model-based bootstrap framework for uncertainty quantification of OPE in finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous Markov decision processes (MDPs). Unlike classical bootstrap methods that rely on resampling complete episodes, the proposed method regenerates trajectories from an estimated MDP and can therefore accommodate a much broader range of offline data formats, including complete trajectories, transition-level observations, and trajectory fragments. This flexibility further improves finite-sample statistical efficiency. We establish bootstrap distributional consistency, asymptotically valid confidence intervals, and consistent variance estimation for the target policy value. Extensive simulations show that the proposed method accurately captures the sampling distribution of the OPE estimator, yielding tighter confidence intervals and more accurate variance estimates in most settings.
summary_zh: 离线策略评估（Offline Policy Evaluation, OPE）在高风险强化学习应用中至关重要，这类场景下新策略在部署前必须得到可靠评估。仅靠点估计在这类场景下并不充足，符合原则的不确定性量化方法（如置信区间、方差估计）是安全、风险感知型决策的核心需求。统一实现上述任务的通用思路是估计评估误差的抽样分布，但现有方法普遍存在鲁棒性、可扩展性或有限样本有效性不足的问题。本文针对有限时域、非时齐马尔可夫决策过程（Markov Decision Processes, MDPs），提出了面向OPE不确定性量化的基于模型的自助法框架。不同于依赖完整轨迹重抽样的经典自助法，该方法通过估计得到的MDP重新生成轨迹，可适配更广泛的离线数据格式，包括完整轨迹、转移级观测和轨迹片段，这一灵活性进一步提升了有限样本统计效率。本文从理论上证明了该方法的自助分布一致性、渐近有效置信区间以及目标策略值的一致估计特性。大量仿真实验表明，该方法可精准捕获OPE估计量的抽样分布，在多数场景下可得到更紧凑的置信区间和更准确的方差估计结果。

title: Minimax-Optimal Online Contract Design with Unrestricted Bounded Contracts
title_zh: 面向无限制有界合约的极小极大最优在线合约设计
authors: Rui Ai, David Simchi-Levi, Han Zhong
abstract: We study repeated contract design when a principal observes outcomes but not the actions that generate them. The principal may use any bounded outcome-contingent payment vector, and the agent's best response can make expected profit discontinuous in those payments. For every fixed number $m\ge2$ of outcomes, the minimax regret over $T$ rounds is of order $T^{m/(m+1)}$, up to logarithmic factors. The upper bound allows arbitrary action spaces and agent heterogeneity, without smoothness or monotone-surplus assumptions. Its key is an effective-dimension reduction that the benchmark can be normalized even when fixed tie-breaking is not shift invariant, after which revealed preference yields a monotone response map in payment-difference coordinates. A learning policy built on a Lipschitz parametrization of this map attains the rate using only observed outcome categories. The lower-bound construction accounts for how incentive losses accumulate across outcome dimensions. It shows that each additional contractible outcome creates a precise and unavoidable increase in the worst-case cost of learning.
summary_zh: 本文研究委托人仅能观测结果、无法观测生成结果的代理人行动场景下的重复合约设计问题。委托人可使用任意有界的结果关联支付向量，而代理人的最优响应会使得期望利润相对于支付向量呈现不连续特性。对于任意结果数$m\ge2$的固定场景，$T$轮迭代下的极小极大遗憾的阶为$T^{m/(m+1)}$（对数因子范围内）。该上界支持任意动作空间和代理人异质性，无需平滑性或剩余单调性假设，其核心是一种有效降维方法：即使固定的平局打破规则不具备平移不变性，基准仍可实现归一化，之后显示偏好可在支付差坐标下生成单调响应映射。基于该映射的Lipschitz参数化构建的学习策略仅需观测结果类别即可达到上述最优阶。下界构造揭示了激励损失在结果维度上的累积规律，证明每新增一个可合约化的结果，学习的最坏情况成本就会出现不可避免的精确增量。

title: COMPASS: Ordered Clustered Routing at 100K Scale
title_zh: COMPASS（有序聚类路由算法）：支持10万节点规模的有序聚类路由
authors: Ido Greenberg, Hugo Linsenmaier, Piotr Sielski, Shie Mannor, Alex Fender, Gal Chechik, Eli Meirom
abstract: Large-scale routing often requires visiting clusters of nodes in a prescribed order, giving rise to the Ordered Clustered Traveling Salesman Problem (OCTSP). Optimizing each cluster independently seems natural, but misses non-local dependencies. We introduce the COMPASS algorithm for OCTSP, which combines search with learning-accelerated routing by orchestrating parallel sub-solvers. COMPASS has no quality ceiling and its solutions keep improving with compute. It exploits the clustered structure, and can reach exact solutions in time exponential in cluster size rather than instance size. Empirically, COMPASS consistently outperforms alternative methods. Unlike common large-scale routing solvers, COMPASS consumes general distance matrices and is not limited to coordinate inputs. We demonstrate scaling to 100K synthetic nodes and to 28.5K real e-commerce nodes. To our knowledge, the latter is the largest reported routing solution over asymmetric distances, 9x beyond established ATSP benchmarks.
summary_zh: 大规模路由场景通常需要按指定顺序访问节点簇，由此衍生出有序聚类旅行商问题（Ordered Clustered Traveling Salesman Problem, OCTSP）。对每个簇单独做优化看似合理，但会忽略非局部依赖关系。本文提出面向OCTSP的COMPASS算法，通过调度并行子求解器将搜索与学习加速路由相结合。COMPASS不存在解质量上限，其求解结果会随计算资源投入持续提升，该算法充分利用聚类结构特性，求解精确解的时间复杂度随簇大小指数增长而非随实例总大小指数增长。大量实验表明COMPASS的性能始终优于其他对比方法。与常见的大规模路由求解器不同，COMPASS支持通用距离矩阵输入，不局限于坐标类输入数据。本文验证了该算法可扩展至10万个合成节点与2.85万个真实电商节点的路由场景，据我们所知，后者是目前已公开的非对称距离下规模最大的路由求解结果，性能是现有非对称旅行商问题（Asymmetric TSP, ATSP）基准的9倍。

title: Detecting Deceptive Recruitment: A Signal-theoretic Machine Learning Framework for Early Identification of Labour Exploitation
title_zh: 识别虚假招聘：面向劳动力剥削早期识别的信号理论机器学习框架
authors: Sajid Siraj, Mahnaz Hosseinzadeh, Amin Vafadarnikjoo, Shuyang Li
abstract: Deceptive online job advertisements have emerged as a primary pathway into forced labour, yet systematic detection methods remain underdeveloped due to data scarcity and absence of empirically validated indicators. We formalise this detection challenge as a classification problem under signalling theory, where exploiters transmit costless signals mimicking legitimate communications across textual, visual, and structural dimensions. Using 464 verified cases (164 deceptive, 300 legitimate) collected through anti-slavery charities across nine origin countries and 21 industries, we develop multimodal detection models combining computer vision, natural language processing, and semantic embeddings. Through systematic feature ablation experiments and repeated stratified cross-validation, we demonstrate that individual modalities achieve substantial discriminatory power (ROC-AUC: 0.87--0.97), whilst their integration yields modest further gains. SHAP-based analysis reveals that text quality and domain-specific risk language are the primary discriminators, with readability indices, risk keyword density, and visa sponsorship mentions ranking highest, followed by visual colour and texture features. These production quality gaps reflect resource constraints that prevent exploiters from maintaining professional standards across all communication channels simultaneously. We operationalise findings through a proof-of-concept decision support system providing interpretable risk scores for practitioners. This work demonstrates how rigorous analytical frameworks can address complex humanitarian operations challenges characterised by information asymmetry and limited ground-truth data.
summary_zh: 虚假在线招聘广告已成为强迫劳动的主要入侵路径，但受数据稀缺与经验验证指标缺失的限制，现有系统性检测方法仍发展不足。本文将该检测挑战形式化为信号理论框架下的分类问题：剥削者会生成无成本的模仿信号，在文本、视觉、结构多个维度伪装成合法招聘信息。本文使用从9个来源国、21个行业的反奴隶制慈善机构收集的464个验证案例（164个虚假案例、300个合法案例），开发融合计算机视觉、自然语言处理与语义嵌入的多模态检测模型。通过系统性特征消融实验与重复分层交叉验证，本文证明单模态模型即可实现优异的判别性能（ROC-AUC：0.87~0.97），多模态融合可进一步小幅提升性能。基于SHAP的分析表明，文本质量与领域特定风险表述是核心判别特征，其中可读性指标、风险关键词密度、签证资助提及的区分度最高，其次是视觉颜色与纹理特征。这类生产质量差异反映了剥削者受资源约束，无法同时在所有传播渠道维持专业标准。本文将研究成果落地为概念验证级决策支持系统，可为从业者提供可解释的风险评分。该研究证明了严谨的分析框架可有效解决信息不对称、地面真值数据有限的复杂人道主义运营挑战。

title: Sharp Reconstruction Bounds for Autoencoders Using the Same Forward Map
title_zh: 采用相同前向映射的自编码器的精确重构界
authors: Patricia Medina, Hy P. G. Lam
abstract: We study reconstruction in autoencoders that apply the same forward map before and after setting the observed coordinates to zero. For equal odd input and hidden dimensions $d\geq 3$, among orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms whose Jacobian singular values lie in $[m,M]$, we show that the least uniform reconstruction-derivative error is $\max\{1-M(M-m)/2,0\}$, with affine maps attaining this sharp bound at every prescribed depth. A translated radial rotation can nevertheless reconstruct any prescribed ball exactly with singular values arbitrarily close to one, motivating additional conditions for a finite-data bound. We test this prediction on a 798,452-point terrestrial LiDAR forest scan. At input scale $0.05$, the mean theoretical bound is $0.155$, about $84\%$ of the mean normalized training error $0.185$ across four spatial regions, two depths, and three seeds. At this scale, adding one hidden coordinate reduces the mean reconstruction error below $6\times10^{-6}$.
summary_zh: 本文研究一类自编码器的重构问题：这类自编码器在将观测坐标置零前后应用相同的前向映射。当输入维度与隐藏维度均为相等的奇数且满足$d\geq3$时，在雅可比奇异值位于区间$[m,M]$的保定向微分同胚集合中，本文证明最小一致重构导数误差为$\max\{1-M(M-m)/2,0\}$，仿射映射可在任意指定深度下达到该精确界。但平移径向旋转可在奇异值任意接近1的情况下精确重构任意指定球，这一结论提示需要引入额外条件才能得到有限数据界。本文在包含798452个点的陆地激光雷达森林扫描数据集上验证了该理论预测：当输入尺度为0.05时，理论平均界为0.155，相当于4个空间区域、2种深度、3个随机种子下平均归一化训练误差0.185的84%；在该尺度下，新增一个隐藏坐标可将平均重构误差降至$6\times10^{-6}$以下。

title: Near-Optimal Pure Single-Loop Extragradient Method for Strongly Convex--Strongly Concave Minimax Optimization
title_zh: 面向强凸-强凹极小极大优化的近最优纯单循环超梯度法
authors: Minhao Zhang, Zi Xu
abstract: We study smooth strongly convex--strongly concave minimax optimization with general nonlinear coupling in the deterministic unconstrained setting. We propose a pure single-loop damped extragradient method with fixed parameters and two new full-gradient evaluations per iteration after one initialization query. The method uses an auxiliary feedback recursion and requires no inner solves, accuracy schedules, or staged restarts. We establish last-iterate linear convergence and show that reducing the squared Euclidean distance to the saddle point to an $\varepsilon$ fraction of its initial value requires $O(\sqrt{\kappa_x\kappa_y}\log(2\kappa_x\kappa_y/\varepsilon))$ full-gradient queries, where $\kappa_x=L/\mu_x$ and $\kappa_y=L/\mu_y$. This bound attains the optimal condition-number order up to logarithmic factors through fixed explicit updates. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.
summary_zh: 本文研究确定性无约束场景下带有通用非线性耦合项的光滑强凸-强凹极小极大优化问题，提出一种纯单循环阻尼超梯度法，仅需固定参数，在1次初始查询后每次迭代执行2次全新全梯度评估。该方法采用辅助反馈递归，无需内层求解、精度调度或分阶段重启操作。本文证明该方法满足最后迭代点线性收敛特性，将欧氏距离到鞍点的平方值降至初始值的$\varepsilon$倍仅需$O(\sqrt{\kappa_x\kappa_y}\log(2\kappa_x\kappa_y/\varepsilon))$次全梯度查询，其中$\kappa_x=L/\mu_x$、$\kappa_y=L/\mu_y$。该界在对数因子范围内达到了条件数阶的理论最优值，且仅通过固定显式更新即可实现。数值实验验证了该方法的有效性。

title: QEncodeBench: Can Large Language Models Encode Classical Problems into Verified Quantum Oracles?
title_zh: QEncodeBench（量子预言机编码基准测试集）：大语言模型能否将经典问题编码为可验证的量子预言机？
authors: Xujun Che, Hanhan Wu, Yuchen Yuan, Chenyang Yu
abstract: Grover search, amplitude amplification, and quantum counting all rely on the same reusable subroutine, a phase oracle, whose construction the algorithms literature takes as given: the classical predicate is assumed to be already encoded as a correct, resource-bounded circuit. We turn this assumption into a measured capability. QEncodeBench tasks large language models (LLMs) with encoding classical constraint problems as phase oracles and scores the generated circuits with an adversarially self-validated verifier that decides full solution-set equivalence up to a global phase, with ancillas restored and resource budgets enforced. Sampled basis-state tests, we show, systematically overestimate this ability. Measured this way, models separate sharply: code models without a reasoning mode solve essentially nothing, and enabling native reasoning on identical weights improves accuracy by an order of magnitude. The failures are overwhelmingly semantic rather than syntactic. Two architectures, a unit-verified constraint agent and a neuro-symbolic compilation pipeline, close most of the remaining gap by delegating correctness-critical composition to deterministic procedures. Ablations quantify the contribution of each component, and resource gating exposes an architecture-dependent trade-off between circuit width and depth. Finally, controlled difficulty escalation reveals architecture-specific responses to difficulty structure: different difficulty axes degrade different methods, while the neuro-symbolic pipeline passes every evaluated instance. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chexujun/QEncodeBench.
summary_zh: Grover搜索、振幅放大与量子计数均依赖同一可复用子例程——相位预言机，现有算法文献通常将相位预言机的构建视为已知条件，即假设经典谓词已被编码为正确、资源受限的电路。本文将该假设转化为可量化的能力评估任务：QEncodeBench要求大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）将经典约束问题编码为相位预言机，并通过对抗性自验证验证器对生成电路打分，该验证器可判定全局相位范围内的全解集等价性，同时保证辅助比特恢复与资源预算约束。本文证明，传统的基态采样测试会系统性高估大语言模型的该类能力。在本文的评估体系下，不同模型的性能差异显著：无推理模式的代码专用模型几乎无法解决任何任务，而在相同权重下启用原生推理可将准确率提升一个数量级。模型的失败绝大多数为语义错误而非语法错误。本文提出两类架构：单元验证约束代理与神经符号编译流水线，可将剩余性能差距基本补齐，将正确性关键的组合逻辑交由确定性过程处理。消融实验量化了各组件的贡献，资源门控机制揭示了电路宽度与深度之间与架构相关的权衡关系。最终，受控难度递增测试揭示了不同架构对难度结构的差异化响应：不同难度维度会导致不同方法的性能下降，而神经符号流水线可通过所有测试实例。相关代码与数据已开源至https://github.com/chexujun/QEncodeBench。

title: EviRec: Continual Evidence Learning for Dual Cold-Start POI Recommendation
title_zh: EviRec（持续证据学习框架）：面向双重冷启动兴趣点推荐的持续证据学习
authors: Rongchao Xu, Lin Jiang, Guang Wang
abstract: Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation is a core task in location-based services, yet most existing methods assume a fixed user population and POI catalog. Through a large-scale data-driven analysis of 10 U.S. cities, we identify substantial POI churn, user turnover, category drift, and decay in static POI memory, motivating the study of continual dual cold-start POI recommendation. To address this setting, we propose EviRec, a continual evidence-learning framework that estimates how much historical evidence should be trusted separately for each candidate POI. EviRec scores each visible candidate from three complementary views: a matching view based on the user's recent mobility profile, a transition-memory view that captures repeated mobility routines, and a lifecycle view that reflects candidate maturity. Because a near-zero transition score may indicate either irrelevance or insufficient observation, EviRec qualifies the evidence using each candidate's observation state and applies a reliability gate to adaptively route between transition-memory and lifecycle evidence. We evaluate EviRec on a full-year, five-city POI check-in dataset containing more than 30,000 users and 684,200 trajectories. Experimental results show that EviRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with the largest gains concentrated on cold-start queries. In particular, EviRec improves NDCG@10 by 20.4\% on Dual-New cases over the strongest baseline. In-depth analyses further confirm that these gains arise primarily from candidate-specific reliability gating while largely preserving previously learned mobility routines.
summary_zh: 兴趣点（Point-of-Interest, POI）推荐是位置服务的核心任务，但现有多数方法假设用户群体与POI目录固定不变。通过对美国10个城市的大规模数据驱动分析，本文发现真实场景下存在显著的POI更替、用户流动、类别漂移与静态POI记忆衰减现象，由此引出双重冷启动场景下的持续POI推荐研究。为解决该问题，本文提出EviRec持续证据学习框架，可针对每个候选POI单独估计历史证据的可信程度。EviRec从三个互补视角对每个可见候选打分：基于用户近期移动画像的匹配视角、捕捉重复移动惯例的转移记忆视角、反映候选成熟度的生命周期视角。由于接近零的转移得分可能代表候选不相关也可能代表观测不足，EviRec结合每个候选的观测状态对证据进行校准，通过可靠性门控机制自适应地在转移记忆证据与生命周期证据之间做路由。本文在覆盖5个城市、时长1年的POI签到数据集（包含超过3万名用户、68.42万条轨迹）上开展评估，实验结果表明EviRec的性能始终优于当前最优基线，性能提升主要集中在冷启动查询场景，尤其在双全新场景下，EviRec的NDCG@10指标相比最优基线提升20.4%。深度分析进一步证实，该性能提升主要来自候选专属的可靠性门控机制，同时该机制可基本保留已学习到的移动惯例。

title: ZeroHAT: Behavior-Conditioned Zero-Shot Human Activity Trace Generation
title_zh: ZeroHAT（行为条件零样本人类活动轨迹生成框架）：行为条件的零样本人类活动轨迹生成
authors: Rongchao Xu, Dahai Yu, Lin Jiang, Guang Wang
abstract: Human activity traces record individuals' timestamped visits to points of interest and are essential for applications such as mobility prediction and urban simulation. However, accessing large-scale HATs is challenging due to high collection costs and privacy concerns. Synthetic HAT generation offers a promising way to make such data available and has attracted growing interest from both industry and academia. Although many efforts have been devoted to this topic, most of them rely on real data from a region to generate synthetic data for the same region, which is infeasible for the many regions where real HATs are unavailable. To fill this gap, we propose ZeroHAT, a behavior-conditioned framework that generates synthetic HATs for a target region in a zero-shot manner by transferring behavioral patterns learned from real HATs in source regions and adapting them with publicly available contextual information about the target region. ZeroHAT has three key novel components: (i) a multidimensional consistency-aware intent extractor; (ii) a cross-region behavioral cloning module; and (iii) a behavior-conditioned activity realization module. We evaluate ZeroHAT on a ten-city benchmark, where extensive experiments show that ZeroHAT achieves 4.5-6.4x the normalized downstream utility of the strongest baseline and improves average fidelity by 15.6%-40.8% across target regions.
summary_zh: 人类活动轨迹（Human Activity Trace, HAT）记录了个体带时间戳的兴趣点访问记录，是移动性预测、城市仿真等应用的核心基础数据。但受采集成本高与隐私顾虑的限制，大规模HAT数据的获取难度极大。合成HAT生成是解决该问题的可行路径，近年来受到工业界与学术界的广泛关注。现有相关研究大多依赖某一区域的真实数据生成该区域的合成数据，对于大量无真实HAT数据的区域而言完全不可行。为填补这一空白，本文提出ZeroHAT行为条件框架，通过迁移从源区域真实HAT数据中学到的行为模式，结合目标区域的公开上下文信息做适配，以零样本方式生成目标区域的合成HAT数据。ZeroHAT包含三个核心创新组件：（1）多维一致性感知的意图提取器；（2）跨区域行为克隆模块；（3）行为条件的活动实现模块。本文在10个城市的基准数据集上开展评估，大量实验表明ZeroHAT的归一化下游效用是最优基线的4.5~6.4倍，在所有目标区域上的平均保真度提升15.6%~40.8%。

title: Hypernetwork-Parameterized Spatially Adaptive Neural Operators for PDE Learning
title_zh: 用于偏微分方程学习的超网络参数化空间自适应神经算子
authors: Jiaquan Zhang, Chaoning Zhang, Shuxu Chen, Meng Ye, Xiaofeng Zhang, Qiang He, Weifeng Huang, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Caiyan Qin
abstract: Spatially heterogeneous partial differential equations (PDEs) exhibit location-dependent dynamics arising from variations in geometry and physical coefficients. Existing neural operators improve localized modeling through multiscale features, attention mechanisms, or domain decomposition, yet their update rules often remain spatially shared. Hypernetwork-based methods adapt parameters across PDE instances but typically generate only one global parameterization per instance. Consequently, shared operators may underfit boundaries and high-gradient regions, with these localized errors accumulating during autoregressive rollout. We propose a spatially adaptive neural operator (SANO), which replaces this spatially shared parameterization with a spatially continuous field of location-dependent operator parameters. SANO uses Fourier-encoded coordinates and a coordinate-conditioned hypernetwork to generate spatial operator-conditioning codes at sampling points. A Hyper-Neural Element (HNE) mechanism interpolates these codes within local subregions, coupling neighboring operators while allowing their update rules to vary across space, and partition-of-unity weights assemble the overlapping local predictions. Experiments on one-, two-, and three-dimensional PDEs and two perforated-domain elliptic benchmarks show that SANO consistently outperforms competitive neural-operator, hypernetwork-based, and physics-informed baselines.
summary_zh: 空间异质偏微分方程（Partial Differential Equations, PDEs）的动力学特性随位置变化，由几何与物理系数的差异导致。现有神经算子方法通过多尺度特征、注意力机制或区域分解提升局部建模能力，但更新规则通常仍为空间共享。基于超网络的方法可跨PDE实例自适应参数，但通常仅为每个实例生成一个全局参数化结果。因此共享算子容易在边界与高梯度区域欠拟合，这类局部误差会在自回归滚动过程中累积。本文提出空间自适应神经算子（Spatially Adaptive Neural Operator, SANO），用位置相关算子参数构成的空间连续场替代原有的空间共享参数化方案。SANO采用傅里叶编码坐标与坐标条件超网络，在采样点处生成空间算子编码，通过超神经单元（Hyper-Neural Element, HNE）机制在局部子区域内插值上述编码，在耦合相邻算子的同时允许更新规则随空间变化，最终通过单位分解权重拼接重叠的局部预测结果。在一维、二维、三维PDE以及两个穿孔域椭圆基准上的实验表明，SANO的性能始终优于对比的主流神经算子、基于超网络与物理信息的基线方法。

title: SAGG: Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating for Robust Multimodal Learning under Heterogeneous Corruption
title_zh: SAGG：面向异构损坏场景下鲁棒多模态学习的样本自适应梯度门控
authors: Wentao Zhang, Yifan Zhu, Yutong Zhang, Wentao Mo
abstract: Multimodal gradient balancing methods modulate encoder gradients with a shared scalar per modality, implicitly assuming that corruption is uniform across the training batch. In practice, corruption is sample-heterogeneous: within a single mini-batch, different samples may have different modalities corrupted. We prove that under this heterogeneous corruption model, any batch-level sample-agnostic linear estimator with a shared modulation parameter incurs an irreducible bias with respect to the clean-data gradient, and that sample-level all-or-nothing gating is the unique unbiased strategy within a natural distribution-free estimator class. Motivated by this result, we propose Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating (SAGG), which makes a binary retain-or-discard decision per sample via an online feature-norm quality test and incorporates a truncation mechanism for variance control. We prove that SAGG-based SGD converges at the standard O(1/sqrt(T)) rate to stationary points of the clean loss without a corruption-dependent error floor, and derive a certified robustness radius for the independent-encoder architecture that connects per-modality Lipschitz constants to the classification margin. Experiments on Kinetics-Sounds and UCF-101 under Gaussian noise injection, partial modality missing, and natural contribution imbalance show that SAGG consistently outperforms ten existing methods, with the largest gains in high-corruption regimes where batch-level bias is most severe.
summary_zh: 现有多模态梯度平衡方法通过为每个模态分配共享标量调整编码器梯度，隐含假设训练批次内的损坏是均匀分布的。但实际场景中损坏具有样本异质性：同一个小批次内不同样本的受损模态可能存在差异。本文证明，在该异构损坏模型下，任意采用共享调制参数的批次级样本无关线性估计器都会相对于干净数据梯度产生不可约偏差，而样本级全有或全无门控是自然无分布估计器类别中唯一的无偏策略。受该结论启发，本文提出样本自适应梯度门控（Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating, SAGG）方法，通过在线特征范数质量测试对每个样本做出保留或丢弃的二元决策，并引入截断机制实现方差控制。本文证明，基于SAGG的随机梯度下降算法以标准O(1/√T)的速率收敛到干净损失的驻点，不存在依赖于损坏的误差下限，并推导了独立编码器架构的可验证鲁棒半径，建立了各模态利普希茨常数与分类间隔的关联。在Kinetics-Sounds和UCF-101数据集上开展的高斯噪声注入、部分模态缺失、自然贡献不平衡实验表明，SAGG的性能始终优于10种现有方法，在批次级偏差最严重的高损坏场景下性能提升幅度最大。

title: Improving Generalization and Robustness in Offline Reinforcement Learning via Boundary-Aware Data Augmentation
title_zh: 通过边界感知数据增强提升离线强化学习的泛化性与鲁棒性
authors: Gong Gao, Weidong Zhao, Xianhui Liu
abstract: Current offline reinforcement learning (ORL) algorithms tend to overfit the training dataset and exhibit poor in-distribution generalization and robustness performance when deployed to real environments, thus compromising their effectiveness. Existing methods typically enhance in-distribution generalization and robustness by leveraging regularization techniques widely used in computer vision. However, due to the high sensitivity of low-level physical signals to distributional shifts, these methods still suffer from notable limitations in in-distribution generalization and robustness, making it difficult to achieve stable performance in complex environments. To address this issue, we theoretically analyze the error bounds of the behavior policy and action-value function trained with random episode interpolation, revealing that the error scales positively correlated with the distance between states. Based on this insight, we propose a method called $\bf{B}$oundary-$\bf{A}$ware $\bf{D}$ata $\bf{A}$ugmentation (BADA), which leverages neighboring states to construct interpolation boundaries, enabling the generation of synthetic data that more faithfully preserves the original data distribution. We first conduct qualitative studies in a toy environment, showing that BADA generates mixed samples that preserve desirable policy smoothness while accurately reconstructing multimodal value distributions. Extensive experiments on limited offline datasets further demonstrate that BADA attains state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks.
summary_zh: 当前离线强化学习（Offline Reinforcement Learning, ORL）算法往往会对训练数据集过拟合，部署到真实环境时表现出较差的分布内泛化能力与鲁棒性，进而损害算法有效性。现有方法通常借鉴计算机视觉领域广泛使用的正则化技术提升分布内泛化性与鲁棒性，但由于底层物理信号对分布偏移高度敏感，这类方法在分布内泛化性与鲁棒性方面仍存在明显局限，难以在复杂环境中实现稳定性能。为解决该问题，本文从理论层面分析了基于随机片段插值训练得到的行为策略与动作值函数的误差边界，发现误差与状态间的距离呈正相关关系。基于该洞见，本文提出边界感知数据增强（Boundary-Aware Data Augmentation, BADA）方法，利用相邻状态构造插值边界，生成能够更忠实地保留原始数据分布的合成数据。本文首先在玩具环境中开展定性研究，结果表明BADA生成的混合样本既保留了理想的策略平滑性，又能准确重建多模态值分布。在有限离线数据集上开展的大量实验进一步证明，BADA在多个基准测试集上均达到了当前最优性能。

title: A Learning Algorithm for Threshold Boolean Networks with Prescribed Fixed Points
title_zh: 面向指定不动点的阈值布尔网络学习算法
authors: Gonzalo A. Ruz
abstract: We present a learning algorithm for inferring threshold Boolean networks (TBNs) with a prescribed set of fixed points. The proposed method employs a custom differentiable loss function that jointly enforces fixed point preservation, penalizes spurious attractors, encourages binary outputs, and promotes sparsity through L1 regularization. Applied to the FOS-GRN model of Arabidopsis thaliana, the approach achieved perfect reconstruction (i.e., all 10 desired fixed points and no spurious ones) in 5 out of 30 independent runs, recovering on average 8.53 $\pm$ 0.90 correct fixed points with no spurious attractors. In contrast, standard methods such as the Perceptron and Logistic Regression recovered up to 10 fixed points but introduced between 8 and 31 spurious ones. An additional analysis varying the sparsity coefficient ($\lambda$) confirmed that the method's performance and the structural properties of the inferred networks remain robust within a practical range (up to 0.01) of regularization strengths. Overall, the results demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of the proposed algorithm in capturing meaningful network dynamics under prescribed dynamical constraints.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于推断具有指定不动点集合的阈值布尔网络（Threshold Boolean Networks, TBNs）的学习算法。该方法采用自定义可微损失函数，联合实现不动点保留、惩罚伪吸引子、鼓励二值输出，并通过L1正则化促进稀疏性。将该方法应用于拟南芥FOS-GRN模型时，30次独立运行中有5次实现了完美重建（即全部10个目标不动点均被恢复，且无伪吸引子），平均恢复出8.53±0.90个正确不动点且不存在伪吸引子。相比之下，感知机、逻辑回归等标准方法最多可恢复10个不动点，但会引入8到31个伪吸引子。通过调整稀疏性系数λ开展的额外分析证实，在实际可用的正则化强度范围内（最高达0.01），该方法的性能与推断得到的网络结构特性均保持鲁棒性。总体而言，结果证明了所提算法在指定动力学约束下捕捉有意义网络动力学的有效性与稳定性。

title: Intact-to-Amputee Transfer in Surface-EMG Gesture Decoding: Training Source and Calibration Budget
title_zh: 表面肌电手势解码中从健全人到截肢者的迁移：训练源与校准预算研究
authors: Jethro Odeyemi, W. J. Zhang
abstract: A recogniser trained on one person rarely transfers to the next, and useful performance usually demands a fresh round of labelled calibration from the end user. A systematic review of 1077 studies quantifies where the evidence is thin: amputees appear in about one in six. Here a montage-agnostic cross-user encoder is carried to eleven transradial amputees on a protocol matched to its intact-limb training data. Zero-shot cross-population transfer fails outright: the encoder requires labeled data from the new user before it begins decoding, and it then exceeds the per-user classifier a clinic would fit by 0.190 macro F1 at three repetitions and for every subject in the cohort. Given three labelled repetitions it reaches 0.779 macro-F1 against 0.589 for the per-user pipeline. Training on forty intact subjects produces better transfers to a new amputee than training on ten other amputees, and combining the two produces better transfers than either individually. The prediction pre-registered for this study, which extends the encoder's baseline-strength account with the premise that amputee EMG is less separable, holds true only after a few repetitions become available and after enriching the source pool with additional amputees. At a single repetition, and at every budget under a source matched to the intact-limb comparison, it fails. Thus, it locates the boundary of the proposed account.
summary_zh: 在某一受试者数据上训练得到的识别器通常很难直接迁移到其他受试者，若要获得可用性能，往往需要终端用户重新提供一轮带标注的校准数据。针对1077项研究开展的系统综述明确了现有证据的薄弱环节：仅约六分之一的研究纳入了截肢者受试者。本文将不依赖电极排布的跨用户编码器部署到11名经桡骨截肢者身上，采用与健全人训练数据匹配的实验方案。零样本人群跨迁移完全失效：该编码器需要新用户的带标注数据才能启动解码，仅使用3次重复标注数据时，其宏F1值比临床常用的逐用户分类器高出0.190，且该优势在队列中所有受试者身上均成立。在3次标注重复的条件下，该方法的宏F1值可达0.779，而逐用户流水线仅为0.589。使用40名健全受试者的数据开展训练，得到的模型向新截肢者的迁移效果优于使用10名其他截肢者数据训练的模型，将两类训练数据结合得到的迁移效果优于单独使用任意一类数据。本研究预先注册的假设认为截肢者肌电的可分性更低，该假设扩展了编码器基线强度的解释框架，其仅在获得少量重复标注数据、且向源池中补充更多截肢者数据后成立，在仅1次重复标注、以及所有与健全人对照源匹配的预算条件下均不成立，由此明确了该解释框架的适用边界。

title: Personalising a Cross-User Surface Electromyography Encoder Under a Small Calibration Budget
title_zh: 小校准预算下跨用户表面肌电编码器的个性化定制
authors: Jethro Odeyemi, W. J. Zhang
abstract: A myoelectric interface needs calibration from the user before it will function. Earlier work has treated calibration as a quantity, but has not asked the question of what a device should do with the calibration repetitions once they have been collected. This paper views personalizing the cross-user encoder as a design decision with a cost. Four alternative approaches to using exactly the same labeled repetitions were tested from a single cross-user encoder per held-out subject. Prototypical adaptation, linear probes, scaled fine-tuning and full fine-tuning were tested at every budget up to the maximum each database allows, five repetitions on DB1 and four on DB2 and DB5. Comparing four ways to spend a small calibration budget across 77 subjects, full fine-tuning is the most accurate at every budget, consistently enough that there is no exception among subsets of subjects. The result which impacts how one might make an engineering decision however is that a gradient free prototypical rule recovers 52 to 78 per cent of its benefit with no optimiser and no per-user copy of the weights, which makes personalisation something a worn device can do at donning time. The widespread intuition that a good representation only needs a fresh classifier is incorrect here. How well each method may perform relative to a per-user classifier that would be fitted by a clinic will depend on the specific database.
summary_zh: 肌电接口在投入使用前需要用户完成校准。现有研究通常将校准视为一个量化指标，但尚未探讨设备在采集到校准重复数据后应当如何利用这些数据。本文将跨用户编码器的个性化定制视为一项有成本的设计决策，针对每个留出受试者，从单个跨用户编码器出发，测试了四种利用完全相同标注重复数据的替代方案。在所有可用预算下（覆盖DB1数据集最多5次重复、DB2和DB5数据集最多4次重复），对原型自适应、线性探针、缩放微调、全量微调四种方法开展了对比。基于77名受试者的小校准预算对比结果显示，全量微调在所有预算下的准确率均为最高，该结论在各受试者子集中均一致成立，不存在例外。但另一项对工程决策具有指导意义的结果表明：无需优化器、也无需存储逐用户权重副本的无梯度原型规则，能够实现全量微调52%~78%的性能收益，使得可穿戴设备在佩戴时即可完成个性化定制。广泛存在的直觉认为优质表征仅需额外训练一个分类器即可获得良好性能，在本场景下并不成立。不同方法相对于临床部署的逐用户分类器的性能表现，与具体使用的数据集密切相关。

title: A Table-Free Index for Tapered Memoization Grids: Compact Out-of-Core Evaluation of Functions of Sorted Arguments
title_zh: 面向锥形记忆网格的无表索引：排序参数函数的紧凑核外计算
authors: Tamal Maharaj
abstract: Many applications must repeatedly evaluate an expensive function f of a sorted score vector whose influence decays with rank: Plackett-Luce choice probabilities, alpha-entmax attention thresholds, and rank-weighted aggregates. Biswas and Regan (TCS 2015) introduced a tapered grid that memoizes such functions, indexed through precomputed node-count tables. We first make explicit that the tapered grid's key set is exactly the set of multiset combinations, so its index is the classical combinatorial number system: this yields a table-free closed-form O(d) rank that eliminates the O(Bd)-O(Bd^2) preprocessing tables of the original scheme, generalizes it beyond a pinned first coordinate, and supplies the previously missing O(d) unranking, which enables order-free parallel construction and key-free storage. The resulting structure is a values-only flat array: at N=37.4M entries it occupies 5.7x less memory than a hash-map memo and answers queries 1.1-1.8x faster once both structures exceed cache, and it remains operable memory-mapped beyond RAM, where pointer-based alternatives cannot reside. We give design guidance for choosing the taper: the optimal per-level refinement ratio equals the influence-decay ratio, and we derive a finite-epsilon closed form for the size penalty of a mismatched ratio -- accurate to a few percent where the classical asymptotic rate overstates the penalty by 16-43%. End-to-end, memoizing the Plackett-Luce normalization -- whose exact evaluation is an iterative transcendental root-find -- is 25-55x faster than Newton's method at 2.6e-3 mean error, against the approximately 10x reported originally; we also report a negative result, alpha-entmax thresholds, where the exact solver's tiny active support makes it 2.6x faster than any table, and distil the scoping rule this implies.
summary_zh: 大量应用需要反复计算以排序得分向量为输入的昂贵函数，这类函数的影响权重随秩次递减，典型场景包括Plackett-Luce选择概率、alpha-entmax注意力阈值、秩加权聚合等。Biswas与Regan（TCS 2015）提出了一种用于对这类函数进行记忆存储的锥形网格，通过预计算节点计数表实现索引。本文首先明确指出，锥形网格的键集恰好是多重集组合集合，因此其索引可采用经典组合数系统：由此得到了无需查表的闭式O(d)秩计算方法，消除了原方案中O(Bd)~O(Bd²)复杂度的预处理表，将其泛化到首坐标不固定的场景，并补充了此前缺失的O(d)复杂度逆秩计算能力，支持无顺序并行构建与无键存储。最终得到的结构是仅存储数值的扁平数组：当存储量为3740万条目时，其占用内存比哈希表记忆结构少5.7倍，当两种结构均超出缓存容量时，查询速度快1.1~1.8倍，且可通过内存映射在RAM外正常运行，而基于指针的替代结构无法在该场景下工作。本文给出了锥形参数的设计指导：每层的最优细化比等于影响衰减比，推导了失配比率带来的大小惩罚的有限ε闭式解，其精度可达数个百分点，而经典渐近方法会将该惩罚高估16%~43%。端到端测试结果显示，对Plackett-Luce归一化（其精确计算为迭代超越方程求根过程）进行记忆存储的速度比牛顿法快25~55倍，平均误差为2.6e-3，远高于原研究报告的约10倍加速比；本文同时报告了一个负面结果：对于alpha-entmax阈值场景，精确求解器的激活支持集极小，其速度比任何查表方案快2.6倍，本文据此提炼出了该方法的适用范围规则。

title: Placement Is Free, Composition Is Not: The Latin Square as a Provably-Balanced Construction for Heterogeneous Sequence-Mixer Stacks
title_zh: 放置无关、组合相关：作为异构序列混合器栈可证明平衡构造的拉丁方阵
authors: Taebong Kim, Youngsik Hong, Minsik Kim, Sunyoung Choi, Jaewon Jang, Minseo Kim
abstract: Since GPT, most Transformers have repeated the same attention mechanism at every layer. Yet this design is largely a convention rather than a tested conclusion. When multiple sequence mixers are combined in one stack, improvements may arise from mechanism choice, placement, or both, making causal attribution difficult. We introduce Aether-7B-5Attn, a 6.59B-parameter mixture-of-experts model ($\approx$2.98B active) whose 49 layers contain seven sequence-mixing mechanisms arranged as a $7\times7$ Latin square. Because each mechanism appears exactly once in every row and column, the design guarantees balanced exposure across depth while eliminating placement confounds. To evaluate this principle, we build a parameter-matched proxy with four mechanisms arranged as a $4\times4$ Latin square over sixteen layers, matched to 700.9M parameters and trained with eight seeds per arm. The results reveal a clear dissociation. Rearranging a distributed heterogeneous stack into a balanced periodic cycle changes validation loss by only 0.16\%, indicating that exact placement has little effect. In contrast, clustering the same mechanisms into contiguous depth bands incurs a 0.59\% penalty, while replacing the heterogeneous stack with a homogeneous one incurs a 1.68\% penalty. These results indicate that performance depends primarily on heterogeneous composition distributed across depth rather than on any particular permutation. We confirm this finding at 2.16$\times$ larger scale (1.514B parameters), where the homogeneous-stack penalty increases to 2.63\% and removing the SSM-family mechanism produces a 3.20\% degradation. We further report per-mechanism cost profiles, English and Korean evaluations, and a causal-safety audit of all 49 layers. We release model weights, training recipes, training code, logs, and architecture source code.
summary_zh: 自GPT问世以来，绝大多数Transformer在每一层都复用相同的注意力机制，但该设计本质上是一种惯例而非经过验证的最优结论。当多个序列混合器组合在同一栈结构中时，机制选择、放置位置或两者共同作用都可能带来性能提升，导致因果归因十分困难。本文提出Aether-7B-5Attn，这一参数规模为65.9亿的混合专家模型（激活参数约29.8亿）的49层中包含7种序列混合机制，按7×7拉丁方阵排布。由于每种机制在每行每列中恰好出现一次，该设计保证了不同深度下的曝光度均衡，同时消除了放置位置带来的混淆变量。为验证该原理，本文构建了参数匹配的代理模型，将4种机制按4×4拉丁方阵排布在16层中，参数量为7.009亿，每组实验设置采用8个不同随机种子训练。结果呈现出明确的分离效应：将分布式异构栈重新排列为平衡周期循环，验证损失仅变化0.16%，说明精确放置位置对性能的影响极小。与之相对，将相同机制聚类到连续深度区间会带来0.59%的性能损失，而将异构栈替换为同构栈会带来1.68%的性能损失。上述结果表明，性能主要取决于跨深度分布的异构组合，而非特定的排列方式。本文在规模扩大2.16倍（15.14亿参数）的场景下验证了该结论，此时同构栈的性能损失提升至2.63%，移除SSM系列机制会带来3.20%的性能下降。本文进一步报告了各机制的成本特性、英语与韩语任务评测结果，以及全部49层的因果安全性审计结果。所有模型权重、训练配方、训练代码、日志与架构源代码均已开源。

title: Improving Online Reinforcement Learning via Bidirectional Behavior Prior Distillation
title_zh: 通过双向行为先验蒸馏改进在线强化学习
authors: Gong Gao, Xiao Lai, Jiaji Shen, Ning Jia, Xianhui Liu, Weidong Zhao
abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms frequently exhibit poor sample efficiency and unstable learning dynamics, stemming from systematic critic estimation errors that are exacerbated by greedy policy updates. Existing behavior-prior reinforcement learning methods attempt to alleviate this issue by relying on offline pre-training to learn behavior models from fixed datasets and using policy priors to constrain online policy updates. However, the limited quality of offline datasets often hinders the ability to provide high-value policies that can effectively guide policy updates. The absence of expert trajectories significantly impairs online policy learning, leading to low sample efficiency and suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we depart from conventional behavior prior approaches and propose a Bidirectional Behavior Prior Distillation (B2PD) algorithm. B2PD leverages action-value priors to guide a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) in generating a high-value behavior support set. The resulting expert behavior priors are further distilled into the agent, effectively reducing inefficient exploration and enabling stable policy optimization, while establishing a bidirectional knowledge flow mechanism. Empirical evaluations on both state- and pixel-based tasks verify that B2PD substantially improves sample efficiency while maintaining stable policy optimization. More broadly, this work shows that enforcing high-quality behavioral support during online learning effectively mitigates critic-induced error amplification, enabling structured behavior priors to guide policy updates in a principled and sample-efficient manner.
summary_zh: 在线强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）算法普遍存在样本效率低、学习动力学不稳定的问题，根源在于贪心策略更新会放大系统性的评论家估计误差。现有行为先验强化学习方法试图通过离线预训练从固定数据集中学习行为模型，利用策略先验约束在线策略更新，以缓解该问题。但离线数据集的质量限制往往导致这类方法无法生成能够有效指导策略更新的高价值策略，专家轨迹的缺失会严重阻碍在线策略学习，造成样本效率低下、性能次优的问题。为应对上述挑战，本文突破传统行为先验方法的思路，提出双向行为先验蒸馏（Bidirectional Behavior Prior Distillation, B2PD）算法。B2PD利用动作值先验引导条件变分自编码器（CVAE）生成高价值行为支持集，将得到的专家行为先验进一步蒸馏到智能体中，有效减少低效探索，实现稳定的策略优化，同时建立了双向知识流动机制。在基于状态与基于像素的两类任务上开展的实证评测表明，B2PD在保持策略优化稳定性的同时，大幅提升了样本效率。更广泛地说，本研究证明了在在线学习过程中强制引入高质量行为支持，能够有效缓解评论家带来的误差放大问题，让结构化行为先验以严谨且样本高效的方式指导策略更新。

title: Counterexamples and Sufficient Conditions: Comments on "Optimally-Transported Generalized Method of Moments"
title_zh: 反例与充分条件：对《最优传输广义矩估计》一文的评论
authors: Masahiro Kato
abstract: We comment on the optimally-transported generalized method of moments (OTGMM) estimator proposed by Schennach & Starck (2026a) and give counterexamples to Theorems 2-6 under their stated assumptions. First, the assumptions used in the small-error analysis are insufficient for consistency in Theorem 2 and asymptotic normality in Theorem 3. Next, we consider the large-error analysis, in which Theorem 4 states that the OTGMM estimator is equivalent to a GMM estimator with modified moments. We show that in a scalar model, Theorem 4 selects a value that differs from the unique OTGMM minimizer and violates the OTGMM sample moment restriction. In an overidentified model satisfying the assumptions used in Theorems 5 and 6, the first component of the Lagrange multiplier has different probability limits under the OTGMM estimator and the GMM estimator with modified moments. Under misspecification, the population value selected by OTGMM depends on the transport metric and on which variables may be adjusted. We give a sufficient condition under which solutions of the modified moment equations also solve the original constrained problem at a given parameter value, and separate conditions for consistency and asymptotic normality of the OTGMM estimator. We also show that Assumption 16 does not imply the matrix bound used in the supplemental proofs and replace Assumption 16 with a matrix condition that yields the bound.
summary_zh: 本文针对Schennach & Starck（2026a）提出的最优传输广义矩估计（Optimally-Transported Generalized Method of Moments, OTGMM）估计器展开讨论，在其给定的假设下给出了针对定理2至定理6的反例。首先，小误差分析中使用的假设不足以保证定理2的一致性与定理3的渐近正态性。其次，针对大误差分析场景，其中定理4声称OTGMM估计器等价于采用修正矩的GMM估计器，本文证明在标量模型中，定理4选出的数值与唯一的OTGMM极小值点不一致，且违反了OTGMM样本矩约束。在满足定理5与定理6假设的过度识别模型中，拉格朗日乘数的第一分量在OTGMM估计器与采用修正矩的GMM估计器下具有不同的概率极限。在模型设定错误的场景下，OTGMM选出的总体值依赖于传输度量与可调整变量的选择。本文给出了修正矩方程的解在给定参数值下同时满足原约束问题的充分条件，以及保证OTGMM估计器一致性与渐近正态性的独立条件。本文还证明了假设16无法推导出补充证明中使用的矩阵边界，因此用一个可得到该边界的矩阵条件替换了原假设16。

title: How Far Can Sub-3B Open Language Models Go in Zero-Shot Essay Scoring on an 8 GB Consumer GPU?
title_zh: 30亿参数以下开源语言模型在8GB消费级GPU上的零样本作文评分能力上限探究
authors: Nguyen Dung Son, Dang Quang Minh, Nguyen Huu Loi, Truong Viet Vu, Nguyen Thai Anh
abstract: Zero-shot essay scoring with large language models is usually demonstrated with proprietary API models, yet the settings where automated scoring is most needed, such as public schools grading thousands of essays under strict privacy rules, are often those where sending student writing to a third-party API is unacceptable. We ask how much capability survives when the model must be a sub-3B open model running fully locally in FP16, with a controlled study of four instruction-tuned models from two families (Qwen2.5 at 0.5B/1.5B/3B, SmolLM2 at 1.7B) on all eight ASAP-AES prompts on a single 8 GB consumer GPU, with bootstrap confidence intervals, Holm-corrected paired tests, and deployment-realistic variants of the key design choices. Three findings emerge. (i) Rubric-decomposed prompting beats holistic prompting for every model under batch min-max aggregation (though Qwen2.5-3B drops significantly on one prompt), and under mean aggregation two unrelated families land within 0.01 at the 1.5-1.7B scale. (ii) Mapping trait scores into the prompt range is fragile to grader calibration: one model compresses traits into a narrow low band (2-4 on 0-10) and naive mean aggregation collapses, while the min-max normalization of Multi-Trait Specialization repairs it (macro QWK 0.204 to 0.388) and stays within 0.03 when its statistics are frozen on 30 held-out essays. (iii) Signed error falls with essay length in eleven of twelve configurations, opposite to the verbosity bias reported for large LLM judges; normalized rubric decomposition largely flattens this slope for well-calibrated models. We anchor results honestly: the best local configuration (0.388) remains far below both the human inter-rater ceiling (0.769) and a length-only baseline (0.523), so we position sub-3B local models strictly for formative, human-supervised feedback.
summary_zh: 大语言模型零样本作文评分的现有演示通常采用闭源API模型，但自动化评分需求最迫切的场景（例如公立学校在严格隐私规则下对数千篇作文进行评分）往往不允许将学生写作内容发送给第三方API。本文针对模型必须为30亿参数以下开源模型、完全在本地以FP16精度运行的场景开展对照研究，在单张8GB消费级GPU上测试了两个系列共4个指令微调模型（Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B、SmolLM2 1.7B）在全部8个ASAP-AES提示集上的性能，采用自举置信区间、经Holm校正的配对检验，以及符合实际部署场景的关键设计变量变体开展实验。研究得到三点结论：（1）在批次最小-最大聚合模式下，基于评分标准分解的提示方法性能优于整体评分提示方法，该结论对所有模型均成立（尽管Qwen2.5-3B在某一个提示集上性能出现明显下降）；在均值聚合模式下，两个无关模型系列在15~17亿参数规模下的性能差距小于0.01。（2）将特征分数映射到提示指定区间的过程对评分器校准十分敏感：某一模型会将特征分数压缩到狭窄的低区间（在0~10分区间内仅输出2~4分），导致朴素均值聚合失效，而多特征专用化的最小-最大归一化方法可修复该问题（宏QWK从0.204提升至0.388），且当统计量在30篇留出作文上冻结时，性能波动不超过0.03。（3）在12种配置中的11种下，带符号误差随作文长度增加而降低，与现有大语言模型评分器报告的冗长偏差现象相反；经过归一化的评分标准分解方法可大幅降低校准良好模型的该斜率。本文如实报告了性能边界：最优本地配置的性能（0.388）仍远低于人类评分员间的一致性上限（0.769）和仅基于长度的基线性能（0.523），因此30亿参数以下本地模型仅适用于形成性、人类监督的反馈场景。

title: Accuracy Is Not Enough: A Cross-Architecture Audit of Demographic Bias in Deep Knowledge Tracing
title_zh: 仅靠准确率并不足够：深度知识追踪中人口统计学偏差的跨架构审计
authors: Dang Quang Minh, Nguyen Dung Son, Nguyen Huu Loi, Truong Viet Vu, Nguyen Thai Anh
abstract: Deep knowledge tracing (DKT) models implicitly decide which students an adaptive system believes have mastered a skill, yet almost all evidence on their demographic fairness comes from Bayesian knowledge tracing; the deep models that power modern systems have received no comparable cross-architecture audit. We close this gap: four architectures (DKT, DKVMN, SAKT, AKT) trained under three regimes (standard, reweighting, adversarial) on two public datasets with demographic metadata, Eedi (15.9M interactions) and OULAD (167k after preprocessing), evaluated with ABROCA, student-level bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests addressing recent critiques of fairness-metric instability. Three findings emerge. (i) Bias is real but context-dependent: every architecture shows a significant socioeconomic ABROCA on Eedi (0.018-0.023, $p<0.005$), with per-group AUC lower for economically disadvantaged students, while gender bias is significant on OULAD for three of four architectures after multiplicity correction yet negligible on Eedi. (ii) The most accurate architecture is the most biased: AKT gains about 4 AUC points from item-level Rasch embeddings and shows the largest socioeconomic ABROCA, exceeding every other architecture under a paired bootstrap ($p\leq0.002$); ablating only the Rasch embeddings removes the accuracy gain and the excess bias together. (iii) Standard mitigation is unreliable: reweighting and adversarial debiasing leave ABROCA essentially unchanged in every configuration that preserves accuracy, even though the adversary is pinned at chance at full reversal strength and a weak-strength positive control rules out a dead probe.
summary_zh: 深度知识追踪（Deep Knowledge Tracing, DKT）模型会隐式判定自适应系统认为哪些学生已经掌握了某项技能，但目前关于其人口统计学公平性的几乎所有证据都来自贝叶斯知识追踪方法，支撑现代系统的深度模型尚未得到同等程度的跨架构偏差审计。本文填补了这一研究空白：在两个带有人口统计元数据的公开数据集Eedi（1590万条交互记录）和OULAD（预处理后共16.7万条记录）上，对4种架构（DKT、深度值记忆网络DKVMN、基于自注意力的知识追踪SAKT、注意知识追踪AKT）在3种训练策略（标准训练、重加权训练、对抗训练）下的表现进行测试，采用ABROCA（ROC曲线间面积，公平性评估指标）、学生层自助置信区间以及针对近期公平性指标不稳定性批评的置换检验完成评估。研究得到三项结论：（1）偏差真实存在但具有场景依赖性：在Eedi数据集上所有架构的社会经济维度ABROCA均表现出显著性（0.018-0.023，p<0.005），经济弱势学生群体的分组AUC更低；而经过多重性校正后，OULAD数据集上4种架构中有3种存在显著性别偏差，但该偏差在Eedi数据集上可忽略不计。（2）准确率最高的架构偏差也最大：AKT通过项目层面的Rasch嵌入获得了约4个百分点的AUC提升，同时其社会经济维度ABROCA也达到最高，在配对自助检验下超过所有其他架构（p≤0.002）；仅移除Rasch嵌入后，准确率增益和超额偏差会同步消失。（3）标准偏差缓解方法不可靠：在所有保留准确率的配置下，重加权和对抗去偏方法都无法从根本上改变ABROCA数值，即便对抗器被固定在完全反转强度的随机水平，且弱强度阳性对照也排除了探测失效的可能。

title: Explaining spatial information flow in short-term traffic forecasting models using a gated graph attention network
title_zh: 基于门控图注意力网络解释短期交通预测模型中的空间信息流动
authors: Yue Li, Shujuan Chen, Ying Jin
abstract: Short-term traffic forecasting supports real-time monitoring and control of road networks, and graph attention networks (GAT) are the standard means of representing spatial dependence in these models. GAT layers are widely described as capturing the influence of neighbouring locations, but this is seldom verified, because the attention weights offered in support cannot be compared against any measured quantity. That leaves two questions open, how the model should be explained and which of its components are necessary. We address this by adding a gate to the GAT layer which learns, at every sensor and every time step, what share of a sensor's updated state is drawn from its neighbours rather than from itself. Regularising the gate withdraws neighbour information progressively and thereby provides a graded form of ablation. We apply the gated GAT to ST-MetaNet, whose encoder and decoder each place one GAT layer between two recurrent layers, and train it on one calendar year of records from 498 loop detectors on the strategic road network of England. The gate assigns a larger share of neighbour information to sensors carrying heavier traffic and follows the daily and weekly cycle of travel, consistent with adjacent locations being more strongly coupled when busy. Mild regularisation improves accuracy slightly, and accuracy declines at higher strengths as the penalty withdraws information the model needs. The encoder gate closes before the decoder gate, but direct ablation qualifies that ordering. Removing either GAT layer alone leaves accuracy at least as good as keeping both, whereas removing both degrades it substantially, so the two layers are largely redundant rather than either being indispensable. The gated GAT therefore yields a modest accuracy gain, an explanation of where and when spatial information flows, and evidence on which layers the architecture requires.
summary_zh: 短期交通预测可为道路网络的实时监控与管控提供支撑，图注意力网络（Graph Attention Networks, GAT）是这类模型中表征空间依赖性的标准工具。现有研究普遍认为GAT层可以捕捉相邻位置的影响，但该结论极少得到验证，因为用于佐证的注意力权重无法与任何实测值进行比对。这就留下两个待解决的问题：应当如何解释这类模型，以及模型的哪些组件是必不可少的。本文针对该问题在GAT层中加入门控机制，该机制可在每个传感器的每个时间步学习传感器更新状态中来自邻居而非自身的信息占比。对门控施加正则化可以逐步收回邻居信息，从而实现分级消融实验。本文将门控GAT应用于ST-MetaNet模型，该模型的编码器和解码器均在两个循环层之间设置一个GAT层，采用英格兰战略道路网络上498个环路检测器一整个日历年的记录完成训练。门控机制会为交通流量更大的传感器分配更高的邻居信息占比，且变化规律符合出行的日度和周度周期，与高峰时段相邻位置耦合性更强的特征一致。轻度正则化可小幅提升准确率，当正则化强度更高时，惩罚项会移除模型所需的信息，导致准确率下降。编码器的门控会先于解码器的门控关闭，但直接消融实验修正了这一排序特征。单独移除任意一个GAT层后，模型准确率至少与保留两个GAT层的表现相当，而同时移除两个GAT层会导致准确率大幅下降，说明两个层在很大程度上是冗余的而非缺一不可。综上，门控GAT可实现小幅准确率提升，能够解释空间信息流动的位置和时间规律，还可为架构所需的必要层提供实证依据。

title: Transformer fault diagnosis using an efficient simulation-driven variational quantum classifier with domain-aware feature encoding
title_zh: 采用领域感知特征编码的高效仿真驱动变分量子分类器用于变压器故障诊断
authors: Huy Hoang Le, Ba Tu Phung, Dai Huynh, Kim-Anh Nguyen
abstract: Early transformer fault diagnosis is challenged by nonlinear dissolved-gas interactions, overlapping fault signatures, and limited labeled data, while practical deployment further requires reliable performance under realistic computational constraints. This paper presents a simulation-driven modeling framework for dissolved gas analysis-based transformer fault diagnosis, in which a carefully engineered variational quantum classifier (VQC) is employed as the computational core and systematically analyzed through simulation. The framework integrates domain-aware feature modeling derived from Duval geometry with a lightweight two-qubit quantum representation, enabling nonlinear gas-interaction effects to be captured within a shallow parameterized circuit. A hybrid ZX-YY quantum feature map is designed to model non-commuting feature interactions, while a full-entanglement EfficientSU2 ansatz provides adequate expressive capacity under strict resource limits. Model behavior is evaluated using a comprehensive simulation pipeline including noise-aware circuit emulation, cross-dataset validation, and limited hardware-in-the-loop execution, allowing key effects of circuit depth, noise, and optimization strategy to be examined. Simulation results on benchmark dissolved-gas-analysis datasets demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy, strong generalization capability, and robustness to realistic noise levels with minimal quantum resources. The results highlight the effectiveness of simulation-informed modeling for practical transformer diagnostic applications, offering a reproducible and resource-efficient pathway for evaluating quantum-enhanced fault diagnosis methods.
summary_zh: 变压器早期故障诊断面临溶解气体非线性交互作用、故障特征重叠、标注数据不足等挑战，实际部署还要求在现实计算约束下保持可靠性能。本文提出一种面向基于溶解气体分析的变压器故障诊断的仿真驱动建模框架，该框架以经过精心设计的变分量子分类器（Variational Quantum Classifier, VQC）为计算核心，通过仿真完成系统性分析。该框架融合了源自杜瓦尔几何的领域感知特征建模与轻量级双量子比特量子表征，可在浅层参数化电路中捕捉气体的非线性交互效应。本文设计了混合ZX-YY量子特征图用于建模非交换特征交互，同时采用全纠缠EfficientSU2拟设，可在严格资源限制下提供充足的表达能力。通过包含噪声感知电路仿真、跨数据集验证、有限硬件在环执行的全流程仿真管线评估模型行为，可检验电路深度、噪声、优化策略的核心影响。在基准溶解气体分析数据集上的仿真结果显示，该方法诊断准确率高、泛化能力强，在最小量子资源占用下对现实噪声水平具备鲁棒性。研究结果证明了仿真引导建模在变压器诊断实际应用中的有效性，可为评估量子增强故障诊断方法提供可复现、资源高效的路径。

title: Subdomain-aware representation compression for pretrained image embeddings
title_zh: 面向预训练图像嵌入的子域感知表征压缩
authors: Poowanut Niamluang, Jittat Fakcharoenphol
abstract: Dimensionality reduction is a well-known technique for improving space efficiency, typically applied uniformly across an entire dataset. This paper investigates the possibilities of using dimensionality reduction techniques for subdomain representation compression. We explore standard techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear discriminant analysis (LDA) in image domains. The results not only demonstrate the expected improvements in space and computation complexity crucial for edge-device ML applications but also show improvements in accuracy over direct full-embedding procedure. One possible explanation is that dimensionality reduction effectively extracts subdomain features. We also performed experiments to demonstrate transfer learning capabilities using the compressed representations.
summary_zh: 降维是提升空间效率的经典技术，通常在整个数据集上统一应用。本文研究将降维技术用于子域表征压缩的可行性，探索图像领域的主成分分析（Principal Component Analysis, PCA）、线性判别分析（Linear Discriminant Analysis, LDA）等标准技术。结果不仅验证了这类方法可显著提升对边缘设备机器学习应用至关重要的空间效率与计算复杂度，还相比直接使用全嵌入的流程实现了准确率提升。一种可能的解释是降维可有效提取子域特征。本文还通过实验验证了压缩后表征的迁移学习能力。

title: Towards a Unified Modality-Agnostic Multimodal Framework for Cognitive Workload Assessment
title_zh: 面向认知负荷评估的统一模态无关多模态框架研究
authors: Stefanos Gkikas, Christian Arzate Cruz, Calvin Joseph, Giorgos Giannakakis, Raul Fernandez Rojas
abstract: Cognitive workload reflects the mental effort required during task performance and is central to the design of adaptive human-machine systems. The use of biosignals to measure cognitive workload has been extensively researched and documented; however, studies examining the effects of combining heterogeneous biosignal modalities for this purpose remain limited. To provide insight into this area, we developed a unified, modality-agnostic, hierarchical Transformer-based architecture to process heterogeneous biosignal modalities within a single model. We use this framework in a pilot study evaluating all $31$ possible combinations of five modalities: Electrocardiogram (ECG), Electrodermal Activity (EDA), Respiration (RESP), Peripheral Oxygen Saturation (SpO$_2$), and Electroencephalogram (EEG), under leave-one-subject-out validation across three cognitively distinct tasks: abstract reasoning (IQ), arithmetic problem solving (MATH), and a game task (GAME). In this pilot setting, the results suggest that: (i) EEG is the strongest single modality, ranking highest in IQ, GAME, and the pooled ALL setting, where samples from all three tasks are combined; (ii) adding more modalities does not consistently improve performance; (iii) the full five-modality combination achieves the highest \textit{Average} score of $73.02%$ on IQ and $68.08%$ when the \textit{Average} scores are averaged over the four evaluation settings: IQ, MATH, GAME, and ALL; and (iv) the proposed method reduces model size by approximately $50%$ compared with late-fusion alternatives while maintaining a lower inference time.
summary_zh: 认知负荷反映任务执行过程中所需的心理努力，是自适应人机系统设计的核心要素。利用生物信号测量认知负荷已得到广泛研究，但针对融合异质生物信号模态用于认知负荷评估的效果研究仍较为有限。为填补这一研究空白，本文开发了一种基于分层Transformer架构的统一模态无关框架，可在单个模型内处理异质生物信号模态。本文在试点研究中采用留一受试者验证策略，在3项认知特征差异明显的任务（抽象推理IQ、算术问题求解MATH、游戏任务GAME）下，对5种模态的全部31种可能组合进行评估，5种模态分别为心电图（ECG）、皮电活动（EDA）、呼吸信号（RESP）、外周血氧饱和度（SpO₂）和脑电图（EEG）。试点结果表明：（1）EEG是性能最优的单模态，在IQ、GAME以及合并三项任务样本的ALL混合场景下排名最高；（2）增加模态数量无法持续提升模型性能；（3）5模态全组合在IQ任务上的平均得分最高可达73.02%，在IQ、MATH、GAME、ALL四个评估场景下的平均得分均值为68.08%；（4）与晚期融合的替代方案相比，所提方法的模型体积降低约50%，同时推理时间更短。

title: Evaluating Financial Sentiment in the Age of AI
title_zh: 人工智能时代的金融情感评估
authors: Arslan Bisharat, Oudom Hean
abstract: Financial sentiment measures are widely used in empirical finance, but it remains unclear whether general-purpose large language models (LLMs) improve on existing finance-specific methods. This paper evaluates twelve sentiment models, including dictionary-based methods, finance-specific transformers, and open-source LLMs, using two criteria: linguistic validity and economic validity. We find that general-purpose LLMs achieve classification performance comparable to finance-specific transformer models without task-specific fine-tuning. However, higher classification accuracy does not translate into stronger economic relationships. Several models produce sentiment measures that are significantly associated with earnings surprises, but none is significantly associated with next-day stock returns. Model performance is strongest for announcements with large earnings beats or misses and substantially weaker for announcements with more moderate earnings surprises. These findings suggest that financial sentiment captures information about firms' economic performance but has limited ability to explain short-run market reactions
summary_zh: 金融情感指标在实证金融领域得到广泛应用，但通用大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）能否在现有金融专用方法基础上实现性能提升仍不明确。本文从语言有效性和经济有效性两个维度出发，对12种情感模型进行评估，涵盖基于词典的方法、金融专用Transformer模型和开源大语言模型。研究发现，无需任务特定微调，通用大语言模型即可达到与金融专用Transformer模型相当的分类性能。但更高的分类准确率并不能转化为更强的经济关联：部分模型生成的情感指标与盈利惊喜显著相关，但没有任何模型生成的指标与次日股票收益显著相关。模型在存在大幅超预期/不及预期盈利的公告上性能最优，在盈利惊喜幅度适中的公告上性能大幅下降。上述结果表明，金融情感可捕捉企业经济表现相关信息，但解释短期市场反应的能力有限。

title: When Does Retrieval Help Time-Series Forecasting?
title_zh: 检索技术何时能提升时间序列预测效果？
authors: Mert Onur Cakiroglu, Elham Buxton, Mehmet Dalkilic, Hasan Kurban
abstract: Retrieval plug-ins supply a deep forecaster with information its lookback window cannot carry. Published evaluations report consistent gains, and each credits its own mechanism. We show that the benefit belongs instead to the operating point: the relation between window length $S$ and dominant seasonal period $L$, an axis the standard protocol never varies. Stratifying the evaluation by that relation exposes the regime. At $S{=}12$, a simple control that repeats the last observed period beats the six standard backbones, in aggregate, on four of seven benchmarks by $8\%$ to $44\%$ of MSE. It beats the strongest plug-in we run on ETTm1 and matches it on ECL. It is worse by up to $25\%$ on the three datasets whose training-split spectra lack a concentrated, shared period. A controlled synthetic sweep of horizon, period, and window shows the benefit boundary tracks the period (correlation $+0.71$), not the horizon ($-0.23$). A paired control with no phase to recover nearly erases the effect, consistent with phase starvation. Zero-shot pretraining does not escape it: a foundation model trails trained backbones by $22\%$ to $50\%$ on the periodic benchmarks. Within our instrument, exact lookup matches graph diffusion: the payoff is consulting the record, not the machinery on top. Two interpretable statistics, a trend test and a staleness rate, predict the sign of the per-cell benefit at $0.76$ accuracy under leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, a suggestive margin over the $0.69$ majority rule, where a 22-feature stack manages $0.57$. We propose no new plug-in. The contribution is the regime map, the protocol that reveals it, and two statistics that screen it before deployment. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/retrieval-regime.
