title: CoRe: Coherence and Relational Alignment for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
authors: Xiaoyu Lin, Huiran Duan, Yining Liu, Zhixiang Wu, Chu Lin, Lin Lu
abstract: Direct forecasting has become a standard paradigm for multivariate time-series forecasting because it predicts the full future horizon in a single pass. However, its training objective is often still decomposed into pointwise errors such as MSE. Such objectives provide stable supervision, but they do not explicitly preserve the structure of the future trajectory: temporal coherence within each variable and relational consistency across variables can both be weakened. We propose CoRe, a model-agnostic learning objective for direct multivariate forecasting. CoRe replaces pointwise supervision with two output-space constraints: a frequency coherence loss that aligns predicted and target spectra, and a low-rank relational graph loss that matches sampled pairwise differences in a target-derived PCA subspace. The resulting objective introduces no trainable parameters and can be applied to existing forecasting backbones by changing only the loss. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that CoRe improves strong baselines, compares favorably with recent forecasting objectives, and remains effective across different backbones, datasets, and hyperparameter settings overall consistently.

title: PrefixBench-H100: Characterizing Prefix Reuse and Time-to-First-Token in H100 LLM Serving
title_zh: PrefixBench-H100：H100大语言模型服务中的前缀复用与首令牌延迟特性表征
authors: Omkar Shewale, Deepak Kumar, Divakar Kumar Yadav
abstract: The goal of PrefixBench-H100 is not to introduce a new caching algorithm, but to expose the practical operating envelope of prefix reuse for H100-class LLM serving. The study identifies the regime where prefix reuse provides substantial first-token latency reductions and the regime where cache pressure erodes them, while showing that cache effectiveness itself is largely insensitive to concurrency and output length; the cross-runtime differences that remain arise above the cache, in the scheduling layer.
summary_zh: PrefixBench-H100的设计目标并非提出新型缓存算法，而是明确H100级大语言模型服务场景下前缀复用的实际运行边界。该研究明确了两类场景：一类是前缀复用可大幅降低首令牌延迟的场景，另一类是缓存压力会抵消上述性能增益的场景。研究同时发现，缓存效率本身基本不受并发度与输出长度的影响，剩余的跨运行时性能差异来源于缓存上层的调度层。

title: Well-posedness of neural turbulence closures and tangent dissipation
title_zh: 神经湍流封闭与切向耗散的适定性
authors: Zhen Zhang, George Em Karniadakis
abstract: A neural turbulence closure defines a new boundary-value problem, $R(U)=N(U)+F(U)=0$, with a coupled Jacobian $J(U)=N'(U)+F'(U)$, where $N$ is the original mean-flow operator and $F$ the learned closure. We establish two consequences of global tangent dissipation. For a monotone original operator, a positive uniform margin supplied by the original operator and closure together guarantees existence, uniqueness and a global inverse-sensitivity bound relating a posteriori solution error to the a priori residual. For a general original operator, a dissipative closure cannot worsen tangent dissipation, but this alone does not guarantee uniqueness. Tangent dissipation depends on both diffusion and reaction. We study two complementary ways to promote it: (1) an exact-integral construction enforcing non-negative tangent diffusion while leaving reaction unconstrained, and (2) a penalty on tangent-reaction violations at sampled states. Tangent diffusion enters the Jacobian, and non-negative secant eddy viscosity alone does not control its coercivity. We conduct tests with channel flow at $Re_\tau=180$--$5200$, which provides a strongly monotone baseline. Both constrained closures reach accurate solutions in all 50 training-seed/Reynolds-number cases. At $Re_\tau=1000$, we conduct tests with 10,000 starts for one fixed network per closure and we find one root for each constrained closure and multiple roots for the other closures. Although this does not prove uniqueness, it provides strong empirical evidence for uniqueness of the tested constrained closures. At $Re_\tau=5200$, the construction and penalty reduce the reported inverse sensitivity relative to the original operator by approximately $372\times$ and $11\times$, respectively.
summary_zh: 神经湍流封闭定义了新的边值问题$R(U)=N(U)+F(U)=0$，其耦合雅可比矩阵为$J(U)=N'(U)+F'(U)$，其中$N$为原始平均流算子，$F$为学习得到的封闭项。本文证明了全局切向耗散的两个核心性质：对于单调原始算子，原始算子与封闭项共同提供的一致正裕度可保证解的存在性、唯一性，以及将后验解误差与先验残差关联的全局逆灵敏度界；对于通用原始算子，耗散性封闭项不会弱化切向耗散，但仅靠该性质无法保证解的唯一性。切向耗散同时依赖于扩散项与反应项。本文研究了两种可增强切向耗散的互补方案：（1）精确积分构造法，在不约束反应项的前提下保证切向扩散非负；（2）对采样状态下的切向反应违例施加惩罚项。切向扩散作用于雅可比矩阵，仅靠非负的割涡粘性无法控制其强制性。本文在$Re_\tau=180$至$5200$区间的槽道流场景下开展测试，该场景提供了强单调基线。两种约束封闭方法在全部50组训练种子/雷诺数测试用例中均得到了精确解。在$Re_\tau=1000$场景下，针对每个封闭方案固定一个网络并从10000个初始点开始测试，结果显示两种约束封闭方案均仅存在一个根，而其他封闭方案存在多个根。该结果虽未从理论上证明唯一性，但为测试的约束封闭方案的唯一性提供了有力实证依据。在$Re_\tau=5200$场景下，与原始算子相比，构造法与惩罚法分别将逆灵敏度降低了约372倍和11倍。

title: A Policy Profile for Croissant: Refusal as a Property of the Dataset
title_zh: Croissant的策略配置文件：将拒识作为数据集的属性
authors: Alexander Chernov
abstract: Croissant is the de facto machine-readable descriptor for ML datasets: JSON-LD over schema.org. Since version 1.1 it also carries data use conditions, recommending DUO and ODRL for them. What no version specifies is how any of them is evaluated: no decision procedure, no bound on evaluation cost, no outcome for a condition an implementation cannot evaluate, no record of what was checked, and nothing on composition with caller-side authority. We supply that half. An additive profile lets a dataset declare the operations it admits and the conditions under which it admits them, over a closed set of five operators whose decision procedure is given in full, so a gate decides from the descriptor alone and records what it checked. Two corpora evaluate it and their evidence is kept apart. Three descriptors that gated a real nf-core pipeline give the deployment result: decisions from a profile document match the gate's native descriptor record for record, stripping the layer leaves a valid Croissant document, and the added cost is 11.7 $\mu$s against a 119 $\mu$s decision. A corpus generated from the profile's grammar gives the breadth, covering every operator, refusal class and conformance clause. Across its valid cases, 552 complete decision records agree three ways -- native descriptor, profile terms, and the same policy as ODRL in usageInfo. The carrier is therefore not the contribution; the evaluation semantics is. Finally, caller-bound and data-bound policies range over non-overlapping state spaces, so neither permit set contains the other.
summary_zh: Croissant是基于schema.org的JSON-LD格式标准，现已成为事实上的机器学习数据集机器可读描述符。从1.1版本开始，该标准开始支持数据使用条件，推荐采用DUO与ODRL规范描述使用条款。但现有版本均未明确使用条件的评估方式：既没有定义判定流程，也没有限制评估开销，未说明实现无法评估条件时的输出结果，未提供校验记录机制，也未定义与调用方侧权限的组合规则。本文填补了上述空白：提出一种可扩展配置文件，允许数据集声明其支持的操作类型与对应生效条件，该配置文件定义了5个算子的封闭集合，且完整给出了所有算子的判定流程，因此网关可仅基于描述符完成权限判定并记录校验内容。本文采用两个语料库对该方案进行评估，二者的证据相互独立。针对可对真实nf-core流水线执行权限管控的3个描述符的部署测试结果表明：配置文件文档生成的判定结果与网关原生描述符记录完全一一对应，移除新增层后仍可得到合法的Croissant文档，新增开销仅为11.7μs，而单次判定总耗时为119μs。基于配置文件语法生成的语料库覆盖了所有算子、拒识类别与一致性条款，覆盖范围完备。在所有合法测试用例中，552条完整判定记录在三个维度上完全一致：原生描述符、配置文件条款、与ODRL使用信息等价的策略。因此该方案的核心贡献并非描述符载体本身，而是其评估语义。最后，调用方绑定策略与数据绑定策略的作用状态空间互不重叠，二者的允许集合不存在相互包含关系。

title: The Complexity Kink: A Prompt-Side Structural Complexity Index for Code-Generation Reliability
title_zh: 复杂度拐点：面向代码生成可靠性的提示侧结构复杂度指数
authors: Michael Hernandez, Tian Zhao
abstract: Complexity measured from generated code is failure-dependent: a difficult prompt can yield a short failing program and be assigned low output complexity. We introduce a six-dimension prompt-side structural-complexity index scored before generation and kept separate from correctness. We select 5,000 Python prompts across six bands of a preliminary single-rater rubric. Four out-of-panel LLM raters rescore the locked prompts, giving 19,997 score rows; composite inter-rater reliability is ICC = 0.872 on the 4,998 prompts with all four ratings. We evaluate 21 models per prompt, yielding 105,000 generations. In the unadjusted mean-pooled analysis, pass rate has a nonmonotone breakpoint at composite 13.75, with 79.9% at or below and 87.6% above. This is not a universal failure cutoff. Task-type fixed effects shift the breakpoint to 10.75 and cut the regime gap from 7.6 to 2.1 points. A construction-frame control shifts it to 8.50 with a raw gap of -3.5 points, and neither frame alone reproduces the pooled +7.6-point change. Model-specific fits include 16 upward and five downward changes. A 365-prompt audit-clean extension matches the original five-model estimates at bins 15 and 16 but adds only 14 prompts above bin 16. Among zero-pass generations with computable Lizard complexity, 28.5% pair a prompt composite above 8 with output complexity at most 10. Human agreement is moderate and rater-dependent on a disagreement-enriched calibration set; paraphrase and cross-language rescoring preserve score ordering. Overidentification tests reject the joint restrictions on the six dimensions, so we treat the composite as an index and make no causal interpretation of the 2SLS estimates. The contribution is a pre-generation measurement framework and a bounded observational analysis of reliability regimes.
summary_zh: 从生成代码中测得的复杂度与生成失败存在依赖关系：难度较高的提示可能生成简短的错误程序，进而被赋予较低的输出复杂度。本文提出一种六维提示侧结构复杂度指数，可在代码生成前完成评分，且与生成结果的正确性完全解耦。研究从初步单人评分规则的六个区间中选取5000条Python提示，由4名未参与前期工作的大语言模型评分员对锁定的提示重新评分，共得到19997条评分记录；在4998条获得全部4个评分的提示上，复合评分者间信度组内相关系数ICC=0.872。研究对每条提示评估21个模型的生成效果，累计得到105000次生成结果。未经调整的均值混合分析显示，通过率在复合指数13.75处存在非单调断点：指数不高于13.75的区间通过率为79.9%，高于13.75的区间通过率为87.6%，但该断点并非通用的失败阈值。加入任务类型固定效应后，断点偏移至10.75，两个区间的通过率差距从7.6个百分点缩小至2.1个百分点；加入构建框架控制变量后，断点偏移至8.50，原始通过率差距变为-3.5个百分点，且单独使用任意一种框架都无法复现混合分析中7.6个百分点的变化。模型拟合结果显示16个模型的断点处通过率上升，5个模型下降。由365条提示组成的经审计清洗的扩展数据集在第15、16分箱处与原5个模型的估计结果匹配，但仅新增14条得分高于16的提示。在可计算Lizard复杂度的零通过率生成结果中，28.5%的样本满足提示复合指数高于8但输出复杂度不超过10的条件。在经过分歧增强的校准集上，人类评分的一致性处于中等水平且与评分员相关；对提示进行释义和跨语言重评分后，评分的排序关系保持不变。过度识别检验拒绝了六个维度的联合约束假设，因此本研究将复合值作为指数处理，不对两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的估计结果做因果解读。本研究的贡献在于提出了生成前测量框架，以及针对可靠性区间的有限观测分析方法。

title: The Output-Space Hypothesis: Enumerative Equivalence Checking for Tensor Programs
title_zh: 输出空间假设：面向张量程序的枚举等价性检验
authors: Paul Biberstein, Joseph Devietti, Mayur Naik
abstract: We propose a novel way to find bugs more consistently by flipping the quantifiers. Rather than generating a single input and checking all output tensor locations for equivalence, what if you could check a single output tensor location's equivalence for all inputs? We implement this idea in a system, \dirigo, by using a novel symbolic execution strategy. We demonstrate that \dirigo can find bugs effectively in a public dataset of 6,988 AI-written CUDA kernels that are all marked correct by differential testing. Of these, \dirigo finds 600 kernels that are actually buggy, and finds 97.3\% of those bugs within two minutes.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种通过翻转量化器更稳定地查找程序漏洞的新方法：不同于生成单个输入并检查所有输出张量位置的等价性，我们尝试针对所有输入仅检查单个输出张量位置的等价性。基于该思路，我们采用新型符号执行策略实现了名为\dirigo的系统。实验结果表明，\dirigo可在公开数据集上有效查找漏洞，该数据集包含6988个由AI生成的CUDA内核，所有内核此前均通过差分测试被标记为正确，而\dirigo从中发现了600个实际存在漏洞的内核，且97.3%的漏洞可在两分钟内被检出。

title: Chain-of-Thought Entropy as a Reliability Signal: A Preregistered Reproduction
title_zh: 思维链熵作为可靠性信号：一项预注册复现研究
authors: Theodore O. Cochran
abstract: This empirical study is an independent reproduction of the dissociation Zhao reported in 2026. The shape of a large language model's chain-of-thought entropy trajectory predicts whether the final answer is correct, while the magnitude of its total entropy drop does not. The dissociation merits reproduction because the magnitude half rests on a single 300-problem run with one model at one seed, while the shape half was reported at full scale on both benchmarks and on a second model family. Registered at OSF before any confirmatory run, the reproduction crosses the complete GSM8K and MATH-500 benchmark test sets with four open-weight models including one reasoning-distilled model of a kind the original did not test. The shape signal replicates. The magnitude signal divides by setting. On the anchor model the accuracy gap between monotone and non-monotone chains is +9.6 percentage points on GSM8K and +27.5 on MATH-500, while the rank correlation of the total entropy drop with correctness is -0.018 on GSM8K and +0.414 on MATH-500. On the reasoning-distilled model the binary form of the shape signal fires on about one chain in a hundred, too few to estimate the registered contrast, while the graded violation count remains predictive there. In an exploratory comparison the final-step entropy alone outperforms the binary shape flag in all eight model-by-benchmark cells by ROC area, and in six or seven by the risk-coverage area the original reports, depending on an integration range the original does not state. The study contributes a reproduction of the shape signal at full test-set scale under seven documented protocol differences, a map of the settings where the magnitude signal holds and fails, and measurements of four protocol dependencies the original does not report.
summary_zh: 本实证研究独立复现了Zhao在2026年提出的解离效应：大语言模型的思维链熵轨迹形状可预测最终答案是否正确，而总熵降的幅度不具备该预测能力。该解离效应值得复现的原因在于，原研究中关于熵降幅度的结论仅基于单模型、单随机种子下的300道题测试结果，而关于轨迹形状的结论则在两个基准集和第二个模型系列上完成了全规模验证。本研究在开展任何验证性运行前已在OSF平台完成预注册，覆盖完整的GSM8K和MATH-500基准测试集，采用4个开源权重模型，其中包含1个原研究未测试过的推理蒸馏模型。实验结果复现了轨迹形状信号的有效性，而幅度信号的表现则随设置发生分化：在基准模型上，单调与非单调思维链的准确率差距在GSM8K上为+9.6个百分点，在MATH-500上为+27.5个百分点，而总熵降与正确性的秩相关系数在GSM8K上为-0.018，在MATH-500上为+0.414。在推理蒸馏模型上，轨迹形状的二元信号仅在约百分之一的思维链上触发，样本量不足以估计预注册的对比结果，但分级违规计数仍具备预测性。探索性对比结果显示，在全部8个模型-基准组合中，仅使用最后一步熵的预测效果在ROC面积指标上均优于二元形状标志；在其中6到7个组合中，其在原研究报告的风险-覆盖面积指标上表现更优，具体数量取决于原研究未明确说明的积分区间。本研究的贡献在于：在7项已记录的协议差异下完成了全测试集规模的形状信号复现，绘制了幅度信号成立与失效的场景分布，测量了原研究未报告的4项协议依赖关系。

title: FedFIbOS: Fisher Importance based Optimal Submodelling for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
title_zh: FedFIbOS：面向异构联邦学习的基于费希尔重要性的最优子建模
authors: Yasmeen Afzal, Jeremiah D. Deng, Haibo Zhang
abstract: Heterogeneous federated learning requires clients with diverse computational capacities to collaboratively train a global model, where each client trains a capacity-constrained submodel. Existing methods select submodel parameters using heuristic importance measures---most prominently parameter magnitude---without theoretical justification for why these measures support convergence. We identify a fundamental gap: existing parameter selection criteria lack theoretical grounding in the convergence framework, partial client participation introduces additional estimation effects in the Fisher scores. We propose \textbf{FedFIbOS}: Fisher Importance-based Optimal Submodelling for heterogeneous federated learning, using Fisher Information in a principled criterion derived from minimizing submodel masking error. %We formally establish when magnitude selection is equivalent to Fisher selection fail under non-IID heterogeneous federated learning. We theoretically formulate submodel selection through a Fisher-weighted quadratic masking surrogate and show that the raw Fisher top-$k$ rule implemented by FedFIbOS solves this surrogate under a Fisher-dominant ranking condition. The resulting method retains the convergence structure of the underlying masked federated optimization bound. Fisher scores are efficiently estimated from empirical diagonal Fisher information using squared gradients, enabling stable and adaptive parameter selection without additional optimization overhead. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and AGNews under pathological and Dirichlet non-IID settings show FedFIbOS achieves ${\approx}10\%$ higher accuracy than the state of the art, with improvements becoming more pronounced under stronger heterogeneity.
summary_zh: 异构联邦学习需要计算能力各异的客户端协同训练全局模型，每个客户端训练一个受自身算力约束的子模型。现有方法采用启发式重要性度量（最常用的是参数幅值）选择子模型参数，但缺乏支撑这类度量收敛性的理论依据。本文指出现有研究存在的核心缺口：现有参数选择标准缺乏收敛框架层面的理论支撑，且客户端部分参与的机制会在费希尔得分中引入额外的估计效应。本文提出FedFIbOS（基于费希尔重要性的异构联邦学习最优子建模方法），以最小化子模型掩码误差为目标推导得到基于费希尔信息的原则性选择准则。本文通过理论推导将子模型选择问题转化为费希尔加权二次掩码代理问题，证明在费希尔主导排序条件下，FedFIbOS实现的原始费希尔前k规则可求解该代理问题，所得方法可保留底层掩码联邦优化边界的收敛结构。费希尔得分可通过平方梯度从经验对角费希尔信息中高效估计，无需额外优化开销即可实现稳定自适应的参数选择。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和AGNews数据集的病态非独立同分布（non-IID）与狄利克雷non-IID设置下开展的实验表明，FedFIbOS的准确率比现有最优方法高出约10%，且在异构性更强的场景下性能提升更为显著。

title: Next-token functional estimation
title_zh: 下一个token的泛函估计
authors: Milind Nakul, Vidya Muthukumar, Ashwin Pananjady
abstract: Suppose we observe the first $n$ points of a sequence of random variables having length $n+1$, and wish to estimate a functional of the unobserved final point and the empirical measure of the $n$ observed training points. Such next-token functionals include the probability that the next token is novel (also known as the surprise probability), the tail probability of the minimum distance between the next token and training points, and the test error of a classifier trained on the observed points. All of these quantities are classically estimated by the leave-one-out method, which is inconsistent under temporal dependence. We propose a leave-a-window-out estimator, which deletes a window of length $\tau$ after each index before forming the empirical measure and reduces to leave-one-out at $\tau = 1$. Under natural assumptions, we show that the error of our estimator decays at a parametric rate for any stationary $\beta$-mixing process that also admits a Marton coupling. Our results thus cover several natural functionals on a large class of stochastic processes. We complement these upper bounds with a sharp minimax lower bound for estimating the surprise probability on mixing Markov chains. Simulations on Markov chains, moving-average processes, and autoregressive processes show that our estimator succeeds in many scenarios where leave-one-out and add-constant baselines fail.
summary_zh: 假设我们观测到长度为n+1的随机变量序列的前n个点，需要估计未观测到的最终点的泛函，以及n个已观测训练点的经验测度。这类下一个token泛函包括下一个token为新值的概率（也称为惊奇概率）、下一个token与训练点最小距离的尾概率、以及在观测点上训练的分类器的测试误差。所有这类量的传统估计方法是留一法，但该方法在时序依赖场景下不具备一致性。本文提出留窗口估计器：在每个索引后删除长度为τ的窗口再构造经验测度，当τ=1时该估计器退化为留一法。在自然假设下，本文证明对于任意满足鞅耦合条件的平稳β混合过程，所提估计器的误差可按参数速率衰减。因此本文的结果覆盖了一大类随机过程上的多种自然泛函。针对混合马尔可夫链上的惊奇概率估计问题，本文进一步推导得到了尖锐的极小极大下界。在马尔可夫链、移动平均过程和自回归过程上开展的仿真实验表明，在留一法和加常数基线方法失效的多数场景下，本文提出的估计器均可正常工作。

title: LSTM-UT and Recurrent-Depth Transformers on Cellular Automata
title_zh: 基于元胞自动机的LSTM-UT与循环深度Transformer
authors: Aras Kavuncu
abstract: Recurrent-depth Transformers apply shared computation repeatedly, but differ in how they retain information across steps. We compare a Block Universal Transformer (BUT), which carries only its current hidden state; CoTFormer, which also retains an expanding attention cache; and a new LSTM Universal Transformer (LSTM-UT) with bounded gated memory. On Rule 30 cellular automata, BUT extrapolates to unseen recurrent depths more reliably than CoTFormer, although its accuracy eventually degrades. State and cache interventions show that CoTFormer's failure depends on their interaction: correcting the current state can temporarily restore accuracy, while retained history can undermine that correction. In a delayed-recall task, BUT also outperforms CoTFormer despite lacking direct access to past states; CoTFormer does not reliably select the requested cached representation. LSTM-UT improves both depth extrapolation and delayed recall over these baselines. The results support bounded gated memory as an effective inductive bias for repeated computation and later retrieval in these tasks.
summary_zh: 循环深度Transformer会重复执行共享计算，但不同模型跨步骤保留信息的机制存在差异。本文对比三类模型：仅携带当前隐藏状态的块通用Transformer（Block Universal Transformer, BUT）、额外保留扩展注意力缓存的CoTFormer，以及本文提出的具备有界门控记忆的新型LSTM通用Transformer（LSTM Universal Transformer, LSTM-UT）。在30号元胞自动机任务上，BUT对未见过的循环深度的外推可靠性优于CoTFormer，不过其准确率最终仍会出现下降。状态与缓存干预实验表明，CoTFormer的失效由状态与缓存的交互导致：修正当前状态可临时恢复准确率，但保留的历史信息会抵消该修正效果。在延迟回忆任务上，BUT同样优于CoTFormer，尽管其无法直接访问历史状态；CoTFormer无法可靠地选中请求的缓存表示。相比两类基线模型，LSTM-UT在深度外推和延迟回忆任务上的性能均有提升。实验结果表明，有界门控记忆是适用于这类任务的有效归纳偏置，可支撑重复计算与后续检索操作。

title: Null importance: Disentangling relevance for interpretable machine learning
title_zh: 零重要性：面向可解释机器学习的相关性解耦
authors: Garvesh Raskutti, Kris Sankaran, Jiaxin Ye
abstract: Feature importance is central to interpretable machine learning, but the term "importance" encompasses several fundamentally different notions of relevance. We develop a unified perspective based on null importance: a population-level characterization of when a feature is irrelevant under a specified notion of relevance. We consider standard notions of null importance arising from marginal and conditional statistical relevance, predictive risk, functional invariance, and causal effects, and show how these notions answer different scientific questions. We illustrate the framework in two applications in which the distinction is particularly consequential: algorithmic fairness, where common fairness criteria correspond to different notions of null importance, and genomic perturbation modeling, where different notions of relevance lead to different conclusions about what a prediction model has learned. The framework connects three aspects of feature analysis: the scientific question defining relevance, the data and model assumptions that shape how different null notions relate, and the methods used to assess importance. We establish sufficient conditions under which null notions coincide and give counterexamples showing how they diverge when those conditions fail. We then characterize which nulls different method families target and when their zero-importance statistics identify those targets. Finally, simulations spanning feature dependence, redundancy, nonlinearity, hidden features and other standard phenomena, along with case studies on image and multiomics data, provide empirical evidence for these theoretical distinctions and their practical consequences. Taken together, these results provide a common statistical language for relating scientific questions, data-generating assumptions, and algorithms, and clarify the conclusions that feature-importance analyses can support.
summary_zh: 特征重要性是可解释机器学习的核心概念，但“重要性”这一术语涵盖了多种本质上完全不同的相关性定义。本文基于零重要性提出统一视角：零重要性是对总体层面特征在指定相关性定义下何时为无关的形式化表征。本文研究了由边际统计相关性、条件统计相关性、预测风险、泛函不变性和因果效应衍生出的各类标准零重要性定义，阐明了不同定义可回答的差异化科学问题。本文通过两个实际应用场景展示了该框架的价值：算法公平性场景下，常见的公平性准则对应不同的零重要性定义；基因组扰动建模场景下，不同的相关性定义会对预测模型的学习内容得出完全不同的结论。该框架打通了特征分析的三个核心环节：定义相关性的科学问题、决定不同零重要性定义关联关系的数据与模型假设、以及用于评估重要性的具体方法。本文推导得到了不同零重要性定义等价的充分条件，并给出了条件不满足时定义发生分化的反例。随后本文刻画了不同方法族对应的零重要性目标，以及其零重要性统计量识别目标的适用场景。最后，覆盖特征依赖、冗余、非线性、隐藏特征等典型现象的仿真实验，以及图像和多组学数据上的案例研究，为上述理论区分及其实际影响提供了实证依据。综上，本文的研究结果为关联科学问题、数据生成假设与算法提供了统一的统计语言，明确了特征重要性分析可支撑的结论边界。

title: Sample Count Is Not Enough: Candidate-Generation Strategy Shapes the Energy and Performance of LLM Test-Time Scaling
title_zh: 仅样本量是不够的：候选生成策略决定大语言模型测试时缩放的能耗与性能
authors: Mobina Kashaniyan, Ali Jannesari
abstract: Test-time scaling can improve large language model reasoning by generating and combining multiple candidate responses. In sampling-based methods, the inference budget is often described by the number of generated candidates, N. However, N tells us how many candidates are generated, not how they are executed. The same candidate budget can be produced in one batched generation call or split across several sequential calls with smaller batch sizes. We first study the effect of increasing N on reasoning accuracy using Phi-3-mini and Qwen2.5-1.5B on 500 GSM8K prompts. As expected, increasing N from 1 to 8 improves accuracy by 8.4 percentage points for Phi-3-mini and 18.4 points for Qwen2.5-1.5B. However, accuracy alone does not show the systems cost of using a larger candidate budget. We therefore fix N = 8 and compare four generation schedules: 1x8, 2x4, 4x2, and 8x1, where axb denotes a generation calls with b candidates per call. We measure latency, throughput, GPU-hours, and gross GPU-device energy while keeping the total candidate count fixed. On A100 GPUs, eight serial calls use 4.64-4.86x as much gross GPU-device energy and have 5.77-6.12x the P95 latency of one batched call with eight candidates. The same pattern appears across three independently scheduled A100 nodes per model and in short-output SciQ/V100 experiments. These results show that candidate count alone is not enough to describe the systems cost of multi-candidate test-time scaling. When candidates are independent and memory allows it, fewer generation calls with larger batch sizes are more efficient. Evaluations should therefore report not only candidate count and accuracy, but also generation schedule and GPU-level systems metrics.
summary_zh: 测试时缩放技术可通过生成并组合多个候选响应提升大语言模型的推理能力。在基于采样的方法中，推理预算通常用生成的候选数量N描述。但N仅能说明生成了多少个候选，无法说明这些候选的执行方式：相同的候选总预算既可以通过一次批量生成调用完成，也可以拆分为多次批量尺寸更小的串行调用完成。本文首先在500条GSM8K提示上使用Phi-3-mini和Qwen2.5-1.5B模型研究N值提升对推理准确率的影响。与预期一致，当N从1提升到8时，Phi-3-mini的准确率提升8.4个百分点，Qwen2.5-1.5B的准确率提升18.4个百分点。但仅靠准确率无法体现使用更大候选预算带来的系统层面成本。因此本文固定N=8，对比四种生成调度策略：1x8、2x4、4x2、8x1，其中axb表示调用a次生成接口、每次生成b个候选。在保持候选总数量不变的前提下，本文测量了延迟、吞吐量、GPU小时数和GPU设备总能耗。在A100 GPU上，8次串行调用的总GPU设备能耗是单次批量生成8个候选调用的4.64-4.86倍，P95延迟是后者的5.77-6.12倍。该模式在每个模型对应的3个独立调度的A100节点上，以及输出较短的SciQ/V100实验中均成立。上述结果表明，仅靠候选数量不足以描述多候选测试时缩放的系统成本。当候选相互独立且内存资源允许时，采用更少的生成调用、更大的批量尺寸效率更高。因此相关评估工作除了报告候选数量和准确率之外，还应当报告生成调度策略和GPU层面的系统指标。

title: Search at the Cost of Sampling: Nearly-Instant Latent Space Bayesian Optimization
title_zh: 以采样为代价的搜索：近即时隐空间贝叶斯优化
authors: Donney Fan, Colin Doumont, Aleksandra Kalisz, Paul Duckworth, Jacob R. Gardner, Henry Moss, Geoff Pleiss
abstract: Generative models are increasingly central to many de novo discovery pipelines, in which designs are generated at scale and filtered through virtual screens to determine a set of candidates to experimentally validate. While Bayesian optimization (BO) is a natural fit for this setting, as it uses past evaluations to guide future proposals, the computational overhead required for its sequential decision-making becomes a bottleneck when virtual screens are relatively cheap. We make BO practical in this regime by exploiting the unique combination of a linear model constrained to a spherical domain where high-dimensional latents concentrate. We build off recent work justifying the use of linear surrogates, while deriving nearly closed-form solutions to the surrogate modelling and acquisition problems that exploit spherical symmetry. The result is at least a 100x speedup over state-of-the art baselines, with matching or improved performance across molecular and image generation benchmarks. Altogether, our method makes BO a practical drop-in for de novo pipelines where it was previously too slow to consider.
summary_zh: 生成模型在各类从头发现流水线中的核心作用日益凸显：这类流水线会大规模生成设计方案，通过虚拟筛选得到待实验验证的候选集。贝叶斯优化（Bayesian Optimization, BO）天然适配这类场景，可利用历史评估结果指导后续方案生成，但当虚拟筛选成本较低时，其序贯决策带来的计算开销会成为性能瓶颈。本文利用高维隐变量集中于球面域的特性，结合约束在该域上的线性模型，大幅降低贝叶斯优化的开销。本文在近期验证线性代理有效性的相关研究基础上，利用球面对称性推导得到代理建模与采集函数问题的近似闭式解。最终实现的方法性能与现有最优基线相当甚至更优，在分子生成和图像生成基准上速度提升至少100倍。总体而言，本文提出的方法让贝叶斯优化可直接嵌入此前因速度过慢无法应用的从头发现流水线中。

title: Enhanced Agriculture-informed Neural Network by Domain Knowledge
title_zh: 融合领域知识的增强型农业先验神经网络
authors: Ci Lin, Futong Li, Rose Chong-Wu, Tet Yeap, Iluju Kiringa
abstract: Accurate prediction of nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions from agriculture is important for assessing environmental impacts and supporting sustainable farming. However, prediction remains difficult because N2O emissions result from complex interactions among soil properties, climate, biochemical processes, and management practices, while high-quality observations are limited. Deep learning models can capture nonlinear relationships but often lack physical interpretability and may generalize poorly across environmental conditions. We propose the Knowledge-enhanced Agriculture-informed Neural Network (KAINN), a hybrid neural-mechanistic framework that extends the Agriculture-informed Neural Network by incorporating domain knowledge about fertilizer diffusion, soil respiration, and water-filled porosity. We evaluate KAINN using CNN, LSTM, and Transformer architectures across multiple growing seasons and input-feature configurations. The results show that KAINN generally provides lower root mean square error and mean absolute error and higher R-squared values than purely data-driven models and the original AINN. Analysis of the learned interfaces also shows smoother and more physically consistent parameter trajectories with reduced uncertainty. These findings demonstrate that incorporating environmental knowledge into neural networks can improve the reliability, interpretability, and generalization of agricultural N2O-emission predictions.
summary_zh: 准确预测农业领域的一氧化二氮（N₂O）排放对评估环境影响、支撑可持续农业生产具有重要意义。但由于N₂O排放由土壤属性、气候、生化过程和管理措施之间的复杂交互作用决定，且高质量观测数据有限，预测工作长期存在难度。深度学习模型可捕捉非线性关系，但通常缺乏物理可解释性，且在不同环境条件下的泛化能力较差。本文提出知识增强型农业先验神经网络（Knowledge-enhanced Agriculture-informed Neural Network, KAINN），这是一种混合神经-机制框架，在原有农业先验神经网络的基础上引入了关于肥料扩散、土壤呼吸和充水孔隙度的领域知识。本文基于CNN、LSTM和Transformer三类架构，在多个生长季和不同输入特征配置下对KAINN开展评估。实验结果表明，与纯数据驱动模型和原始农业先验神经网络（AINN）相比，KAINN的均方根误差和平均绝对误差普遍更低，R²值更高。对学习到的接口的分析显示，KAINN得到的参数轨迹更平滑、物理一致性更强，不确定性更低。上述结果证明，将环境领域知识融入神经网络可提升农业N₂O排放预测的可靠性、可解释性和泛化能力。

title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) Improves Classification Accuracy of Bacterial Raman Spectral Data Enabling Portable Diagnostics
title_zh: 清晰度感知最小化（SAM）提升细菌拉曼光谱数据分类精度，可实现便携式诊断
authors: Kaitlin Zareno, Jarett Dewbury, Siamak K. Sorooshyari, Hossein Mobahi, Loza F. Tadesse
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance is expected to claim 10 million lives per year by 2050, and resource-limited regions are most affected. Raman spectroscopy is a novel pathogen diagnostic approach promising rapid and portable antibiotic resistance testing within a few hours, compared to days when using gold standard methods. However, current algorithms for Raman spectra analysis 1) are unable to generalize well on limited datasets across diverse patient populations and 2) require increased complexity due to the necessity of non-trivial pre-processing steps, such as feature extraction, which are essential to mitigate the low-quality nature of Raman spectral data. In this work, we address these limitations using Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to enhance model generalization across a diverse array of hyperparameters in clinical bacterial isolate classification tasks. We demonstrate that SAM achieves accuracy improvements of up to 10.5% on a single split, and an increase in average accuracy of 2.7% across all splits in spectral classification tasks over the traditional optimizer, Adam. These results display the capability of SAM to advance the clinical application of AI-powered Raman spectroscopy tools.
summary_zh: 到2050年，抗菌耐药性预计每年将导致1000万人死亡，其中资源匮乏地区受影响最为严重。拉曼光谱是一种新型病原体诊断技术，有望在数小时内完成快速、便携的抗生素耐药性检测，远快于耗时数天的金标准方法。但当前拉曼光谱分析算法存在两大局限：1）在不同患者群体的有限数据集上泛化能力差；2）需要引入特征提取等复杂的非平凡预处理步骤来缓解拉曼光谱数据质量偏低的问题，大幅提升了算法复杂度。本研究采用清晰度感知最小化（Sharpness-Aware Minimization, SAM）解决上述局限，在临床细菌分离株分类任务的超参数大范围调整场景下提升模型泛化能力。实验结果表明，与传统优化器Adam相比，SAM在单划分下的精度最高可提升10.5%，在所有划分下的平均精度提升2.7%。该结果证明SAM可推动人工智能赋能的拉曼光谱工具在临床场景的落地应用。

title: Bayesian Optimization with Rich Auxiliary Information via LLMs
title_zh: 借助大语言模型融合丰富辅助信息的贝叶斯优化
authors: Tejus Gupta, Efe Mert Karag\"ozl\"u, Rohit Sonker, Barnab\'as P\'oczos, Jeff Schnieder
abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions, yet many real-world optimization problems contain substantially richer information than function evaluations alone. Examples include training curves in hyperparameter optimization, expert notes and images in scientific experimentation, and prior knowledge about where optima may lie. We show that large language models (LLMs) can effectively leverage such rich auxiliary information to guide optimization. Motivated by these findings, we develop three methods for incorporating auxiliary information into BO using LLMs. Across hyperparameter optimization benchmarks and a real-world nuclear fusion optimization task, our methods consistently outperform both standard BO and existing LLM-based optimization approaches. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of LLMs for leveraging rich auxiliary information in BO.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化（Bayesian Optimization, BO）被广泛用于优化代价高昂的黑盒函数，但大量现实优化问题中存在远多于函数评估值的丰富信息，例如超参数优化中的训练曲线、科学实验中的专家注释与图像、关于最优解可能位置的先验知识等。本研究证明大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）可有效利用这类丰富的辅助信息引导优化过程。基于该发现，我们开发了三种基于大语言模型将辅助信息融入贝叶斯优化的方法。在超参数优化基准测试和真实核聚变优化任务中，所提方法的表现始终优于标准贝叶斯优化方法和现有基于大语言模型的优化方法，验证了大语言模型在贝叶斯优化场景下利用丰富辅助信息的有效性。

title: Demystifying Linear Operator Learning for Control Systems
title_zh: 控制系统线性算子学习的原理解析
authors: Max Beier, Nicolas Hoischen, Sandra Hirche, Petar Bevanda
abstract: This paper proposes a structured approach to learning linear operators for control systems from data. We address both structural and learning-theoretic aspects of the problem. To derive structural assumptions, we propose using the well-established framework of (semi)groups for evolution equations, as operators in control systems are of the same type. Further, we propose analyzing learning algorithms through the lens of the inverse problems framework. This reveals how a learned model depends on the data via error decompositions, convergence guarantees, and optimal regularization -- enabling us to compare existing methods and derive provably advantageous algorithms. In order to obtain these results, we restrict our scope to bounded operators on Hilbert spaces. Although this may appear restrictive, existing approaches often make this assumption implicitly to obtain matrix-like representations. We demonstrate the power of using these frameworks by deriving a convergent estimator for time-varying systems.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种从数据中学习控制系统线性算子的结构化方法，同时覆盖该问题的结构特性与学习理论层面。为推导结构假设，我们采用成熟的（半）群框架描述演化方程，而控制系统中的算子与这类算子属于同一类型。此外，我们从逆问题框架的视角分析学习算法，通过误差分解、收敛保证与最优正则化规则揭示学习模型对数据的依赖关系，可用于对比现有方法并推导具备可证明优势的算法。为得到上述结论，我们将研究范围限定为希尔伯特空间上的有界算子，尽管该限定看似严格，但现有方法通常也会隐式引入该假设以获得类矩阵表示。最后通过推导时变系统的收敛估计器，我们验证了上述框架的实用价值。

title: Stable Policy Learning
title_zh: 稳定策略学习
authors: Harvey Barnhard, Giacomo Opocher, Rahul Singh
abstract: In evidence-based policymaking, typically one experimental sample is observed, then a learned policy recommendation is implemented at scale. Policies learned from the experimental data can perform well in expected welfare, yet random sampling in the experiment can produce recommendations with poor welfare outcomes. In this paper, we ask: how should policy learning algorithms balance expected welfare against sampling risk? Our main contribution is to show that algorithmic stability plays a central role in characterizing and navigating the tradeoff. Intuitively, if a policy learning algorithm's recommendation remains stable when one experimental unit is replaced, then that algorithm has limited sampling risk. We propose a method for policy learning called policy-vote bagging, which learns treatment decisions on many subsamples then averages their votes into treatment probabilities. Relative to using one subsample, averaging across subsamples preserves expected welfare and improves expected utility for a risk-averse researcher. We derive sharp bounds linking estimation accuracy, subsample size, and welfare variation, including an exact guarantee under CARA utility.
summary_zh: 在循证政策制定场景中，通常仅能观测到一组实验样本，之后学习得到的政策建议会被大规模落地实施。从实验数据中学习得到的政策在期望福利层面可能表现优异，但实验中的随机采样过程可能生成福利结果很差的政策建议。本文围绕核心问题展开研究：策略学习算法应当如何平衡期望福利与采样风险？本文的核心贡献是证明算法稳定性在刻画和权衡二者关系的过程中起到核心作用：直观来说，如果替换任意一个实验单元后策略学习算法给出的建议仍能保持稳定，那么该算法的采样风险就处于较低水平。本文提出一种名为策略投票袋装（policy-vote bagging）的策略学习方法，该方法在大量子样本上学习治疗决策，再将各子样本的投票结果平均得到治疗概率。与仅使用单个子样本的方法相比，跨子样本平均的操作可在保留期望福利的同时，为风险厌恶型研究者提升期望效用。本文推导了关联估计精度、子样本规模与福利波动的紧边界，包含CARA效用下的精确保证。

title: Deep Learning Detection of Beyond-General-Relativity Deviations in Gravitational-Wave Signals: A Detection-Threshold Study with Real LIGO Noise
title_zh: 利用真实LIGO噪声探测引力波信号中超越广义相对论偏差的深度学习方法：探测阈值研究
authors: Muhammad Adnan Shahzad
abstract: We study machine-learning detection of controlled beyond-General-Relativity (beyond-GR) deviations in gravitational-wave signals, using both synthetic aLIGO-PSD noise and real LIGO H1 detector strain. Three deviation families are applied to General-Relativistic inspiral-merger-ringdown waveforms: amplitude modulation, phase modulation, and frequency modulation, each parameterized by a dimensionless strength coefficient $\beta$. A hybrid classifier combining a one-dimensional convolutional neural network with ten hand-crafted waveform statistics is trained on GR and modified waveforms and tested on a deviation type excluded from training. The central result is a quantitative detectability curve as a function of $\beta$. Using the real GW150914 strain as a template and real H1 detector noise, we find a detection threshold at $\beta \approx 0.25$, with accuracy rising smoothly from chance at $\beta \leq 0.2$ to perfect classification at $\beta \geq 0.5$. The threshold value is specific to the quadratic-in-time modulation form adopted here and should not be interpreted as a generic constraint on beyond-GR parameters. We nevertheless argue that the negative result at small $\beta$ is informative: it establishes a quantitative limit on machine-learning-only beyond-GR searches in real detector noise, in the absence of matched-filter signal extraction.
summary_zh: 本研究基于合成aLIGO功率谱密度噪声与真实LIGO H1探测器应变数据，探究机器学习方法对引力波信号中受控超越广义相对论（beyond-General-Relativity, 超越GR）偏差的探测能力。我们在符合广义相对论的旋进-合并-铃宕波形上引入三类偏差：幅度调制、相位调制与频率调制，每类偏差由无量纲强度系数β参数化。我们将一维卷积神经网络与10个人工设计的波形统计量结合构建混合分类器，在广义相对论波形与修改后波形的数据集上完成训练，再使用训练集未包含的偏差类型完成测试。核心结果是得到了随β变化的定量可探测性曲线：以真实GW150914应变作为模板、叠加真实H1探测器噪声时，探测阈值约为β≈0.25，分类精度从β≤0.2时的随机猜测水平平滑提升至β≥0.5时的完全正确分类。该阈值仅适用于本文采用的时间二次型调制形式，不能被解读为对超越GR参数的通用约束。但我们认为小β下的阴性结果仍具备参考价值：它在不使用匹配滤波信号提取的前提下，为真实探测器噪声下仅依靠机器学习开展超越GR搜索的性能划定了定量边界。

title: Improving Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning via Selective Reward Stimulation
title_zh: 通过选择性奖励刺激改进离线目标条件强化学习
authors: Jing Zhang
abstract: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning aims to learn policies that reach specified goals, but remains challenging in offline settings with sparse rewards and long-horizon dependencies. In such settings, goal-completion information can be temporally distant from the early decisions that enable success, while offline value estimation introduces additional error. We study this issue from a reward-propagation perspective and show, in a stylized delayed-goal setting, how goal-directed value separation can become small relative to local estimation error. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning (RSIQL), a simple non-hierarchical method that introduces additional reward signals at progress-making intermediate states in offline trajectories. RSIQL uses an auxiliary goal-conditioned value function to identify intermediate states estimated to make progress toward the goal and applies reward stimulation to provide less-delayed training supervision. Unlike hierarchical methods, RSIQL does not learn a separate high-level subgoal policy. Experiments on D4RL goal-reaching benchmarks and OGBench show that RSIQL improves over goal-conditioned IQL on average and achieves performance competitive with hierarchical offline goal-conditioned methods, while retaining a simple flat policy structure.
summary_zh: 目标条件强化学习旨在学习可抵达指定目标的策略，但在具备稀疏奖励、长程依赖特性的离线场景下仍面临诸多挑战。这类场景中，目标达成信息在时间维度上与促成成功的早期决策距离较远，同时离线价值估计过程会引入额外误差。本文从奖励传播视角对该问题展开研究，在典型的延迟目标设置下证明了目标导向的价值分离度会相对局部估计误差变得极小。基于该分析，我们提出奖励刺激隐Q学习（Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning, RSIQL），这是一种无需层级结构的简单方法，可在离线轨迹中取得进展的中间状态处引入额外奖励信号。RSIQL使用辅助目标条件价值函数识别被估计为正在向目标推进的中间状态，施加奖励刺激以提供延迟更低的训练监督信号。与层级方法不同，RSIQL不需要学习独立的高层子目标策略。在D4RL目标到达基准测试与OGBench上的实验结果表明，RSIQL的平均表现优于目标条件隐Q学习，性能可与层级离线目标条件方法相媲美，同时保留了简洁的扁平策略结构。

title: FCx: An algorithm for finding Feasible Counterfactual Explanations
title_zh: FCx：一种用于生成可行反事实解释的算法
authors: Kleopatra Markou, Vana Kalogeraki, Dimitrios Gunopulos
abstract: Counterfactual (CF) explanations identify changes that alter an input's classification. While existing methods produce realistic and low-cost CFs, they often fail to ensure feasibility, by suggesting non-constructive modifications or incompatible with future changes (e.g., changing an individual's race to secure a job offer). We introduce a refinement of CF explanations that explicitly enforces feasibility. Our approach is the first to efficiently generate CFs that are realistic, low-cost and feasible. We accommodate both hard feasible constraints, specified by domain knowledge users, and soft feasible constraints, inferred automatically via causal inference from the dataset. Our method, Feasible Counterfactual Explanations (FCx), is based on a modified Variational Autoencoder (VAE) optimized with a multi-factor loss function. We measure the cost of a change based on the absolute change in values (proximity) as well as the number of features changed (sparsity) while realism is measured based on the LOF for density estimation, guaranteeing that CFs reside in densely populated regions. Extensive experiments on four public datasets show that our approach matches state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics while guaranteeing feasibility.
summary_zh: 反事实（Counterfactual, CF）解释可识别能改变输入分类结果的调整方案。现有方法生成的反事实解释虽然真实度高、调整成本低，但通常无法保证可行性，会给出不具备可操作性、或与现实规则冲突的修改建议，例如建议修改个人种族以获得工作录用资格。本文提出反事实解释的一种改进框架，明确将可行性约束纳入生成过程，是首个可高效生成同时满足真实度高、成本低、可行性要求的反事实解释的方法。该框架同时支持由领域专家指定的硬可行性约束，以及通过因果推理从数据集自动推断得到的软可行性约束。所提可行反事实解释算法（Feasible Counterfactual Explanations, FCx）基于改进的变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoder, VAE）实现，采用多因子损失函数优化。我们基于特征值的绝对变化量（邻近度）与修改特征的数量（稀疏度）衡量调整成本，基于用于密度估计的局部离群因子（Local Outlier Factor, LOF）衡量真实度，保证生成的反事实样本位于数据分布的高密度区域。在4个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在保证可行性的同时，多项指标的表现均达到当前最优水平。

title: Machine-Learning Assessment of the Predictive Value of Inflammatory Biomarkers for Cognitive Impairment in an Older Hispanic Adult Cohort
title_zh: 老年西班牙裔成人队列中炎症生物标志物认知障碍预测价值的机器学习评估
authors: Antony Garcia, Gabrielle Britton, Alcibiades Villarreal, Diana Oviedo, Giselle Rangel, Xinming Huang
abstract: Small clinical tabular datasets require interpretable machine learning because deep learning is often impractical and ensemble models can be difficult to inspect. A key pitfall is that statistical significance does not necessarily imply predictive utility. Using data from the Panama Aging Research Initiative--Health Disparities (PARI-HD) cohort (n=165), we implemented a leakage-safe threshold-likelihood Bernoulli/Categorical Naive Bayes (BNB/CNB) classifier. Within every training fold, each continuous predictor was reduced to a supervised chi-square-derived state, while income entered the model through a categorical likelihood. All data-dependent steps were performed within repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation with 30 repeats. The demographic baseline achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.630 +/- 0.017. I-309 (CCL1) was the dominant incremental feature, increasing AUC by 0.110, with paired DeLong tests yielding p<0.05 in 100% of repeats. In the pre-specified primary analysis, I-309 produced a fixed-partition DeLong p=0.0018, with robustness assessed across 200 random partitions, where the median p-value was 0.0011. Within the exploratory family of 18 candidate markers, I-309 achieved a Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted q=0.032 on the frozen partition and satisfied q<0.05 in 85% of random partitions, whereas no other marker demonstrated reliable incremental predictive value. Because the fitted model is an inspectable table of thresholds and class-conditional probabilities, these results identify I-309/CCL1 as an interpretable candidate feature for tabular prediction of cognitive impairment, pending external validation.
summary_zh: 小型临床表格数据集需要采用可解释机器学习方法，因为深度学习通常难以落地，集成模型也往往难以解读。这类场景的核心痛点是统计显著性并不等同于预测效用。本研究使用巴拿马老龄化研究倡议-健康差异（PARI-HD）队列数据（n=165），实现了一种可避免数据泄露的阈值似然伯努利/类别朴素贝叶斯（BNB/CNB）分类器。在每个训练折内，所有连续预测变量都会通过监督卡方检验规则转换为状态变量，收入特征则通过类别似然输入模型。所有依赖数据的步骤都在重复分层10折交叉验证（共30次重复）框架下执行。仅使用人口统计学基线特征的模型ROC-AUC达到0.630±0.017。I-309（CCL1）是贡献最大的增量特征，可将AUC提升0.110，配对DeLong检验在100%的重复中得到p<0.05。在预设的主分析中，I-309在固定划分下的DeLong检验p值为0.0018，在200次随机划分下的中位p值为0.0011，鲁棒性得到验证。在包含18个候选生物标志物的探索性分析中，I-309在固定划分下的Benjamini-Hochberg校正后q值为0.032，且在85%的随机划分下满足q<0.05，其余所有标志物均未展现出可靠的增量预测价值。由于拟合得到的模型是由阈值和类条件概率构成的可解释表格，本研究确认I-309/CCL1是用于认知障碍表格预测的可解释候选特征，后续将开展外部验证进一步确认其价值。

title: Stiefel Attention: When the Geometry of Transformer Projection Matrices Dominates Optimizer Choice---and When It Does Not
title_zh: 斯蒂费尔注意力：Transformer投影矩阵的几何特性何时主导优化器选择、何时不产生影响
authors: Rub\'en Dar\'io Guerrero
abstract: The query and key projections $\WQ,\WK$ in attention are almost always trained by Euclidean optimizers with no constraint on their geometry. We constrain them to the Stiefel manifold and optimize them there with a Riemannian Adam that carries one scalar second moment per frame, caps its step by a trust region, and retracts polarly. Four propositions prove this update is steepest descent in the embedded metric, independent of gradient scale, well conditioned, and exactly $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariant, each certified numerically in \texttt{float64}. A fifth supplies the mechanism: weight decay has \emph{identically zero} Riemannian gradient on $\St(d,r)$, since $W = W I_r$ lies in the normal space, so the learned attention geometry survives the collapse cycles that decay drives through the rest of the model. On modular arithmetic grokking, a single run holds $97.0\%$ validation accuracy at epoch 20\,000 against the baseline's $61.1\%$---an unstable endpoint we report as evidence for the mechanism rather than as an effect size. On CIFAR-10 patches the same rule gains $\mathbf{+8.98}$\,pp over 12 paired starts ($t{=}60.6$, $12/12$), and the gap widens with data rather than eroding. The step rule earns this: a fixed-step Riemannian update is degree one in the gradient, so it moves $24$--$40\times$ less per step than an identically shaped AdamW matrix---its frames barely leave their initialization, and freezing them outright costs only $0.28$\,pp. An ablation credits the whole gain to making the step scale free, and nothing measurable to the projector or to equivariance. A negative result sharpens the account: gauge removal cannot motivate the method, because a direction along which the loss is invariant carries no gradient at all.
summary_zh: 注意力机制中的查询投影矩阵WQ与键投影矩阵WK几乎都采用欧几里得优化器训练，未对其几何特性施加任何约束。本文将二者约束在斯蒂费尔（Stiefel）流形上，采用黎曼Adam算法完成优化：该算法为每帧维护一个标量二阶矩，通过信赖域限制步长，并采用极 retraction 完成回退操作。本文提出4个命题，证明该更新规则是嵌入度量下的最陡下降，不受梯度尺度影响、具备良好条件数，且严格满足O(d)等变性，所有特性均通过float64数值验证。第5个命题揭示了其作用机制：权重衰减在斯蒂费尔流形St(d,r)上的黎曼梯度恒等于零，由于W=WIr位于法空间，因此注意力的学习几何特性可在权重衰减引发的模型其余部分的坍缩周期中保留下来。在模块化算术grokking任务中，单次运行在第20000轮的验证精度可达97.0%，而基线方法仅为61.1%，该不稳定结果作为机制的佐证而非效应值呈现。在CIFAR-10图像块任务上，该规则在12组配对初始设置下平均精度提升8.98个百分点（t=60.6，12组全部通过显著性检验），且性能差距随数据量增大而扩大，不会逐渐消失。该步长规则的核心优势在于：固定步长黎曼更新的梯度阶数为1，每步移动距离是同配置AdamW矩阵的1/24~1/40，其帧几乎不会偏离初始位置，直接将帧完全冻结也仅会损失0.28个百分点的精度。消融实验证明全部性能增益都来自步长的尺度无关特性，投影操作与等变性均未贡献可测量的性能提升。阴性结果进一步完善了结论：规范移除不能解释该方法的有效性，因为损失函数不变的方向上根本不存在梯度。

title: Smart Insole Human Activity Recognition for Continuous Monitoring in Elderly Care
title_zh: 面向养老场景连续监测的智能鞋垫人体活动识别
authors: Edwin Rios, Antony Garcia, Fengpei Yuan, Xinming Huang
abstract: Falls in older adults are often preceded by changes in mobility, balance, and postural transitions. This paper presents a wireless smart insole platform and machine-learning workflow for recognizing sitting, standing, walking, and unstable walking from plantar-pressure and inertial signals. Each insole integrates 16 active pressure-sensing locations and a six-dimensional IMU stream consisting of tri-axial acceleration and angular velocity. Data were collected from 15 healthy adults at 80~Hz and segmented into overlapping windows. Window length and candidate model families were first screened with stratified 10-fold cross-validation; the primary performance estimate was then obtained with participant-independent 5-fold Stratified Group cross-validation, ensuring that all windows from a participant remained in a single fold. Under this protocol, Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting (HGB) achieved macro-F1 scores of 0.954 and 0.959 for the left and right feet, respectively, and 0.980 with bilateral sensing. A compact 1D-CNN evaluated with the same participant-independent folds did not significantly outperform HGB ($p=0.0625$). The results show that low-profile footwear sensing can infer activity state from pressure and IMU measurements for participants unseen during training, establishing a basis for activity monitoring and fall prevention in elderly care.
summary_zh: 老年人跌倒前通常会出现移动能力、平衡状态与姿势转换的变化。本文研发了一套无线智能鞋垫平台与机器学习工作流，可基于足底压力信号与惯性信号识别坐、站、行走、不稳定行走四类状态。每只鞋垫集成16个主动压力传感位点，以及由三轴加速度、角速度构成的六维惯性测量单元（Inertial Measurement Unit, IMU）数据流。实验以80Hz采样率采集15名健康成年人的数据，将数据切分为重叠窗口。首先采用分层10折交叉验证筛选窗口长度与候选模型族，之后采用参与者独立的5折分层分组交叉验证获取核心性能估计值，保证同一参与者的所有窗口都划分至同一折中。在该实验协议下，基于直方图的梯度提升（Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting, HGB）方法在左脚、右脚数据上的宏F1值分别达到0.954与0.959，采用双侧传感时宏F1值可达0.980。在相同的参与者独立划分下评估的轻量一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）性能未显著优于HGB（p=0.0625）。实验结果表明，低剖面鞋载传感系统可基于压力与IMU测量值识别训练过程中未见过的参与者的活动状态，为养老场景下的活动监测与跌倒预防奠定了基础。

title: Learning Submanifolds for Subsequent Inference on Random Dot Product Graphs, Part 1: Theory
title_zh: 面向随机点积图后续推理的子流形学习 第1部分：理论
authors: Michael W. Trosset, Carey E. Priebe
abstract: We propose a framework for restricted inference on random dot product graphs whose latent positions lie on an unknown low-dimensional support manifold. For general decision problems, we propose semisupervised decision rules that use auxiliary data to learn the support manifold. Specifically, our rules use the Isomap manifold learning procedure to construct a low-dimensional Euclidean representation of the observed graph, in which space an isometrically invariant function maps configurations of points to actions. We study the behavior of the proposed rules as the quantity of auxiliary data sampled from the unknown support manifold increases. We show that, as the auxiliary sample size increases, the risk of the semisupervised rule converges to the risk of an oracle rule that relies on the maximal amount of low-dimensional Euclidean structure that can be extracted from the support manifold. Examples, applications, and simulation studies are deferred to a sequel.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一个针对随机点积图的受限推理框架，这类图的潜在位置位于未知的低维支撑流形上。针对通用决策问题，我们提出了利用辅助数据学习支撑流形的半监督决策规则。具体而言，该规则采用Isomap流形学习算法构建观测图的低维欧几里得表示，在该空间中通过等距不变函数将点的配置映射为动作。我们研究了当从未知支撑流形采样的辅助数据量增加时所提规则的性能表现，证明随着辅助样本量增大，半监督规则的风险会收敛到神谕规则的风险，后者依赖于可从支撑流形中提取的最大量低维欧几里得结构。相关示例、应用与仿真研究将在后续论文中展开。

title: Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes for Privacy-Preserving Modeling of Heterogeneous Distributed Systems
title_zh: 面向异构分布式系统隐私保护建模的个性化联邦分层高斯过程
authors: Xianjian Xie, Hao Yan
abstract: We present Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes (pFedHGP) for probabilistic regression and classification when data are distributed across heterogeneous clients. Each client's latent function decomposes into (i) a shared global component, (ii) a client-specific deviation that shares the global kernel structure, and (iii) a flexible local residual. Sparse inducing-variable approximations and federated variational inference keep raw data local while the server synchronizes only low-dimensional statistics for the shared component. Full predictive distributions support uncertainty-aware decisions. In application studies, pFedHGP attains perfect fault classification in press tonnage monitoring using 13.77% of labeled cycles and recovers geographic zones in federated air-quality modeling without centralizing station-level time series. An Instantaneous Linear Mixing Model viewpoint links the hierarchy to multi-output Gaussian processes for correlated sensors.
summary_zh: 本文提出个性化联邦分层高斯过程（Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes, pFedHGP），用于数据分布在异构客户端场景下的概率回归与分类任务。每个客户端的潜在函数可分解为三部分：(i) 共享全局分量，(ii) 共享全局核结构的客户端特定偏差，(iii) 灵活的局部残差。稀疏诱导变量近似与联邦变分推断保证原始数据保留在本地，服务器仅同步共享分量的低维统计量。完整的预测分布支持具备不确定性感知能力的决策。在应用研究中，pFedHGP仅使用13.77%的标注循环即可在压力吨位监测任务中实现完美故障分类，还可在联邦空气质量建模中恢复地理区域，无需将站点级时间序列集中化。瞬时线性混合模型视角将该分层结构与面向关联传感器的多输出高斯过程关联起来。

title: Learning-Induced Dynamical Transition in Recurrent Neural Networks
title_zh: 循环神经网络中的学习诱导动力学转变
authors: Varun Vaidya
abstract: Learning in recurrent neural networks can fundamentally reshape their underlying dynamics, transforming initially chaotic activity into stable task-dependent behavior. We develop a non-equilibrium dynamical mean-field theory(DMFT) to describe this transition during learning. We show that a slow feedback-driven learning process generates an evolving effective feedback strength that drives the network through a transition from chaotic to stable dynamics defined by a bifurcation of the DMFT solution. By deriving the two-time correlation function throughout learning, we identify a critical feedback strength and a corresponding learning rate dependent critical time separating these regimes. The transition arises from the progressive deformation of an effective dynamical landscape by the growing learned feedback structure. Starting from the untrained state, the theory predicts the time evolution of the network output during training and shows quantitative agreement with numerical simulations.
summary_zh: 循环神经网络中的学习过程可从根本上重塑其底层动力学，将初始的混沌活动转化为稳定的任务依赖行为。本文发展了非平衡动力学平均场理论（Dynamical Mean-Field Theory, DMFT）来描述学习过程中的这一转变。我们发现，由慢反馈驱动的学习过程会生成不断演化的有效反馈强度，驱动网络通过DMFT解的分岔定义的转变，从混沌动力学过渡到稳定动力学。通过推导学习全过程的双时间关联函数，我们确定了临界反馈强度以及对应的、依赖于学习率的临界时间点，用于划分两种动力学区域。该转变源于不断增长的学习反馈结构对有效动力学景观的逐步变形。从未训练状态出发，该理论可预测训练过程中网络输出的时间演化，且与数值仿真结果定量吻合。

title: Radio-Frequency Convolutional Neural Networks
title_zh: 射频卷积神经网络
authors: Zhihui Gao, Shi-Yuan Ma, Yiran Chen, Dirk Englund, Tingjun Chen
abstract: Running artificial intelligence (AI) models directly on edge devices such as smartphones, wearables, and drones offers low latency, pervasive scalability, and data privacy, but these devices rarely carry the computing capability that modern neural networks demand. Edge accelerators have been developed in response, yet each adds computing hardware to devices already constrained in size, weight, power, and cost (SWaP-C). An alternative lies in what these devices already carry: the frequency mixer in every wireless radio multiplies signals in time, natively performing convolution in the frequency domain. Here we introduce radio-frequency convolutional neural networks (RF-CNNs), which repurpose existing communication hardware for CNN inference. Multi-channel convolutions are mapped onto frequency tones for a passive mixer to execute in a single pass. We experimentally demonstrate that RF-CNN runs deep CNNs up to 26.4 million parameters and nine layers from classification of wireless signals and images to controllable image generation, close to full-precision performance. Because the weights arrive over the air and the analog hardware is shared with communication, the edge device spends energy only on data preparation and readout-down to 0.72 femtojoules per multiply-accumulate, two orders of magnitude less than it would cost on an added digital processor. These results suggest that deployed wireless infrastructure can bring efficient, state-of-the-art AI inference to the billions of devices it already connects.
summary_zh: 在智能手机、可穿戴设备、无人机等边缘设备上直接运行人工智能模型具备低延迟、普适可扩展性与数据隐私优势，但这类设备通常不具备现代神经网络所需的计算能力。为应对该问题学界已开发出边缘加速器，但这类设备本身在尺寸、重量、功耗与成本（Size, Weight, Power, and Cost, SWaP-C）方面已受约束，额外加装加速器会进一步增加计算硬件负担。另一种可行方案复用设备已有硬件：每台无线无线电中的混频器可在时域对信号做乘法运算，天然实现频域卷积。本文提出射频卷积神经网络（Radio-Frequency Convolutional Neural Networks, RF-CNNs），复用现有通信硬件实现卷积神经网络推理。多通道卷积被映射到频率音调上，由无源混频器单次执行完成。实验证明RF-CNN可运行参数量最高达2640万、共9层的深度卷积神经网络，覆盖无线信号分类、图像分类到可控图像生成任务，性能接近全精度模型。由于权重通过空中传输，且模拟硬件与通信模块共享，边缘设备仅需为数据准备和读出操作消耗能量，每次乘累加运算能耗低至0.72飞焦，比加装额外数字处理器的成本低两个数量级。上述结果表明，已部署的无线基础设施可为其已连接的数十亿设备带来高效的前沿人工智能推理能力。

title: Block Parallelism For Efficient Distributed Long-Context Diffusion Language Model Training
title_zh: 面向高效分布式长上下文扩散语言模型训练的块并行方法
authors: Tarun Suresh, Pranshu Chaturvedi, Hangoo Kang, Parth Shroff, Ishan S. Khare, Hermann Kumbong, Azalia Mirhoseini
abstract: Block diffusion language models (BDLMs) combine autoregressive dependencies across blocks with parallel denoising within blocks, but long-context training is constrained by distributed attention communication and activation memory. Conventional context parallelism (CP) shards the combined clean-plus-corrupted sequence by position, communicating shared clean K/V together with block-specific corrupted K/V and their gradients. We observe that the BDLM objective separates over target blocks. We introduce block parallelism (BP), a new distributed parallelism dimension that assigns each corrupted-block computation to one rank. To scale BP to long contexts, we introduce context-sharded block parallelism (CSBP), which also shards the shared clean sequence across those ranks. CSBP keeps corrupted K/V and gradients local, avoids replicated clean prefixes, and preserves BDLM training semantics. On 16 H200 GPUs at 256K context, CSBP improves throughput over the best baseline by 1.18-1.45x for supervised fine-tuning and 1.27-1.33x for conversion of autoregressive models to BDLMs, while matching or reducing peak HBM. Full-model speedup reaches 1.61x at 512K. On eight H100 GPUs, CSBP accelerates DFlash2 speculative-decoder training by 2.48x at 512K and 7.59x at 1M. In matched 12-hour DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT runs, CSBP achieves higher pass rates at every trained checkpoint on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench Lite. Code: https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM
summary_zh: 块扩散语言模型（Block Diffusion Language Models, BDLMs）结合了跨块的自回归依赖与块内的并行去噪，但长上下文训练受分布式注意力通信与激活内存约束限制。传统上下文并行（Context Parallelism, CP）按位置拆分干净序列与损坏序列的组合序列，需要同步传输共享干净K/V、块特定损坏K/V及其梯度。我们观察到BDLM的目标函数可按目标块解耦，据此提出块并行（Block Parallelism, BP）这一全新分布式并行维度，将每个损坏块的计算分配给一个进程。为将块并行扩展到长上下文场景，进一步提出上下文分片块并行（Context-Sharded Block Parallelism, CSBP），该方法同时在各进程间分片共享干净序列。CSBP可保证损坏K/V与梯度保留在本地，避免复制干净前缀，同时完全保留BDLM的训练语义。在搭载16张H200 GPU、上下文长度为256K的环境下，CSBP在监督微调任务上的吞吐量比最优基线高1.18-1.45倍，在自回归模型转BDLM任务上的吞吐量高1.27-1.33倍，同时峰值高带宽内存占用与基线持平或更低。在上下文长度512K时全模型加速比可达1.61倍。在8张H100 GPU环境下，CSBP在上下文长度512K时可将DFlash2投机解码器训练速度提升2.48倍，在上下文长度1M时提升7.59倍。在时长12小时的DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B监督微调对比实验中，CSBP在SWE-bench Verified与Terminal-Bench Lite的所有训练检查点上均取得了更高的通过率。代码开源地址：https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM

title: Generative Query Suggestion via Intent Coverage and Query-Level Credit Assignment
title_zh: 基于意图覆盖与查询级信用分配的生成式查询推荐
authors: Xinpeng Liu, Lu Ma, Jiayi Qiao, Mengyu Zhou, Linglong Li, Xiaofeng Bian, Haonan Chen, Xiaoxi Jiang, Guanjun Jiang
abstract: Generative query suggestion aims to enhance user engagement by anticipating user intents and recommending relevant follow-up queries. A central challenge is to generate slates whose individual queries are useful while the slate covers distinct intents. We propose an Intent-Driven Query Suggestion Framework with dual-stage optimization. First, intent-aware diversity modeling constructs intent-aligned supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data and uses an Intent-Aware Diversity Reward to optimize intent coverage. Second, query-level credit assignment routes individual quality signals to the corresponding query tokens while sharing a slate-level diversity signal across the slate. Experiments on a large-scale production dataset, including online A/B testing and offline evaluation, show improvements in click-through rate, query quality, and intent coverage.
summary_zh: 生成式查询推荐旨在通过预判用户意图、推荐相关后续查询提升用户参与度，其核心挑战在于生成的查询集合中单个查询具备实用性的同时，整个集合可覆盖不同的用户意图。本文提出一种双阶段优化的意图驱动查询推荐框架：第一阶段通过意图感知多样性建模构建与意图对齐的监督微调数据，使用意图感知多样性奖励优化意图覆盖度；第二阶段通过查询级信用分配将单个质量信号路由到对应查询的token，同时在整个查询集合内共享集合级多样性信号。在大规模生产数据集上开展的在线A/B测试与离线评估实验表明，该方法在点击率、查询质量与意图覆盖度三个指标上均有提升。

title: Federated Soft Clustering via Generalized Total Variation Minimization
title_zh: 基于广义全变分最小化的联邦软聚类
authors: Shamsiiat Abdurakhmanova, Alexander Jung
abstract: We study federated soft clustering over federated learning (FL) networks of devices that each hold a private local dataset and fit a personalized Gaussian mixture model (GMM). Generalized total variation minimization (GTVMin) couples the local maximum likelihood problems through a graph regularizer that penalizes a discrepancy between the models of connected nodes. The choice of discrepancy measure is a key design decision: we compare a squared Euclidean distance between model parameters, which requires component matching, with two measures that compare the local model distributions directly and hence need no matching: a Monte-Carlo approximated Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and a closed-form maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). All three resulting GTVMin instances are optimized by synchronous projected gradient updates; for the smooth MMD instance we provide a convergence guarantee to stationary points. We characterize their computational cost and evaluate their robustness to data heterogeneity.
summary_zh: 本文研究联邦学习网络下的联邦软聚类问题，网络中的每个设备持有私有本地数据集，拟合个性化高斯混合模型（Gaussian Mixture Model, GMM）。广义全变分最小化（Generalized Total Variation Minimization, GTVMin）通过图正则器耦合本地最大似然问题，该正则器对相连节点模型之间的差异施加惩罚。差异度量的选择是核心设计决策：我们对比了需要做分量匹配的模型参数间平方欧氏距离，以及两种无需匹配、直接对比本地模型分布的度量方法：蒙特卡洛近似的库尔贝克-莱布尼茨（Kullback-Leibler, KL）散度与闭式最大均值差异（Maximum Mean Discrepancy, MMD）。所有三种GTVMin实例均通过同步投影梯度更新优化，针对平滑MMD实例我们证明了其收敛到驻点的保证。本文刻画了三种方法的计算成本，并评估了它们对数据异质性的鲁棒性。

title: Advantage Scale Calibration Imbalance in Group-Relative Optimization under Low-Variance Rewards: Diagnosis and Bounded Recovery
title_zh: 低方差奖励下组相对优化中的优势尺度校准失衡：问题诊断与有界恢复
authors: Fei Ding
abstract: In verifier-style RLVR, group-relative optimization often treats advantage scale as an implementation detail. This paper separates two low-variance cases: sub-resolution jitter that should not become a preference signal, and credible but small cardinal gaps that should be learned without distorting KL calibration. We propose an advantage-scale three-way calibration interface: the same within-group scale denominator simultaneously determines the reward-branch strength, prompt-level batch weight, and the effective KL calibration induced when the reward branch is re-expressed on the original cardinal scale. This interface explains why RLOO / Dr.GRPO can let credible small gaps become KL dominated, whereas GRPO's standard-deviation denominator can amplify tiny gaps without bound. Based on this interface, we further introduce the Reward-Resolution Protocol and MaxNorm-AC, respectively filtering sub-resolution gaps and providing bounded cardinal recovery on credible nonzero gaps. Across dense / MoE architectures and math / code reasoning, MaxNorm-AC improves over the strongest robust-scale baseline while truncating the low-variance inverse-scale tail.
summary_zh: 在验证器风格的RLVR任务中，组相对优化通常将优势尺度视为实现细节。本文区分了两种低方差场景：不应成为偏好信号的亚分辨率抖动，以及不应在扭曲KL校准的前提下被学习的可信小基数间隙。我们提出优势尺度三向校准接口：同一组内尺度分母可同时确定奖励分支强度、提示级批次权重，以及奖励分支在原始基数尺度上重新表达时诱导的有效KL校准。该接口解释了RLOO/Dr.GRPO会让可信小间隙被KL主导，而GRPO的标准差分母会无限制放大微小间隙的原因。基于该接口，我们进一步提出奖励分辨率协议与MaxNorm-AC方法，分别实现亚分辨率间隙过滤，以及对可信非零间隙的有界基数恢复。在稠密/混合专家架构、数学/代码推理任务上，MaxNorm-AC在截断低方差逆尺度尾部的同时，性能优于最优的鲁棒尺度基线。

title: VisKG-LM: Compiling Knowledge Graphs into Visual Memory for Multiple-Choice Question Answering
title_zh: VisKG-LM：将知识图谱编译为视觉内存以实现多项选择问答
authors: Yixin Peng, Er Jin, Shiwei Luo, Diego Collarana, Stefan Decker
abstract: Knowledge graphs are usually integrated into question answering by encoding a retrieved subgraph with a graph neural network and fusing it with the language model in the online inference path. The same subgraph is therefore re-encoded from scratch every time a pair is scored, across training epochs, seeds, and evaluation runs, even though the knowledge graph never changes. We ask whether the retrieved knowledge graphs can instead be compiled once, offline, and then accessed as read-only memory. VisKG-LM shows that it can, by decoupling graph encoding from language reasoning. It serializes each retrieved candidate-specific subgraph as Relation-Labeled Paths and renders the result as an image whose two-dimensional layout preserves the branching structure of the paths. Each image is encoded once, offline, and cached for reuse. At inference, the language model contextualizes the question and candidate from text alone, and only its final layer consults the cached visual memory, reading both its global layout and its local relational detail. The graph information thus enters only after the text has been understood. On the test sets of CommonsenseQA, OpenBookQA, and MedQA-USMLE, VisKG-LMimproves over GreaseLM by $1.2$, $0.8$, and $4.3$ points, respectively, while matching or surpassing GraphVis, a $7$B vision-language model, with only about $400$M online parameters. Against a matched text-only control that receives the identical Relation-Labeled Paths, it gains $4.2$, $6.5$, and $5.1$ points across the three benchmarks. These gains show that the complete visual-memory interface adds value beyond path textualization alone and support compiled visual memory as an alternative to online graph propagation.
summary_zh: 现有方法通常通过图神经网络编码检索到的子图，再在在线推理路径中将其与语言模型融合，实现知识图谱与问答任务的集成。这类方法在训练轮次、随机种子与评估运行过程中，每次对问答对打分都需要从头重新编码同一子图，即便知识图谱本身从未发生变化。本文研究是否可以离线一次性编译检索到的知识图谱，之后将其作为只读内存访问。VisKG-LM通过将图编码与语言推理解耦实现了该思路：它将每个检索到的候选特定子图序列化为带关系标签的路径，再将结果渲染为图像，其二维布局保留了路径的分支结构。每张图像仅需离线编码一次，缓存后即可复用。推理阶段，语言模型仅从文本中获取问题与候选的上下文表示，仅在最后一层访问缓存的视觉内存，读取其全局布局与局部关系细节，确保图信息在文本内容被充分理解之后才进入模型。在CommonsenseQA、OpenBookQA与MedQA-USMLE测试集上，VisKG-LM的性能分别比GreaseLM高1.2、0.8与4.3个点，且仅使用约4亿个在线参数，性能与7B规模的视觉语言模型GraphVis持平甚至更优。与接收完全相同带关系标签路径的纯文本对照模型相比，VisKG-LM在三个基准上分别获得4.2、6.5与5.1个点的性能提升。该结果表明完整的视觉内存接口比仅将路径文本化具备额外价值，证明编译型视觉内存可作为在线图传播的替代方案。

title: Stop Removing Stopwords: How an Inherited Preprocessing Default Distorts Legal Text-as-Data
title_zh: 停止移除停用词：继承的预处理默认值如何扭曲法律文本数据
authors: Gregory M. Dickinson
abstract: Empirical legal scholarship increasingly treats judicial text as data, and much of it still runs on sparse, interpretable pipelines -- TF-IDF features and linear classifiers -- because the textual feature is often the object of study, not merely a means to a prediction. Yet these pipelines inherit a chain of preprocessing defaults from mid-century information retrieval that were never validated against classification accuracy, the most entrenched being stopword removal. This study introduces an exhaustive single-word ablation that measures a preprocessing step's effect directly against the downstream objective, and applies it to stopword removal as the hardest case to dislodge. Matching Supreme Court Database labels to Caselaw Access Project opinion texts, it examines two binary tasks that bracket F1 headroom, ideological direction (no-removal baseline F1 ~ 0.68) and constitutional versus non-constitutional law type (~ 0.92), across 7,668 and 7,001 opinions. For each task the analysis approximates the best stoplist any expert could build, removing each of roughly 18,500 candidate words and measuring the effect directly. Three findings follow: generic stoplists in common use fall below the no-removal baseline in every test; even optimized stoplists are statistically indistinguishable from removing nothing; and meta-models trained on word-level features cannot predict which removals help, so list curation has nothing to target. The method generalizes to any inherited preprocessing default, and the result is a caution specific to interpretable legal text-as-data: a step that silently reshapes which features a model sees can distort the very doctrinal and ideological signal such research exists to recover. Leaving stopwords in place is a question of measurement validity.
summary_zh: 实证法律研究越来越多地将司法文本作为数据处理，其中大量研究仍采用稀疏、可解释的流水线：TF-IDF特征与线性分类器，因为文本特征本身往往是研究对象，而非仅用于预测的手段。但这类流水线继承了20世纪中期信息检索领域的一系列预处理默认值，这些默认值从未针对分类准确率做过验证，其中最根深蒂固的就是停用词移除操作。本研究提出一种穷尽式单词消融方法，可直接衡量预处理步骤对下游目标的影响，并将其应用于最难推翻的停用词移除场景。通过将最高法院数据库标签与判例访问项目的裁判文书文本匹配，我们在7668份与7001份裁判文书上分别测试了两个覆盖F1值上下限的二分类任务：意识形态倾向分类（不移除停用词基线F1约为0.68）与宪法类/非宪法类法律类型分类（基线F1约为0.92）。针对每个任务，我们近似构建了任何专家都能得到的最优停用词表，逐个移除约18500个候选词并直接测量其影响。研究得到三点结论：常用的通用停用词表在所有测试场景下的性能都低于不移除停用词的基线；即便经过优化的停用词表，其性能与完全不移除停用词的结果在统计上也无显著差异；基于词级特征训练的元模型无法预测哪些词的移除会带来性能提升，因此停用词表优化没有明确目标。该方法可推广到任何继承得到的预处理默认值，研究结果为可解释法律文本数据研究提供了警示：会悄无声息改变模型可见特征的预处理步骤，可能扭曲这类研究旨在恢复的教义与意识形态信号。保留停用词是保障测量有效性的必要举措。

title: Sampling Reveals Style: Unsupervised, Training-Free Discovery of Prompt-Conditional Stylistic Axes in LLM Activations
title_zh: 采样揭示风格：大语言模型激活中提示条件化风格轴的无监督、免训练发现方法
authors: Ajit Mallavarapu, Ziwei Gu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode rich stylistic structure in their hidden activations, but discovering which stylistic dimensions are salient for a given prompt typically requires supervised contrastive data. We present a training-free, prompt-conditional alternative: we repeatedly sample completions of a single prompt at elevated temperature, apply Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to the pooled hidden activations, and label the resulting axes automatically from the pole generations. We validate the discovered axes against 245 human-elicited stylistic annotations in a two-phase study. On our strongest model (Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct), the top two axes match spontaneously requested human dimensions with 72.8% precision and 43.6% macro-recall, and 75.6% of validity ratings judge the axes' polar generations accurate to their labels, with 90.9% adjacent inter-annotator agreement. Discoverability is strongly model-dependent: both Qwen models and Llama-3.2-3B expose human-salient axes, while DeepSeek-7B-Chat drops to 35.3% precision, its leading components dominated by structural rather than stylistic variance. Simple PCA over a model's own decoding variance is thus an effective, low-cost probe of stylistic structure in LLM representations, one that also exposes sharp cross-model differences in how that structure is organized.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在其隐藏激活中编码了丰富的风格结构，但要发现给定提示下哪些风格维度是显著的，通常需要有监督对比数据。本文提出了一种免训练的、提示条件化的替代方案：我们在较高温度下重复采样单个提示的补全结果，对池化后的隐藏激活应用主成分分析（PCA），并根据极点生成结果自动标记得到的轴。我们通过两阶段研究，基于245个人工标注的风格注释对发现的轴进行了验证。在性能最优的模型Qwen-3.5-4B-Instruct上，前两个轴与用户自发提出的风格维度匹配精度达72.8%，宏召回率达43.6%；75.6%的有效性评分认为轴的极点生成结果与其标签准确对应，相邻标注者间一致性达90.9%。风格轴的可发现性高度依赖于模型：Qwen系列模型和Llama-3.2-3B都能暴露人类可感知的风格轴，而DeepSeek-7B-Chat的精度降至35.3%，其主成分由结构方差而非风格方差主导。由此可见，对模型自身解码方差执行简单的PCA是一种高效、低成本的探测LLM表征中风格结构的方法，同时也能揭示不同模型在风格组织结构上的显著差异。

title: Subliminal Prompting Beyond Static Geometry: Causal Depth and Multi-Token Confounds
title_zh: 超越静态几何的阈下提示：因果深度与多令牌混淆因素
authors: Barath Velmurugan
abstract: Subliminal learning shows that language models can transmit a hidden trait through outputs that appear unrelated to it. One proposed explanation, token entanglement, links animal and number tokens through the model's output vocabulary. Yet existing measurements answer different questions: whether outputs co-vary, fixed output vectors align, an answer can be read from a hidden state, or that state causally controls the answer. We measure each separately in a fixed animal-number prompting protocol. From Llama-3.1-8B to 70B, fixed output-vector similarity predicts behavior less well: the paired mean correlation change is -0.080 (95% CI [-0.127, -0.035]). A fixed output-head readout shows no resolved change in normalized depth AUC. To test control, we copy the temporary answer-position state from one number prompt into another at five depths and measure which prompt the final animal score follows. Donor-control AUC rises from 0.254 to 0.540, a paired change of +0.286 (95% CI [+0.272, +0.300]), with increases for all 18 concepts. The contrast remains with exactly eight transformer blocks remaining, while specificity and identity controls remain small or exact. In two Qwen models, scoring every digit in sequence does not recover the positive one-token association. Per-token averaging instead creates a positive pooled association that disappears after controlling number width, revealing a length confound. Thus, fixed geometry, observational readability, causal timing, and multi-token measurement are distinct properties of this frozen prompting channel. They constrain token-level explanations but do not identify the mechanism of training-time trait transfer.
summary_zh: 阈下学习表明，语言模型可以通过看似与隐藏特征无关的输出传递该特征。一种被称为令牌纠缠的解释认为，动物令牌和数字令牌通过模型的输出词汇表建立关联。但现有测量方法回答的是不同的问题：输出是否共变、固定输出向量是否对齐、是否能从隐藏状态读出答案，或者该状态是否因果性地控制答案。我们在固定动物-数字提示协议中分别对上述特性进行了测量。从Llama-3.1-8B到70B，固定输出向量相似度对行为的预测能力逐渐下降：配对平均相关系数变化为-0.080（95%置信区间[-0.127, -0.035]）。固定输出头读出结果显示归一化深度AUC没有明确变化。为了测试控制关系，我们将某一数字提示的临时答案位置状态在5个不同深度复制到另一个提示中，测量最终的动物得分会跟随哪一个提示。供体控制AUC从0.254上升到0.540，配对变化为+0.286（95%置信区间[+0.272, +0.300]），全部18个概念均出现该增长。当剩余恰好8个Transformer块时，该对比效应仍然存在，而特异性和身份控制的影响仍然很小或完全不存在。在两个Qwen模型中，按顺序对每个数字打分无法恢复正向的单令牌关联。按令牌取平均反而会生成正向的池化关联，该关联在控制数字长度后消失，说明存在长度混淆因素。因此，静态几何、观测可读性、因果时序和多令牌测量是该冻结提示通道的不同属性。这些属性约束了令牌层面的解释，但仍无法确定训练阶段特征迁移的具体机制。

title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
title_zh: 统一在线话语中的群体间敌意模型
authors: Patrick Gerard, Julia Mendelsohn, Kristina Lerman
abstract: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.
summary_zh: 针对社会群体的敌意修辞会将排斥行为正常化、为不公待遇辩护，还会加剧两极分化和政治暴力。在线言论中的敌意修辞治理工作借鉴了社会心理学、道德心理学和政治学的基础理论，但这些理论大多是并行发展的，对敌意生成机制的解释往往存在差异甚至相互矛盾，且很少在真实话语场景下进行相互对比验证。这导致学界对敌意的修辞机制缺乏系统性理解，无法明确其在真实话语中的表现形式和相互关联。本研究使用2024年美国总统大选期间来自TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X平台的286万条帖子，在统一的实证框架下对群体间敌意的6种基础理论机制（边界构建、威胁构建、替罪羊化、负面评价、非人化和行动导向）进行建模，还原群体间敌意修辞的整体组织结构。研究发现，从结构上看，边界构建和威胁构建是整个系统的锚点；从时间顺序上看，这些机制遵循固定的出现顺序：边界构建、贬损和行动导向往往较早出现，非人化和威胁构建出现较晚，替罪羊化最后出现。绘制这些理论框架在话语中的实际表现形式，能够打破社会科学不同研究传统之间长期存在的壁垒，为计算社会科学提供更清晰的实证基础，支撑超越单标签检测的群体间敌意修辞建模工作。

title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
title_zh: JEPA-Anything：跨不同世界学习预测模型
authors: Taoyong Cui, Zhongyao Wang, Xinyue Xu, Weiyang Liu, Zhaochen Yu, Yuying Zhang, Qiang Gao, Mengyue Yang, Wanli Ouyang, Pheng Ann Heng, Yingcheng Wu, Zhenfei Yin, Ling Yang
abstract: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything
summary_zh: 世界建模能够让智能体预判行为后果、指导干预决策，并通过交互完成学习。但现有预测模型仍局限于特定领域：是否存在一种通用学习原则，能够支撑跨完全不同系统的世界建模？本文提出JEPA-Anything，这是一种基于正交预测因子分解（OPF）的领域无关框架。作为联合嵌入预测架构的扩展，OPF将潜在目标分解为互补因子，通过专用路径学习各因子，并在统一的预测设计中对其进行重组。我们在7个领域对JEPA-Anything进行了评估：视觉、生物学、临床轨迹、控制任务、分子动力学、物理场和气象。实验覆盖表征学习、干预预测、分布外泛化和长程动力学任务，包含10组匹配动力学任务、超过1000次临床事件预测，以及4个系统的100步分子推演。与匹配的JEPA基线相比，JEPA-Anything在全部10项动力学任务上的指标均有提升，在Interventional Pong任务上的单干预预测误差降低了34.8%；在所有4个系统的对比方法中，其一步和100步分子预测误差均为最低。除预测任务外，由因子提名的生物干预方案在细胞共培养、患者来源类器官、肿瘤碎片和小鼠实验中得到了验证；潜在轨道模式还原出的开普勒标度指数拟合斜率为-1.4991。这些结果证明跨异构世界存在通用的因子化预测原则，将世界建模与干预决策、实验驱动的科学发现关联起来。代码开源地址：https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
title_zh: 按需注意力：语言模型可自主判断何时调用回溯
authors: Haibo Feng, Ruiqi Liang, Hanyang Peng, Shiqi Yu
abstract: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.
summary_zh: 推理和智能体工作负载对高效长上下文推理的需求日益增长，但全注意力解码在每一步都需要读取不断增长的历史内容，无论该内容对下一次预测是否有增益。本文研究发现，预训练模型的解码状态在执行全局读取之前就已经包含了可预测该增益的信息。基于这一发现，我们提出按需注意力（ODA），这是一种以局部注意力为核心的解码方法，通过轻量级的回溯头，在生成过程中根据预测的增益变化选择性调用全局注意力。ODA仅训练回溯头，预训练权重保持不变，且完整的历史KV缓存可用于后续回溯。我们进一步在vLLM中实现了GPU端的条件执行，将全局读取量的降低转化为长上下文场景下相对于全注意力解码的实际速度提升。在Qwen和Gemma系列模型（包含混合注意力骨干网络）上的实验表明，选择性回溯能够恢复局部注意力下损失的大部分性能，同时大幅减少全局读取量。这些发现为长上下文推理提供了新的思路：预训练模型可以自主引导对其保留信息的访问过程。

title: Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol
title_zh: 摘要偏差：大语言模型中客观投影向告知模式标签的方向性坍缩——一个概念框架与预注册测试方案
authors: Levent Bulut
abstract: This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.
summary_zh: 本报告并未声称该偏差已得到验证，仅定义了该概念的内涵，将其置于大语言模型即评判者的偏差体系下进行定位，对已完成的独立可靠性研究进行重新解读，得到与该概念一致的方向性证据，并预注册了包含决策规则的双机制测试方案，若测试结果不符合预期则将放弃该概念的相关假设。

title: HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication
title_zh: HerHealthEval：面向女性健康沟通的多语言与语域敏感理解能力评估
